--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
    JOIN pg_extension AS ext
    ON ev.objid = ext.oid
    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_cron'
  )
  THEN
    grant usage on schema cron to postgres with grant option;

    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option;

    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on sequences to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on tables to postgres with grant option;
    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all
        on functions to postgres with grant option;

    grant all privileges on all tables in schema cron to postgres with grant option;
    revoke all on table cron.job from postgres;
    grant select on table cron.job to postgres with grant option;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 899 (class 1255 OID 16568)
-- Name: grant_pg_graphql_access(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $_$
DECLARE
    func_is_graphql_resolve bool;
BEGIN
    func_is_graphql_resolve = (
        SELECT n.proname = 'resolve'
        FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
        LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS n
        ON ev.objid = n.oid
    );

    IF func_is_graphql_resolve
    THEN
        -- Update public wrapper to pass all arguments through to the pg_graphql resolve func
        DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS graphql_public.graphql;
        create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(
            "operationName" text default null,
            query text default null,
            variables jsonb default null,
            extensions jsonb default null
        )
            returns jsonb
            language sql
        as $$
            select graphql.resolve(
                query := query,
                variables := coalesce(variables, '{}'),
                "operationName" := "operationName",
                extensions := extensions
            );
        $$;

        -- This hook executes when `graphql.resolve` is created. That is not necessarily the last
        -- function in the extension so we need to grant permissions on existing entities AND
        -- update default permissions to any others that are created after `graphql.resolve`
        grant usage on schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        grant select on all tables in schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        grant execute on all functions in schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        grant all on all sequences in schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        alter default privileges in schema graphql grant all on tables to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        alter default privileges in schema graphql grant all on functions to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
        alter default privileges in schema graphql grant all on sequences to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;

        -- Allow postgres role to allow granting usage on graphql and graphql_public schemas to custom roles
        grant usage on schema graphql_public to postgres with grant option;
        grant usage on schema graphql to postgres with grant option;
    END IF;

END;
$_$;

-- TOC entry 669 (class 1255 OID 16549)
-- Name: grant_pg_net_access(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_net_access() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev
    JOIN pg_extension AS ext
    ON ev.objid = ext.oid
    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_net'
  )
  THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_roles
      WHERE rolname = 'supabase_functions_admin'
    )
    THEN
      CREATE USER supabase_functions_admin NOINHERIT CREATEROLE LOGIN NOREPLICATION;
    END IF;

    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA net TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;

    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT FROM pg_extension
      WHERE extname = 'pg_net'
      -- all versions in use on existing projects as of 2025-02-20
      -- version 0.12.0 onwards don't need these applied
      AND extversion IN ('0.2', '0.6', '0.7', '0.7.1', '0.8', '0.10.0', '0.11.0')
    ) THEN
      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;
      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;

      ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;
      ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;

      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;
      REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;

      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
      GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

-- TOC entry 931 (class 1255 OID 16559)
-- Name: pgrst_ddl_watch(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $$;


--
-- TOC entry 916 (class 1255 OID 16560)
-- Name: pgrst_drop_watch(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
DECLARE
  obj record;
BEGIN
  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()
  LOOP
    IF obj.object_type IN (
      'schema'
    , 'table'
    , 'foreign table'
    , 'view'
    , 'materialized view'
    , 'function'
    , 'trigger'
    , 'type'
    , 'rule'
    )
    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $$;

-- TOC entry 893 (class 1255 OID 16570)
-- Name: set_graphql_placeholder(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: extensions; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION extensions.set_graphql_placeholder() RETURNS event_trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $_$
    DECLARE
    graphql_is_dropped bool;
    BEGIN
    graphql_is_dropped = (
        SELECT ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'
        FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() AS ev
        WHERE ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'
    );

    IF graphql_is_dropped
    THEN
        create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(
            "operationName" text default null,
            query text default null,
            variables jsonb default null,
            extensions jsonb default null
        )
            returns jsonb
            language plpgsql
        as $$
            DECLARE
                server_version float;
            BEGIN
                server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float);

                IF server_version >= 14 THEN
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                ELSE
                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(
                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.'
                            )
                        )
                    );
                END IF;
            END;
        $$;
    END IF;

    END;
$_$;

-- TOC entry 757 (class 1255 OID 16387)
-- Name: get_auth(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: pgbouncer; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION pgbouncer.get_auth(p_usename text) RETURNS TABLE(username text, password text)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO ''
    AS $_$
  BEGIN
      RAISE DEBUG 'PgBouncer auth request: %', p_usename;

      RETURN QUERY
      SELECT
          rolname::text,
          CASE WHEN rolvaliduntil < now()
              THEN null
              ELSE rolpassword::text
          END
      FROM pg_authid
      WHERE rolname=$1 and rolcanlogin;
  END;
  $_$;

-- TOC entry 694 (class 1255 OID 103367)
-- Name: activate_costing_master_revision(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.activate_costing_master_revision(p_revision_id uuid, p_updated_by text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_costing_type text;
begin
  select costing_type
    into v_costing_type
    from public.costing_master_revisions
   where id = p_revision_id
   limit 1;

  if v_costing_type is null then
    raise exception 'Costing master revision not found';
  end if;

  update public.costing_master_revisions
     set is_current = false,
         status = case when status = 'ACTIVE' then 'ARCHIVED' else status end,
         updated_by = coalesce(p_updated_by, updated_by),
         updated_at = now()
   where costing_type = v_costing_type
     and id <> p_revision_id
     and is_current = true;

  update public.costing_master_revisions
     set is_current = true,
         status = 'ACTIVE',
         effective_from = coalesce(effective_from, now()),
         updated_by = coalesce(p_updated_by, updated_by),
         updated_at = now()
   where id = p_revision_id;

  return p_revision_id;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 706 (class 1255 OID 74087)
-- Name: activate_item_bom_revision(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.activate_item_bom_revision(p_revision_id uuid, p_approved_by text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_target public.item_bom_revisions%rowtype;
begin
  select *
    into v_target
    from public.item_bom_revisions
   where id = p_revision_id
   limit 1;

  if v_target.id is null then
    raise exception 'BOM revision not found: %', p_revision_id;
  end if;

  update public.item_bom_revisions
     set is_current = false,
         status = case when id = p_revision_id then status else 'ARCHIVED' end,
         archived_at = case when id = p_revision_id then archived_at else now() end,
         archived_by = case when id = p_revision_id then archived_by else p_approved_by end,
         updated_by = p_approved_by
   where item_code = v_target.item_code
     and is_current = true
     and id <> p_revision_id;

  update public.item_bom_revisions
     set is_current = true,
         status = 'ACTIVE',
         effective_from = coalesce(effective_from, now()),
         approved_at = now(),
         approved_by = p_approved_by,
         updated_by = p_approved_by
   where id = p_revision_id;

  update public.items
     set manufacturing_enabled = true,
         revision_controlled = true,
         bom_basis = 'PER_UNIT',
         current_revision_no = v_target.revision_no,
         item_lifecycle_status = case
           when active = false then 'INACTIVE'
           else 'ACTIVE'
         end
   where item_code = v_target.item_code;

  return p_revision_id;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 868 (class 1255 OID 231330)
-- Name: align_legacy_issued_kraft_reel(uuid, uuid, numeric, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.align_legacy_issued_kraft_reel(p_request_id uuid, p_issue_ledger_id uuid, p_issue_qty_kg numeric, p_note text, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $_$
declare
  v_request public.inv_legacy_reel_alignment_requests%rowtype;
  v_item public.inv_items%rowtype;
  v_wo public.work_orders%rowtype;
  v_issue public.inv_ledger%rowtype;
  v_existing public.inv_legacy_reel_alignments%rowtype;
  v_lot_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_cycle_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_reel_no text;
  v_qty numeric := coalesce(p_issue_qty_kg, 0);
  v_used_qty numeric := 0;
  v_pending_consumption numeric := 0;
  v_note text := trim(coalesce(p_note, ''));
begin
  select * into v_request
  from public.inv_legacy_reel_alignment_requests
  where id = p_request_id
  for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'Legacy reel alignment request was not found'; end if;

  if v_request.status = 'ALIGNED' then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true, 'duplicate', true, 'reelNo', v_request.internal_reel_no,
      'lotId', v_request.aligned_lot_id, 'issueCycleId', v_request.aligned_issue_cycle_id
    );
  end if;
  if v_request.status <> 'PENDING' then
    raise exception 'Legacy reel alignment request is not pending';
  end if;
  if v_note = '' then raise exception 'Stores reconciliation note is required'; end if;
  if v_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'Original issued gross weight must be greater than zero'; end if;

  v_reel_no := upper(trim(v_request.internal_reel_no));
  if v_reel_no !~ '^KR-[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*$' or length(v_reel_no) > 34 then
    raise exception 'Internal reel number % is not a valid KR- reel number', v_reel_no;
  end if;

  select * into v_existing
  from public.inv_legacy_reel_alignments
  where internal_reel_no = v_reel_no;

  if found then
    if v_existing.wo_id <> v_request.wo_id or v_existing.item_id <> v_request.item_id then
      raise exception 'Reel % is already aligned to a different item or work order', v_reel_no;
    end if;
    v_lot_id := v_existing.lot_id;
    v_cycle_id := v_existing.issue_cycle_id;
  else
    if exists (select 1 from public.inv_lots where upper(trim(batch_no)) = v_reel_no) then
      raise exception 'Batch/reel number % already exists and must be reviewed before legacy alignment', v_reel_no;
    end if;

    select * into v_item from public.inv_items where id = v_request.item_id for share;
    if not found then raise exception 'Kraft item was not found'; end if;
    if v_item.reel_tracking_enabled is not true
       or upper(trim(coalesce(v_item.category, ''))) <> 'KRAFT PAPER'
       or upper(trim(coalesce(v_item.uom, ''))) <> 'KG' then
      raise exception 'Legacy reel alignment is allowed only for reel-tracked Kraft Paper items in KG';
    end if;
    if coalesce(v_request.requested_width_mm, 0) <= 0
       or coalesce(v_request.requested_gsm, 0) <= 0 then
      raise exception 'The pending legacy reel request must contain width and GSM';
    end if;

    select * into v_wo from public.work_orders where id = v_request.wo_id for share;
    if not found or trim(coalesce(v_wo.wo_number, '')) <> trim(v_request.wo_no) then
      raise exception 'Work order does not match the pending production request';
    end if;

    select * into v_issue from public.inv_ledger where id = p_issue_ledger_id for share;
    if not found then raise exception 'Select the historical inventory issue transaction'; end if;
    if v_issue.item_id <> v_request.item_id
       or trim(coalesce(v_issue.ref_no, '')) <> trim(v_request.wo_no)
       or upper(trim(coalesce(v_issue.ref_type, ''))) <> 'ISSUE'
       or coalesce(v_issue.qty_out, 0) <= 0 then
      raise exception 'Historical issue must belong to the same item and work order';
    end if;

    select coalesce(sum(issue_qty_kg), 0) into v_used_qty
    from public.inv_legacy_reel_alignments
    where historical_issue_ledger_id = p_issue_ledger_id;
    if v_used_qty + v_qty > v_issue.qty_out + 0.001 then
      raise exception 'Aligned reel weight would exceed the historical issue quantity. Remaining evidence is % KG',
        round(greatest(v_issue.qty_out - v_used_qty, 0), 3);
    end if;

    select coalesce(sum(calculated_consumption_kg), 0) into v_pending_consumption
    from public.inv_legacy_reel_alignment_requests
    where status = 'PENDING'
      and internal_reel_no = v_reel_no
      and wo_id = v_request.wo_id
      and item_id = v_request.item_id;
    if v_pending_consumption > v_qty + 0.001 then
      raise exception 'Recorded production consumption % KG exceeds entered issued weight % KG',
        round(v_pending_consumption, 3), round(v_qty, 3);
    end if;

    insert into public.inv_lots (
      id, item_id, item_code, batch_no, source_type, source_ref, location,
      receipt_date, qty_received, qty_available, rate, department, remarks,
      created_at, is_reel, reel_status, assigned_wo_no, gross_weight_kg,
      master_width_mm, master_gsm, issued_gross_qty, issued_at
    ) values (
      v_lot_id, v_item.id, v_item.item_code, v_reel_no,
      'LEGACY-ISSUED-ALIGNMENT', v_issue.id::text, 'CORRUGATION FLOOR',
      coalesce(v_issue.created_at, now()), v_qty, 0, coalesce(v_issue.rate, 0),
      coalesce(v_issue.department, v_item.department),
      'No stock movement; linked to historical issue ' || v_issue.id::text || ' | ' || v_note,
      now(), true, 'ISSUED', v_wo.wo_number, v_qty,
      v_request.requested_width_mm, v_request.requested_gsm,
      v_qty, coalesce(v_issue.created_at, now())
    );

    insert into public.inv_reel_issue_cycles (
      id, lot_id, internal_reel_no, wo_id, wo_no, material_key,
      issue_ledger_id, issue_qty_kg, status, issue_actor, issued_at
    ) values (
      v_cycle_id, v_lot_id, v_reel_no, v_wo.id, v_wo.wo_number,
      coalesce(nullif(trim(v_issue.remarks), ''), 'LEGACY-REEL-ALIGNMENT'),
      v_issue.id, v_qty, 'ACTIVE', trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
      coalesce(v_issue.created_at, now())
    );

    update public.inv_lots set current_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle_id where id = v_lot_id;

    insert into public.inv_reel_events (
      lot_id, internal_reel_no, event_type, wo_no, qty, balance_after,
      location, material_key, reason, actor, metadata, issue_cycle_id
    ) values (
      v_lot_id, v_reel_no, 'WO_ISSUE', v_wo.wo_number, v_qty, 0,
      'CORRUGATION FLOOR', 'LEGACY-REEL-ALIGNMENT', v_note,
      trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'legacyAlignment', true,
        'ledgerQuantityChanged', false,
        'historicalIssueLedgerId', v_issue.id
      ),
      v_cycle_id
    );

    insert into public.inv_legacy_reel_alignments (
      internal_reel_no, lot_id, issue_cycle_id, item_id, item_code,
      wo_id, wo_no, historical_issue_ledger_id, issue_qty_kg,
      alignment_note, actor
    ) values (
      v_reel_no, v_lot_id, v_cycle_id, v_item.id, v_item.item_code,
      v_wo.id, v_wo.wo_number, v_issue.id, v_qty, v_note,
      trim(coalesce(p_actor, ''))
    );
  end if;

  update public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details
  set liner_reel_lot_id = v_lot_id,
      liner_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle_id
  where wo_id = v_request.wo_id
    and upper(trim(coalesce(liner_reel_no, ''))) = v_reel_no
    and upper(trim(coalesce(liner_actual_item_code, ''))) = upper(trim(v_request.item_code))
    and liner_reel_lot_id is null;

  update public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details
  set fluting_reel_lot_id = v_lot_id,
      fluting_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle_id
  where wo_id = v_request.wo_id
    and upper(trim(coalesce(fluting_reel_no, ''))) = v_reel_no
    and upper(trim(coalesce(fluting_actual_item_code, ''))) = upper(trim(v_request.item_code))
    and fluting_reel_lot_id is null;

  update public.inv_legacy_reel_alignment_requests
  set status = 'ALIGNED', aligned_lot_id = v_lot_id,
      aligned_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle_id, resolved_by = trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
      resolved_at = now(), resolution_note = v_note
  where status = 'PENDING'
    and internal_reel_no = v_reel_no
    and wo_id = v_request.wo_id
    and item_id = v_request.item_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'reelNo', v_reel_no, 'lotId', v_lot_id,
    'issueCycleId', v_cycle_id, 'woNo', v_request.wo_no,
    'issueQtyKg', v_qty
  );
end;
$_$;

-- TOC entry 787 (class 1255 OID 218104)
-- Name: assert_purchase_rate_override(uuid, text, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.assert_purchase_rate_override(p_id uuid, p_context_type text, p_expected jsonb) RETURNS public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  approval public.purchase_rate_override_approvals%rowtype;
  expected_vendor_id text := trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'vendor_id', ''));
  expected_vendor_name text := upper(trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'vendor_name', '')));
begin
  select *
  into approval
  from public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
  where id = p_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override approval not found';
  end if;
  if approval.status <> 'APPROVED' or approval.consumed_at is not null then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override is not approved or was already consumed';
  end if;
  if approval.expires_at is not null and approval.expires_at <= now() then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override approval has expired';
  end if;
  if upper(approval.context_type) <> upper(trim(coalesce(p_context_type, ''))) then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override context does not match';
  end if;
  if upper(trim(approval.item_code)) <> upper(trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'item_code', ''))) then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override item does not match';
  end if;
  if upper(trim(approval.rate_key)) <> upper(trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'rate_key', ''))) then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override rate key does not match';
  end if;
  if upper(trim(approval.purchase_uom)) <> upper(trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'purchase_uom', ''))) then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override purchase UOM does not match';
  end if;
  if abs(approval.requested_rate - coalesce(nullif(p_expected->>'rate', '')::numeric, 0)) > 0.0001 then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override rate does not match';
  end if;
  if abs(approval.requested_tax_pct - coalesce(nullif(p_expected->>'tax_pct', '')::numeric, 0)) > 0.0001 then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override GST does not match';
  end if;
  if abs(approval.requested_qty - coalesce(nullif(p_expected->>'qty', '')::numeric, 0)) > 0.0001 then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override stock quantity does not match';
  end if;
  if nullif(p_expected->>'master_rate', '') is not null
     and abs(approval.master_rate - (p_expected->>'master_rate')::numeric) > 0.0001 then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override ceiling does not match';
  end if;
  if nullif(p_expected->>'master_tax_pct', '') is not null
     and abs(approval.master_tax_pct - (p_expected->>'master_tax_pct')::numeric) > 0.0001 then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override master GST does not match';
  end if;

  if nullif(trim(approval.vendor_id), '') is not null then
    if expected_vendor_id = '' or trim(approval.vendor_id) <> expected_vendor_id then
      raise exception 'Purchase rate override vendor does not match';
    end if;
  elsif nullif(trim(approval.vendor_name), '') is not null then
    if expected_vendor_name = '' or upper(trim(approval.vendor_name)) <> expected_vendor_name then
      raise exception 'Purchase rate override vendor does not match';
    end if;
  else
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override does not contain a vendor';
  end if;

  if upper(approval.context_type) = 'PO_RATE' then
    if trim(approval.pr_no) = '' or trim(approval.pr_no) <> trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'pr_no', '')) then
      raise exception 'Purchase rate override PR does not match';
    end if;
    if trim(approval.po_no) <> '' and trim(approval.po_no) <> trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'po_no', '')) then
      raise exception 'Purchase rate override PO does not match';
    end if;
    if approval.po_line_id is not null
       and approval.po_line_id::text <> trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'po_line_id', '')) then
      raise exception 'Purchase rate override PO line does not match';
    end if;
  else
    if trim(approval.po_no) = '' or trim(approval.po_no) <> trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'po_no', '')) then
      raise exception 'Purchase rate override PO does not match';
    end if;
    if approval.po_line_id is null
       or approval.po_line_id::text <> trim(coalesce(p_expected->>'po_line_id', '')) then
      raise exception 'Purchase rate override PO line does not match';
    end if;
  end if;

  return approval;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 847 (class 1255 OID 233458)
-- Name: assign_active_kraft_reel_to_work_order(uuid, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.assign_active_kraft_reel_to_work_order(p_lot_id uuid, p_wo_no text, p_material_key text, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $_$
declare
  v_lot public.inv_lots%rowtype;
  v_cycle public.inv_reel_issue_cycles%rowtype;
  v_issue_ledger public.inv_ledger%rowtype;
  v_wo public.work_orders%rowtype;
  v_requirement record;
  v_wo_no text := trim(coalesce(p_wo_no, ''));
  v_material_key text := trim(coalesce(p_material_key, ''));
  v_previous_wo text;
  v_previous_ledger_ref text;
  v_previous_ledger_remarks text;
  v_rm_type text := '';
  v_rm_key text := '';
  v_requirement_key text := '';
  v_requirement_gsm numeric;
begin
  if v_wo_no = '' then raise exception 'Work order no is required'; end if;
  if v_material_key = '' then raise exception 'Work-order material key is required'; end if;

  select * into v_lot
  from public.inv_lots
  where id = p_lot_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_lot.is_reel is not true then
    raise exception 'Kraft reel was not found';
  end if;
  if v_lot.reel_status <> 'ISSUED'
     or upper(trim(coalesce(v_lot.location, ''))) <> 'CORRUGATION FLOOR' then
    raise exception 'Only a reel currently issued to Corrugation Floor can be assigned';
  end if;

  select * into v_cycle
  from public.inv_reel_issue_cycles
  where id = v_lot.current_issue_cycle_id
    and lot_id = v_lot.id
    and status = 'ACTIVE'
  for update;

  if not found then raise exception 'Active reel issue cycle was not found'; end if;
  if v_cycle.issue_ledger_id is null then
    raise exception 'The active reel cycle has no linked issue ledger. Reconcile this reel before assigning a work order';
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_cycle.custody_scope, 'WORK_ORDER') = 'WORK_ORDER'
     and trim(coalesce(v_cycle.wo_no, '')) <> ''
     and upper(trim(v_cycle.wo_no)) <> 'CORRUGATION FLOOR'
     and v_cycle.wo_no <> v_wo_no then
    raise exception 'Reel % is assigned to %. Return it before assigning another WO',
      v_lot.batch_no, v_cycle.wo_no;
  end if;

  select * into v_wo
  from public.work_orders
  where wo_number = v_wo_no
  for share;

  if not found then raise exception 'Work order % was not found', v_wo_no; end if;

  select * into v_requirement
  from public.inv_wo_issue_requirement_v r
  where r.wo_number = v_wo_no
    and r.material_key = v_material_key
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Material % does not belong to work order %', v_material_key, v_wo_no;
  end if;

  if upper(trim(coalesce(v_requirement.uom::text, ''))) not in
     ('KG', 'KGS', 'KILOGRAM', 'KILOGRAMS') then
    raise exception 'Selected WO material must be issued in KG for kraft reel assignment';
  end if;

  select coalesce(i.rm_type, '') into v_rm_type
  from public.inv_items i
  where i.id = v_lot.item_id;

  v_rm_key := regexp_replace(upper(trim(coalesce(v_rm_type, ''))), '[^A-Z0-9]+', '', 'g');
  v_requirement_key := regexp_replace(
    upper(trim(coalesce(v_requirement.item_label::text, ''))),
    '[^A-Z0-9]+', '', 'g'
  );

  if v_rm_key <> '' and v_requirement_key <> ''
     and position(v_rm_key in v_requirement_key) = 0
     and position(v_requirement_key in v_rm_key) = 0 then
    raise exception 'Reel RM type % does not match WO material %',
      v_rm_type, v_requirement.item_label;
  end if;

  if trim(coalesce(v_requirement.gsm::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' then
    v_requirement_gsm := trim(v_requirement.gsm::text)::numeric;
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_lot.master_gsm, 0) > 0
     and coalesce(v_requirement_gsm, 0) > 0
     and abs(v_lot.master_gsm - v_requirement_gsm) > 0.01 then
    raise exception 'Reel GSM % does not match WO material GSM %',
      v_lot.master_gsm, v_requirement_gsm;
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_lot.master_width_mm, 0) > 0
     and coalesce(v_requirement.deckle_mm, 0) > 0
     and v_lot.master_width_mm + 0.01 < v_requirement.deckle_mm then
    raise exception 'Reel width % mm is below the WO deckle requirement % mm',
      v_lot.master_width_mm, v_requirement.deckle_mm;
  end if;

  select * into v_issue_ledger
  from public.inv_ledger
  where id = v_cycle.issue_ledger_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'The issue ledger linked to reel % was not found', v_lot.batch_no;
  end if;
  if upper(trim(coalesce(v_issue_ledger.ref_type, ''))) <> 'ISSUE'
     or coalesce(v_issue_ledger.qty_out, 0) <= 0 then
    raise exception 'The linked reel ledger is not a valid stock issue';
  end if;
  if v_issue_ledger.item_id is distinct from v_lot.item_id then
    raise exception 'The linked issue ledger belongs to another item';
  end if;

  v_previous_wo := nullif(trim(coalesce(v_cycle.wo_no, '')), '');
  v_previous_ledger_ref := trim(coalesce(v_issue_ledger.ref_no, ''));
  v_previous_ledger_remarks := coalesce(v_issue_ledger.remarks, '');

  if v_previous_ledger_ref <> ''
     and upper(v_previous_ledger_ref) not in ('CORRUGATION FLOOR', 'FLOOR')
     and v_previous_ledger_ref <> v_wo_no
     and v_previous_ledger_ref <> coalesce(v_previous_wo, '') then
    raise exception 'The reel issue ledger is already attributed to %', v_previous_ledger_ref;
  end if;

  update public.inv_ledger
  set ref_no = v_wo_no,
      remarks = v_material_key
  where id = v_issue_ledger.id;

  update public.inv_reel_issue_cycles
  set wo_id = v_wo.id,
      wo_no = v_wo_no,
      material_key = v_material_key,
      custody_scope = 'WORK_ORDER',
      custody_location = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR',
      updated_at = now()
  where id = v_cycle.id;

  update public.inv_lots
  set assigned_wo_no = v_wo_no
  where id = v_lot.id;

  insert into public.inv_reel_events (
    lot_id, internal_reel_no, event_type, wo_no, qty, balance_after,
    location, material_key, reason, actor, metadata, issue_cycle_id
  ) values (
    v_lot.id, v_lot.batch_no, 'SUBSTITUTION', v_wo_no, 0, 0,
    'CORRUGATION FLOOR', v_material_key,
    'Stores assigned active floor reel to current work order',
    trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'assignmentOnly', true,
      'previousWoNo', v_previous_wo,
      'assignedWoNo', v_wo_no,
      'issueLedgerId', v_issue_ledger.id,
      'previousLedgerRef', v_previous_ledger_ref,
      'previousLedgerRemarks', v_previous_ledger_remarks,
      'newLedgerRef', v_wo_no,
      'newLedgerRemarks', v_material_key,
      'stockChanged', false,
      'ledgerAttributionChanged', true
    ),
    v_cycle.id
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'reelNo', v_lot.batch_no,
    'assignedWoNo', v_wo_no,
    'materialKey', v_material_key,
    'issueCycleId', v_cycle.id,
    'issueLedgerId', v_issue_ledger.id,
    'stockChanged', false,
    'ledgerAttributionChanged', true
  );
end;
$_$;

--
-- TOC entry 826 (class 1255 OID 125953)
-- Name: backfill_missing_sales_order_artworks(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.backfill_missing_sales_order_artworks() RETURNS bigint
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_inserted bigint := 0;
begin
  with inserted as (
    insert into public.artworks (
      so_id,
      line_no,
      artwork_no,
      product_type,
      plate_status,
      die_status,
      status,
      sheet_length,
      sheet_width,
      sheet_ups,
      printing_colors
    )
    select
      sol.so_id,
      sol.line_no,
      null,
      coalesce(sol.category, ''),
      'PENDING',
      'PENDING',
      'NO_ART',
      null,
      null,
      null,
      null
    from public.sales_order_lines sol
    join public.sales_orders so
      on so.id = sol.so_id
    left join public.artworks a
      on a.so_id = sol.so_id
     and a.line_no::text = sol.line_no::text
    where a.id is null
      and sol.so_id is not null
      and sol.line_no is not null
      and upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')
      and upper(coalesce(sol.status, 'OPEN')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')
      and upper(coalesce(so.order_prefix, '')) <> 'MB'
      and upper(coalesce(so.sales_type, '')) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'
      and upper(trim(coalesce(sol.product_code, ''))) not in ('SLC001', 'SLC002', 'SLC003')
      and upper(trim(coalesce(sol.category, ''))) not in ('FLEXO PRINTING PLATE', 'OFFSET PRINTING PLATE', 'DIE')
      and upper(trim(coalesce(sol.hsn_group, ''))) not in ('FLEXO PRINTING PLATE', 'OFFSET PRINTING PLATE', 'DIE')
      and upper(trim(coalesce(sol.product_name, ''))) not in ('FLEXO PRINTING PLATE', 'OFFSET PRINTING PLATE', 'DIE')
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_inserted
  from inserted;

  return coalesce(v_inserted, 0);
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 929 (class 1255 OID 225162)
-- Name: billing_cancel_adjustment_note(uuid, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_cancel_adjustment_note(p_note_id uuid, p_actor text, p_reason text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_note public.billing_adjustment_notes%rowtype;
begin
  if trim(coalesce(p_reason,''))='' then raise exception 'Cancellation reason is required'; end if;
  select * into v_note from public.billing_adjustment_notes where id=p_note_id for update;
  if v_note.id is null or v_note.status<>'POSTED' then raise exception 'Only posted notes can be cancelled'; end if;
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.billing_adjustment_note_lines l
    join public.v_billing_net_invoice_usage u on u.so_line_id=l.so_line_id
    where l.note_id=p_note_id and l.rebill_release_qty>0
      and coalesce(u.invoiced_posted_qty,0)>coalesce(l.gross_posted_qty_at_post,0)
  ) then
    raise exception 'Released quantity has already been rebilled; this note must be reversed through a controlled adjustment';
  end if;
  perform set_config('erp.adjustment_cancel','1',true);
  update public.billing_adjustment_notes set status='CANCELLED',
    cancelled_by=coalesce(nullif(p_actor,''),'system'),cancelled_at=now(),
    cancellation_reason=trim(p_reason)
  where id=p_note_id;
  perform public.billing_refresh_adjusted_so_line_status(x.so_line_id)
  from (select distinct so_line_id from public.billing_adjustment_note_lines where note_id=p_note_id) x;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'noteId',p_note_id,'noteNo',v_note.note_no,'status','CANCELLED');
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 894 (class 1255 OID 134424)
-- Name: billing_client_search(text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_client_search(p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 80) RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, client_code text, client_name text, state text, gstin text, credit_days integer, category text, active boolean, pan_no text, payment_terms text, bill_to_address text, bill_to_city text, bill_to_state text, bill_to_pincode text, ship_to_address text, ship_to_city text, ship_to_state text, ship_to_pincode text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  select
    c.id,
    c.client_code,
    c.client_name,
    c.state,
    c.gstin,
    c.credit_days,
    c.category,
    c.active,
    c.pan_no,
    c.payment_terms,
    c.bill_to_address,
    c.bill_to_city,
    c.bill_to_state,
    c.bill_to_pincode,
    c.ship_to_address,
    c.ship_to_city,
    c.ship_to_state,
    c.ship_to_pincode
  from public.clients c
  where c.active is distinct from false
    and (
      coalesce(trim(p_q), '') = ''
      or (
        coalesce(c.client_code, '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(c.client_name, '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(c.gstin, '')
      ) ilike '%' || trim(p_q) || '%'
    )
  order by c.client_name nulls last, c.client_code
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 80), 1), 200);
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 849 (class 1255 OID 97708)
-- Name: billing_document_register_v2(date, date, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_document_register_v2(p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_status text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(id text, invoice_no text, invoice_date date, document_type text, client_code text, client_name text, status text, billing_mode text, total_qty numeric, line_count integer, product_preview text, remarks text, subtotal numeric, tax_total numeric, grand_total numeric, posted_at timestamp with time zone)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  with base as (
    select
      inv.id::text as id,
      inv.invoice_no,
      inv.invoice_date,
      case
        when upper(coalesce(inv.document_type, '')) in ('INVOICE', 'CHALLAN') then upper(inv.document_type)
        when coalesce(inv.invoice_no, '') like 'DC-H/%' then 'CHALLAN'
        else 'INVOICE'
      end as document_type,
      coalesce(inv.client_code, 'MANUAL') as client_code,
      coalesce(nullif(inv.bill_to_name, ''), nullif(inv.client_name, ''), c.client_name, inv.client_code, 'MANUAL') as client_name,
      coalesce(inv.status, 'DRAFT') as status,
      coalesce(inv.billing_mode, '') as billing_mode,
      coalesce(inv.remarks, '') as remarks,
      coalesce(inv.subtotal, 0)::numeric(18,2) as subtotal,
      coalesce(inv.tax_total, greatest(coalesce(inv.grand_total, 0) - coalesce(inv.subtotal, 0) - coalesce(inv.freight, 0), 0))::numeric(18,2) as tax_total,
      coalesce(inv.grand_total, 0)::numeric(18,2) as grand_total,
      inv.posted_at
    from public.invoices inv
    left join public.clients c on c.client_code = inv.client_code
    where (p_date_from is null or inv.invoice_date >= p_date_from)
      and (p_date_to is null or inv.invoice_date <= p_date_to)
      and (
        coalesce(upper(p_status), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        or upper(coalesce(inv.status, '')) = upper(p_status)
      )
      and (
        coalesce(trim(p_q), '') = ''
        or (
          coalesce(inv.invoice_no, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.client_code, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.client_name, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.bill_to_name, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.status, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.invoice_date::text, '')
        ) ilike '%' || trim(p_q) || '%'
      )
  ),
  line_meta as (
    select
      il.invoice_id::text as id,
      count(*)::integer as line_count,
      coalesce(sum(il.qty), 0)::numeric(18,3) as total_qty,
      min(upper(coalesce(nullif(il.source_mode, ''), 'UNKNOWN'))) as derived_billing_mode
    from public.invoice_lines il
    group by il.invoice_id
  ),
  line_preview_raw as (
    select
      s.id,
      s.product_label,
      row_number() over (partition by s.id order by s.product_label) as rn
    from (
      select distinct
        il.invoice_id::text as id,
        coalesce(nullif(il.product_name, ''), nullif(il.product_code, ''), 'Item') as product_label
      from public.invoice_lines il
    ) s
  ),
  line_preview as (
    select
      id,
      string_agg(product_label, ', ' order by product_label) as product_preview
    from line_preview_raw
    where rn <= 2
    group by id
  )
  select
    b.id,
    b.invoice_no,
    b.invoice_date,
    b.document_type,
    b.client_code,
    b.client_name,
    b.status,
    coalesce(nullif(b.billing_mode, ''), lm.derived_billing_mode, 'UNKNOWN') as billing_mode,
    coalesce(lm.total_qty, 0)::numeric(18,3) as total_qty,
    coalesce(lm.line_count, 0)::integer as line_count,
    coalesce(lp.product_preview, '') as product_preview,
    b.remarks,
    b.subtotal,
    b.tax_total,
    b.grand_total,
    b.posted_at
  from base b
  left join line_meta lm on lm.id = b.id
  left join line_preview lp on lp.id = b.id
  order by b.invoice_date desc, b.id desc
  limit 500;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 812 (class 1255 OID 134425)
-- Name: billing_document_register_v3(date, date, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_document_register_v3(p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_status text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(id text, invoice_no text, invoice_date date, document_type text, client_code text, client_name text, status text, billing_mode text, total_qty numeric, line_count integer, product_preview text, remarks text, subtotal numeric, tax_total numeric, grand_total numeric, created_at timestamp with time zone, posted_at timestamp with time zone, sort_ts timestamp with time zone)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  with base as (
    select
      inv.id,
      inv.id::text as id_text,
      inv.invoice_no,
      inv.invoice_date,
      case
        when upper(coalesce(inv.document_type, '')) in ('INVOICE', 'CHALLAN') then upper(inv.document_type)
        when coalesce(inv.invoice_no, '') like 'DC-H/%' then 'CHALLAN'
        else 'INVOICE'
      end as document_type,
      coalesce(inv.client_code, 'MANUAL') as client_code,
      coalesce(nullif(inv.bill_to_name, ''), nullif(inv.client_name, ''), c.client_name, inv.client_code, 'MANUAL') as client_name,
      coalesce(inv.status, 'DRAFT') as status,
      coalesce(inv.billing_mode, '') as billing_mode,
      coalesce(inv.remarks, '') as remarks,
      coalesce(inv.subtotal, 0)::numeric(18,2) as subtotal,
      coalesce(inv.tax_total, greatest(coalesce(inv.grand_total, 0) - coalesce(inv.subtotal, 0) - coalesce(inv.freight, 0), 0))::numeric(18,2) as tax_total,
      coalesce(inv.grand_total, 0)::numeric(18,2) as grand_total,
      inv.created_at,
      inv.posted_at,
      coalesce(inv.posted_at, inv.created_at, inv.invoice_date::timestamp) as sort_ts
    from public.invoices inv
    left join public.clients c on c.client_code = inv.client_code
    where (p_date_from is null or inv.invoice_date >= p_date_from)
      and (p_date_to is null or inv.invoice_date <= p_date_to)
      and (
        coalesce(upper(p_status), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
        or upper(coalesce(inv.status, '')) = upper(p_status)
      )
      and (
        coalesce(trim(p_q), '') = ''
        or (
          coalesce(inv.invoice_no, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.client_code, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.client_name, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.bill_to_name, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.status, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.billing_mode, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.remarks, '') || ' ' ||
          coalesce(inv.invoice_date::text, '')
        ) ilike '%' || trim(p_q) || '%'
      )
    order by inv.invoice_date desc, coalesce(inv.posted_at, inv.created_at, inv.invoice_date::timestamp) desc, inv.invoice_no desc
    limit 5000
  ),
  line_meta as (
    select
      il.invoice_id,
      count(*)::integer as line_count,
      coalesce(sum(il.qty), 0)::numeric(18,3) as total_qty,
      min(upper(coalesce(nullif(il.source_mode, ''), 'UNKNOWN'))) as derived_billing_mode
    from public.invoice_lines il
    join base b on b.id = il.invoice_id
    group by il.invoice_id
  ),
  preview_distinct as (
    select distinct
      il.invoice_id,
      coalesce(nullif(il.product_name, ''), nullif(il.product_code, ''), 'Item') as product_label
    from public.invoice_lines il
    join base b on b.id = il.invoice_id
  ),
  preview_ranked as (
    select
      pd.invoice_id,
      pd.product_label,
      row_number() over (partition by pd.invoice_id order by pd.product_label) as rn
    from preview_distinct pd
  ),
  preview as (
    select
      pr.invoice_id,
      string_agg(pr.product_label, ', ' order by pr.product_label) as product_preview
    from preview_ranked pr
    where pr.rn <= 2
    group by pr.invoice_id
  )
  select
    b.id_text as id,
    b.invoice_no,
    b.invoice_date,
    b.document_type,
    b.client_code,
    b.client_name,
    b.status,
    coalesce(nullif(b.billing_mode, ''), lm.derived_billing_mode, 'UNKNOWN') as billing_mode,
    coalesce(lm.total_qty, 0)::numeric(18,3) as total_qty,
    coalesce(lm.line_count, 0)::integer as line_count,
    coalesce(pv.product_preview, '') as product_preview,
    b.remarks,
    b.subtotal,
    b.tax_total,
    b.grand_total,
    b.created_at,
    b.posted_at,
    b.sort_ts
  from base b
  left join line_meta lm on lm.invoice_id = b.id
  left join preview pv on pv.invoice_id = b.id
  order by b.invoice_date desc, b.sort_ts desc, b.invoice_no desc;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_invoice_register(p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_status text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(id text, invoice_no text, invoice_date date, client_code text, client_name text, status text, subtotal numeric, tax_total numeric, grand_total numeric, posted_at timestamp with time zone)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  select
    inv.id,
    inv.invoice_no,
    inv.invoice_date,
    inv.client_code,
    coalesce(inv.client_code, 'MANUAL') as client_name,
    inv.status,
    inv.subtotal,
    (coalesce(inv.grand_total, 0) - coalesce(inv.subtotal, 0))::numeric as tax_total,
    inv.grand_total,
    null::timestamptz as posted_at
  from public.invoices inv

    and (
      coalesce(upper(p_status), 'ALL') = 'ALL'
      or upper(coalesce(inv.status, '')) = upper(p_status)
    )
    and (
      coalesce(trim(p_q), '') = ''
      or (
        coalesce(inv.invoice_no, '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(inv.client_code, '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(inv.status, '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(inv.invoice_date::text, '')
      ) ilike '%' || trim(p_q) || '%'
    )
  order by inv.invoice_date desc, inv.id desc
  limit 200;
$$;

    v.client_state,
    v.client_gstin,
    v.client_address,
    v.po_number,
    v.po_date,
    v.currency,
    v.sales_remarks,
    v.mode_of_transport,
    v.transport_preference,
    v.transport_payment,
    v.billing_remarks,
    v.sales_rep,
    v.line_no,
    v.product_code,
    v.product_name,
    v.category,
    v.unit,
    v.rate,
    v.gst_pct,
    v.hsn_group,
    v.order_qty,
    v.packed_qty,
    v.dispatched_qty,
    v.fg_adjusted_qty,
    v.billed_qty,
    v.posted_qty,
    v.draft_qty,
    v.dispatch_billable_qty,
    v.fg_billable_qty,
    v.direct_billable_qty,
    case
      when upper(coalesce(p_mode, 'DISPATCH')) = 'DIRECT' then v.direct_billable_qty
      when upper(coalesce(p_mode, 'DISPATCH')) = 'FG' then v.fg_billable_qty
      else v.dispatch_billable_qty
    end as billable_qty,
    v.latest_packed_at,
    v.dispatch_no,
    v.dispatch_date,
    v.transporter,
    v.vehicle_no,
    v.lr_no,
    v.job_reference,
    v.division,
    v.quote_no,
    v.pm_code,
    v.expected_delivery,
    v.final_delivery,
    v.prepress_remarks,
    v.product_remarks,
    v.invoice_refs
  from public.v_billing_line_read_model v
  where v.client_code = p_client_code
    and (coalesce(trim(p_so_number), '') = '' or v.so_number = trim(p_so_number))
    and (coalesce(trim(p_q), '') = '' or v.match_text like '%' || lower(trim(p_q)) || '%')
    and (
      not coalesce(p_only_open, true)
      or (
        case
          when upper(coalesce(p_mode, 'DISPATCH')) = 'DIRECT' then v.direct_billable_qty
          when upper(coalesce(p_mode, 'DISPATCH')) = 'FG' then v.fg_billable_qty
          else v.dispatch_billable_qty
        end
      ) > 0
    )
  order by v.so_date desc nulls last, v.so_number desc, v.line_no asc;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 721 (class 1255 OID 148108)
-- Name: billing_job_dataset_v4(text, text, text, text, boolean, boolean); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_job_dataset_v4(p_client_code text, p_so_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_mode text DEFAULT 'DISPATCH'::text, p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_only_open boolean DEFAULT true, p_include_rows boolean DEFAULT true) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  with selected_client as (
    select c.*
    from public.clients c
    where c.client_code = p_client_code
    limit 1
  ),
  parties as (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cp) order by cp.address_type, cp.is_default desc, cp.label, cp.party_name), '[]'::jsonb) as rows
    from public.client_parties cp
    join selected_client c on c.id = cp.client_id
    where cp.active is distinct from false
  ),
  so_options as (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'soNumber', x.so_number,
      'soDate', x.so_date,
      'poNumber', x.po_number
    ) order by x.so_date desc nulls last, x.so_number desc), '[]'::jsonb) as rows
    from (
      select so.so_number, so.so_date, so.po_number
      from public.sales_orders so
      where so.client_code = p_client_code
        and upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')) <> 'CANCELLED'
        and upper(coalesce(so.order_prefix, '')) <> 'MB'
        and upper(coalesce(so.sales_type, '')) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'
        and coalesce(so.so_number, '') !~* '^MB[/-]'
        and (coalesce(trim(p_so_number), '') = '' or so.so_number = trim(p_so_number))
      order by so.so_date desc nulls last, so.so_number desc
    ) x
  ),
  job_rows as (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.so_date desc nulls last, r.so_number desc, r.line_no asc), '[]'::jsonb) as rows
    from public.billing_job_dataset(
      p_client_code,
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_so_number, '')), ''),
      coalesce(p_mode, 'DISPATCH'),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_q, '')), ''),
      coalesce(p_only_open, true)
    ) r
    where coalesce(p_include_rows, true)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'fastPath', 'billing_job_dataset_v4',
    'mode', upper(coalesce(p_mode, 'DISPATCH')),
    'client', coalesce((select to_jsonb(c) from selected_client c), 'null'::jsonb),
    'parties', coalesce((select rows from parties), '[]'::jsonb),
    'soOptions', coalesce((select rows from so_options), '[]'::jsonb),
    'rowsDeferred', not coalesce(p_include_rows, true),
    'rows', case when coalesce(p_include_rows, true) then coalesce((select rows from job_rows), '[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end
  );
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 919 (class 1255 OID 225134)
-- Name: billing_next_adjustment_note_no(text, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_next_adjustment_note_no(p_note_type text, p_note_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE) RETURNS text
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $_$
declare
  v_type text := upper(coalesce(p_note_type, ''));
  v_prefix text;
  v_fy text;
  v_next integer;
begin
  if v_type not in ('CREDIT_NOTE','DEBIT_NOTE') then
    raise exception 'Invalid adjustment note type';
  end if;
  v_prefix := case when v_type = 'CREDIT_NOTE' then 'CN-H' else 'DN-H' end;
  v_fy := case
    when extract(month from p_note_date) >= 4
      then to_char(p_note_date, 'YY') || '-' || to_char(p_note_date + interval '1 year', 'YY')
    else to_char(p_note_date - interval '1 year', 'YY') || '-' || to_char(p_note_date, 'YY')
  end;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_prefix || '/' || v_fy));
  select coalesce(max((regexp_match(note_no, '/([0-9]+)$'))[1]::integer), 0) + 1
    into v_next
  from public.billing_adjustment_notes
  where note_no like v_prefix || '/' || v_fy || '/%';
  return v_prefix || '/' || v_fy || '/' || lpad(v_next::text, 4, '0');
end;
$_$;


--
-- TOC entry 716 (class 1255 OID 225158)
-- Name: billing_post_adjustment_note(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_post_adjustment_note(p_note_id uuid, p_actor text DEFAULT 'system'::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_note public.billing_adjustment_notes%rowtype;
  v_invoice public.invoices%rowtype;
  v_line record;
  v_subtotal numeric := 0;
  v_tax numeric := 0;
  v_total_qty numeric := 0;
  v_release numeric := 0;
  v_charge_taxable numeric := 0;
  v_charge_tax numeric := 0;
  v_prior_credit_total numeric := 0;
begin
  select * into v_note from public.billing_adjustment_notes
  where id = p_note_id for update;
  if v_note.id is null then raise exception 'Adjustment note not found'; end if;
  if v_note.status <> 'DRAFT' then raise exception 'Only draft notes can be posted'; end if;
  if coalesce(trim(v_note.note_no),'') = '' then raise exception 'Adjustment note number is required'; end if;

  -- Serialize all adjustment posting against the same source invoice. This
  -- makes cumulative-credit checks safe even when two users post together.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_note.original_invoice_id::text));

  select * into v_invoice from public.invoices
  where id = v_note.original_invoice_id for update;
  if v_invoice.id is null or v_invoice.status <> 'POSTED'
     or coalesce(v_invoice.document_type,'INVOICE') = 'CHALLAN'
     or coalesce(v_invoice.invoice_no,'') like 'DC-H/%' then
    raise exception 'Original document must be a posted invoice';
  end if;
  if v_invoice.client_code is distinct from v_note.client_code then
    raise exception 'Adjustment-note customer does not match original invoice';
  end if;

  if not exists (select 1 from public.billing_adjustment_note_lines where note_id = p_note_id) then
    if coalesce(v_note.charge_taxable_amount,0) <= 0 then
      raise exception 'Adjustment note has no lines or charges';
    end if;
  end if;

  for v_line in
    select l.*, il.invoice_id,
      b.creditable_qty, b.creditable_taxable
    from public.billing_adjustment_note_lines l
    join public.invoice_lines il on il.id = l.original_invoice_line_id
    join public.v_billing_adjustment_line_balance b
      on b.original_invoice_line_id = l.original_invoice_line_id
    where l.note_id = p_note_id
    for update of l, il
  loop
    if v_line.invoice_id <> v_note.original_invoice_id then
      raise exception 'Adjustment line does not belong to original invoice';
    end if;
    if v_line.adjustment_qty <= 0 and v_line.taxable_amount <= 0 then
      raise exception 'Each adjustment line requires quantity or value';
    end if;
    if v_line.rebill_release_qty > v_line.adjustment_qty then
      raise exception 'Rebill release cannot exceed adjusted quantity';
    end if;
    if v_note.note_type = 'DEBIT_NOTE' and v_line.rebill_release_qty <> 0 then
      raise exception 'Debit notes cannot release quantity for rebilling';
    end if;
    if v_note.note_type = 'CREDIT_NOTE'
       and (v_line.adjustment_qty > v_line.creditable_qty
            or v_line.taxable_amount > v_line.creditable_taxable) then
      raise exception 'Credit exceeds remaining original invoice line balance';
    end if;
    v_subtotal := v_subtotal + v_line.taxable_amount;
    v_tax := v_tax + v_line.cgst_amt + v_line.sgst_amt + v_line.igst_amt;
    v_total_qty := v_total_qty + v_line.adjustment_qty;
    v_release := v_release + v_line.rebill_release_qty;
  end loop;

  v_charge_taxable := coalesce(v_note.charge_taxable_amount,0);
  v_charge_tax := coalesce(v_note.charge_cgst_amt,0)+coalesce(v_note.charge_sgst_amt,0)+coalesce(v_note.charge_igst_amt,0);
  if v_note.note_type='CREDIT_NOTE' then
    select coalesce(sum(grand_total),0) into v_prior_credit_total
    from public.billing_adjustment_notes
    where original_invoice_id=v_note.original_invoice_id and note_type='CREDIT_NOTE'
      and status='POSTED' and id<>p_note_id;
    if v_subtotal+v_charge_taxable+v_tax+v_charge_tax >
       greatest(coalesce(v_invoice.grand_total,0)-v_prior_credit_total,0)+0.01 then
      raise exception 'Credit note total exceeds remaining original invoice value';
    end if;
  end if;

  update public.billing_adjustment_note_lines l set
    gross_posted_qty_at_post=coalesce(u.invoiced_posted_qty,0)
  from public.v_billing_net_invoice_usage u
  where l.note_id=p_note_id and u.so_line_id=l.so_line_id;

  update public.billing_adjustment_notes set
    subtotal = round(v_subtotal+v_charge_taxable,2),
    tax_total = round(v_tax+v_charge_tax,2),
    grand_total = round(v_subtotal+v_charge_taxable+v_tax+v_charge_tax,2),
    total_adjustment_qty = round(v_total_qty,3),
    total_rebill_release_qty = round(v_release,3),
    status = 'POSTED',
    approved_by = coalesce(nullif(p_actor,''),'system'),
    approved_at = now(),
    posted_by = coalesce(nullif(p_actor,''),'system'),
    posted_at = now()
  where id = p_note_id;

  perform public.billing_refresh_adjusted_so_line_status(x.so_line_id)
  from (
    select distinct so_line_id
    from public.billing_adjustment_note_lines where note_id = p_note_id
  ) x
  where to_regprocedure('public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(uuid)') is not null;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,'noteId',p_note_id,'noteNo',v_note.note_no,
    'noteType',v_note.note_type,'status','POSTED',
    'subtotal',round(v_subtotal+v_charge_taxable,2),'taxTotal',round(v_tax+v_charge_tax,2),
    'grandTotal',round(v_subtotal+v_charge_taxable+v_tax+v_charge_tax,2),
    'releasedQty',round(v_release,3)
  );
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 779 (class 1255 OID 148109)
-- Name: billing_post_invoice_v4(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_post_invoice_v4(p_invoice_id uuid, p_actor text DEFAULT 'system'::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_inv public.invoices%rowtype;
  v_document_type text;
  v_line_count integer := 0;
  v_subtotal numeric := 0;
  v_line_tax numeric := 0;
  v_freight numeric := 0;
  v_freight_gst_pct numeric := 0;
  v_freight_tax numeric := 0;
  v_tax_total numeric := 0;
  v_grand_total numeric := 0;
  v_touched_so_line_ids uuid[] := '{}'::uuid[];
begin
  if p_invoice_id is null then
    raise exception 'Invoice id required';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_inv
  from public.invoices
  where id = p_invoice_id
  for update;

  if v_inv.id is null then
    raise exception 'Invoice % not found', p_invoice_id;
  end if;

  if upper(coalesce(v_inv.status, '')) = 'POSTED' then
    raise exception 'Document % already posted', coalesce(v_inv.invoice_no, p_invoice_id::text);
  end if;

  v_document_type := case
    when upper(coalesce(v_inv.document_type, '')) in ('INVOICE', 'CHALLAN') then upper(v_inv.document_type)
    when coalesce(v_inv.invoice_no, '') like 'DC-H/%' then 'CHALLAN'
    else 'INVOICE'
  end;

  select
    count(*)::integer,
    coalesce(sum(coalesce(il.line_amount, il.taxable_amount, 0)), 0),
    coalesce(sum(coalesce(il.cgst_amt, 0) + coalesce(il.sgst_amt, 0) + coalesce(il.igst_amt, 0)), 0),
    coalesce(array_agg(distinct il.so_line_id) filter (where il.so_line_id is not null), '{}'::uuid[])
  into
    v_line_count,
    v_subtotal,
    v_line_tax,
    v_touched_so_line_ids
  from public.invoice_lines il
  where il.invoice_id = p_invoice_id;

  if v_line_count <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Document % has no lines', coalesce(v_inv.invoice_no, p_invoice_id::text);
  end if;

  v_freight := coalesce(v_inv.freight, 0);
  v_freight_gst_pct := case
    when v_document_type = 'CHALLAN' then 0
    else coalesce(v_inv.freight_gst_pct, 0)
  end;
  v_freight_tax := round((v_freight * v_freight_gst_pct / 100.0)::numeric, 2);
  v_tax_total := round((v_line_tax + v_freight_tax)::numeric, 2);
  v_grand_total := round((v_subtotal + v_tax_total + v_freight)::numeric, 2);

  update public.invoices
  set
    subtotal = round(v_subtotal::numeric, 2),
    tax_total = v_tax_total,
    grand_total = v_grand_total,
    freight = v_freight,
    freight_gst_pct = v_freight_gst_pct,
    status = 'POSTED',
    posted_at = now()
  where id = p_invoice_id;

  if to_regclass('public.invoice_audit_log') is not null then
    insert into public.invoice_audit_log(invoice_id, action, actor, remarks)
    values (
      p_invoice_id,
      'POSTED',
      coalesce(nullif(p_actor, ''), 'system'),
      'Posted by billing_post_invoice_v4 | subtotal=' || v_subtotal || ' | tax=' || v_tax_total || ' | grand=' || v_grand_total
    );
  end if;

  if to_regprocedure('public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(uuid)') is not null then
    perform public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(x.so_line_id)
    from unnest(v_touched_so_line_ids) as x(so_line_id);
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'invoiceId', p_invoice_id,
    'invoiceNo', v_inv.invoice_no,
    'documentType', v_document_type,
    'status', 'POSTED',
    'subtotal', v_subtotal,
    'taxTotal', v_tax_total,
    'grandTotal', v_grand_total
  );
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 798 (class 1255 OID 225157)
-- Name: billing_refresh_adjusted_so_line_status(uuid); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_refresh_adjusted_so_line_status(p_so_line_id uuid) RETURNS void
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare v_net numeric:=0;v_order numeric:=0;v_dispatch numeric:=0;v_closed_by text:='';
begin
  perform public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(p_so_line_id);
  select coalesce(u.net_posted_billed_qty,0),coalesce(l.qty,0),coalesce(l.closed_by,'')
    into v_net,v_order,v_closed_by
  from public.sales_order_lines l
  left join public.v_billing_net_invoice_usage u on u.so_line_id=l.id
  where l.id=p_so_line_id;
  if v_net<v_order and upper(v_closed_by) like '%FULLY BILLED%' then
    select coalesce(sum(dispatch_qty),0) into v_dispatch
    from public.dispatch_records where so_line_id=p_so_line_id;
    update public.sales_order_lines set
      status=case when v_dispatch>=v_order and v_order>0 then 'CLOSED'
                  when v_dispatch>0 then 'PARTIAL_DISPATCHED' else 'OPEN' end,
      closed_at=case when v_dispatch>=v_order and v_order>0 then coalesce(closed_at,now()) else null end,
      closed_by=case when v_dispatch>=v_order and v_order>0 then 'System - fully dispatched' else null end,
      status_updated_at=now()
    where id=p_so_line_id;
  end if;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 824 (class 1255 OID 132907)
-- Name: billing_replace_invoice_lines(uuid, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_replace_invoice_lines(p_invoice_id uuid, p_lines jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_invoice_id uuid := p_invoice_id;
  v_line_count integer := 0;
  v_lock_triggers text[] := '{}'::text[];
  v_trigger_name text;
  v_touched_so_line_ids uuid[] := '{}'::uuid[];
begin
  if v_invoice_id is null then
    raise exception 'Invoice id required';
  end if;

  if not exists (select 1 from public.invoices where id = v_invoice_id) then
    raise exception 'Invoice % not found', v_invoice_id;
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_lines, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'p_lines must be a JSON array';
  end if;

  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct so_line_id) filter (where so_line_id is not null), '{}'::uuid[])
  into v_touched_so_line_ids
  from public.invoice_lines
  where invoice_id = v_invoice_id;

  select coalesce(array_agg(t.tgname::text), '{}'::text[])
  into v_lock_triggers
  from pg_trigger t
  join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  join pg_proc p on p.oid = t.tgfoid
  where n.nspname = 'public'
    and c.relname = 'invoice_lines'
    and not t.tgisinternal
    and p.proname = 'lock_invoice_lines';

  begin
    foreach v_trigger_name in array v_lock_triggers loop
      execute format('alter table public.invoice_lines disable trigger %I', v_trigger_name);
    end loop;

    delete from public.invoice_lines
    where invoice_id = v_invoice_id;

    insert into public.invoice_lines (
      invoice_id,
      so_id,
      so_line_id,
      so_number,
      line_no,
      product_code,
      product_name,
      hsn,
      unit,
      qty,
      rate,
      gst_pct,
      division,
      taxable_amount,
      line_amount,
      cgst_pct,
      sgst_pct,
      igst_pct,
      cgst_amt,
      sgst_amt,
      igst_amt,
      line_total,
      source_mode,
      dispatch_qty_snapshot,
      ordered_qty_snapshot,
      billed_qty_snapshot
    )
    select
      v_invoice_id,
      nullif(x.so_id, '')::uuid,
      nullif(x.so_line_id, '')::uuid,
      coalesce(x.so_number, ''),
      coalesce(x.line_no, 0),
      coalesce(x.product_code, ''),
      coalesce(x.product_name, ''),
      coalesce(x.hsn, ''),
      coalesce(x.unit, 'Nos'),
      coalesce(x.qty, 0),
      coalesce(x.rate, 0),
      coalesce(x.gst_pct, 0),
      coalesce(x.division, ''),
      coalesce(x.taxable_amount, 0),
      coalesce(x.line_amount, 0),
      coalesce(x.cgst_pct, 0),
      coalesce(x.sgst_pct, 0),
      coalesce(x.igst_pct, 0),
      coalesce(x.cgst_amt, 0),
      coalesce(x.sgst_amt, 0),
      coalesce(x.igst_amt, 0),
      coalesce(x.line_total, 0),
      coalesce(x.source_mode, ''),
      coalesce(x.dispatch_qty_snapshot, 0),
      coalesce(x.ordered_qty_snapshot, 0),
      coalesce(x.billed_qty_snapshot, 0)
    from jsonb_to_recordset(coalesce(p_lines, '[]'::jsonb)) as x(
      so_id text,
      so_line_id text,
      so_number text,
      line_no integer,
      product_code text,
      product_name text,
      hsn text,
      unit text,
      qty numeric,
      rate numeric,
      gst_pct numeric,
      division text,
      taxable_amount numeric,
      line_amount numeric,
      cgst_pct numeric,
      sgst_pct numeric,
      igst_pct numeric,
      cgst_amt numeric,
      sgst_amt numeric,
      igst_amt numeric,
      line_total numeric,
      source_mode text,
      dispatch_qty_snapshot numeric,
      ordered_qty_snapshot numeric,
      billed_qty_snapshot numeric
    )
    where coalesce(x.qty, 0) > 0;

    get diagnostics v_line_count = row_count;

    select coalesce(array_agg(distinct so_line_id) filter (where so_line_id is not null), '{}'::uuid[])
    into v_touched_so_line_ids
    from (
      select unnest(v_touched_so_line_ids) as so_line_id
      union
      select so_line_id
      from public.invoice_lines
      where invoice_id = v_invoice_id
    ) s;

    foreach v_trigger_name in array v_lock_triggers loop
      execute format('alter table public.invoice_lines enable trigger %I', v_trigger_name);
    end loop;
  exception when others then
    foreach v_trigger_name in array v_lock_triggers loop
      begin
        execute format('alter table public.invoice_lines enable trigger %I', v_trigger_name);
      exception when others then
        null;
      end;
    end loop;
    raise;
  end;

  if to_regprocedure('public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(uuid)') is not null then
    perform public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(x.so_line_id)
    from unnest(v_touched_so_line_ids) as x(so_line_id);
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'invoiceId', v_invoice_id,
    'lineCount', v_line_count
  );
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 928 (class 1255 OID 225155)
-- Name: billing_save_adjustment_draft(uuid, jsonb, jsonb, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_save_adjustment_draft(p_note_id uuid, p_header jsonb, p_lines jsonb, p_actor text DEFAULT 'system'::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_note_id uuid := p_note_id;
  v_note_no text;
  v_type text := upper(coalesce(p_header->>'noteType',''));
  v_treatment text := upper(coalesce(p_header->>'noteTreatment','GST'));
  v_invoice_id uuid := nullif(p_header->>'originalInvoiceId','')::uuid;
  v_note_date date := nullif(p_header->>'noteDate','')::date;
  v_reason_code text := upper(trim(coalesce(p_header->>'reasonCode','')));
  v_reason_text text := trim(coalesce(p_header->>'reasonText',''));
  v_invoice public.invoices%rowtype;
  v_existing public.billing_adjustment_notes%rowtype;
  v_line_count integer;
  v_subtotal numeric;
  v_line_tax numeric;
  v_charge_taxable numeric := greatest(coalesce((p_header->>'chargeTaxableAmount')::numeric,0),0);
  v_charge_cgst numeric := greatest(coalesce((p_header->>'chargeCgstAmount')::numeric,0),0);
  v_charge_sgst numeric := greatest(coalesce((p_header->>'chargeSgstAmount')::numeric,0),0);
  v_charge_igst numeric := greatest(coalesce((p_header->>'chargeIgstAmount')::numeric,0),0);
  v_adjustment_qty numeric;
  v_release_qty numeric;
begin
  if v_type not in ('CREDIT_NOTE','DEBIT_NOTE') then raise exception 'Invalid adjustment note type'; end if;
  if v_treatment not in ('GST','COMMERCIAL') then raise exception 'Invalid note treatment'; end if;
  if v_invoice_id is null then raise exception 'Original invoice is required'; end if;
  if v_note_date is null then raise exception 'Valid note date is required'; end if;
  if v_reason_code = '' then raise exception 'Adjustment reason is required'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_lines,'[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array' then raise exception 'Lines must be an array'; end if;

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_invoice_id::text));
  select * into v_invoice from public.invoices where id = v_invoice_id for update;
  if v_invoice.id is null or upper(coalesce(v_invoice.status,'')) <> 'POSTED'
     or upper(coalesce(v_invoice.document_type,'')) = 'CHALLAN'
     or coalesce(v_invoice.invoice_no,'') like 'DC-H/%' then
    raise exception 'Original document must be a posted invoice';
  end if;
  if v_note_date < v_invoice.invoice_date then
    raise exception 'Adjustment note date cannot be earlier than the original invoice date';
  end if;
  if v_note_date > current_date then raise exception 'Future-dated adjustment notes are not allowed'; end if;

  if v_note_id is not null then
    select * into v_existing from public.billing_adjustment_notes where id = v_note_id for update;
    if v_existing.id is null or v_existing.status <> 'DRAFT' then raise exception 'Only draft notes can be edited'; end if;
    if v_existing.original_invoice_id <> v_invoice_id or v_existing.note_type <> v_type then
      raise exception 'Original invoice and note type cannot be changed';
    end if;
    v_note_no := v_existing.note_no;
    update public.billing_adjustment_notes set
      note_date=v_note_date,note_treatment=v_treatment,reason_code=v_reason_code,reason_text=v_reason_text,
      charge_taxable_amount=v_charge_taxable,charge_cgst_amt=v_charge_cgst,
      charge_sgst_amt=v_charge_sgst,charge_igst_amt=v_charge_igst
    where id=v_note_id;
    delete from public.billing_adjustment_note_lines where note_id=v_note_id;
  else
    v_note_no := public.billing_next_adjustment_note_no(v_type,v_note_date);
    insert into public.billing_adjustment_notes(
      note_no,note_type,note_treatment,note_date,original_invoice_id,
      client_code,client_name,client_gstin,client_state,bill_to_name,bill_to_address,
      bill_to_gstin,bill_to_state,currency,reason_code,reason_text,
      charge_taxable_amount,charge_cgst_amt,charge_sgst_amt,charge_igst_amt,
      status,created_by
    ) values (
      v_note_no,v_type,v_treatment,v_note_date,v_invoice_id,
      v_invoice.client_code,v_invoice.client_name,v_invoice.client_gst,v_invoice.client_state,
      v_invoice.bill_to_name,v_invoice.bill_to_address,v_invoice.bill_to_gstin,v_invoice.bill_to_state,
      coalesce(v_invoice.currency,'INR'),v_reason_code,v_reason_text,
      v_charge_taxable,v_charge_cgst,v_charge_sgst,v_charge_igst,
      'DRAFT',coalesce(nullif(p_actor,''),'system')
    ) returning id into v_note_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.billing_adjustment_note_lines(
    note_id,original_invoice_line_id,so_id,so_line_id,so_number,line_no,
    product_code,product_name,hsn,unit,division,original_invoice_qty,
    adjustment_qty,rebill_release_qty,rate,gst_pct,taxable_amount,
    cgst_pct,sgst_pct,igst_pct,cgst_amt,sgst_amt,igst_amt,line_total,reason
  )
  select
    v_note_id,il.id,il.so_id,il.so_line_id,il.so_number,il.line_no,
    il.product_code,il.product_name,il.hsn,il.unit,il.division,il.qty,
    round(x.adjustment_qty,3),round(x.rebill_release_qty,3),il.rate,
    case when v_treatment='COMMERCIAL' then 0 else coalesce(il.gst_pct,0) end,
    round(x.taxable_amount,2),
    case when v_treatment='COMMERCIAL' then 0 else coalesce(il.cgst_pct,0) end,
    case when v_treatment='COMMERCIAL' then 0 else coalesce(il.sgst_pct,0) end,
    case when v_treatment='COMMERCIAL' then 0 else coalesce(il.igst_pct,0) end,
    case when v_treatment='COMMERCIAL' then 0 else round(x.taxable_amount*coalesce(il.cgst_pct,0)/100,2) end,
    case when v_treatment='COMMERCIAL' then 0 else round(x.taxable_amount*coalesce(il.sgst_pct,0)/100,2) end,
    case when v_treatment='COMMERCIAL' then 0 else round(x.taxable_amount*coalesce(il.igst_pct,0)/100,2) end,
    round(x.taxable_amount +
      case when v_treatment='COMMERCIAL' then 0 else x.taxable_amount *
        (coalesce(il.cgst_pct,0)+coalesce(il.sgst_pct,0)+coalesce(il.igst_pct,0))/100 end,2),
    trim(coalesce(x.reason,''))
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_lines) as x(
    original_invoice_line_id uuid,adjustment_qty numeric,
    rebill_release_qty numeric,taxable_amount numeric,reason text
  )
  join public.invoice_lines il on il.id=x.original_invoice_line_id
  join public.v_billing_adjustment_line_balance b on b.original_invoice_line_id=il.id
  where il.invoice_id=v_invoice_id
    and coalesce(x.adjustment_qty,0)>=0 and coalesce(x.taxable_amount,0)>=0
    and coalesce(x.rebill_release_qty,0)>=0
    and coalesce(x.rebill_release_qty,0)<=coalesce(x.adjustment_qty,0)
    and (coalesce(x.adjustment_qty,0)>0 or coalesce(x.taxable_amount,0)>0)
    and (v_type='DEBIT_NOTE' or
      (coalesce(x.adjustment_qty,0)<=b.creditable_qty and coalesce(x.taxable_amount,0)<=b.creditable_taxable))
    and (v_type='CREDIT_NOTE' or coalesce(x.rebill_release_qty,0)=0);

  get diagnostics v_line_count = row_count;
  if v_line_count <> jsonb_array_length(p_lines) then
    raise exception 'One or more adjustment lines failed source, balance, or quantity validation';
  end if;
  if v_line_count=0 and v_charge_taxable=0 then raise exception 'Adjustment note has no value'; end if;

  select coalesce(sum(taxable_amount),0),coalesce(sum(cgst_amt+sgst_amt+igst_amt),0),
    coalesce(sum(adjustment_qty),0),coalesce(sum(rebill_release_qty),0)
  into v_subtotal,v_line_tax,v_adjustment_qty,v_release_qty
  from public.billing_adjustment_note_lines where note_id=v_note_id;

  update public.billing_adjustment_notes set
    subtotal=round(v_subtotal+v_charge_taxable,2),
    tax_total=round(v_line_tax+v_charge_cgst+v_charge_sgst+v_charge_igst,2),
    grand_total=round(v_subtotal+v_charge_taxable+v_line_tax+v_charge_cgst+v_charge_sgst+v_charge_igst,2),
    total_adjustment_qty=round(v_adjustment_qty,3),
    total_rebill_release_qty=round(v_release_qty,3)
  where id=v_note_id;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'noteId',v_note_id,'noteNo',v_note_no,
    'noteType',v_type,'status','DRAFT');
end;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.billing_selected_job_rows_v4(p_so_line_ids uuid[], p_mode text DEFAULT 'DISPATCH'::text) RETURNS TABLE(so_id uuid, so_line_id uuid, so_number text, so_date date, client_code text, client_name text, client_state text, client_gstin text, client_address text, po_number text, po_date date, currency text, sales_remarks text, mode_of_transport text, transport_preference text, transport_payment text, billing_remarks text, sales_rep text, line_no integer, product_code text, product_name text, category text, unit text, rate numeric, gst_pct numeric, hsn_group text, order_qty numeric, packed_qty numeric, dispatched_qty numeric, fg_adjusted_qty numeric, billed_qty numeric, posted_qty numeric, draft_qty numeric, dispatch_billable_qty numeric, fg_billable_qty numeric, direct_billable_qty numeric, billable_qty numeric, latest_packed_at timestamp with time zone, dispatch_no text, dispatch_date timestamp with time zone, transporter text, vehicle_no text, lr_no text, job_reference text, division text, quote_no text, pm_code text, expected_delivery date, final_delivery date, prepress_remarks text, product_remarks text, invoice_refs text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE

    v.so_date,
    v.client_code,
    v.client_name,
    v.client_state,
    v.client_gstin,
    v.client_address,
    v.po_number,
    v.po_date,
    v.currency,
    v.sales_remarks,
    v.mode_of_transport,
    v.transport_preference,
    v.transport_payment,
    v.billing_remarks,
    v.sales_rep,

    v.product_code,
