    v.category,
    v.unit,
    v.rate,
    v.gst_pct,
    v.hsn_group,
    v.order_qty,
    v.packed_qty,
    v.dispatched_qty,

--
-- TOC entry 872 (class 1255 OID 209488)
-- Name: bulk_update_item_dimensions(jsonb, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.bulk_update_item_dimensions(p_rows jsonb, p_updated_by text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_row jsonb;
  v_item public.items%rowtype;
  v_length numeric(12,3);
  v_width numeric(12,3);
  v_height numeric(12,3);
  v_unit text;
  v_display_length numeric;
  v_display_width numeric;
  v_display_height numeric;
  v_updated integer := 0;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 then
    raise exception 'No dimension changes supplied';
  end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(p_rows) > 250 then
    raise exception 'A maximum of 250 item dimensions can be saved at once';
  end if;

  for v_row in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  loop
    v_length := nullif(v_row->>'length_mm', '')::numeric;
    v_width := nullif(v_row->>'width_mm', '')::numeric;
    v_height := nullif(v_row->>'height_mm', '')::numeric;
    v_unit := case upper(coalesce(nullif(v_row->>'dimension_unit', ''), 'MM'))
      when 'IN' then 'INCH' when 'INCHES' then 'INCH' when 'INCH' then 'INCH' when 'CM' then 'CM' else 'MM' end;

    if coalesce(v_length, 0) <= 0 or coalesce(v_width, 0) <= 0 then
      raise exception 'Positive length and width are required for %', v_row->>'item_code';
    end if;

    select * into v_item from public.items where item_code = trim(v_row->>'item_code') for update;
    if v_item.id is null then raise exception 'Item not found: %', v_row->>'item_code'; end if;

    insert into public.item_dimension_audit (
      item_code, old_length_mm, old_width_mm, old_height_mm, old_dimension_unit,
      new_length_mm, new_width_mm, new_height_mm, new_dimension_unit, changed_by
    ) values (
      v_item.item_code, v_item.length_mm, v_item.width_mm, v_item.height_mm, v_item.dimension_unit,
      v_length, v_width, v_height, v_unit, p_updated_by
    );

    update public.items set
      length_mm = v_length, width_mm = v_width, height_mm = v_height, dimension_unit = v_unit
    where id = v_item.id;

    v_display_length := case v_unit when 'INCH' then round(v_length / 25.4, 3) when 'CM' then round(v_length / 10, 3) else v_length end;
    v_display_width := case v_unit when 'INCH' then round(v_width / 25.4, 3) when 'CM' then round(v_width / 10, 3) else v_width end;
    v_display_height := case when v_height is null then null when v_unit = 'INCH' then round(v_height / 25.4, 3) when v_unit = 'CM' then round(v_height / 10, 3) else v_height end;

    update public.item_bom_revisions
    set item_info_json = coalesce(item_info_json, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
      'dimensionUom', v_unit,
      'length', v_display_length,
      'width', v_display_width,
      'height', v_display_height,
      'dims', concat_ws('x', v_display_length::text, v_display_width::text, v_display_height::text)
    ), updated_by = p_updated_by
    where item_code = v_item.item_code and is_current = true;

    v_updated := v_updated + 1;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'updated', v_updated);
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 759 (class 1255 OID 216171)
-- Name: consume_purchase_rate_override(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.consume_purchase_rate_override(p_id uuid, p_consumed_ref text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  claimed jsonb;
begin
  update public.purchase_rate_override_approvals p
  set status = 'CONSUMED',
      consumed_at = now(),
      consumed_ref = coalesce(p_consumed_ref, ''),
      updated_at = now()
  where p.id = p_id
    and p.status = 'APPROVED'
    and p.consumed_at is null
  returning to_jsonb(p) into claimed;

  if claimed is null then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override is not approved or was already consumed';
  end if;

  return claimed;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 776 (class 1255 OID 217293)
-- Name: consume_work_order_stock_reservation(text, text, uuid, numeric, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.consume_work_order_stock_reservation(p_wo_number text, p_material_key text, p_item_id uuid, p_qty numeric, p_actor text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS numeric
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_row inventory_reservations%rowtype;
  v_after numeric;
begin
  select * into v_row
    from inventory_reservations
   where wo_number = trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, ''))
     and material_key = trim(coalesce(p_material_key, ''))
     and item_id = p_item_id
     and location = 'MAIN'
     and status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED')
   for update;
  if v_row.id is null then return 0; end if;

  v_after := greatest(v_row.reserved_qty - greatest(coalesce(p_qty, 0), 0), 0);
  update inventory_reservations
     set reserved_qty = v_after,
         status = case when v_after > 0 then 'PARTIALLY_ISSUED' else 'FULFILLED' end,
         updated_by = p_actor,
         updated_at = now()
   where id = v_row.id;

  insert into inventory_reservation_audit (
    reservation_id, wo_number, work_order_material_id, material_key, item_id,
    location, action, before_qty, after_qty, changed_qty, reason, changed_by
  ) values (
    v_row.id, v_row.wo_number, v_row.work_order_material_id, v_row.material_key, v_row.item_id,
    v_row.location, 'CONSUME_ON_ISSUE', v_row.reserved_qty, v_after,
    v_after - v_row.reserved_qty, 'Consumed by Stores material issue', p_actor
  );
  return v_after;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 829 (class 1255 OID 74086)
-- Name: create_item_bom_revision(text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.create_item_bom_revision(p_item_code text, p_created_by text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_revision_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS uuid
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_current public.item_bom_revisions%rowtype;
  v_new_id uuid;
  v_next_revision integer;
begin
  select *
    into v_current
    from public.item_bom_revisions
   where item_code = p_item_code
     and is_current = true
   limit 1;

  select coalesce(max(revision_no), 0) + 1
    into v_next_revision
    from public.item_bom_revisions
   where item_code = p_item_code;

  insert into public.item_bom_revisions (
    item_code,
    revision_no,
    status,
    is_current,
    bom_basis,
    base_quantity,
    output_quantity,
    output_uom,
    revision_reason,
    change_summary,
    item_info_json,
    source_revision_id,
    created_by,
    updated_by
  )
  values (
    p_item_code,
    v_next_revision,
    'DRAFT',
    false,
    coalesce(v_current.bom_basis, 'PER_UNIT'),
    coalesce(v_current.base_quantity, 1),
    coalesce(v_current.output_quantity, 1),
    coalesce(v_current.output_uom, 'NOS'),
    p_revision_reason,
    null,
    coalesce(v_current.item_info_json, '{}'::jsonb),
    v_current.id,
    p_created_by,
    p_created_by
  )
  returning id into v_new_id;

  if v_current.id is not null then
    insert into public.item_bom_materials (
      revision_id,
      line_no,
      material_type,
      material_group,
      material_item_code,
      material_name,
      qty_per_unit,
      uom,
      wastage_pct,
      gsm,
      deckle_mm,
      cut_size_mm,
      flute,
      ply_no,
      remarks,
      extra_json,
      created_by,
      updated_by
    )
    select
      v_new_id,
      line_no,
      material_type,
      material_group,
      material_item_code,
      material_name,
      qty_per_unit,
      uom,
      wastage_pct,
      gsm,
      deckle_mm,
      cut_size_mm,
      flute,
      ply_no,
      remarks,
      extra_json,
      p_created_by,
      p_created_by
    from public.item_bom_materials
    where revision_id = v_current.id;

    insert into public.item_bom_routing (
      revision_id,
      sequence_no,
      department,
      operation_name,
      machine_name,
      setup_time_min,
      run_time_min,
      standard_rate_qty_per_hour,
      outsource,
      remarks,
      extra_json,
      created_by,
      updated_by
    )
    select
      v_new_id,
      sequence_no,
      department,
      operation_name,
      machine_name,
      setup_time_min,
      run_time_min,
      standard_rate_qty_per_hour,
      outsource,
      remarks,
      extra_json,
      p_created_by,
      p_created_by
    from public.item_bom_routing
    where revision_id = v_current.id;
  end if;

  return v_new_id;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 696 (class 1255 OID 218111)
-- Name: decide_purchase_rate_override(uuid, text, text, text, text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.decide_purchase_rate_override(p_id uuid, p_decision text, p_remarks text, p_decided_by text, p_decided_by_user_id text, p_valid_days integer) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  request_row public.purchase_rate_override_approvals%rowtype;
  decision text := upper(trim(coalesce(p_decision, '')));
  valid_days integer := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_valid_days, 3), 30));
begin
  if decision not in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') then
    raise exception 'Decision must be APPROVED or REJECTED';
  end if;
  if trim(coalesce(p_remarks, '')) = '' then
    raise exception 'Approval or rejection remarks are required';
  end if;

  select * into request_row
  from public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
  where id = p_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Purchase rate override request not found';
  end if;
  if request_row.status <> 'PENDING' then
    raise exception 'This request was already decided by another user';
  end if;
  if nullif(trim(request_row.requested_by_user_id), '') is not null
     and trim(request_row.requested_by_user_id) = trim(coalesce(p_decided_by_user_id, '')) then
    raise exception 'You cannot approve or reject your own purchase rate override request';
  end if;

  if request_row.context_type = 'PO_RATE' and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.inv_purchase_requests pr
    where pr.pr_no = request_row.pr_no
      and upper(coalesce(pr.status, '')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'SHORT_CLOSED')
      and upper(trim(coalesce(pr.item_code, ''))) = upper(trim(request_row.item_code))
  ) then
    update public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
    set status = 'STALE',
        stale_reason = 'Purchase request is missing, closed for ordering, or no longer matches the item',
        updated_at = now()
    where id = p_id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'status', 'STALE', 'message', 'Purchase request is no longer valid for this override');
  end if;

  if request_row.context_type = 'GRN_RATE' and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.purchase_order_lines pol
    join public.purchase_orders po on po.id = pol.po_id
    where pol.id = request_row.po_line_id
      and pol.po_no = request_row.po_no
      and upper(coalesce(po.status, '')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'SHORT_CLOSED')
      and upper(trim(pol.item_code)) = upper(trim(request_row.item_code))
      and (
        trim(request_row.vendor_id) = ''
        or po.vendor_id::text = trim(request_row.vendor_id)
      )
  ) then
    update public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
    set status = 'STALE',
        stale_reason = 'Purchase order or line is no longer valid for receipt',
        updated_at = now()
    where id = p_id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'status', 'STALE', 'message', 'Purchase order line is no longer valid for this override');
  end if;

  update public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
  set
    status = decision,
    approval_remarks = trim(p_remarks),
    decided_by = trim(coalesce(p_decided_by, '')),
    decided_by_user_id = trim(coalesce(p_decided_by_user_id, '')),
    decided_at = now(),
    expires_at = case when decision = 'APPROVED' then now() + make_interval(days => valid_days) else null end,
    updated_at = now()
  where id = p_id
    and status = 'PENDING'
  returning * into request_row;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'This request was already decided by another user';
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'status', request_row.status, 'request', to_jsonb(request_row));
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 762 (class 1255 OID 173723)
-- Name: delete_work_order_with_audit(text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.delete_work_order_with_audit(p_wo_number text, p_deleted_by text DEFAULT ''::text, p_reason text DEFAULT ''::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $_$
declare
  v_wo public.work_orders%rowtype;
  v_audit_id uuid;
  v_so_numbers text[] := array[]::text[];
  v_jobs jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_materials jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_routing jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_production_entries jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_inventory_reservations jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_linked_samples jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select *
  into v_wo
  from public.work_orders
  where wo_number = trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, ''))
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Work Order not found: %', p_wo_number;
  end if;

  if public.work_order_has_open_material_issue(v_wo.wo_number) then
    raise exception 'Work order % cannot be deleted because material is still net issued against it.', v_wo.wo_number;
  end if;

  select
    coalesce(array_agg(distinct woj.so_number) filter (where coalesce(woj.so_number, '') <> ''), array[]::text[]),
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(woj) order by woj.line_no, woj.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_so_numbers, v_jobs
  from public.work_order_jobs woj
  where woj.wo_id = v_wo.id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(wom) order by wom.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_materials
  from public.work_order_materials wom
  where wom.wo_id = v_wo.id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(wor) order by wor.sequence_no, wor.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_routing
  from public.work_order_routing wor
  where wor.wo_id = v_wo.id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pe) order by pe.created_at, pe.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_production_entries
  from public.production_entries pe
  where pe.wo_id = v_wo.id;

  if to_regclass('public.inventory_reservations') is not null then
    execute
      'select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ir)), ''[]''::jsonb)
       from public.inventory_reservations ir
       where ir.reference_type = ''WORK_ORDER'' and ir.reference_no = $1'
      into v_inventory_reservations
      using v_wo.wo_number;
  end if;

  if to_regclass('public.npd_sample_work_orders') is not null then
    execute
      'select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(nsw)), ''[]''::jsonb)
       from public.npd_sample_work_orders nsw
       where nsw.linked_wo_id = $1'
      into v_linked_samples
      using v_wo.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.work_order_deletion_audit_log (
    wo_id,
    wo_number,
    wo_date,
    wo_status,
    work_order_type,
    deleted_by,
    deletion_reason,
    deletion_status,
    deleted_data,
    so_numbers
  )
  values (
    v_wo.id,
    v_wo.wo_number,
    v_wo.wo_date,
    v_wo.status,
    coalesce(v_wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,type}', ''),
    trim(coalesce(p_deleted_by, '')),
    trim(coalesce(p_reason, '')),
    'PENDING',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'work_order', to_jsonb(v_wo),
      'jobs', v_jobs,
      'materials', v_materials,
      'routing', v_routing,
      'production_entries', v_production_entries,
      'inventory_reservations', v_inventory_reservations,
      'linked_sample_work_orders', v_linked_samples
    ),
    v_so_numbers
  )
  returning id into v_audit_id;

  if to_regclass('public.inventory_reservations') is not null then
    execute
      'delete from public.inventory_reservations
       where reference_type = ''WORK_ORDER'' and reference_no = $1'
      using v_wo.wo_number;
  end if;

  delete from public.work_order_routing where wo_id = v_wo.id;
  delete from public.work_order_materials where wo_id = v_wo.id;
  delete from public.work_order_jobs where wo_id = v_wo.id;
  delete from public.work_orders where id = v_wo.id;

  update public.work_order_deletion_audit_log
  set deletion_status = 'COMPLETED',
      completed_at = now()
  where id = v_audit_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'woNo', v_wo.wo_number,
    'auditId', v_audit_id,
    'soNumbers', to_jsonb(v_so_numbers)
  );
end;
$_$;

--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.delete_work_order_with_audit(p_wo_number text, p_deleted_by text, p_reason text) IS 'Blocks deletion while material is still net issued and atomically archives all work order data before deletion.';


--
-- TOC entry 882 (class 1255 OID 187447)
-- Name: enforce_artwork_approval_requires_so_approval(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.enforce_artwork_approval_requires_so_approval() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_status_changed boolean := false;
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    v_status_changed := true;
  elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    v_status_changed :=
      upper(coalesce(old.status, '')) is distinct from upper(coalesce(new.status, ''));
  end if;

  if upper(coalesce(new.status, '')) = 'APPROVED'
     and nullif(btrim(new.artwork_no), '') is not null
     and new.so_id is not null
     and new.line_no is not null
     and v_status_changed then
    if not exists (
      select 1
      from public.sales_order_lines sol
      where sol.so_id = new.so_id
        and sol.line_no = new.line_no
        and upper(coalesce(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING')) = 'APPROVED'
        and upper(coalesce(sol.business_status, 'PENDING')) = 'APPROVED'
    ) then
      raise exception
        'Cannot approve artwork before linked sales order line has both Accounts and Business approval.';
    end if;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 771 (class 1255 OID 233459)
-- Name: enforce_corrugation_reel_work_order_assignment(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.enforce_corrugation_reel_work_order_assignment() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_assigned_wo text;
begin
  if new.liner_reel_lot_id is not null then
    select c.wo_no into v_assigned_wo
    from public.inv_lots l
    join public.inv_reel_issue_cycles c
      on c.id = l.current_issue_cycle_id
     and c.lot_id = l.id
     and c.status = 'ACTIVE'
    where l.id = new.liner_reel_lot_id
      and l.is_reel is true
      and l.reel_status = 'ISSUED'
      and upper(coalesce(l.location, '')) = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR'
      and c.custody_scope = 'WORK_ORDER'
      and c.wo_id = new.wo_id
      and c.id = coalesce(new.liner_issue_cycle_id, c.id);
    if not found then
      select assigned_wo_no into v_assigned_wo
      from public.inv_lots where id = new.liner_reel_lot_id;
      raise exception 'Liner reel is assigned to WO %. Stores must return or assign it to this work order before production entry',
        coalesce(nullif(v_assigned_wo, ''), '(unassigned)');
    end if;
  end if;

  if new.fluting_reel_lot_id is not null then
    select c.wo_no into v_assigned_wo
    from public.inv_lots l
    join public.inv_reel_issue_cycles c
      on c.id = l.current_issue_cycle_id
     and c.lot_id = l.id
     and c.status = 'ACTIVE'
    where l.id = new.fluting_reel_lot_id
      and l.is_reel is true
      and l.reel_status = 'ISSUED'
      and upper(coalesce(l.location, '')) = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR'
      and c.custody_scope = 'WORK_ORDER'
      and c.wo_id = new.wo_id
      and c.id = coalesce(new.fluting_issue_cycle_id, c.id);
    if not found then
      select assigned_wo_no into v_assigned_wo
      from public.inv_lots where id = new.fluting_reel_lot_id;
      raise exception 'Fluting reel is assigned to WO %. Stores must return or assign it to this work order before production entry',
        coalesce(nullif(v_assigned_wo, ''), '(unassigned)');
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 845 (class 1255 OID 187449)
-- Name: enforce_so_approval_locked_after_artwork_approval(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.enforce_so_approval_locked_after_artwork_approval() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if (
       (
         upper(coalesce(old.accounts_status, 'PENDING')) = 'APPROVED'
         and upper(coalesce(new.accounts_status, 'PENDING')) <> 'APPROVED'
       )
       or (
         upper(coalesce(old.business_status, 'PENDING')) = 'APPROVED'
         and upper(coalesce(new.business_status, 'PENDING')) <> 'APPROVED'
       )
     )
     and exists (
       select 1
       from public.artworks a
       where a.so_id = new.so_id
         and a.line_no = new.line_no
         and upper(coalesce(a.status, '')) = 'APPROVED'
         and nullif(btrim(a.artwork_no), '') is not null
     ) then
    raise exception
      'Cannot hold or unapprove sales order line because artwork is already approved.';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 797 (class 1255 OID 125946)
-- Name: ensure_artwork_row_for_sales_order_line_trg(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.ensure_artwork_row_for_sales_order_line_trg() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_order_status text := 'OPEN';
  v_order_prefix text := '';
  v_sales_type text := '';
  v_item_code text := upper(trim(coalesce(new.product_code, '')));
  v_category text := upper(trim(coalesce(new.category, '')));
  v_hsn_group text := upper(trim(coalesce(new.hsn_group, '')));
  v_product_name text := upper(trim(coalesce(new.product_name, '')));
begin
  if new.so_id is null or new.line_no is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  select
    upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')),
    upper(coalesce(so.order_prefix, '')),
    upper(coalesce(so.sales_type, ''))
  into
    v_order_status,
    v_order_prefix,
    v_sales_type
  from public.sales_orders so
  where so.id = new.so_id;

  if coalesce(v_order_status, 'OPEN') in ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') then
    return new;
  end if;

  if upper(coalesce(new.status, 'OPEN')) in ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') then
    return new;
  end if;

  if v_order_prefix = 'MB' or v_sales_type = 'MANUAL_BILLING' then
    return new;
  end if;

  if v_item_code in ('SLC001', 'SLC002', 'SLC003')
     or v_category in ('FLEXO PRINTING PLATE', 'OFFSET PRINTING PLATE', 'DIE')
     or v_hsn_group in ('FLEXO PRINTING PLATE', 'OFFSET PRINTING PLATE', 'DIE')
     or v_product_name in ('FLEXO PRINTING PLATE', 'OFFSET PRINTING PLATE', 'DIE') then
    return new;
  end if;

  insert into public.artworks (
    so_id,
    line_no,
    artwork_no,
    product_type,
    plate_status,
    die_status,
    status,
    sheet_length,
    sheet_width,
    sheet_ups,
    printing_colors
  )
  select
    new.so_id,
    new.line_no,
    null,
    coalesce(new.category, ''),
    'PENDING',
    'PENDING',
    'NO_ART',
    null,
    null,
    null,
    null
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from public.artworks a
    where a.so_id = new.so_id
      and a.line_no::text = new.line_no::text
  );

  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 668 (class 1255 OID 234257)
-- Name: fg_stock_period_report(date, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.fg_stock_period_report(p_from_date date, p_to_date date) RETURNS TABLE(row_id text, source_type text, pack_id uuid, opening_id uuid, so_id uuid, so_line_id uuid, so_number text, line_no text, client_code text, client_name text, product_code text, product_name text, uom text, stock_date timestamp with time zone, remarks text, opening_qty numeric, inward_qty numeric, billing_qty numeric, adjustment_qty numeric, outward_qty numeric, closing_qty numeric, billed_qty numeric, billable_qty numeric, unit_rate_ex_gst numeric, gst_pct numeric, unit_rate_inc_gst numeric, opening_value_ex_gst numeric, opening_gst_value numeric, opening_value_inc_gst numeric, inward_value_ex_gst numeric, outward_value_ex_gst numeric, closing_value_ex_gst numeric, closing_gst_value numeric, closing_value_inc_gst numeric)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
with bounds as (
  select coalesce(p_from_date, current_date) as from_date,
         greatest(coalesce(p_to_date, current_date), coalesce(p_from_date, current_date)) as to_date
),
pack_events as (
  select pel.so_line_id,
         (array_agg(pel.pack_id order by pel.posted_at desc, pel.id desc)
           filter (where pel.pack_id is not null))[1] as pack_id,
         min(pel.posted_at) as first_stock_at,
         sum(pel.packed_qty) filter (
           where (pel.posted_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date < b.from_date
         ) as qty_before,
         sum(pel.packed_qty) filter (
           where (pel.posted_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date between b.from_date and b.to_date
         ) as qty_period
  from public.packing_entry_log pel cross join bounds b
  where pel.so_line_id is not null
    and (pel.posted_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date <= b.to_date
  group by pel.so_line_id
),
pack_fallback as (
  select pr.so_line_id,
         (array_agg(pr.id order by pr.packed_at desc nulls last, pr.created_at desc, pr.id desc))[1] as pack_id,
         min(pr.packed_at) at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata' as first_stock_at,
         sum(pr.packed_qty) filter (where pr.packed_at::date < b.from_date) as qty_before,
         sum(pr.packed_qty) filter (where pr.packed_at::date between b.from_date and b.to_date) as qty_period
  from public.packing_records pr cross join bounds b
  where pr.so_line_id is not null
    and pr.packed_at::date <= b.to_date
    and not exists (select 1 from public.packing_entry_log pel where pel.so_line_id = pr.so_line_id)
  group by pr.so_line_id
),
packed_in as (
  select * from pack_events
  union all
  select * from pack_fallback
),
billing_events as (
  select il.so_line_id, i.invoice_date as movement_date, coalesce(il.qty,0) as qty
  from public.invoice_lines il
  join public.invoices i on i.id = il.invoice_id
  where il.so_line_id is not null
    and upper(coalesce(i.status,'')) <> 'CANCELLED'
  union all
  select anl.so_line_id, an.note_date as movement_date, -coalesce(anl.rebill_release_qty,0) as qty
  from public.billing_adjustment_note_lines anl
  join public.billing_adjustment_notes an on an.id = anl.note_id
  where anl.so_line_id is not null
    and upper(coalesce(an.status,'')) = 'POSTED'
    and upper(coalesce(an.note_type,'')) = 'CREDIT_NOTE'
    and coalesce(anl.rebill_release_qty,0) > 0
),
billings as (
  select be.so_line_id,
         sum(be.qty) filter (where be.movement_date < b.from_date) as qty_before,
         sum(be.qty) filter (where be.movement_date between b.from_date and b.to_date) as qty_period
  from billing_events be cross join bounds b
  where be.movement_date <= b.to_date
  group by be.so_line_id
),
packed_adjustments as (
  select fa.so_line_id,
         sum(coalesce(fa.adjustment_qty,0)) filter (
           where (fa.adjustment_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date < b.from_date
         ) as qty_before,
         sum(coalesce(fa.adjustment_qty,0)) filter (
           where (fa.adjustment_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date between b.from_date and b.to_date
         ) as qty_period
  from public.fg_stock_adjustments fa cross join bounds b
  where upper(fa.source_type) = 'PACKED'
    and fa.so_line_id is not null
    and (fa.adjustment_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date <= b.to_date
  group by fa.so_line_id
),
packed_base as (
  select
    'PACKED::' || pi.so_line_id::text as row_id,
    'PACKED'::text as source_type,
    pi.pack_id,
    null::uuid as opening_id,
    sol.so_id,
    sol.id as so_line_id,
    so.so_number,
    sol.line_no::text,
    so.client_code,
    coalesce(c.client_name,so.client_code) as client_name,
    sol.product_code,
    sol.product_name,
    coalesce(sol.unit,'Pcs') as uom,
    pi.first_stock_at as stock_date,
    coalesce(sol.product_remarks,'') as remarks,
    greatest(coalesce(pi.qty_before,0)-coalesce(bl.qty_before,0)-coalesce(a.qty_before,0),0) as opening_qty,
    coalesce(pi.qty_period,0) as inward_qty,
    coalesce(bl.qty_period,0) as billing_qty,
    coalesce(a.qty_period,0) as adjustment_qty,
    coalesce(bl.qty_period,0)+coalesce(a.qty_period,0) as outward_qty,
    greatest(coalesce(pi.qty_before,0)+coalesce(pi.qty_period,0)-coalesce(bl.qty_before,0)-coalesce(bl.qty_period,0)-coalesce(a.qty_before,0)-coalesce(a.qty_period,0),0) as closing_qty,
    coalesce(bl.qty_before,0)+coalesce(bl.qty_period,0) as billed_qty,
    greatest(coalesce(pi.qty_before,0)+coalesce(pi.qty_period,0)-coalesce(bl.qty_before,0)-coalesce(bl.qty_period,0)-coalesce(a.qty_before,0)-coalesce(a.qty_period,0),0) as billable_qty,
    case when coalesce(sol.qty,0) <> 0 and sol.net_amount is not null
      then coalesce(sol.net_amount,0)/sol.qty
      else coalesce(sol.rate,0)*(1-coalesce(sol.disc_pct,0)/100) end as unit_rate_ex_gst,
    coalesce(sol.gst_pct,0) as gst_pct
  from packed_in pi
  join public.sales_order_lines sol on sol.id = pi.so_line_id
  left join public.sales_orders so on so.id = sol.so_id
  left join public.clients c on c.client_code = so.client_code
  left join billings bl on bl.so_line_id = pi.so_line_id
  left join packed_adjustments a on a.so_line_id = pi.so_line_id
),
opening_dispatches as (
  select od.opening_id,
         sum(coalesce(od.dispatch_qty,0)) filter (
           where (od.dispatch_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date < b.from_date
         ) as qty_before,
         sum(coalesce(od.dispatch_qty,0)) filter (
           where (od.dispatch_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date between b.from_date and b.to_date
         ) as qty_period
  from public.fg_opening_dispatch_entries od cross join bounds b
  where (od.dispatch_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date <= b.to_date
  group by od.opening_id
),
opening_adjustments as (
  select fa.opening_id,
         sum(coalesce(fa.adjustment_qty,0)) filter (
           where (fa.adjustment_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date < b.from_date
         ) as qty_before,
         sum(coalesce(fa.adjustment_qty,0)) filter (
           where (fa.adjustment_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date between b.from_date and b.to_date
         ) as qty_period
  from public.fg_stock_adjustments fa cross join bounds b
  where upper(fa.source_type) = 'OPENING'
    and fa.opening_id is not null
    and (fa.adjustment_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date <= b.to_date
  group by fa.opening_id
),
opening_base as (
  select
    'OPENING::' || os.id::text as row_id,
    'OPENING'::text as source_type,
    null::uuid as pack_id,
    os.id as opening_id,
    null::uuid as so_id,
    null::uuid as so_line_id,
    ''::text as so_number,
    ''::text as line_no,
    os.client_code,
    coalesce(os.client_name,os.client_code) as client_name,
    os.product_code,
    os.product_name,
    coalesce(os.uom,'Pcs') as uom,
    os.opening_date as stock_date,
    coalesce(os.remarks,'') as remarks,
    case when (os.opening_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date < b.from_date
      then greatest(coalesce(os.opening_qty,0)-coalesce(od.qty_before,0)-coalesce(oa.qty_before,0),0) else 0 end as opening_qty,
    case when (os.opening_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date between b.from_date and b.to_date
      then coalesce(os.opening_qty,0) else 0 end as inward_qty,
    0::numeric as billing_qty,
    coalesce(oa.qty_period,0) as adjustment_qty,
    coalesce(od.qty_period,0)+coalesce(oa.qty_period,0) as outward_qty,
    greatest(
      case when (os.opening_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date < b.from_date then coalesce(os.opening_qty,0) else 0 end
      + case when (os.opening_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date between b.from_date and b.to_date then coalesce(os.opening_qty,0) else 0 end
      - coalesce(od.qty_before,0)-coalesce(od.qty_period,0)-coalesce(oa.qty_before,0)-coalesce(oa.qty_period,0),0
    ) as closing_qty,
    0::numeric as billed_qty,
    greatest(
      case when (os.opening_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date <= b.to_date then coalesce(os.opening_qty,0) else 0 end
      - coalesce(od.qty_before,0)-coalesce(od.qty_period,0)-coalesce(oa.qty_before,0)-coalesce(oa.qty_period,0),0
    ) as billable_qty,
    coalesce(os.unit_rate_ex_gst,0) as unit_rate_ex_gst,
    coalesce(os.gst_pct,0) as gst_pct
  from public.fg_opening_stock os cross join bounds b
  left join opening_dispatches od on od.opening_id = os.id
  left join opening_adjustments oa on oa.opening_id = os.id
  where (os.opening_date at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date <= b.to_date
),
base as (
  select * from packed_base
  union all
  select * from opening_base
)
select
  b.row_id,b.source_type,b.pack_id,b.opening_id,b.so_id,b.so_line_id,b.so_number,b.line_no,
  b.client_code,b.client_name,b.product_code,b.product_name,b.uom,b.stock_date,b.remarks,
  round(b.opening_qty,3),round(b.inward_qty,3),round(b.billing_qty,3),round(b.adjustment_qty,3),
  round(b.outward_qty,3),round(b.closing_qty,3),round(b.billed_qty,3),round(b.billable_qty,3),
  round(b.unit_rate_ex_gst,4),round(b.gst_pct,2),round(b.unit_rate_ex_gst*(1+b.gst_pct/100),4),
  round(b.opening_qty*b.unit_rate_ex_gst,2),round(b.opening_qty*b.unit_rate_ex_gst*b.gst_pct/100,2),
  round(b.opening_qty*b.unit_rate_ex_gst*(1+b.gst_pct/100),2),
  round(b.inward_qty*b.unit_rate_ex_gst,2),round(b.outward_qty*b.unit_rate_ex_gst,2),
  round(b.closing_qty*b.unit_rate_ex_gst,2),round(b.closing_qty*b.unit_rate_ex_gst*b.gst_pct/100,2),
  round(b.closing_qty*b.unit_rate_ex_gst*(1+b.gst_pct/100),2)
from base b;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 680 (class 1255 OID 231728)
-- Name: finalize_floor_legacy_reel_alignment(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.finalize_floor_legacy_reel_alignment() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
      begin
        update public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details
        set liner_reel_lot_id = new.lot_id,
            liner_issue_cycle_id = new.issue_cycle_id
        where upper(trim(coalesce(liner_reel_no, ''))) = new.internal_reel_no
          and upper(trim(coalesce(liner_actual_item_code, ''))) = upper(trim(new.item_code))
          and liner_reel_lot_id is null;

        update public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details
        set fluting_reel_lot_id = new.lot_id,
            fluting_issue_cycle_id = new.issue_cycle_id
        where upper(trim(coalesce(fluting_reel_no, ''))) = new.internal_reel_no
          and upper(trim(coalesce(fluting_actual_item_code, ''))) = upper(trim(new.item_code))
          and fluting_reel_lot_id is null;

        update public.inv_legacy_reel_alignment_requests
        set status = 'ALIGNED',
            aligned_lot_id = new.lot_id,
            aligned_issue_cycle_id = new.issue_cycle_id,
            resolved_by = coalesce(nullif(trim(new.actor), ''), resolved_by),
            resolved_at = coalesce(resolved_at, now()),
            resolution_note = coalesce(resolution_note, new.alignment_note)
        where status = 'PENDING'
          and internal_reel_no = new.internal_reel_no
          and item_id = new.item_id;
        return new;
      end;
      $$;

--
-- TOC entry 858 (class 1255 OID 162663)
-- Name: generate_npd_sample_wo_no(text, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.generate_npd_sample_wo_no(p_prefix text DEFAULT 'SMP-WO'::text, p_request_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE) RETURNS text
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_prefix text := coalesce(nullif(trim(p_prefix), ''), 'SMP-WO');
  v_date date := coalesce(p_request_date, current_date);
  v_fy_start integer;
  v_fy text;
  v_next integer;
begin
  if extract(month from v_date) >= 4 then
    v_fy_start := extract(year from v_date)::integer;
  else
    v_fy_start := extract(year from v_date)::integer - 1;
  end if;

  v_fy := right(v_fy_start::text, 2) || '-' || right((v_fy_start + 1)::text, 2);

  insert into public.npd_sequences(prefix, fy, last_no)
  values (v_prefix, v_fy, 0)
  on conflict (prefix, fy) do nothing;

  update public.npd_sequences
     set last_no = last_no + 1,
         updated_at = now()
   where prefix = v_prefix
     and fy = v_fy
   returning last_no into v_next;

  return v_prefix || lpad(v_next::text, 4, '0') || '_' || v_fy;
end;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 695 (class 1255 OID 18858)
-- Name: generate_so_number(text, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.generate_so_number(prefix text, so_date date) RETURNS text
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  fy text;
  seq bigint;
begin
  fy :=
    case
      when extract(month from so_date) >= 4
      then to_char(so_date, 'YY') || '_' || to_char(so_date + interval '1 year', 'YY')
      else to_char(so_date - interval '1 year', 'YY') || '_' || to_char(so_date, 'YY')
    end;

  if prefix = 'SL' then
    seq := nextval('so_seq_sl');
  else
    seq := nextval('so_seq_m');
  end if;

  return prefix || lpad(seq::text, 6, '0') || '_' || fy;
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 833 (class 1255 OID 33452)
-- Name: generate_so_number(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.generate_so_number(p_prefix text, p_fy text) RETURNS TABLE(so_number text)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  next_no integer;
begin
  -- Ensure sequence row exists
  insert into invoice_sequences(prefix, fy, last_no)
  values (p_prefix, p_fy, 0)
  on conflict (prefix) do nothing;

  -- Increment and fetch
  update invoice_sequences
  set last_no = last_no + 1
  where prefix = p_prefix
  returning last_no into next_no;

  -- Build SO number
  so_number := p_prefix || '/' || p_fy || '/' || lpad(next_no::text, 6, '0');

  return next;
end;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 677 (class 1255 OID 21160)
-- Name: get_next_invoice_no(text, date); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.get_next_invoice_no(p_prefix text, p_invoice_date date) RETURNS text
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_fy text;
  v_next integer;
begin
  if extract(month from p_invoice_date) >= 4 then
    v_fy := to_char(p_invoice_date, 'YY') || '-' || to_char(p_invoice_date + interval '1 year', 'YY');
  else
    v_fy := to_char(p_invoice_date - interval '1 year', 'YY') || '-' || to_char(p_invoice_date, 'YY');
  end if;

  insert into public.invoice_sequences (fy, prefix, last_no)
  values (v_fy, p_prefix, 0)
  on conflict (prefix) do update
  set
    fy = excluded.fy,
    last_no = case
      when public.invoice_sequences.fy = excluded.fy then public.invoice_sequences.last_no
      else 0
    end;

  update public.invoice_sequences
  set last_no = last_no + 1
  where fy = v_fy
    and prefix = p_prefix
  returning last_no into v_next;

  if upper(coalesce(p_prefix, '')) = 'DI-H' then
    return p_prefix || '/' || v_fy || '/' || lpad(v_next::text, 4, '0');
  end if;

  return p_prefix || '/' || v_fy || '/' || v_next;
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 789 (class 1255 OID 46979)
-- Name: inv_avg_rate(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_avg_rate(p_item_id uuid, p_location text) RETURNS numeric
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  select
    case
      when sum(qty_in) = 0 then 0
      else sum(value)/sum(qty_in)
    end
  from inv_ledger
  where item_id = p_item_id
    and (p_location is null or location = p_location);
$$;

-- TOC entry 925 (class 1255 OID 205709)
-- Name: inv_record_wo_excess_issue_review(text, text, text, numeric, numeric, numeric, numeric, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_record_wo_excess_issue_review(p_wo_no text, p_material_key text, p_action_type text, p_excess_qty numeric DEFAULT 0, p_excess_pct numeric DEFAULT 0, p_required_qty numeric DEFAULT 0, p_net_issued_qty numeric DEFAULT 0, p_remarks text DEFAULT ''::text, p_reviewed_by text DEFAULT ''::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_action text := upper(trim(coalesce(p_action_type, '')));
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if trim(coalesce(p_wo_no, '')) = '' then
    raise exception 'WO number is required.';
  end if;

  if trim(coalesce(p_material_key, '')) = '' then
    raise exception 'Material key is required.';
  end if;

  if v_action not in ('ROUNDING_WRITE_OFF', 'REISSUE_REJECTION', 'RETURN_REQUIRED', 'COMMENT') then
    raise exception 'Invalid review action: %', p_action_type;
  end if;

  if v_action = 'ROUNDING_WRITE_OFF' and coalesce(p_excess_pct, 0::numeric) > 5.0001 then
    raise exception 'Write off is allowed only up to 5 percent excess. Current excess is % percent.', round(coalesce(p_excess_pct, 0::numeric), 2);
  end if;

  if v_action in ('ROUNDING_WRITE_OFF', 'REISSUE_REJECTION') and trim(coalesce(p_remarks, '')) = '' then
    raise exception 'Remarks are required for this review action.';
  end if;

  insert into public.inv_wo_excess_issue_reviews (
    wo_no,
    material_key,
    action_type,
    excess_qty_snapshot,
    excess_pct_snapshot,
    required_qty_snapshot,
    net_issued_qty_snapshot,
    remarks,
    reviewed_by
  )
  values (
    trim(coalesce(p_wo_no, '')),
    trim(coalesce(p_material_key, '')),
    v_action,
    round(coalesce(p_excess_qty, 0::numeric), 4),
    round(coalesce(p_excess_pct, 0::numeric), 4),
    round(coalesce(p_required_qty, 0::numeric), 4),
    round(coalesce(p_net_issued_qty, 0::numeric), 4),
    trim(coalesce(p_remarks, '')),
    trim(coalesce(p_reviewed_by, ''))
  )
  returning id into v_id;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'reviewId', v_id);
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 867 (class 1255 OID 192356)
-- Name: inv_replenishment_snapshot_ui(text, text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_replenishment_snapshot_ui(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_alert text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT NULL::integer) RETURNS TABLE(item_id text, item_code text, item_name text, category text, department text, uom text, location text, is_active boolean, stock_managed boolean, is_consumable boolean, integer_uom boolean, manual_lead_time_days numeric, effective_lead_time_days numeric, moq_qty numeric, consumption_window_days integer, total_consumption_qty numeric, avg_daily_consumption numeric, safety_factor numeric, minimum_stock_level numeric, current_stock_qty numeric, open_pr_qty numeric, open_po_qty numeric, pipeline_qty numeric, reserved_qty numeric, net_available_qty numeric, shortage_qty numeric, suggested_pr_qty numeric, alert_level text, can_create_pr boolean, existing_pr_nos text, existing_po_nos text, reason text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  select
    r.item_id,
    r.item_code,
    r.item_name,
    r.category,
    r.department,
    r.uom,
    r.location,
    r.is_active,
    r.stock_managed,
    r.is_consumable,
    r.integer_uom,
    r.manual_lead_time_days,
    r.effective_lead_time_days,
    r.moq_qty,
    r.consumption_window_days,
    r.total_consumption_qty,
    r.avg_daily_consumption,
    r.safety_factor,
    r.minimum_stock_level,
    r.current_stock_qty,
    r.open_pr_qty,
    r.open_po_qty,
    r.pipeline_qty,
    r.reserved_qty,
    r.net_available_qty,
    r.shortage_qty,
    r.suggested_pr_qty,
    r.alert_level,
    r.can_create_pr,
    r.existing_pr_nos,
    r.existing_po_nos,
    r.reason
  from public.v_inventory_replenishment_snapshot r
  where (
      p_search is null
      or trim(p_search) = ''
      or lower(concat_ws(
        ' ',
        r.item_code,
        r.item_name,
        r.category,
        r.department,
        r.uom,
        r.location,
        r.alert_level,
        r.existing_pr_nos,
        r.existing_po_nos,
        r.reason
      )) like '%' || lower(trim(p_search)) || '%'
    )
    and (
      p_alert is null
      or trim(p_alert) = ''
      or (upper(trim(p_alert)) = 'ACTIONABLE' and r.can_create_pr)
      or r.alert_level = upper(trim(p_alert))
    )
  order by
    case r.alert_level
      when 'CRITICAL' then 0
      when 'REORDER' then 1
      when 'WATCH' then 2
      when 'MISSING_LEAD_TIME' then 3
      when 'NO_CONSUMPTION' then 4
      when 'OK' then 5
      else 6
    end,
    r.item_name,
    r.item_code,
    r.location
  limit case
    when p_limit is null or p_limit <= 0 then null
    else greatest(p_limit, 1)
  end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 892 (class 1255 OID 217555)
-- Name: inv_stock_allocation_detail_ui(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_stock_allocation_detail_ui(p_item_id uuid, p_location text DEFAULT 'MAIN'::text) RETURNS TABLE(reservation_id uuid, wo_number text, material_key text, item_code text, item_name text, location text, uom text, required_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric, allocated_qty numeric, shortage_qty numeric, status text, created_by text, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_by text, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
  select ir.id, ir.wo_number, ir.material_key, i.item_code, i.item_name,
         ir.location, ir.uom, ir.required_qty,
         coalesce(v.net_issued_qty, 0),
         ir.reserved_qty,
         greatest(ir.required_qty - coalesce(v.net_issued_qty, 0) - ir.reserved_qty, 0),
         ir.status, ir.created_by, ir.created_at, ir.updated_by, ir.updated_at
    from inventory_reservations ir
    join inv_items i on i.id = ir.item_id
    left join inv_wo_issue_requirement_v v
      on v.wo_number = ir.wo_number and v.material_key = ir.material_key
   where ir.item_id = p_item_id
     and upper(ir.location) = upper(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_location), ''), 'MAIN'))
     and ir.status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED')
     and ir.reserved_qty > 0
   order by ir.created_at, ir.wo_number;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 761 (class 1255 OID 217554)
-- Name: inv_stock_allocation_totals_ui(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_stock_allocation_totals_ui(p_location text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_code text, item_name text, location text, allocated_qty numeric, allocation_count bigint, work_orders text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
  select ir.item_id, i.item_code, i.item_name, ir.location,
         round(sum(ir.reserved_qty), 6) as allocated_qty,
         count(*) as allocation_count,
         string_agg(distinct ir.wo_number, ', ' order by ir.wo_number) as work_orders
    from inventory_reservations ir
    join inv_items i on i.id = ir.item_id
   where ir.status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED')
     and ir.reserved_qty > 0
     and (nullif(trim(coalesce(p_location, '')), '') is null
          or upper(ir.location) = upper(trim(p_location)))
     and (nullif(trim(coalesce(p_search, '')), '') is null
          or i.item_code ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
          or i.item_name ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
          or coalesce(i.category, '') ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
          or coalesce(i.department, '') ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%')
   group by ir.item_id, i.item_code, i.item_name, ir.location
   order by i.item_name, i.item_code, ir.location;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 704 (class 1255 OID 46978)
-- Name: inv_stock_qty(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_stock_qty(p_item_id uuid, p_location text) RETURNS numeric
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  select coalesce(sum(qty_in - qty_out), 0)
  from inv_ledger
  where item_id = p_item_id
    and (p_location is null or location = p_location);
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 795 (class 1255 OID 40251)
-- Name: inv_stock_snapshot(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_stock_snapshot(p_location text, p_search text) RETURNS TABLE(itemcode text, itemname text, location text, qty numeric, avgrate numeric, value numeric)
    LANGUAGE sql
    AS $$
  SELECT
    i.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    l.location,

    -- Current stock qty
    SUM(l.qty_in - l.qty_out) AS qty,

    -- Weighted average based ONLY on receipts
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(l.qty_in) = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN l.qty_in > 0 THEN l.value
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
        /
        SUM(l.qty_in)
    END AS avgrate,

    -- Stock value = current qty × avg rate
    SUM(l.qty_in - l.qty_out)
    *
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(l.qty_in) = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN l.qty_in > 0 THEN l.value
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
        /
        SUM(l.qty_in)
    END AS value

  FROM inv_ledger l
  JOIN inv_items i ON i.id = l.item_id

  WHERE
    (p_location IS NULL OR l.location = p_location)
    AND (
      p_search IS NULL OR
      LOWER(i.item_code || ' ' || i.item_name)
      LIKE '%' || LOWER(p_search) || '%'
    )

  GROUP BY
    i.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    l.location;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 728 (class 1255 OID 70156)
-- Name: inv_stock_snapshot_mv(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_stock_snapshot_mv(p_location text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(itemcode text, itemname text, category text, location text, qty numeric, avgrate numeric, value numeric)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  select
    m.item_code::text as itemcode,
    m.item_name::text as itemname,
    coalesce(m.category, '')::text as category,
    coalesce(m.location, '')::text as location,
    coalesce(m.qty, 0)::numeric as qty,
    coalesce(m.avgrate, 0)::numeric as avgrate,
    coalesce(m.value, 0)::numeric as value
  from public.inv_stock_mv m
  where (p_location is null or m.location = p_location)
    and (
      p_search is null
      or m.item_code ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
      or m.item_name ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
      or coalesce(m.category, '') ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
    )
  order by m.item_name;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 809 (class 1255 OID 89149)
-- Name: inv_stock_snapshot_ui(text, text, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_stock_snapshot_ui(p_location text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT NULL::integer) RETURNS TABLE(itemcode text, itemname text, category text, department text, uom text, location text, qty numeric, avgrate numeric, avg_rate numeric, value numeric, last_movement_at timestamp with time zone, oldest_receipt_at timestamp with time zone, ageing_days integer, movement_class text, next_batch_no text, batch_count integer, avg_lead_time_days numeric, avg_daily_consumption numeric, safety_factor numeric, minimum_stock_level numeric, msl_status text, msl_gap numeric)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  with base_rows as (
    select
      s.item_id,
      s.item_code,
      s.item_name,
      s.category,
      s.department,
      s.uom,
      s.location,
      s.qty,
      s.avg_rate,
      s.value,
      s.last_movement_at
    from public.inv_stock_mv s
    where (p_location is null or trim(p_location) = '' or upper(s.location) = upper(trim(p_location)))
      and upper(coalesce(s.location, '')) <> 'FG'
      and (
        p_search is null or trim(p_search) = '' or
        lower(
          concat_ws(
            ' ',
            s.item_code,
            s.item_name,
            s.category,
            s.department,
            s.uom,
            s.location
          )
        ) like '%' || lower(trim(p_search)) || '%'
      )

    union all

    select
      i.id as item_id,
      i.item_code,
      i.item_name,
      coalesce(i.category, ''::text) as category,
      coalesce(i.department, ''::text) as department,
      coalesce(i.uom, ''::text) as uom,
      coalesce(nullif(upper(trim(p_location)), ''), 'MAIN') as location,
      0::numeric as qty,
      0::numeric as avg_rate,
      0::numeric as value,
      null::timestamptz as last_movement_at
      from public.inv_items i
    where not exists (
        select 1
        from public.inv_stock_mv s0
        where s0.item_id = i.id
          and upper(coalesce(s0.location, '')) <> 'FG'
          and (p_location is null or trim(p_location) = '' or upper(s0.location) = upper(trim(p_location)))
      )
      and (
        p_search is null or trim(p_search) = '' or
        lower(
          concat_ws(
            ' ',
            i.item_code,
            i.item_name,
            i.category,
            i.department,
            i.uom,
            coalesce(nullif(upper(trim(p_location)), ''), 'MAIN')
          )
        ) like '%' || lower(trim(p_search)) || '%'
      )
  )
  select
    b.item_code as itemcode,
    b.item_name as itemname,
    b.category,
    b.department,
    b.uom,
    b.location,
    b.qty,
    b.avg_rate as avgrate,
    b.avg_rate,
    b.value,
    b.last_movement_at,
    a.oldest_receipt_at,
    a.ageing_days,
    a.movement_class,
    a.next_batch_no,
    a.batch_count,
    a.avg_lead_time_days,
    a.avg_daily_consumption,
    a.safety_factor,
    a.minimum_stock_level,
    case when b.qty < coalesce(a.minimum_stock_level, 0) then 'BELOW_MSL' else 'OK' end as msl_status,
    round((b.qty - coalesce(a.minimum_stock_level, 0))::numeric, 2) as msl_gap
  from base_rows b
  left join public.inv_stock_analytics_mv a
    on a.item_id = b.item_id
   and a.location = b.location
  order by b.item_name asc, b.item_code asc, b.location asc
  limit case
    when p_limit is null or p_limit <= 0 then null
    else greatest(p_limit, 1)
  end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 886 (class 1255 OID 205706)
-- Name: inv_wo_excess_issue_review_ui(text, date, date, text, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_wo_excess_issue_review_ui(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_review_filter text DEFAULT 'ALL'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 500000, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0) RETURNS TABLE(wo_date date, wo_no text, job_card_no text, sales_orders text, client text, product text, artwork_no text, department text, material_key text, material text, gsm text, deckle_mm numeric, cut_mm numeric, uom text, required_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric, returned_qty numeric, net_issued_qty numeric, pending_qty numeric, excess_qty numeric, excess_pct numeric, within_writeoff_limit boolean, status text, issue_batches text, return_batches text, last_issue_date timestamp with time zone, last_return_date timestamp with time zone, production_rejected_qty numeric, production_rejection_hint text, review_action text, review_status text, review_remarks text, reviewed_by text, reviewed_at timestamp with time zone)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  with base as (
    -- Fetch the complete date/search result inside PostgreSQL. The review filter
    -- and requested page are applied only after review status has been joined.
    select *
    from public.inv_wo_issue_variance_export_ui(
      p_search,
      p_date_from,
      p_date_to,
      500000,
      0
    )
  ),
  production_rejection as (
    select
      wo.wo_number as wo_no,
      sum(coalesce(pe.rejected_qty, 0::numeric))::numeric as rejected_qty
    from public.work_orders wo
    join public.production_entries pe on pe.wo_id = wo.id
    where coalesce(pe.rejected_qty, 0::numeric) > 0
    group by wo.wo_number
  ),
  latest_review as (
    select distinct on (r.wo_no, r.material_key)
      r.wo_no,
      r.material_key,
      r.action_type,
      r.remarks,
      r.reviewed_by,
      r.reviewed_at
    from public.inv_wo_excess_issue_reviews r
    order by r.wo_no, r.material_key, r.reviewed_at desc, r.id desc
  ),
  enriched as (
    select
      b.*,
      case
        when coalesce(b.required_qty, 0::numeric) > 0
          then round((coalesce(b.excess_qty, 0::numeric) / nullif(b.required_qty, 0::numeric) * 100.0)::numeric, 4)
        else 0::numeric
      end as excess_pct,
      coalesce(pr.rejected_qty, 0::numeric) as production_rejected_qty,
      lr.action_type as review_action,
      lr.remarks as review_remarks,
      lr.reviewed_by,
      lr.reviewed_at
    from base b
    left join production_rejection pr on pr.wo_no = b.wo_no
    left join latest_review lr on lr.wo_no = b.wo_no and lr.material_key = b.material_key
  ),
  review_filtered as (
    select e.*
    from enriched e
    where
      upper(coalesce(p_review_filter, 'ALL')) in ('', 'ALL')
      or (
        upper(coalesce(p_review_filter, 'ALL')) = 'PENDING'
        and coalesce(e.review_action, '') in ('', 'COMMENT')
      )
      or (
        upper(coalesce(p_review_filter, 'ALL')) = 'REVIEWED'
        and coalesce(e.review_action, '') in ('ROUNDING_WRITE_OFF', 'REISSUE_REJECTION')
      )
      or (
        upper(coalesce(p_review_filter, 'ALL')) = 'RETURN_REQUIRED'
        and coalesce(e.review_action, '') = 'RETURN_REQUIRED'
      )
  )
  select
    e.wo_date,
    e.wo_no,
    e.job_card_no,
    e.sales_orders,
    e.client,
    e.product,
    e.artwork_no,
    e.department,
    e.material_key,
    e.material,
    e.gsm,
    e.deckle_mm,
    e.cut_mm,
    e.uom,
    round(coalesce(e.required_qty, 0::numeric)::numeric, 2),
    round(coalesce(e.issued_qty, 0::numeric)::numeric, 2),
    round(coalesce(e.returned_qty, 0::numeric)::numeric, 2),
    round(coalesce(e.net_issued_qty, 0::numeric)::numeric, 2),
    round(coalesce(e.pending_qty, 0::numeric)::numeric, 2),
    round(coalesce(e.excess_qty, 0::numeric)::numeric, 2),
    round(coalesce(e.excess_pct, 0::numeric)::numeric, 2),
    coalesce(e.excess_pct, 0::numeric) <= 5.0,
    coalesce(e.status, 'EXCESS'),
    coalesce(e.issue_batches, ''),
    coalesce(e.return_batches, ''),
    e.last_issue_date,
    e.last_return_date,
    round(coalesce(e.production_rejected_qty, 0::numeric)::numeric, 2),
    case
      when coalesce(e.production_rejected_qty, 0::numeric) > 0 then 'Production rejection recorded'
      else ''
    end,
    coalesce(e.review_action, ''),
    case
      when e.review_action in ('ROUNDING_WRITE_OFF', 'REISSUE_REJECTION') then 'REVIEWED'
      when e.review_action = 'RETURN_REQUIRED' then 'RETURN_REQUIRED'
      when e.review_action = 'COMMENT' then 'PENDING'
      else 'PENDING'
    end,
    coalesce(e.review_remarks, ''),
    coalesce(e.reviewed_by, ''),
    e.reviewed_at
  from review_filtered e
  order by e.last_issue_date desc nulls last,
           e.wo_date desc nulls last,
           e.wo_no desc,
           e.material asc,
           e.material_key asc
  limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 500000), 1)
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.inv_wo_excess_issue_review_ui(p_search text, p_date_from date, p_date_to date, p_review_filter text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer) IS 'Returns complete WO excess rows. Search, date, and review filters are applied before deterministic pagination.';


--
-- TOC entry 774 (class 1255 OID 212593)
-- Name: inv_wo_issue_variance_export_ui(text, date, date, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_wo_issue_variance_export_ui(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 500000, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0) RETURNS TABLE(wo_date date, wo_no text, job_card_no text, sales_orders text, client text, product text, artwork_no text, department text, material_key text, material text, gsm text, deckle_mm numeric, cut_mm numeric, uom text, required_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric, returned_qty numeric, net_issued_qty numeric, pending_qty numeric, excess_qty numeric, status text, issue_batches text, return_batches text, last_issue_date timestamp with time zone, last_return_date timestamp with time zone)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  with filtered as (
    select v.*
    from public.inv_wo_issue_variance_export_v v
    where (
      p_search is null
      or trim(p_search) = ''
      or v.wo_no ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or v.job_card_no ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or v.sales_orders ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or v.client ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or v.product ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or v.artwork_no ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or v.material ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
    )
      and coalesce(v.required_qty, 0) > 0
      and coalesce(v.excess_qty, 0) > 0.0001
  ),
  matched_ledger as (
    select
      f.wo_no,
      f.material_key as report_material_key,
      f.required_qty,
      il.id as ledger_id,
      upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) as ref_type,
      coalesce(il.qty_out, 0::numeric) as qty_out,
      coalesce(il.qty_in, 0::numeric) as qty_in,
      case
        when upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) = 'WO-RETURN'
          then -1 * coalesce(il.qty_in, 0::numeric)
        else coalesce(il.qty_out, 0::numeric)
      end as signed_qty,
      coalesce(il.batch_no, '') as batch_no,
      il.created_at
    from filtered f
    join public.inv_ledger il
      on trim(coalesce(il.ref_no, '')) = trim(coalesce(f.wo_no, ''))
    where upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) in ('ISSUE', 'WO-RETURN')
      and coalesce(il.remarks, '') <> ''
      and (
        coalesce(il.qty_out, 0::numeric) > 0
        or coalesce(il.qty_in, 0::numeric) > 0
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.inv_ledger rev
        where rev.ref_no = il.id::text
          and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
      )
      and (
        f.material_key = il.remarks
        or upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
          upper(coalesce(f.material, '')),
          upper(coalesce(split_part(f.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
        )
      )
      and (coalesce(f.gsm, '') = '' or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = '' or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = coalesce(f.gsm, ''))
      and (
        coalesce(f.deckle_mm, 0) = 0
        or coalesce(nullif(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 3), '')::numeric, 0) = 0
        or abs(coalesce(nullif(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 3), '')::numeric, 0) - coalesce(f.deckle_mm, 0)) <= 0.01
      )
      and (
        coalesce(f.cut_mm, 0) = 0
        or coalesce(nullif(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 4), '')::numeric, 0) = 0
        or abs(coalesce(nullif(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 4), '')::numeric, 0) - coalesce(f.cut_mm, 0)) <= 0.01
      )
      and (
        case
          when upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 5), '')) in ('RM', 'R.M.', 'RUNNING METER', 'RUNNING METERS') then 'RM'
          when upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 5), '')) in ('KG', 'KGS', 'KILOGRAM', 'KILOGRAMS') then 'KG'
          when upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 5), '')) in ('SHEET', 'SHEETS') then 'SHEET'
          else upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 5), ''))
        end = upper(coalesce(f.uom, ''))
        or (
          f.department = 'Flexo'
          and f.uom = 'RM'
          and case
            when upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 5), '')) in ('RM', 'R.M.', 'RUNNING METER', 'RUNNING METERS') then 'RM'
            when upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 5), '')) in ('KG', 'KGS', 'KILOGRAM', 'KILOGRAMS') then 'KG'
            else upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 5), ''))
          end in ('RM', 'KG')
        )
      )
  ),
  sequenced_ledger as (
    select
      ml.*,
      coalesce(
        sum(ml.signed_qty) over (
          partition by ml.wo_no, ml.report_material_key
          order by ml.created_at, ml.ledger_id
          rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding
        ),
        0::numeric
      ) as net_before
    from matched_ledger ml
  ),
  excess_issue_events as (
    select
      sl.wo_no,
      sl.report_material_key,
      sl.created_at,
      sl.batch_no,
      greatest(sl.net_before + sl.qty_out - coalesce(sl.required_qty, 0), 0)
        - greatest(sl.net_before - coalesce(sl.required_qty, 0), 0) as event_excess_qty
    from sequenced_ledger sl
    where sl.ref_type = 'ISSUE'
      and sl.qty_out > 0
  ),
  period_excess as (
    select
      eie.wo_no,
      eie.report_material_key,
      sum(eie.event_excess_qty) as period_excess_qty,
      max(eie.created_at) as last_excess_issue_date,
      string_agg(distinct nullif(trim(eie.batch_no), ''), ', ') as excess_issue_batches
    from excess_issue_events eie
    where eie.event_excess_qty > 0.0001
      and (p_date_from is null or (eie.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date >= p_date_from)
      and (p_date_to is null or (eie.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date <= p_date_to)
    group by eie.wo_no, eie.report_material_key
  )
  select
    f.wo_date,
    f.wo_no,
    f.job_card_no,
    f.sales_orders,
    f.client,
    f.product,
    f.artwork_no,
    f.department,
    f.material_key,
    f.material,
    f.gsm,
    f.deckle_mm,
    f.cut_mm,
    f.uom,
    f.required_qty,
    f.issued_qty,
    f.returned_qty,
    f.net_issued_qty,
    f.pending_qty,
    least(coalesce(f.excess_qty, 0), coalesce(pe.period_excess_qty, 0)) as excess_qty,
    'EXCESS'::text as status,
    coalesce(pe.excess_issue_batches, f.issue_batches),
    f.return_batches,
    pe.last_excess_issue_date as last_issue_date,
    f.last_return_date
  from filtered f
  join period_excess pe
    on pe.wo_no = f.wo_no
   and pe.report_material_key = f.material_key
  where least(coalesce(f.excess_qty, 0), coalesce(pe.period_excess_qty, 0)) > 0.0001
  order by pe.last_excess_issue_date desc nulls last, f.wo_date desc nulls last, f.wo_no desc, f.material asc, f.material_key asc
  limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 500000), 1)
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 683 (class 1255 OID 212438)
-- Name: inv_work_order_issue_reconciled_ui(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_work_order_issue_reconciled_ui(p_wo_no text) RETURNS TABLE(wo_number text, issue_department text, line_status text, material_key text, item_label text, gsm text, deckle_mm numeric, cut_mm numeric, uom text, required_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric, returned_qty numeric, net_issued_qty numeric, remaining_qty numeric, excess_qty numeric, item_code text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  with source_rows as (
    select
      src.*,
      ii.id as source_item_id,
      count(*) over (partition by src.wo_number, ii.id) as source_item_line_count
    from public.inv_wo_issue_material_source_v src
    left join public.inv_items ii
      on upper(trim(coalesce(ii.item_code, ''))) = upper(trim(coalesce(src.item_code, '')))
    where src.wo_number = trim(p_wo_no)
  ),
  prepared as (
    select
      src.*,
      coalesce(issue_totals.issued_qty, 0::numeric) as issued_qty,
      coalesce(return_totals.returned_qty, 0::numeric) as returned_qty
    from source_rows src
    left join lateral (
      select sum(coalesce(il.qty_out, 0::numeric)) as issued_qty
      from public.inv_ledger il
      where trim(coalesce(il.ref_no, '')) = src.wo_number
        and upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) = 'ISSUE'
        and coalesce(il.qty_out, 0::numeric) > 0
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from public.inv_ledger rev
          where rev.ref_no = il.id::text
            and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
        )
        and case
          -- For an item appearing on only one WO material line, item identity is
          -- stronger than an old material-key format and includes every valid
          -- issue for that item (for example, reissues under an older key).
          when src.source_item_id is not null
           and src.source_item_line_count = 1 then (
             il.item_id = src.source_item_id
             or (
               upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
                 upper(coalesce(src.item_label, '')),
                 upper(coalesce(src.item_code, '')),
                 upper(coalesce(split_part(src.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
               )
               and (
                 coalesce(src.gsm::text, '') = ''
                 or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = ''
                 or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = coalesce(src.gsm::text, '')
               )
             )
           )
          -- When the same item has multiple material lines, retain the precise
          -- material-key match so the lines do not borrow from each other.
          when exists (
            select 1
            from public.inv_ledger exact_key
            where trim(coalesce(exact_key.ref_no, '')) = src.wo_number
              and upper(coalesce(exact_key.ref_type, '')) = 'ISSUE'
              and coalesce(exact_key.qty_out, 0::numeric) > 0
              and exact_key.remarks = src.material_key
              and not exists (
                select 1 from public.inv_ledger rev
                where rev.ref_no = exact_key.id::text
                  and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
              )
          ) then il.remarks = src.material_key
          -- Retain a tightly constrained legacy fallback only when identity is absent.
          else upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
            upper(coalesce(src.item_label, '')),
            upper(coalesce(src.item_code, '')),
            upper(coalesce(split_part(src.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
          )
        end
    ) issue_totals on true
    left join lateral (
      select sum(coalesce(il.qty_in, 0::numeric)) as returned_qty
      from public.inv_ledger il
      where trim(coalesce(il.ref_no, '')) = src.wo_number
        and upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) = 'WO-RETURN'
        and coalesce(il.qty_in, 0::numeric) > 0
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from public.inv_ledger rev
          where rev.ref_no = il.id::text
            and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
        )
        and case
          when src.source_item_id is not null
           and src.source_item_line_count = 1 then (
             il.item_id = src.source_item_id
             or (
               upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
                 upper(coalesce(src.item_label, '')),
                 upper(coalesce(src.item_code, '')),
                 upper(coalesce(split_part(src.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
               )
               and (
                 coalesce(src.gsm::text, '') = ''
                 or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = ''
                 or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = coalesce(src.gsm::text, '')
               )
             )
           )
          when exists (
            select 1
            from public.inv_ledger exact_key
            where trim(coalesce(exact_key.ref_no, '')) = src.wo_number
              and upper(coalesce(exact_key.ref_type, '')) = 'WO-RETURN'
              and coalesce(exact_key.qty_in, 0::numeric) > 0
              and exact_key.remarks = src.material_key
              and not exists (
                select 1 from public.inv_ledger rev
                where rev.ref_no = exact_key.id::text
                  and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
              )
          ) then il.remarks = src.material_key
          else upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
            upper(coalesce(src.item_label, '')),
            upper(coalesce(src.item_code, '')),
            upper(coalesce(split_part(src.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
          )
        end
    ) return_totals on true
  )
  select
    wo_number::text,
    issue_department::text,
    case
      when greatest(required_qty - greatest(issued_qty - returned_qty, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) > 0.0001 then 'PENDING'
      else 'ISSUED'
    end::text as line_status,
    material_key::text,
    item_label::text,
    gsm::text,
    deckle_mm,
    cut_mm,
    uom::text,
    required_qty,
    issued_qty,
    returned_qty,
    greatest(issued_qty - returned_qty, 0::numeric) as net_issued_qty,
    greatest(required_qty - greatest(issued_qty - returned_qty, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) as remaining_qty,
    greatest(greatest(issued_qty - returned_qty, 0::numeric) - required_qty, 0::numeric) as excess_qty,
    item_code::text
  from prepared
  order by item_label asc, material_key asc;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 917 (class 1255 OID 226338)
-- Name: inv_work_order_issue_reconciled_v2(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_work_order_issue_reconciled_v2(p_wo_no text) RETURNS TABLE(wo_number text, issue_department text, line_status text, material_key text, item_label text, gsm text, deckle_mm numeric, cut_mm numeric, uom text, required_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric, returned_qty numeric, net_issued_qty numeric, remaining_qty numeric, excess_qty numeric, item_code text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  with source_rows as materialized (
    select
      src.*,
      ii.id as source_item_id,
      count(*) over (partition by src.wo_number, ii.id) as source_item_line_count
    from public.inv_wo_issue_material_source_v src
    left join public.inv_items ii
      on upper(trim(coalesce(ii.item_code, ''))) = upper(trim(coalesce(src.item_code, '')))
    where src.wo_number = trim(p_wo_no)
  ),
  ledger_rows as materialized (
    select il.*
    from public.inv_ledger il
    where il.ref_no = trim(p_wo_no)
      and upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) in ('ISSUE', 'WO-RETURN')
      and (coalesce(il.qty_out, 0) > 0 or coalesce(il.qty_in, 0) > 0)
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.inv_ledger rev
        where rev.ref_no = il.id::text
          and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
      )
  ),
  prepared as (
    select
      src.*,
      coalesce(issue_totals.issued_qty, 0::numeric) as issued_qty,
      coalesce(return_totals.returned_qty, 0::numeric) as returned_qty
    from source_rows src
    left join lateral (
      select sum(coalesce(il.qty_out, 0::numeric)) as issued_qty
      from ledger_rows il
      where upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) = 'ISSUE'
        and case
          when src.source_item_id is not null
           and src.source_item_line_count = 1 then (
             il.item_id = src.source_item_id
             or (
               upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
                 upper(coalesce(src.item_label, '')),
                 upper(coalesce(src.item_code, '')),
                 upper(coalesce(split_part(src.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
               )
               and (
                 coalesce(src.gsm::text, '') = ''
                 or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = ''
                 or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = coalesce(src.gsm::text, '')
               )
             )
           )
          when exists (
            select 1
            from ledger_rows exact_key
            where upper(coalesce(exact_key.ref_type, '')) = 'ISSUE'
              and exact_key.remarks = src.material_key
          ) then il.remarks = src.material_key
          else upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
            upper(coalesce(src.item_label, '')),
            upper(coalesce(src.item_code, '')),
            upper(coalesce(split_part(src.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
          )
        end
    ) issue_totals on true
    left join lateral (
      select sum(coalesce(il.qty_in, 0::numeric)) as returned_qty
      from ledger_rows il
      where upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) = 'WO-RETURN'
        and case
          when src.source_item_id is not null
           and src.source_item_line_count = 1 then (
             il.item_id = src.source_item_id
             or (
               upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
                 upper(coalesce(src.item_label, '')),
                 upper(coalesce(src.item_code, '')),
                 upper(coalesce(split_part(src.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
               )
               and (
                 coalesce(src.gsm::text, '') = ''
                 or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = ''
                 or coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 2), '') = coalesce(src.gsm::text, '')
               )
             )
           )
          when exists (
            select 1
            from ledger_rows exact_key
            where upper(coalesce(exact_key.ref_type, '')) = 'WO-RETURN'
              and exact_key.remarks = src.material_key
          ) then il.remarks = src.material_key
          else upper(coalesce(split_part(il.remarks, '|', 1), '')) in (
            upper(coalesce(src.item_label, '')),
            upper(coalesce(src.item_code, '')),
            upper(coalesce(split_part(src.material_key, '|', 1), ''))
          )
        end
    ) return_totals on true
  )
  select
    wo_number::text,
    issue_department::text,
    case
      when greatest(required_qty - greatest(issued_qty - returned_qty, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) > 0.0001
        then 'PENDING'
      else 'ISSUED'
    end::text as line_status,
    material_key::text,
    item_label::text,
    gsm::text,
    deckle_mm,
    cut_mm,
    uom::text,
    required_qty,
    issued_qty,
    returned_qty,
    greatest(issued_qty - returned_qty, 0::numeric) as net_issued_qty,
    greatest(required_qty - greatest(issued_qty - returned_qty, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) as remaining_qty,
    greatest(greatest(issued_qty - returned_qty, 0::numeric) - required_qty, 0::numeric) as excess_qty,
    item_code::text
  from prepared
  order by item_label asc, material_key asc;
$$;
