-- TOC entry 932 (class 1255 OID 212585)
-- Name: inv_work_orders_for_issue_summary_ui(text, text, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.inv_work_orders_for_issue_summary_ui(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50000, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0) RETURNS TABLE(wo_no text, issue_department text, material_status text, required_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric, returned_qty numeric, net_issued_qty numeric, remaining_qty numeric, excess_qty numeric, line_count integer)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
  select
    s.wo_number::text as wo_no,
    s.issue_department::text,
    s.material_status::text,
    s.required_qty,
    s.issued_qty,
    s.returned_qty,
    s.net_issued_qty,
    s.remaining_qty,
    s.excess_qty,
    s.line_count::integer
  from public.inv_wo_issue_status_fast_v s
  where (p_status is null or trim(p_status) = '' or upper(s.material_status) = upper(trim(p_status)))
    and (
      p_search is null
      or trim(p_search) = ''
      or s.wo_number ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.work_orders wo
        join public.work_order_jobs woj on woj.wo_id = wo.id
        where wo.wo_number = s.wo_number
          and (
            woj.job_reference ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
            or woj.so_number ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
            or woj.product_name ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
            or woj.client_name ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
            or woj.artwork_no ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
          )
      )
    )
  order by s.wo_number desc
  limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50000), 1)
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 796 (class 1255 OID 220127)
-- Name: issue_kraft_reel(uuid, text, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.issue_kraft_reel(p_lot_id uuid, p_wo_no text, p_material_key text, p_department text, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_lot public.inv_lots%rowtype;
  v_wo public.work_orders%rowtype;
  v_ledger_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_allocation_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_cycle_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_wo_no text := trim(coalesce(p_wo_no, ''));
  v_material_key text := trim(coalesce(p_material_key, ''));
begin
  select * into v_lot
  from public.inv_lots
  where id = p_lot_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_lot.is_reel is not true then
    raise exception 'Kraft reel was not found';
  end if;
  if v_wo_no = '' or upper(v_wo_no) in ('DIRECT', 'CORRUGATION FLOOR') then
    raise exception 'A work order is required for kraft reel issue';
  end if;
  if v_material_key = '' then
    raise exception 'Work-order material key is required';
  end if;

  select * into v_wo
  from public.work_orders
  where wo_number = v_wo_no
  for share;
  if not found then raise exception 'Work order % was not found', v_wo_no; end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.inv_wo_issue_requirement_v r
    where r.wo_number = v_wo_no
      and r.material_key = v_material_key
  ) then
    raise exception 'Material % does not belong to work order %', v_material_key, v_wo_no;
  end if;
  if v_lot.reel_status not in ('AVAILABLE','RETURNED') then
    raise exception 'Reel % is not available for issue', v_lot.batch_no;
  end if;
  if upper(coalesce(v_lot.location, '')) <> 'MAIN' then
    raise exception 'Reel % must be in Main Stores before issue', v_lot.batch_no;
  end if;
  if v_lot.qty_available <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Reel % has no available balance', v_lot.batch_no;
  end if;
  if exists (
    select 1 from public.inv_reel_issue_cycles
    where lot_id = v_lot.id and status = 'ACTIVE'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Reel % already has an active issue cycle', v_lot.batch_no;
  end if;

  insert into public.inv_ledger (
    id, item_id, location, ref_type, ref_no, qty_in, qty_out, rate,
    value, remarks, created_at, department, batch_no
  ) values (
    v_ledger_id, v_lot.item_id, 'MAIN', 'ISSUE', v_wo_no,
    0, v_lot.qty_available, v_lot.rate, v_lot.qty_available * v_lot.rate,
    v_material_key, now(),
    trim(coalesce(p_department, v_lot.department, 'Corrugation')), v_lot.batch_no
  );

  insert into public.inv_lot_allocations (
    id, ledger_id, lot_id, batch_no, item_id, qty, rate, txn_type, created_at
  ) values (
    v_allocation_id, v_ledger_id, v_lot.id, v_lot.batch_no, v_lot.item_id,
    v_lot.qty_available, v_lot.rate, 'ISSUE', now()
  );

  insert into public.inv_reel_issue_cycles (
    id, lot_id, internal_reel_no, wo_id, wo_no, material_key,
    issue_ledger_id, issue_qty_kg, status, issue_actor,
    custody_scope, custody_location
  ) values (
    v_cycle_id, v_lot.id, v_lot.batch_no, v_wo.id, v_wo_no,
    v_material_key, v_ledger_id, v_lot.qty_available, 'ACTIVE',
    trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')), 'WORK_ORDER', 'CORRUGATION FLOOR'
  );

  insert into public.inv_reel_events (
    lot_id, internal_reel_no, event_type, wo_no, qty, balance_after,
    location, material_key, actor, metadata, issue_cycle_id
  ) values (
    v_lot.id, v_lot.batch_no, 'WO_ISSUE', v_wo_no, v_lot.qty_available, 0,
    'CORRUGATION FLOOR', v_material_key, trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'issueLedgerId', v_ledger_id,
      'issueCycleId', v_cycle_id,
      'custodyScope', 'WORK_ORDER',
      'assignedWoNo', v_wo_no
    ),
    v_cycle_id
  );

  update public.inv_lots
  set qty_available = 0,
      reel_status = 'ISSUED',
      assigned_wo_no = v_wo_no,
      issued_gross_qty = v_lot.qty_available,
      issued_at = now(),
      returned_at = null,
      location = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR',
      current_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle_id
  where id = v_lot.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'reelNo', v_lot.batch_no,
    'issuedQty', v_lot.qty_available,
    'assignedWoNo', v_wo_no,
    'custodyScope', 'WORK_ORDER',
    'custodyLocation', 'CORRUGATION FLOOR',
    'ledgerId', v_ledger_id,
    'issueCycleId', v_cycle_id
  );
end;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 748 (class 1255 OID 220679)
-- Name: issue_kraft_reels_bulk(jsonb, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.issue_kraft_reels_bulk(p_rows jsonb, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_row jsonb;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_results jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 then
    raise exception 'No kraft reels were supplied for issue';
  end if;
  for v_row in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  loop
    v_result := public.issue_kraft_reel(
      (v_row->>'lot_id')::uuid,
      v_row->>'wo_no',
      v_row->>'material_key',
      v_row->>'department',
      p_actor
    );
    v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_array(v_result);
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'count', jsonb_array_length(v_results), 'rows', v_results);
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 786 (class 1255 OID 209485)
-- Name: item_master_dimension_to_mm(numeric, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.item_master_dimension_to_mm(p_value numeric, p_unit text) RETURNS numeric
    LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE
    AS $$
  select case upper(coalesce(p_unit, 'MM'))
    when 'IN' then round(p_value * 25.4, 3)
    when 'INCH' then round(p_value * 25.4, 3)
    when 'INCHES' then round(p_value * 25.4, 3)
    when 'CM' then round(p_value * 10, 3)
    else round(p_value, 3)
  end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 808 (class 1255 OID 209487)
-- Name: item_master_register(text, text, text, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.item_master_register(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_dimension_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
with prepared as (
  select
    i.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    i.category,
    i.product_category,
    i.unit,
    i.active,
    i.manufacturing_enabled,
    i.current_revision_no,
    i.item_lifecycle_status,
    i.length_mm,
    i.width_mm,
    i.height_mm,
    coalesce(nullif(upper(i.dimension_unit), ''), 'MM') as dimension_unit,
    case
      when coalesce(i.length_mm, 0) > 0 and coalesce(i.width_mm, 0) > 0 then 'COMPLETE'
      else 'MISSING'
    end as dimension_status,
    case
      when r.id is null or coalesce(public.item_master_try_numeric(r.item_info_json->>'length'), 0) <= 0 or coalesce(public.item_master_try_numeric(r.item_info_json->>'width'), 0) <= 0 then false
      when coalesce(i.length_mm, 0) <= 0 or coalesce(i.width_mm, 0) <= 0 then false
      else abs(i.length_mm - public.item_master_dimension_to_mm(public.item_master_try_numeric(r.item_info_json->>'length'), r.item_info_json->>'dimensionUom')) > 0.01
        or abs(i.width_mm - public.item_master_dimension_to_mm(public.item_master_try_numeric(r.item_info_json->>'width'), r.item_info_json->>'dimensionUom')) > 0.01
    end as dimension_conflict
  from public.items i
  left join lateral (
    select br.id, br.item_info_json
    from public.item_bom_revisions br
    where br.item_code = i.item_code and br.is_current = true
    order by br.revision_no desc
    limit 1
  ) r on true
), filtered as (
  select *
  from prepared p
  where
    (coalesce(nullif(lower(p_status), ''), 'all') = 'all'
      or (lower(p_status) = 'active' and p.active = true)
      or (lower(p_status) = 'inactive' and p.active = false))
    and (coalesce(nullif(trim(p_search), ''), '') = ''
      or p.item_code ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or p.item_name ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or coalesce(p.category, '') ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%'
      or coalesce(p.product_category, '') ilike '%' || trim(p_search) || '%')
    and (coalesce(nullif(lower(p_dimension_status), ''), 'all') = 'all'
      or lower(p.dimension_status) = lower(p_dimension_status)
      or (lower(p_dimension_status) = 'conflict' and p.dimension_conflict = true))
), totals as (
  select
    count(*)::integer as total,
    count(*) filter (where active)::integer as active,
    count(*) filter (where current_revision_no is not null)::integer as with_bom,
    count(*) filter (where dimension_status = 'MISSING')::integer as missing_dimensions,
    count(*) filter (where dimension_conflict)::integer as dimension_conflicts
  from filtered
), page_rows as (
  select * from filtered
  order by item_name asc, item_code asc
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0)
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 1), 250)
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'rows', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page_rows) order by item_name, item_code) from page_rows), '[]'::jsonb),
  'total', totals.total,
  'summary', jsonb_build_object(
    'total', totals.total,
    'active', totals.active,
    'withBom', totals.with_bom,
    'missingDimensions', totals.missing_dimensions,
    'dimensionConflicts', totals.dimension_conflicts
  )
)
from totals;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.item_master_try_numeric(p_value text) RETURNS numeric
    LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE
    AS $$

exception when invalid_text_representation then
  return null;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 890 (class 1255 OID 220686)
-- Name: kraft_reel_flute_factor(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.kraft_reel_flute_factor(p_flute text) RETURNS numeric
    LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE
    AS $$
  select case upper(trim(coalesce(p_flute, '')))
    when 'B' then 1.40::numeric
    when 'E' then 1.30::numeric
    when 'C' then 1.45::numeric
    else 1.35::numeric
  end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 871 (class 1255 OID 21199)
-- Name: lock_invoice_lines(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.lock_invoice_lines() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1 from invoices
    where id = old.invoice_id
      and status = 'POSTED'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Cannot modify invoice lines after posting';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 838 (class 1255 OID 225131)
-- Name: lock_posted_billing_adjustment(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.lock_posted_billing_adjustment() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if tg_table_name = 'billing_adjustment_notes' then
    if old.status = 'POSTED' then
      if current_setting('erp.adjustment_cancel', true) = '1'
         and new.status = 'CANCELLED'
         and new.id = old.id
         and new.note_no is not distinct from old.note_no
         and new.original_invoice_id = old.original_invoice_id
         and new.note_type = old.note_type then
        return new;
      end if;
      raise exception 'Posted adjustment note cannot be modified';
    end if;
  elsif exists (
    select 1 from public.billing_adjustment_notes n
    where n.id = old.note_id and n.status = 'POSTED'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Lines of a posted adjustment note cannot be modified';
  end if;
  return case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old else new end;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 904 (class 1255 OID 218110)
-- Name: mark_purchase_rate_override_stale(uuid, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.mark_purchase_rate_override_stale(p_id uuid, p_reason text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  changed public.purchase_rate_override_approvals%rowtype;
begin
  update public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
  set
    status = 'STALE',
    stale_reason = trim(coalesce(p_reason, 'Underlying purchase data changed')),
    updated_at = now()
  where id = p_id
    and status in ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
  returning * into changed;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', changed.id is not null, 'request', to_jsonb(changed));
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 819 (class 1255 OID 220054)
-- Name: next_internal_reel_no(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.next_internal_reel_no() RETURNS text
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_period text := to_char(current_date, 'YYYYMM');
  v_next bigint;
begin
  insert into public.inv_reel_sequences (period_key, last_no, updated_at)
  values (v_period, 1, now())
  on conflict (period_key) do update
  set last_no = public.inv_reel_sequences.last_no + 1,
      updated_at = now()
  returning last_no into v_next;

  return 'KR-' || v_period || '-' || lpad(v_next::text, 6, '0');
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 816 (class 1255 OID 231726)
-- Name: normalize_reel_issue_cycle_custody(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.normalize_reel_issue_cycle_custody() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_location text;
begin
  if new.status = 'ACTIVE' then
    select upper(trim(coalesce(location, ''))) into v_location
    from public.inv_lots
    where id = new.lot_id;

    if v_location = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR' then
      new.custody_location := 'CORRUGATION FLOOR';
    end if;

    if new.wo_id is not null and trim(coalesce(new.wo_no, '')) <> ''
       and upper(trim(coalesce(new.wo_no, ''))) <> 'CORRUGATION FLOOR' then
      new.custody_scope := 'WORK_ORDER';
    else
      new.custody_scope := 'FLOOR';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 679 (class 1255 OID 185084)
-- Name: packing_queue_dataset(boolean, boolean, date, date, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.packing_queue_dataset(p_show_pending_all boolean DEFAULT true, p_include_completed boolean DEFAULT false, p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20000, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0) RETURNS TABLE(pack_id uuid, so_id uuid, so_line_id uuid, so_number text, line_no text, product_code text, product_name text, client_name text, category text, department_category text, category_group text, order_qty numeric, produced_qty numeric, packed_qty numeric, packed_weight_kg numeric, packing_rejected_qty numeric, packing_rejected_weight_kg numeric, ready_to_dispatch boolean, expected_delivery date, final_delivery date, division text, quote_no text, pm_code text, product_remarks text, prepress_remarks text, so_remarks text, artwork_no text, wo_number text, wo_date date, transport_mode text, production_status text, packing_status text, dispatch_status text, production_pending_qty numeric, packing_pending_qty numeric, dispatch_pending_qty numeric, current_stage text, overall_status text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
with rejection_totals as (
  select
    so_line_id,
    sum(coalesce(rejected_qty, 0))::numeric as rejected_qty,
    sum(coalesce(rejected_weight_kg, 0))::numeric as rejected_weight_kg
  from public.v_packing_rejection_totals
  group by so_line_id
),
queue_base as (
  select
    q.pack_id,
    q.so_id,
    q.so_line_id,
    q.so_number::text as so_number,
    q.line_no::text as line_no,
    q.product_code::text as product_code,
    q.product_name::text as product_name,
    q.client_name::text as client_name,
    q.category::text as category,
    q.department_category::text as department_category,
    case
      when upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) like '%FLEXO%' then 'Flexo'
      when upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) like '%CORR%' then 'Corrugation'
      when upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) like '%OFFSET%' then 'Offset'
      when upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) like '%DIGITAL%' then 'Digital'
      else coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, 'Other')::text
    end as category_group,
    coalesce(q.order_qty, 0)::numeric as order_qty,
    coalesce(q.produced_qty, 0)::numeric as produced_qty,
    coalesce(q.packed_qty, 0)::numeric as packed_qty,
    coalesce(q.packed_weight_kg, 0)::numeric as packed_weight_kg,
    coalesce(rt.rejected_qty, 0)::numeric as packing_rejected_qty,
    coalesce(rt.rejected_weight_kg, 0)::numeric as packing_rejected_weight_kg,
    coalesce(q.ready_to_dispatch, true)::boolean as ready_to_dispatch,
    q.expected_delivery,
    q.final_delivery,
    q.division::text as division,
    q.quote_no::text as quote_no,
    q.pm_code::text as pm_code,
    q.product_remarks::text as product_remarks,
    q.prepress_remarks::text as prepress_remarks,
    q.so_remarks::text as so_remarks,
    q.artwork_no::text as artwork_no,
    q.wo_number::text as wo_number,
    q.wo_date,
    q.transport_mode::text as transport_mode
  from public.v_packing_queue_fast q
  left join public.sales_orders so on so.so_number = q.so_number
  left join rejection_totals rt on rt.so_line_id = q.so_line_id
  where coalesce(upper(so.status), '') <> 'CANCELLED'
    and upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) not like '%CORR%'
),
base as (
  select *
  from queue_base q
  where coalesce(q.produced_qty, 0) > 0
),
statused as (
  select
    b.*,
    case
      when coalesce(b.produced_qty, 0) >= coalesce(b.order_qty, 0) and coalesce(b.order_qty, 0) > 0 then 'COMPLETED'
      when coalesce(b.produced_qty, 0) > 0 then 'IN_PROGRESS'
      else 'PENDING'
    end as production_status,
    case
      when coalesce(b.produced_qty, 0) <= 0 then 'PENDING'
      when coalesce(b.packed_qty, 0) + coalesce(b.packing_rejected_qty, 0) >= coalesce(b.produced_qty, 0) then 'COMPLETED'
      when coalesce(b.packed_qty, 0) > 0 then 'IN_PROGRESS'
      when coalesce(b.packing_rejected_qty, 0) > 0 then 'IN_PROGRESS'
      else 'PENDING'
    end as packing_status,
    'PENDING'::text as dispatch_status,
    greatest(coalesce(b.order_qty, 0) - coalesce(b.produced_qty, 0), 0)::numeric as production_pending_qty,
    greatest(coalesce(b.produced_qty, 0) - coalesce(b.packed_qty, 0) - coalesce(b.packing_rejected_qty, 0), 0)::numeric as packing_pending_qty,
    coalesce(b.packed_qty, 0)::numeric as dispatch_pending_qty
  from base b
),
final_rows as (
  select
    s.*,
    case when s.packing_status = 'COMPLETED' then 'Completed' else 'Packing' end as current_stage,
    case
      when s.packing_status = 'COMPLETED' then 'COMPLETED'
      when s.packing_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' or s.production_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' then 'IN_PROGRESS'
      else 'PENDING'
    end as overall_status
  from statused s
)
select
  f.pack_id,
  f.so_id,
  f.so_line_id,
  f.so_number,
  f.line_no,
  f.product_code,
  f.product_name,
  f.client_name,
  f.category,
  f.department_category,
  f.category_group,
  f.order_qty,
  f.produced_qty,
  f.packed_qty,
  f.packed_weight_kg,
  f.packing_rejected_qty,
  f.packing_rejected_weight_kg,
  f.ready_to_dispatch,
  f.expected_delivery,
  f.final_delivery,
  f.division,
  f.quote_no,
  f.pm_code,
  f.product_remarks,
  f.prepress_remarks,
  f.so_remarks,
  f.artwork_no,
  f.wo_number,
  f.wo_date,
  f.transport_mode,
  f.production_status,
  f.packing_status,
  f.dispatch_status,
  f.production_pending_qty,
  f.packing_pending_qty,
  f.dispatch_pending_qty,
  f.current_stage,
  f.overall_status
from final_rows f
where
  case
    when coalesce(p_show_pending_all, true) then
      case
        when coalesce(p_include_completed, false) then f.packing_status <> 'SHORT_CLOSED'
        else f.packing_status not in ('COMPLETED', 'SHORT_CLOSED')
      end
    else
      (p_date_from is null or coalesce(f.wo_date, f.expected_delivery)::date >= p_date_from)
      and (p_date_to is null or coalesce(f.wo_date, f.expected_delivery)::date <= p_date_to)
  end
order by f.wo_date desc nulls last, f.so_number asc, f.line_no asc
limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20000), 1), 50000)
offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 785 (class 1255 OID 219733)
-- Name: packing_queue_dataset_v2(boolean, boolean, date, date, integer, integer); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.packing_queue_dataset_v2(p_show_pending_all boolean DEFAULT true, p_include_completed boolean DEFAULT false, p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20000, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0) RETURNS TABLE(pack_id uuid, so_id uuid, so_line_id uuid, so_number text, line_no text, product_code text, product_name text, client_name text, category text, department_category text, category_group text, order_qty numeric, produced_qty numeric, packed_qty numeric, packed_weight_kg numeric, packing_rejected_qty numeric, packing_rejected_weight_kg numeric, ready_to_dispatch boolean, expected_delivery date, final_delivery date, division text, quote_no text, pm_code text, product_remarks text, prepress_remarks text, so_remarks text, artwork_no text, wo_number text, wo_date date, transport_mode text, source_produced_qty numeric, source_uom text, conversion_type text, conversion_factor numeric, conversion_status text, source_process_name text, production_status text, packing_status text, dispatch_status text, production_pending_qty numeric, packing_pending_qty numeric, dispatch_pending_qty numeric, current_stage text, overall_status text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    AS $$
with rejection_totals as (
  select
    so_line_id,
    sum(coalesce(rejected_qty, 0))::numeric as rejected_qty,
    sum(coalesce(rejected_weight_kg, 0))::numeric as rejected_weight_kg
  from public.v_packing_rejection_totals
  group by so_line_id
),
quantity_rollup as (
  select
    q.pack_id,
    q.so_id,
    q.so_line_id,
    q.so_number,
    q.line_no,
    max(q.product_code) as product_code,
    max(q.product_name) as product_name,
    max(q.client_name) as client_name,
    max(q.category) as category,
    max(q.department_category) as department_category,
    max(q.order_qty)::numeric as order_qty,
    sum(coalesce(q.produced_qty, 0))::numeric as produced_qty,
    max(coalesce(q.packed_qty, 0))::numeric as packed_qty,
    max(coalesce(q.packed_weight_kg, 0))::numeric as packed_weight_kg,
    bool_or(q.ready_to_dispatch = true) as ready_to_dispatch,
    max(q.expected_delivery) as expected_delivery,
    max(q.final_delivery) as final_delivery,
    max(q.division) as division,
    max(q.quote_no) as quote_no,
    max(q.pm_code) as pm_code,
    max(q.product_remarks) as product_remarks,
    max(q.prepress_remarks) as prepress_remarks,
    max(q.so_remarks) as so_remarks,
    max(q.artwork_no) as artwork_no,
    string_agg(distinct q.wo_number, ', ' order by q.wo_number) filter (where coalesce(q.wo_number, '') <> '') as wo_number,
    max(q.wo_date) as wo_date,
    max(q.transport_mode) as transport_mode,
    sum(coalesce(q.source_produced_qty, 0))::numeric as source_produced_qty,
    case
      when count(distinct q.source_uom) = 1 then max(q.source_uom)
      else 'MIXED'
    end::text as source_uom,
    case
      when count(distinct q.conversion_type) = 1 then max(q.conversion_type)
      else 'MULTIPLE_WORK_ORDERS'
    end::text as conversion_type,
    case
      when count(distinct q.conversion_factor) = 1 then max(q.conversion_factor)
      else 0
    end::numeric as conversion_factor,
    case
      when bool_or(coalesce(q.conversion_status, 'OK') <> 'OK')
        then max(case when coalesce(q.conversion_status, 'OK') <> 'OK' then q.conversion_status end)
      else 'OK'
    end::text as conversion_status,
    string_agg(distinct q.source_process_name, ', ' order by q.source_process_name)
      filter (where coalesce(q.source_process_name, '') <> '') as source_process_name
  from public.v_packing_queue_finished_v2 q
  group by
    q.pack_id,
    q.so_id,
    q.so_line_id,
    q.so_number,
    q.line_no
),
queue_base as (
  select
    q.pack_id,
    q.so_id,
    q.so_line_id,
    q.so_number::text as so_number,
    q.line_no::text as line_no,
    q.product_code::text as product_code,
    q.product_name::text as product_name,
    q.client_name::text as client_name,
    q.category::text as category,
    q.department_category::text as department_category,
    case
      when upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) like '%FLEXO%' then 'Flexo'
      when upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) like '%CORR%' then 'Corrugation'
      when upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) like '%OFFSET%' then 'Offset'
      when upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) like '%DIGITAL%' then 'Digital'
      else coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, 'Other')::text
    end as category_group,
    coalesce(q.order_qty, 0)::numeric as order_qty,
    coalesce(q.produced_qty, 0)::numeric as produced_qty,
    coalesce(q.packed_qty, 0)::numeric as packed_qty,
    coalesce(q.packed_weight_kg, 0)::numeric as packed_weight_kg,
    coalesce(rt.rejected_qty, 0)::numeric as packing_rejected_qty,
    coalesce(rt.rejected_weight_kg, 0)::numeric as packing_rejected_weight_kg,
    coalesce(q.ready_to_dispatch, false)::boolean as ready_to_dispatch,
    q.expected_delivery,
    q.final_delivery,
    q.division::text as division,
    q.quote_no::text as quote_no,
    q.pm_code::text as pm_code,
    q.product_remarks::text as product_remarks,
    q.prepress_remarks::text as prepress_remarks,
    q.so_remarks::text as so_remarks,
    q.artwork_no::text as artwork_no,
    q.wo_number::text as wo_number,
    q.wo_date,
    q.transport_mode::text as transport_mode,
    coalesce(q.source_produced_qty, 0)::numeric as source_produced_qty,
    q.source_uom::text as source_uom,
    q.conversion_type::text as conversion_type,
    coalesce(q.conversion_factor, 0)::numeric as conversion_factor,
    q.conversion_status::text as conversion_status,
    q.source_process_name::text as source_process_name
  from quantity_rollup q
  left join public.sales_orders so on so.so_number = q.so_number
  left join rejection_totals rt on rt.so_line_id = q.so_line_id
  where coalesce(upper(so.status), '') <> 'CANCELLED'
    and upper(coalesce(q.department_category, q.category, '')) not like '%CORR%'
),
base as (
  select *
  from queue_base q
  where coalesce(q.produced_qty, 0) > 0
     or coalesce(q.packed_qty, 0) > 0
     or coalesce(q.conversion_status, 'OK') <> 'OK'
),
statused as (
  select
    b.*,
    case
      when b.produced_qty >= b.order_qty and b.order_qty > 0 then 'COMPLETED'
      when b.produced_qty > 0 then 'IN_PROGRESS'
      else 'PENDING'
    end::text as production_status,
    case
      when b.produced_qty <= 0 then 'PENDING'
      when b.packed_qty + b.packing_rejected_qty >= b.produced_qty then 'COMPLETED'
      when b.packed_qty > 0 or b.packing_rejected_qty > 0 then 'IN_PROGRESS'
      else 'PENDING'
    end::text as packing_status,
    'PENDING'::text as dispatch_status,
    greatest(b.order_qty - b.produced_qty, 0)::numeric as production_pending_qty,
    greatest(b.produced_qty - b.packed_qty - b.packing_rejected_qty, 0)::numeric as packing_pending_qty,
    b.packed_qty::numeric as dispatch_pending_qty
  from base b
),
filtered as (
  select
    s.*,
    case when s.packing_status = 'COMPLETED' then 'Completed' else 'Packing' end::text as current_stage,
    case
      when s.packing_status = 'COMPLETED' then 'COMPLETED'
      when s.packing_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' or s.production_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' then 'IN_PROGRESS'
      else 'PENDING'
    end::text as overall_status
  from statused s
  where (
    p_show_pending_all
    or (
      (p_date_from is null or s.wo_date >= p_date_from)
      and (p_date_to is null or s.wo_date <= p_date_to)
    )
  )
  and (
    p_include_completed
    or s.packing_status <> 'COMPLETED'
  )
)
select
  f.pack_id,
  f.so_id,
  f.so_line_id,
  f.so_number,
  f.line_no,
  f.product_code,
  f.product_name,
  f.client_name,
  f.category,
  f.department_category,
  f.category_group,
  f.order_qty,
  f.produced_qty,
  f.packed_qty,
  f.packed_weight_kg,
  f.packing_rejected_qty,
  f.packing_rejected_weight_kg,
  f.ready_to_dispatch,
  f.expected_delivery,
  f.final_delivery,
  f.division,
  f.quote_no,
  f.pm_code,
  f.product_remarks,
  f.prepress_remarks,
  f.so_remarks,
  f.artwork_no,
  f.wo_number,
  f.wo_date,
  f.transport_mode,
  f.source_produced_qty,
  f.source_uom,
  f.conversion_type,
  f.conversion_factor,
  f.conversion_status,
  f.source_process_name,
  f.production_status,
  f.packing_status,
  f.dispatch_status,
  f.production_pending_qty,
  f.packing_pending_qty,
  f.dispatch_pending_qty,
  f.current_stage,
  f.overall_status
from filtered f
order by f.wo_date desc nulls last, f.so_number, f.line_no
limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20000), 1)
offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$$;

$$;


--
-- TOC entry 901 (class 1255 OID 220680)
-- Name: post_inventory_issue_bulk(jsonb, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.post_inventory_issue_bulk(p_rows jsonb, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_row jsonb;
  v_item public.inv_items%rowtype;
  v_lot public.inv_lots%rowtype;
  v_qty numeric;
  v_take numeric;
  v_balance numeric;
  v_value numeric;
  v_rate numeric;
  v_ledger_id uuid;
  v_first_batch text;
  v_location text;
  v_batch text;
  v_intent text;
  v_wo_no text;
  v_material_key text;
  v_ref_no text;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_results jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 then
    raise exception 'No inventory issue rows were supplied';
  end if;

  for v_row in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  loop
    v_qty := coalesce(nullif(v_row->>'qty', '')::numeric, 0);
    v_location := trim(coalesce(v_row->>'location', 'MAIN'));
    v_batch := trim(coalesce(v_row->>'batch_no', ''));
    v_intent := upper(trim(coalesce(v_row->>'transaction_intent', '')));
    v_wo_no := trim(coalesce(v_row->>'wo_no', ''));
    v_material_key := trim(coalesce(v_row->>'material_key', ''));
    if v_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'Every issue row must have a positive quantity'; end if;

    select * into v_item
    from public.inv_items
    where id = (v_row->>'item_id')::uuid
      and active is true;
    if not found then raise exception 'Active inventory item was not found for issue'; end if;

    if v_item.reel_tracking_enabled is true then
      if nullif(v_row->>'reel_lot_id', '') is null then
        raise exception 'Internal reel lot is required for %', v_item.item_code;
      end if;
      v_result := public.issue_kraft_reel(
        (v_row->>'reel_lot_id')::uuid,
        v_wo_no,
        v_material_key,
        v_row->>'department',
        p_actor
      );
      if abs(coalesce((v_result->>'issuedQty')::numeric, 0) - v_qty) > 0.0001 then
        raise exception 'Reel issue quantity changed during posting for %', v_item.item_code;
      end if;
      v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_array(v_result);
      continue;
    end if;

    if v_intent = 'WO_ISSUE' then
      if v_wo_no = '' or v_material_key = '' then
        raise exception 'Work order and material key are required for WO issue';
      end if;
      v_ref_no := v_wo_no;
    elsif v_intent = 'DIRECT_ISSUE' then
      v_ref_no := trim(coalesce(v_row->>'issue_reference', ''));
      if v_ref_no = '' then v_ref_no := 'DIRECT'; end if;
    else
      raise exception 'Invalid inventory issue transaction intent';
    end if;

    v_ledger_id := gen_random_uuid();
    v_balance := v_qty;
    v_value := 0;
    v_first_batch := null;

    insert into public.inv_ledger (
      id, item_id, location, ref_type, ref_no, qty_in, qty_out,
      rate, value, remarks, created_at, department, batch_no
    ) values (
      v_ledger_id, v_item.id, v_location, 'ISSUE', v_ref_no,
      0, v_qty, 0, 0,
      case
        when v_intent = 'WO_ISSUE' then v_material_key
        else trim(coalesce(v_row->>'remarks', 'Direct Issue'))
      end,
      now(), trim(coalesce(v_row->>'department', '')), ''
    );

    for v_lot in
      select *
      from public.inv_lots
      where item_id = v_item.id
        and location = v_location
        and qty_available > 0
        and (v_batch = '' or batch_no = v_batch)
        and is_reel is not true
      order by receipt_date, created_at, id
      for update
    loop
      exit when v_balance <= 0.0001;
      v_take := least(v_lot.qty_available, v_balance);
      if v_take <= 0 then continue; end if;
      if v_first_batch is null then v_first_batch := v_lot.batch_no; end if;

      update public.inv_lots
      set qty_available = round(qty_available - v_take, 6)
      where id = v_lot.id;

      insert into public.inv_lot_allocations (
        id, ledger_id, lot_id, batch_no, item_id, qty, rate, txn_type, created_at
      ) values (
        gen_random_uuid(), v_ledger_id, v_lot.id, v_lot.batch_no,
        v_item.id, v_take, v_lot.rate, 'ISSUE', now()
      );

      v_value := v_value + (v_take * v_lot.rate);
      v_balance := round(v_balance - v_take, 6);
    end loop;

    if v_balance > 0.0001 then
      raise exception 'Insufficient FIFO stock for % at %', v_item.item_code, v_location;
    end if;
    v_rate := case when v_qty > 0 then round(v_value / v_qty, 6) else 0 end;

    update public.inv_ledger
    set rate = v_rate,
        value = round(v_value, 6),
        batch_no = coalesce(v_first_batch, '')
    where id = v_ledger_id;

    v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true,
      'ledgerId', v_ledger_id,
      'itemCode', v_item.item_code,
      'issuedQty', v_qty,
      'rate', v_rate,
      'batchNo', coalesce(v_first_batch, ''),
      'woNo', case when v_intent = 'WO_ISSUE' then v_wo_no else null end
    ));
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'count', jsonb_array_length(v_results),
    'rows', v_results
  );
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 745 (class 1255 OID 226339)
-- Name: post_inventory_issue_bulk_v2(jsonb, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.post_inventory_issue_bulk_v2(p_rows jsonb, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_result jsonb;
  v_reservation record;
  v_wo_no text;
  v_detail_rows jsonb;
  v_work_orders jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_warnings jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 then
    raise exception 'No inventory issue rows were supplied';
  end if;

  -- Keep the existing function as the authority for FIFO allocation, reels,
  -- ledger posting, and stock validation.
  v_result := public.post_inventory_issue_bulk(p_rows, p_actor);

  -- Consolidate identical reservation requests before locking rows.
  for v_reservation in
    select
      trim(coalesce(row_data->>'wo_no', '')) as wo_no,
      trim(coalesce(row_data->>'material_key', '')) as material_key,
      (row_data->>'item_id')::uuid as item_id,
      sum(coalesce(nullif(row_data->>'qty', '')::numeric, 0)) as qty
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) as input_rows(row_data)
    where upper(trim(coalesce(row_data->>'transaction_intent', ''))) = 'WO_ISSUE'
      and trim(coalesce(row_data->>'wo_no', '')) <> ''
      and trim(coalesce(row_data->>'material_key', '')) <> ''
      and nullif(row_data->>'item_id', '') is not null
    group by
      trim(coalesce(row_data->>'wo_no', '')),
      trim(coalesce(row_data->>'material_key', '')),
      (row_data->>'item_id')::uuid
  loop
    begin
      perform public.consume_work_order_stock_reservation(
        v_reservation.wo_no,
        v_reservation.material_key,
        v_reservation.item_id,
        v_reservation.qty,
        p_actor
      );
    exception when others then
      v_warnings := v_warnings || jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'step', 'RESERVATION',
          'woNo', v_reservation.wo_no,
          'materialKey', v_reservation.material_key,
          'message', sqlerrm
        )
      );
    end;
  end loop;

  -- Return authoritative requirement rows for each affected work order.
  for v_wo_no in
    select distinct trim(coalesce(row_data->>'wo_no', ''))
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) as input_rows(row_data)
    where upper(trim(coalesce(row_data->>'transaction_intent', ''))) = 'WO_ISSUE'
      and trim(coalesce(row_data->>'wo_no', '')) <> ''
  loop
    begin
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(detail_row)), '[]'::jsonb)
        into v_detail_rows
      from public.inv_work_order_issue_reconciled_v2(v_wo_no) as detail_row;

      v_work_orders := v_work_orders || jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object('woNo', v_wo_no, 'rows', v_detail_rows)
      );
    exception when others then
      v_warnings := v_warnings || jsonb_build_array(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'step', 'DETAIL_REFRESH',
          'woNo', v_wo_no,
          'message', sqlerrm
        )
      );
    end;
  end loop;

  return coalesce(v_result, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'workOrders', v_work_orders,
    'reservationMode', 'ATOMIC_WHEN_AVAILABLE',
    'warnings', v_warnings
  );
end;
$$;

--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.post_inventory_issue_bulk_v2(p_rows jsonb, p_actor text) IS 'Atomically posts inventory issues through the established bulk RPC, consumes WO reservations, and returns refreshed WO requirement rows.';


--
-- TOC entry 790 (class 1255 OID 218114)
-- Name: post_purchase_grn_transaction(jsonb, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.post_purchase_grn_transaction(p_header jsonb, p_lines jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  idempotency text := trim(coalesce(p_header->>'idempotency_key', ''));
  grn_number text := trim(coalesce(p_header->>'grn_no', ''));
  line_json jsonb;
  reel_json jsonb;
  po_line public.purchase_order_lines%rowtype;
  po_header public.purchase_orders%rowtype;
  item_row public.inv_items%rowtype;
  approval_id uuid;
  already_received numeric;
  results jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  existing_results jsonb;
  v_receipt_id uuid;
  v_lot_id uuid;
  v_ledger_id uuid;
  v_reel_no text;
  v_reel_qty numeric;
  v_reel_total numeric;
  v_has_reels boolean;
  v_first_reel text;
  v_first_lot_id uuid;
  v_first_ledger_id uuid;
begin
  if idempotency = '' or grn_number = '' then
    raise exception 'GRN idempotency key and GRN number are required';
  end if;

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(idempotency, 0));

  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'receiptNo', coalesce(r.ledger_id::text, r.id::text),
    'batchNo', coalesce(
      l.batch_no,
      (select min(gr.internal_reel_no) from public.purchase_grn_reels gr where gr.receipt_id = r.id),
      ''
    ),
    'poLineId', r.po_line_id,
    'duplicate', true
  ))
  into existing_results
  from public.purchase_po_receipts r
  left join public.inv_lots l on l.id = r.lot_id
  where r.idempotency_key = idempotency;

  if existing_results is not null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true, 'duplicate', true, 'grnNo', grn_number,
      'receiptNo', existing_results->0->>'receiptNo', 'receipts', existing_results
    );
  end if;

  for line_json in
    select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_lines, '[]'::jsonb))
  loop
    select * into po_line
    from public.purchase_order_lines
    where id = (line_json->>'po_line_id')::uuid
      and po_no = trim(p_header->>'po_no')
    for update;
    if not found then raise exception 'Purchase order line not found for GRN'; end if;

    select * into po_header
    from public.purchase_orders
    where id = po_line.po_id
    for update;
    if not found or upper(coalesce(po_header.status, '')) in ('CANCELLED', 'SHORT_CLOSED') then
      raise exception 'Purchase order is not open for receipt';
    end if;

    select * into item_row
    from public.inv_items
    where id = (line_json->>'item_id')::uuid;
    if not found then raise exception 'Inventory item not found for GRN'; end if;

    select coalesce(sum(qty), 0)
    into already_received
    from public.purchase_po_receipts
    where po_line_id = po_line.id;

    if coalesce((line_json->>'allow_over_receipt')::boolean, false) is false
       and already_received + (line_json->>'qty')::numeric > po_line.qty + 0.0001 then
      raise exception 'GRN quantity exceeds the current PO pending quantity';
    end if;

    v_receipt_id := (line_json->>'receipt_id')::uuid;
    v_has_reels := jsonb_typeof(line_json->'reels') = 'array'
      and jsonb_array_length(line_json->'reels') > 0;
    v_first_reel := null;
    v_first_lot_id := null;
    v_first_ledger_id := null;

    if item_row.reel_tracking_enabled is true and v_has_reels is false then
      raise exception 'Individual reel weights are required for reel-tracked item %', po_line.item_code;
    end if;
    if item_row.reel_tracking_enabled is true
       and (coalesce(item_row.width_mm, 0) <= 0 or coalesce(item_row.gsm, 0) <= 0) then
      raise exception 'Reel-tracked item % must have master width and GSM before GRN', po_line.item_code;
    end if;

    if v_has_reels then
      if item_row.reel_tracking_enabled is not true then
        raise exception 'Reel details are not allowed for non reel-tracked item %', po_line.item_code;
      end if;

      select coalesce(sum((value->>'gross_weight_kg')::numeric), 0)
      into v_reel_total
      from jsonb_array_elements(line_json->'reels');

      if abs(v_reel_total - (line_json->>'qty')::numeric) > 0.0001 then
        raise exception 'Reel weight total must equal received stock quantity for item %', po_line.item_code;
      end if;

      for reel_json in
        select value from jsonb_array_elements(line_json->'reels')
      loop
        v_reel_qty := coalesce(nullif(reel_json->>'gross_weight_kg', '')::numeric, 0);
        if v_reel_qty <= 0 then
          raise exception 'Every reel must have a positive gross weight';
        end if;

        v_lot_id := gen_random_uuid();
        v_ledger_id := gen_random_uuid();
        
        -- GRN_MANUAL_REEL_NO_V1: temporary manual numbering until opening stock is registered.
        v_reel_no := upper(trim(coalesce(reel_json->>'internal_reel_no', '')));
        if v_reel_no = '' then
          raise exception 'Enter an internal reel number for every received reel';
        end if;
        if not public.is_valid_internal_kraft_reel_no(v_reel_no) then
          raise exception 'Internal reel number % must start with KR- and use only letters, numbers, and hyphens', v_reel_no;
        end if;
        if exists (
          select 1 from public.inv_lots where upper(trim(batch_no)) = v_reel_no
        ) or exists (
          select 1 from public.purchase_grn_reels where upper(trim(internal_reel_no)) = v_reel_no
        ) then
          raise exception 'Internal reel number % already exists', v_reel_no;
        end if;
        if v_first_reel is null then
          v_first_reel := v_reel_no;
          v_first_lot_id := v_lot_id;
          v_first_ledger_id := v_ledger_id;
        end if;

        insert into public.inv_lots (
          id, item_id, item_code, batch_no, source_type, source_ref, location,
          receipt_date, qty_received, qty_available, rate, department, remarks,
          created_at, is_reel, reel_status, gross_weight_kg, master_width_mm,
          master_gsm
        ) values (
          v_lot_id, item_row.id, po_line.item_code, v_reel_no,
          'PO-RECEIPT', po_line.po_no, coalesce(line_json->>'location', 'MAIN'),
          coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'receipt_at', '')::timestamptz, now()),
          v_reel_qty, v_reel_qty, (line_json->>'stock_rate')::numeric,
          po_line.department, coalesce(line_json->>'remarks', ''), now(),
          true, 'AVAILABLE', v_reel_qty, item_row.width_mm, item_row.gsm
        );

        insert into public.inv_ledger (
          id, item_id, location, ref_type, ref_no, qty_in, qty_out, rate,
          value, remarks, created_at, department, batch_no
        ) values (
          v_ledger_id, item_row.id, coalesce(line_json->>'location', 'MAIN'),
          'PO-RECEIPT', po_line.po_no, v_reel_qty, 0,
          (line_json->>'stock_rate')::numeric,
          v_reel_qty * (line_json->>'stock_rate')::numeric,
          coalesce(line_json->>'remarks', ''), now(), po_line.department, v_reel_no
        );

        insert into public.purchase_grn_reels (
          receipt_id, po_line_id, lot_id, ledger_id, internal_reel_no,
          gross_weight_kg, master_width_mm, master_gsm
        ) values (
          v_receipt_id, po_line.id, v_lot_id, v_ledger_id, v_reel_no,
          v_reel_qty, item_row.width_mm, item_row.gsm
        );

        insert into public.inv_reel_events (
          lot_id, internal_reel_no, event_type, qty, balance_after,
          location, actor, metadata
        ) values (
          v_lot_id, v_reel_no, 'GRN_RECEIPT', v_reel_qty, v_reel_qty,
          coalesce(line_json->>'location', 'MAIN'),
          trim(coalesce(p_header->>'created_by', '')),
          jsonb_build_object('grnNo', grn_number, 'poNo', po_line.po_no)
        );
      end loop;
    else
      v_lot_id := (line_json->>'lot_id')::uuid;
      v_ledger_id := (line_json->>'ledger_id')::uuid;
      v_first_lot_id := v_lot_id;
      v_first_ledger_id := v_ledger_id;

      insert into public.inv_lots (
        id, item_id, item_code, batch_no, source_type, source_ref, location,
        receipt_date, qty_received, qty_available, rate, department, remarks, created_at
      ) values (
        v_lot_id, item_row.id, po_line.item_code, line_json->>'batch_no',
        'PO-RECEIPT', po_line.po_no, coalesce(line_json->>'location', 'MAIN'),
        coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'receipt_at', '')::timestamptz, now()),
        (line_json->>'qty')::numeric, (line_json->>'qty')::numeric,
        (line_json->>'stock_rate')::numeric, po_line.department,
        coalesce(line_json->>'remarks', ''), now()
      );

      insert into public.inv_ledger (
        id, item_id, location, ref_type, ref_no, qty_in, qty_out, rate,
        value, remarks, created_at, department, batch_no
      ) values (
        v_ledger_id, item_row.id, coalesce(line_json->>'location', 'MAIN'),
        'PO-RECEIPT', po_line.po_no, (line_json->>'qty')::numeric, 0,
        (line_json->>'stock_rate')::numeric,
        (line_json->>'qty')::numeric * (line_json->>'stock_rate')::numeric,
        coalesce(line_json->>'remarks', ''), now(), po_line.department,
        line_json->>'batch_no'
      );
    end if;

    insert into public.purchase_po_receipts (
      id, po_id, po_no, po_line_id, line_no, source_type, source_ref, job_ref,
      artwork_no, so_refs, receipt_date, challan_no, qty, rate, tax_pct,
      remarks, created_at, updated_at, grn_no, idempotency_key, ledger_id,
      lot_id, rate_override_approval_id, rate_ceiling_snapshot,
      rate_control_status, stock_uom, purchase_uom, purchase_qty
    ) values (
      v_receipt_id, po_line.po_id, po_line.po_no, po_line.id,
      po_line.line_no, po_line.source_type, po_line.source_ref, po_line.job_ref,
      coalesce(line_json->>'artwork_no', po_line.item_code), po_line.job_ref,
      coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'receipt_date', '')::date, current_date),
      coalesce(p_header->>'challan_no', ''), (line_json->>'qty')::numeric,
      (line_json->>'rate')::numeric, coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'tax_pct', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(line_json->>'receipt_remarks', ''), now(), now(), grn_number,
      idempotency, v_first_ledger_id, v_first_lot_id,
      nullif(line_json->>'rate_override_approval_id', '')::uuid,
      nullif(line_json->>'rate_ceiling_snapshot', '')::numeric,
      coalesce(line_json->>'rate_control_status', 'MANUAL_ALLOWED'),
      coalesce(line_json->>'stock_uom', ''), coalesce(line_json->>'purchase_uom', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'purchase_qty', '')::numeric, (line_json->>'qty')::numeric)
    );

    if trim(coalesce(po_line.source_ref, '')) <> '' then
      update public.inv_purchase_requests
      set received_qty = coalesce(received_qty, 0) + (line_json->>'qty')::numeric,
          status = case
            when coalesce(received_qty, 0) + (line_json->>'qty')::numeric >= requested_qty
              then 'CLOSED'
            else 'OPEN'
          end
      where pr_no = po_line.source_ref;
    end if;

    if coalesce(line_json->>'rate_control_status', '') = 'OVERRIDE_APPROVED' then
      approval_id := nullif(line_json->>'rate_override_approval_id', '')::uuid;
      update public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
      set status = 'CONSUMED',
          consumed_at = now(),
          consumed_ref = po_line.po_no || '/' || po_line.line_no || '/' || grn_number,
          updated_at = now()
      where id = approval_id
        and status = 'APPROVED'
        and consumed_at is null
        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now());
      if not found then
        raise exception 'GRN rate override is not approved, has expired, or was already consumed';
      end if;
    end if;

    results := results || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'receiptNo', coalesce(v_first_ledger_id::text, v_receipt_id::text),
      'batchNo', coalesce(v_first_reel, line_json->>'batch_no', ''),
      'reelCount', case when v_has_reels then jsonb_array_length(line_json->'reels') else 0 end,
      'poLineId', po_line.id,
      'rateOverrideApprovalId', line_json->>'rate_override_approval_id'
    ));
  end loop;

  if jsonb_array_length(results) = 0 then
    raise exception 'No valid GRN lines were supplied';
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true, 'duplicate', false, 'grnNo', grn_number,
    'receiptNo', results->0->>'receiptNo', 'receipts', results
  );
end;
$$;

-- Name: FUNCTION post_purchase_grn_transaction(p_header jsonb, p_lines jsonb); Type: COMMENT; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.post_purchase_grn_transaction(p_header jsonb, p_lines jsonb) IS 'Atomically posts purchase GRNs. Reel-tracked kraft lines temporarily require unique manual KR-<digits> internal reel numbers.';


--
-- TOC entry 843 (class 1255 OID 218888)
-- Name: post_purchase_grn_transaction_v2(jsonb, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.post_purchase_grn_transaction_v2(p_header jsonb, p_lines jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  idempotency text := trim(coalesce(p_header->>'idempotency_key', ''));
  grn_number text := trim(coalesce(p_header->>'grn_no', ''));
  v_grn_id uuid;
  result jsonb;
begin
  if idempotency = '' or grn_number = '' then
    raise exception 'GRN idempotency key and GRN number are required';
  end if;
  if p_lines is null or jsonb_typeof(p_lines) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'GRN lines must be supplied as an array';
  end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(p_lines) = 0 then
    raise exception 'At least one GRN line is required';
  end if;

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(idempotency, 0));

  select id into v_grn_id
  from public.purchase_grns
  where idempotency_key = idempotency;

  if v_grn_id is null then
    v_grn_id := gen_random_uuid();
    insert into public.purchase_grns (
      id, grn_no, po_no, vendor_id, vendor_name, invoice_no, invoice_date,
      challan_no, challan_date, location, payment_terms, freight_terms,
      freight_value, freight_gst_pct, delivery_terms, remarks,
      idempotency_key, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at
    ) values (
      v_grn_id,
      grn_number,
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'po_no', '')),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_id', '')), '')::uuid,
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_name', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'invoice_no', '')),
      (p_header->>'invoice_date')::date,
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'challan_no', '')),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_header->>'challan_date', '')), '')::date,
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'location', 'MAIN')),
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'payment_terms', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'freight_terms', '')),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'freight_value', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'freight_gst_pct', '')::numeric, 0),
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'delivery_terms', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'remarks', '')),
      idempotency,
      'POSTED',
      trim(coalesce(p_header->>'created_by', '')),
      now(),
      now()
    );
  end if;

  result := public.post_purchase_grn_transaction(p_header, p_lines);

  update public.purchase_po_receipts
  set grn_id = v_grn_id
  where idempotency_key = idempotency
    and purchase_po_receipts.grn_id is null;

  return coalesce(result, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('grnId', v_grn_id);
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 689 (class 1255 OID 21197)
-- Name: prevent_over_billing(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.prevent_over_billing() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_order_qty numeric;
  v_billed numeric;
begin
  select qty into v_order_qty
  from sales_order_lines
  where id = new.so_line_id;

  select coalesce(sum(qty),0)
  into v_billed
  from invoice_lines il
  join invoices i on i.id = il.invoice_id
  where il.so_line_id = new.so_line_id
    and i.status <> 'CANCELLED';

  if (v_billed + new.qty) > v_order_qty then
    raise exception
      'Over billing not allowed. Ordered: %, Already billed: %, Trying: %',
      v_order_qty, v_billed, new.qty;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 678 (class 1255 OID 216142)
-- Name: prevent_purchase_rate_master_overlap(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.prevent_purchase_rate_master_overlap() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  if new.status = 'ACTIVE' and exists (
    select 1
    from public.purchase_rate_masters rm
    where rm.id <> new.id
      and rm.status = 'ACTIVE'
      and upper(rm.rate_key) = upper(new.rate_key)
      and upper(rm.purchase_uom) = upper(new.purchase_uom)
      and daterange(rm.effective_from, coalesce(rm.effective_to, 'infinity'::date), '[]') &&
          daterange(new.effective_from, coalesce(new.effective_to, 'infinity'::date), '[]')
  ) then
    raise exception 'An active purchase rate already overlaps this rate key, purchase UOM, and effective period';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 792 (class 1255 OID 173721)
-- Name: prevent_unaudited_work_order_delete(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.prevent_unaudited_work_order_delete() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  if public.work_order_has_open_material_issue(old.wo_number) then
    raise exception 'Work order % cannot be deleted because material is still net issued against it.', old.wo_number;
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.work_order_deletion_audit_log al
    where al.wo_id = old.id
      and al.deletion_status = 'PENDING'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Direct work order deletion is not allowed. Use delete_work_order_with_audit.';
  end if;

  return old;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 896 (class 1255 OID 217589)
-- Name: preview_work_order_stock_allocation(jsonb, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.preview_work_order_stock_allocation(p_items jsonb, p_wo_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_location text DEFAULT 'MAIN'::text) RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_code text, item_name text, location text, uom text, required_qty numeric, physical_stock_qty numeric, allocated_other_qty numeric, allocated_this_wo_qty numeric, free_stock_qty numeric, expected_this_wo_qty numeric, shortage_qty numeric, allocation_status text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
  with requested_raw as (
    select upper(trim(x.item_code)) as item_code,
           greatest(coalesce(x.required_qty, 0), 0) as required_qty
      from jsonb_to_recordset(coalesce(p_items, '[]'::jsonb))
           as x(item_code text, required_qty numeric)
     where nullif(trim(x.item_code), '') is not null
  ),
  requested as (
    select item_code, sum(required_qty) as required_qty
      from requested_raw
     group by item_code
  ),
  target as (
    select i.id as item_id, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.uom, r.required_qty
      from requested r
      join inv_items i on upper(i.item_code) = r.item_code
  ),
  stock as (
    select s.item_id, sum(coalesce(s.qty, 0)) as physical_qty
      from inv_stock_mv s
     where upper(s.location) = upper(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_location), ''), 'MAIN'))
     group by s.item_id
  ),
  reserved as (
    select ir.item_id,
           sum(ir.reserved_qty) filter (
             where nullif(trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, '')), '') is not null
               and ir.wo_number = trim(p_wo_number)
           ) as this_qty,
           sum(ir.reserved_qty) filter (
             where nullif(trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, '')), '') is null
                or ir.wo_number <> trim(p_wo_number)
           ) as other_qty
      from inventory_reservations ir
     where upper(ir.location) = upper(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_location), ''), 'MAIN'))
       and ir.status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED')
       and ir.reserved_qty > 0
     group by ir.item_id
  ),
  calculated as (
    select t.*, coalesce(s.physical_qty, 0) as physical_qty,
           coalesce(r.other_qty, 0) as other_qty,
           coalesce(r.this_qty, 0) as this_qty,
           greatest(coalesce(s.physical_qty, 0) - coalesce(r.other_qty, 0) - coalesce(r.this_qty, 0), 0) as free_qty
      from target t
      left join stock s on s.item_id = t.item_id
      left join reserved r on r.item_id = t.item_id
  ),
  expected as (
    select c.*,
           least(c.required_qty, c.this_qty + c.free_qty) as expected_qty
      from calculated c
  )
  select e.item_id, e.item_code, e.item_name,
         upper(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_location), ''), 'MAIN')), e.uom,
         e.required_qty, e.physical_qty, e.other_qty, e.this_qty, e.free_qty,
         e.expected_qty, greatest(e.required_qty - e.expected_qty, 0),
         case
           when e.expected_qty >= e.required_qty then 'FULL'
           when e.expected_qty > 0 then 'PARTIAL'
           else 'NOT_ALLOCATED'
         end
    from expected e
   order by e.item_name, e.item_code;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 719 (class 1255 OID 228733)
-- Name: production_find_work_orders(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.production_find_work_orders(p_query text) RETURNS TABLE(wo_id uuid, wo_number text, wo_date date, artwork_nos text, client_name text, product_names text, so_numbers text, department_category text)
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
  with matches as (
    select wo.id, wo.wo_number, wo.wo_date, wo.snapshot_json
    from public.work_orders wo
    where lower(wo.wo_number) like '%' || lower(trim(p_query)) || '%'
    order by
      case when lower(wo.wo_number) = lower(trim(p_query)) then 0 else 1 end,
      case when lower(wo.wo_number) like lower(trim(p_query)) || '%' then 0 else 1 end,
      wo.wo_date desc
    limit 12
  )
  select
    m.id,
    m.wo_number,
    m.wo_date,
    string_agg(distinct nullif(j.artwork_no, ''), ', ' order by nullif(j.artwork_no, '')),
    max(nullif(j.client_name, '')),
    string_agg(distinct nullif(j.product_name, ''), ' / ' order by nullif(j.product_name, '')),
    string_agg(distinct nullif(j.so_number, ''), ', ' order by nullif(j.so_number, '')),
    case
      when upper(coalesce(m.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails' ->> 'type', '')) like '%FLEXO%' then 'FLEXO'
      when upper(coalesce(m.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails' ->> 'type', '')) like '%CORR%' then 'CORRUGATION'
      when upper(coalesce(m.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails' ->> 'type', '')) like '%OFFSET%' then 'OFFSET'
      when upper(coalesce(m.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails' ->> 'type', '')) like '%DIGITAL%' then 'DIGITAL'
      when upper(coalesce(max(j.category), '')) like '%FLEXO%' then 'FLEXO'
      when upper(coalesce(max(j.category), '')) like '%CORR%' then 'CORRUGATION'
      when upper(coalesce(max(j.category), '')) like '%OFFSET%' then 'OFFSET'
      when upper(coalesce(max(j.category), '')) like '%DIGITAL%' then 'DIGITAL'
      else null
    end
  from matches m
  left join public.work_order_jobs j on j.wo_id = m.id
  group by m.id, m.wo_number, m.wo_date, m.snapshot_json
  order by
    case when lower(m.wo_number) = lower(trim(p_query)) then 0 else 1 end,
    case when lower(m.wo_number) like lower(trim(p_query)) || '%' then 0 else 1 end,
    m.wo_date desc;
$$;
