--
-- TOC entry 438 (class 1259 OID 82423)
-- Name: v_production_stage_queue_fast; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_production_stage_queue_fast AS
 WITH RECURSIVE artwork_category AS (
         SELECT a.artwork_no,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS department_category
           FROM public.artworks a
          WHERE (COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY a.artwork_no
        ), snapshot_metrics AS (
         SELECT wo.id AS wo_id,
            COALESCE(( SELECT sum(COALESCE((NULLIF((p.value ->> 'requiredQty'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (NULLIF((p.value ->> 'sheetsWithWaste'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric)) AS sum
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE((wo.snapshot_json -> 'papers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) p(value)), (0)::numeric) AS paper_sheets_with_waste,
            COALESCE(( SELECT sum(COALESCE((NULLIF((p.value ->> 'coreSheets'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (NULLIF((p.value ->> 'sheets'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric)) AS sum
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE((wo.snapshot_json -> 'papers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) p(value)), (0)::numeric) AS paper_core_sheets,
            COALESCE(( SELECT sum(COALESCE((NULLIF((j.value ->> 'coreSheets'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric)) AS sum
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobs'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) j(value)), (0)::numeric) AS job_core_sheets,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'flexoDetails'::text) ->> 'totalRunningMeter'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'flexoDetails'::text) ->> 'baseRunningMeter'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS flexo_running_meter,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'flexoDetails'::text) ->> 'requiredKg'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS flexo_required_kg,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'wastage'::text) ->> 'processSheets'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS process_waste_sheets,
            GREATEST(COALESCE((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'corrugationSetCount'::text), ''::text))::numeric,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'totalBoardPlyCount'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (ceil(((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'totalBoardPlyCount'::text), ''::text))::numeric / (2)::numeric)) - (1)::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE((wo.snapshot_json -> 'corrugation'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) > 0) THEN floor(((jsonb_array_length(COALESCE((wo.snapshot_json -> 'corrugation'::text), '[]'::jsonb)))::numeric / (2)::numeric))
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END, (1)::numeric), (1)::numeric) AS corrugation_set_count
           FROM public.work_orders wo
        ), stores_issue_plan AS (
         SELECT wo.id AS wo_id,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(l.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET'::text, 'SHEETS'::text])) THEN COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS issued_sheet_qty,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(l.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'R.M.'::text, 'RUNNING METER'::text, 'RUNNING METERS'::text])) THEN COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS issued_rm_qty,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(l.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])) THEN COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS issued_kg_qty
           FROM ((public.work_orders wo
             JOIN public.inv_ledger l ON (((l.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (l.ref_no = wo.wo_number))))
             LEFT JOIN public.inv_ledger rev ON (((rev.ref_no = (l.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))
          WHERE (rev.id IS NULL)
          GROUP BY wo.id
        ), stores_issue_plan_normalized AS (
         SELECT sip.wo_id,
            sip.issued_sheet_qty,
            sip.issued_rm_qty,
            sip.issued_kg_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((sm.flexo_required_kg > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) > (sm.flexo_required_kg * (20)::numeric)) AND ((COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) / (1000)::numeric) <= (sm.flexo_required_kg * 2.5))) THEN (COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) / (1000)::numeric)
                    ELSE COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric)
                END AS effective_issued_kg_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((sm.flexo_running_meter > (0)::numeric) AND (sm.flexo_required_kg > (0)::numeric)) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN (
                        CASE
                            WHEN ((sm.flexo_required_kg > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) > (sm.flexo_required_kg * (20)::numeric)) AND ((COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) / (1000)::numeric) <= (sm.flexo_required_kg * 2.5))) THEN (((COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) / (1000)::numeric) * sm.flexo_running_meter) / sm.flexo_required_kg)
                            ELSE ((COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) * sm.flexo_running_meter) / sm.flexo_required_kg)
                        END > (sm.flexo_running_meter * (5)::numeric)) THEN sm.flexo_running_meter
                        ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN ((sm.flexo_required_kg > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) > (sm.flexo_required_kg * (20)::numeric)) AND ((COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) / (1000)::numeric) <= (sm.flexo_required_kg * 2.5))) THEN (((COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) / (1000)::numeric) * sm.flexo_running_meter) / sm.flexo_required_kg)
                            ELSE ((COALESCE(sip.issued_kg_qty, (0)::numeric) * sm.flexo_running_meter) / sm.flexo_required_kg)
                        END
                    END
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS issued_kg_equivalent_rm
           FROM (stores_issue_plan sip
             JOIN snapshot_metrics sm ON ((sm.wo_id = sip.wo_id)))
        ), initial_routing AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.wo_id) r.wo_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text) AS first_process_name
           FROM public.work_order_routing r
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['PACKING'::text, 'DISPATCH'::text, 'CUTTING PRE'::text, 'CUTTING POST'::text, 'QC'::text]))
          ORDER BY r.wo_id, r.sequence_no, r.id
        ), job_meta AS (
         SELECT woj.wo_id,
            wo.wo_number,
            wo.wo_date,
            string_agg(DISTINCT woj.so_number, ', '::text ORDER BY woj.so_number) AS so_numbers,
            string_agg(DISTINCT (woj.line_no)::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (woj.line_no)::text) AS line_nos,
            string_agg(DISTINCT woj.artwork_no, ', '::text ORDER BY woj.artwork_no) AS artwork_nos,
            max(NULLIF(woj.client_name, ''::text)) AS client_name,
            string_agg(DISTINCT woj.product_name, ' / '::text ORDER BY woj.product_name) AS product_names,
            sum(COALESCE(woj.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS order_qty,
            max(sm.flexo_running_meter) AS flexo_running_meter,
            max(sm.corrugation_set_count) AS corrugation_set_count,
            max(NULLIF(woj.job_priority, ''::text)) AS job_priority,
            max(woj.expected_delivery) AS expected_delivery,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(sum(COALESCE(woj.ups, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric),
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(NULLIF(max(sm.paper_core_sheets), (0)::numeric), NULLIF(max(sm.job_core_sheets), (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (sum(COALESCE(woj.qty, (0)::numeric)) / COALESCE(NULLIF(max(sm.paper_core_sheets), (0)::numeric), NULLIF(max(sm.job_core_sheets), (0)::numeric)))
                    ELSE (1)::numeric
                END) AS ups_factor,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(max(ac.department_category),
                    CASE
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                        ELSE NULL::text
                    END)
                END AS department_category,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(max(ir.first_process_name), ''::text)) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(max(ir.first_process_name), ''::text)) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(max(ac.department_category), ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text)) THEN GREATEST((COALESCE(max(sipn.issued_rm_qty), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(max(sipn.issued_kg_equivalent_rm), (0)::numeric)), COALESCE(max(sm.flexo_running_meter), (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(max(sipn.issued_sheet_qty), (0)::numeric), NULLIF(max(sm.paper_sheets_with_waste), (0)::numeric), NULLIF((max(sm.paper_core_sheets) + max(sm.process_waste_sheets)), (0)::numeric), (max(sm.job_core_sheets) + max(sm.process_waste_sheets)))
                END AS stage1_plan_qty
           FROM (((((public.work_order_jobs woj
             JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
             JOIN snapshot_metrics sm ON ((sm.wo_id = wo.id)))
             LEFT JOIN stores_issue_plan_normalized sipn ON ((sipn.wo_id = wo.id)))
             LEFT JOIN initial_routing ir ON ((ir.wo_id = wo.id)))
             LEFT JOIN artwork_category ac ON ((ac.artwork_no = woj.artwork_no)))
          GROUP BY woj.wo_id, wo.wo_number, wo.wo_date, wo.snapshot_json
        ), production_totals AS (
         SELECT pe.routing_id,
            sum(GREATEST(COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric)) AS gross_produced_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS ok_produced_qty
           FROM public.production_entries pe
          GROUP BY pe.routing_id
        ), routing_base AS (
         SELECT r.id AS routing_id,
            r.wo_id,
            jm.wo_number,
            jm.wo_date,
            jm.so_numbers,
            jm.line_nos,
            jm.artwork_nos,
            jm.client_name,
            jm.product_names,
            jm.order_qty,
            jm.flexo_running_meter,
            jm.corrugation_set_count,
            jm.job_priority,
            jm.expected_delivery,
            jm.ups_factor,
            jm.department_category,
            r.sequence_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text) AS process_name,
            r.department,
            r.planned_machine,
            upper(COALESCE(r.status, ''::text)) AS routing_status,
            COALESCE(pt.gross_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS gross_produced_qty,
            COALESCE(pt.ok_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS ok_produced_qty,
            corr_anchor.routing_id AS corr_top_sheet_anchor_routing_id,
            COALESCE(corr_anchor.ok_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS corr_top_sheet_anchor_ok_qty,
            jm.stage1_plan_qty,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.wo_id ORDER BY r.sequence_no, r.id) AS rn
           FROM (((public.work_order_routing r
             JOIN job_meta jm ON ((jm.wo_id = r.wo_id)))
             LEFT JOIN production_totals pt ON ((pt.routing_id = r.id)))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT anchor_r.id AS routing_id,
                    COALESCE(anchor_pt.ok_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS ok_produced_qty
                   FROM (public.work_order_routing anchor_r
                     LEFT JOIN production_totals anchor_pt ON ((anchor_pt.routing_id = anchor_r.id)))
                  WHERE ((jm.department_category = 'CORRUGATION'::text) AND (anchor_r.wo_id = r.wo_id) AND ((anchor_r.sequence_no < r.sequence_no) OR ((anchor_r.sequence_no = r.sequence_no) AND ((anchor_r.id)::text < (r.id)::text))) AND ((upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(anchor_r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(anchor_r.department, ''::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%PRINT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(anchor_r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(anchor_r.department, ''::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(anchor_r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(anchor_r.department, ''::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%COAT%'::text)))
                  ORDER BY anchor_r.sequence_no DESC, anchor_r.id DESC
                 LIMIT 1) corr_anchor ON (true))
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['PACKING'::text, 'DISPATCH'::text, 'CUTTING PRE'::text, 'CUTTING POST'::text, 'QC'::text]))
        ), stage_calc AS (
         SELECT rb.routing_id,
            rb.wo_id,
            rb.wo_number,
            rb.wo_date,
            rb.so_numbers,
            rb.line_nos,
            rb.artwork_nos,
            rb.client_name,
            rb.product_names,
            rb.order_qty,
            rb.flexo_running_meter,
            rb.job_priority,
            rb.expected_delivery,
            rb.ups_factor,
            rb.department_category,
            rb.sequence_no,
            rb.process_name,
            rb.department,
            rb.planned_machine,
            rb.routing_status,
            rb.gross_produced_qty AS produced_qty,
            rb.ok_produced_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text)) AND (upper(rb.process_name) !~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN GREATEST(rb.stage1_plan_qty, rb.gross_produced_qty)
                    WHEN (rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) THEN GREATEST(rb.stage1_plan_qty, rb.gross_produced_qty)
                    ELSE rb.stage1_plan_qty
                END AS planned_qty,
            GREATEST((
                CASE
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text)) AND (upper(rb.process_name) !~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN GREATEST(rb.stage1_plan_qty, rb.gross_produced_qty)
                    WHEN (rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) THEN GREATEST(rb.stage1_plan_qty, rb.gross_produced_qty)
                    ELSE rb.stage1_plan_qty
                END - rb.gross_produced_qty), (0)::numeric) AS balance_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) AND (upper(rb.process_name) !~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) AND (upper(rb.process_name) !~~ '%DIECUT%'::text) AND (upper(rb.process_name) !~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN rb.ok_produced_qty
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS rm_carry_qty,
            rb.rn
           FROM routing_base rb
          WHERE (rb.rn = 1)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT rb.routing_id,
            rb.wo_id,
            rb.wo_number,
            rb.wo_date,
            rb.so_numbers,
            rb.line_nos,
            rb.artwork_nos,
            rb.client_name,
            rb.product_names,
            rb.order_qty,
            rb.flexo_running_meter,
            rb.job_priority,
            rb.expected_delivery,
            rb.ups_factor,
            rb.department_category,
            rb.sequence_no,
            rb.process_name,
            rb.department,
            rb.planned_machine,
            rb.routing_status,
            rb.gross_produced_qty AS produced_qty,
            rb.ok_produced_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'CORRUGATION'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sc_1.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rb.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%2 PLY%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rb.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%TWO PLY%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rb.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%PLY MAKING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rb.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text)) THEN LEAST(
                    CASE
                        WHEN (rb.corr_top_sheet_anchor_routing_id IS NOT NULL) THEN rb.corr_top_sheet_anchor_ok_qty
                        ELSE rb.stage1_plan_qty
                    END, floor((sc_1.ok_produced_qty / GREATEST(COALESCE(rb.corrugation_set_count, (1)::numeric), (1)::numeric))))
                    WHEN (rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%PRINT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%COAT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) OR (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text))) THEN sc_1.rm_carry_qty
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text)) AND (upper(rb.process_name) !~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN sc_1.rm_carry_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%2 PLY%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%TWO PLY%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%PLY MAKING%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%CORRUGATION SHEET PASTING%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%PRINT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%COAT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    ELSE sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                END AS planned_qty,
            GREATEST((
                CASE
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'CORRUGATION'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sc_1.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rb.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%2 PLY%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rb.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%TWO PLY%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rb.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%PLY MAKING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rb.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text)) THEN LEAST(
                    CASE
                        WHEN (rb.corr_top_sheet_anchor_routing_id IS NOT NULL) THEN rb.corr_top_sheet_anchor_ok_qty
                        ELSE rb.stage1_plan_qty
                    END, floor((sc_1.ok_produced_qty / GREATEST(COALESCE(rb.corrugation_set_count, (1)::numeric), (1)::numeric))))
                    WHEN (rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%PRINT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%COAT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) OR (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text))) THEN sc_1.rm_carry_qty
                    WHEN ((rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text)) AND (upper(rb.process_name) !~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN sc_1.rm_carry_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%2 PLY%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%TWO PLY%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%PLY MAKING%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%CORRUGATION SHEET PASTING%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(rb.process_name) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text) THEN sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%PRINT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%COAT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    WHEN (upper(sc_1.process_name) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text) THEN round((sc_1.ok_produced_qty * COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.ups_factor, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric)))
                    ELSE sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                END - rb.gross_produced_qty), (0)::numeric) AS balance_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN (rb.department_category = 'FLEXO'::text) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN (rb.ok_produced_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN rb.ok_produced_qty
                        ELSE sc_1.ok_produced_qty
                    END
                    ELSE sc_1.rm_carry_qty
                END AS rm_carry_qty,
            rb.rn
           FROM (routing_base rb
             JOIN stage_calc sc_1 ON (((sc_1.wo_id = rb.wo_id) AND (rb.rn = (sc_1.rn + 1)))))
        )
 SELECT routing_id,
    wo_id,
    wo_number,
    wo_date,
    so_numbers,
    line_nos,
    artwork_nos,
    client_name,
    product_names,
    department_category,
    process_name,
    department,
    planned_machine,
    sequence_no,
    expected_delivery,
    job_priority,
    planned_qty,
    produced_qty,
    balance_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (routing_status = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) THEN 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text
            WHEN (routing_status = 'HOLD'::text) THEN 'HOLD'::text
            WHEN ((planned_qty <= (0)::numeric) AND (produced_qty <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PENDING'::text
            WHEN (balance_qty <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'COMPLETED'::text
            WHEN (produced_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING'::text
        END AS status
   FROM stage_calc sc;


--
-- TOC entry 469 (class 1259 OID 111861)
-- Name: v_production_stage_rows_fast; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_production_stage_rows_fast AS
 WITH RECURSIVE split_marker AS (
         SELECT q.wo_id,
            min(q.sequence_no) AS split_seq
           FROM public.v_production_stage_queue_fast q
          WHERE (((NULLIF(current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL) OR ((q.wo_id)::text = current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true))) AND (upper(COALESCE(q.department_category, ''::text)) <> 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text)))
          GROUP BY q.wo_id
        ), queue_meta AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT q.wo_id,
            q.wo_date,
            q.wo_number,
            q.so_numbers,
            q.line_nos,
            q.artwork_nos,
            q.client_name,
            q.product_names,
            q.department_category,
            q.expected_delivery,
            q.job_priority
           FROM public.v_production_stage_queue_fast q
          WHERE ((NULLIF(current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL) OR ((q.wo_id)::text = current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true)))
        ), combined_rows AS (
         SELECT (q.routing_id)::text AS row_key,
            0 AS row_sort,
            ''::text AS job_sort,
            'COMBINED'::text AS row_kind,
            'Combined Sheet Flow'::text AS row_description,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(q.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text)) AND (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN 'RM'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN 'SHEETS'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(q.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) THEN 'RM'::text
                    ELSE 'SHEETS'::text
                END AS plan_unit,
            q.wo_id,
            q.wo_date,
            q.routing_id,
            q.wo_number,
            q.so_numbers,
            q.so_numbers AS so_number_display,
            NULL::text AS so_number,
            NULL::text AS line_no,
            NULL::text AS job_reference,
            NULL::numeric AS job_ups,
            q.client_name,
            q.product_names AS product_name,
            q.product_names,
            q.artwork_nos AS artwork_no,
            q.artwork_nos,
            q.process_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(q.department_category, ''::text)) = 'DIGITAL'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text)) THEN 'Printing'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(q.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text))) THEN 'Inspection/Slitting'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(q.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN 'Flexo Die Sheeting'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(q.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO PRINT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%ONLINE GOLD FOIL%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%ONLINE SILVER FOIL%'::text))) THEN 'Flexo Printing'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(q.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text))) THEN 'Flexo Die Cutting Offline'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) = 'CORRUGATION SHEET PASTING'::text) THEN 'Sheet Pasting'::text
                    ELSE q.process_name
                END AS process_display_name,
            q.department,
            q.planned_machine,
            q.sequence_no,
            q.expected_delivery,
            q.job_priority,
            q.department_category,
            q.planned_qty,
            q.produced_qty,
            q.balance_qty,
            q.status
           FROM (public.v_production_stage_queue_fast q
             LEFT JOIN split_marker sm ON ((sm.wo_id = q.wo_id)))
          WHERE (((NULLIF(current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL) OR ((q.wo_id)::text = current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true))) AND ((sm.split_seq IS NULL) OR (q.sequence_no <= sm.split_seq)) AND (upper(COALESCE(q.process_name, ''::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['PACKING'::text, 'DISPATCH'::text, 'CUTTING PRE'::text, 'CUTTING POST'::text, 'QC'::text])))
        ), job_dimension AS (
         SELECT woj.wo_id,
            woj.so_number,
            (woj.line_no)::text AS line_no,
            woj.job_reference,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(woj.so_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE((woj.line_no)::text, ''::text) <> ''::text)) THEN ((woj.so_number || '||'::text) || (woj.line_no)::text)
                    WHEN (COALESCE(woj.job_reference, ''::text) <> ''::text) THEN ('REF||'::text || woj.job_reference)
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS job_key,
            max(NULLIF(woj.client_name, ''::text)) AS client_name,
            max(NULLIF(woj.product_name, ''::text)) AS product_name,
            max(NULLIF(woj.artwork_no, ''::text)) AS artwork_no,
            max(NULLIF(woj.job_priority, ''::text)) AS job_priority,
            max(woj.expected_delivery) AS expected_delivery,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(max(COALESCE(woj.ups, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), NULLIF(max(COALESCE(woj.group_ups, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric) AS job_ups
           FROM public.work_order_jobs woj
          WHERE ((NULLIF(current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL) OR ((woj.wo_id)::text = current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true)))
          GROUP BY woj.wo_id, woj.so_number, (woj.line_no)::text, woj.job_reference,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(woj.so_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE((woj.line_no)::text, ''::text) <> ''::text)) THEN ((woj.so_number || '||'::text) || (woj.line_no)::text)
                    WHEN (COALESCE(woj.job_reference, ''::text) <> ''::text) THEN ('REF||'::text || woj.job_reference)
                    ELSE ''::text
                END
        ), routing_entry_totals AS (
         SELECT pe.routing_id,
            sum(GREATEST(COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric)) AS gross_produced_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS ok_produced_qty
           FROM public.production_entries pe
          WHERE ((NULLIF(current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.work_order_routing scope_r
                  WHERE ((scope_r.id = pe.routing_id) AND ((scope_r.wo_id)::text = current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true))))))
          GROUP BY pe.routing_id
        ), job_entry_totals AS (
         SELECT pe.routing_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.so_number, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'SO:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text)) AS so_number,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.line_no, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'LINE:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text)) AS line_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'JOBREF:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text)) AS job_reference,
            sum(GREATEST(COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric)) AS gross_produced_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS ok_produced_qty
           FROM public.production_entries pe
          WHERE ((NULLIF(current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.work_order_routing scope_r
                  WHERE ((scope_r.id = pe.routing_id) AND ((scope_r.wo_id)::text = current_setting('app.production_wo_id'::text, true))))))
          GROUP BY pe.routing_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.so_number, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'SO:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text)), COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.line_no, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'LINE:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text)), COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'JOBREF:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text))
        ), job_totals AS (
         SELECT jet.routing_id,
            jet.so_number,
            jet.line_no,
            jet.job_reference,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(jet.so_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(jet.line_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)) THEN ((jet.so_number || '||'::text) || jet.line_no)
                    WHEN (COALESCE(jet.job_reference, ''::text) <> ''::text) THEN ('REF||'::text || jet.job_reference)
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS job_key,
            jet.gross_produced_qty,
            jet.ok_produced_qty
           FROM job_entry_totals jet
        ), post_split_routing AS (
         SELECT r.id AS routing_id,
            r.wo_id,
            qm.wo_date,
            qm.wo_number,
            qm.so_numbers,
            qm.line_nos,
            qm.artwork_nos,
            qm.client_name,
            qm.product_names,
            qm.department_category,
            qm.expected_delivery,
            qm.job_priority,
            r.sequence_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text) AS process_name,
            r.department,
            r.planned_machine,
            upper(COALESCE(r.status, ''::text)) AS routing_status,
            sm.split_seq,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.wo_id ORDER BY r.sequence_no, r.id) AS post_rn
           FROM ((public.work_order_routing r
             JOIN split_marker sm ON ((sm.wo_id = r.wo_id)))
             JOIN queue_meta qm ON ((qm.wo_id = r.wo_id)))
          WHERE ((r.sequence_no > sm.split_seq) AND (upper(COALESCE(r.process_name, ''::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['PACKING'::text, 'DISPATCH'::text, 'CUTTING PRE'::text, 'CUTTING POST'::text, 'QC'::text])))
        ), split_seed AS (
         SELECT psr.wo_id,
            psr.sequence_no,
            psr.post_rn,
            psr.routing_id,
            jd.job_key,
            jd.so_number,
            jd.line_no,
            jd.job_reference,
            jd.client_name,
            jd.product_name,
            jd.artwork_no,
            jd.job_priority,
            jd.expected_delivery,
            jd.job_ups,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%2 PLY%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%TWO PLY%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%PLY MAKING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORRUGATION SHEET PASTING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text) OR ((upper(COALESCE(psr.department_category, ''::text)) <> 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text))) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN COALESCE(ret.ok_produced_qty, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (COALESCE(ret.ok_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(NULLIF(jd.job_ups, (0)::numeric), (1)::numeric))
                END AS planned_qty,
            COALESCE(jt.gross_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS produced_qty,
            COALESCE(jt.ok_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS ok_produced_qty
           FROM (((((post_split_routing psr
             JOIN split_marker sm ON (((sm.wo_id = psr.wo_id) AND (psr.post_rn = 1))))
             JOIN job_dimension jd ON ((jd.wo_id = psr.wo_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.v_production_stage_queue_fast dc ON (((dc.wo_id = psr.wo_id) AND (dc.sequence_no = sm.split_seq))))
             LEFT JOIN routing_entry_totals ret ON ((ret.routing_id = dc.routing_id)))
             LEFT JOIN job_totals jt ON (((jt.routing_id = psr.routing_id) AND (jt.job_key = jd.job_key))))
        ), job_stage_calc AS (
         SELECT ss.wo_id,
            ss.sequence_no,
            ss.post_rn,
            ss.routing_id,
            ss.job_key,
            ss.so_number,
            ss.line_no,
            ss.job_reference,
            ss.client_name,
            ss.product_name,
            ss.artwork_no,
            ss.job_priority,
            ss.expected_delivery,
            ss.job_ups,
            ss.planned_qty,
            ss.produced_qty,
            ss.ok_produced_qty
           FROM split_seed ss
        UNION ALL
         SELECT nxt.wo_id,
            nxt.sequence_no,
            nxt.post_rn,
            nxt.routing_id,
            prev.job_key,
            prev.so_number,
            prev.line_no,
            prev.job_reference,
            prev.client_name,
            prev.product_name,
            prev.artwork_no,
            prev.job_priority,
            prev.expected_delivery,
            prev.job_ups,
            prev.ok_produced_qty AS planned_qty,
            COALESCE(jt.gross_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS produced_qty,
            COALESCE(jt.ok_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS ok_produced_qty
           FROM ((job_stage_calc prev
             JOIN post_split_routing nxt ON (((nxt.wo_id = prev.wo_id) AND (nxt.post_rn = (prev.post_rn + 1)))))
             LEFT JOIN job_totals jt ON (((jt.routing_id = nxt.routing_id) AND (jt.job_key = prev.job_key))))
        )
 SELECT cr.row_key,
    cr.row_sort,
    cr.job_sort,
    cr.row_kind,
    cr.row_description,
    cr.plan_unit,
    cr.wo_id,
    cr.wo_date,
    cr.routing_id,
    cr.wo_number,
    cr.so_numbers,
    cr.so_number_display,
    cr.so_number,
    cr.line_no,
    cr.job_reference,
    cr.job_ups,
    cr.client_name,
    cr.product_name,
    cr.product_names,
    cr.artwork_no,
    cr.artwork_nos,
    cr.process_name,
    cr.process_display_name,
    cr.department,
    cr.planned_machine,
    cr.sequence_no,
    cr.expected_delivery,
    cr.job_priority,
    cr.department_category,
    cr.planned_qty,
    cr.produced_qty,
    cr.balance_qty,
    cr.status
   FROM combined_rows cr
UNION ALL
 SELECT (((jsc.routing_id)::text || '||'::text) || jsc.job_key) AS row_key,
    1 AS row_sort,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(jsc.job_reference, ''::text), ((COALESCE(jsc.so_number, ''::text) || '-'::text) || COALESCE(jsc.line_no, ''::text))) AS job_sort,
    'JOB'::text AS row_kind,
    'Separated Job'::text AS row_description,
        CASE
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text)) THEN 'RM'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text)) AND (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) !~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN 'RM'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%2 PLY%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%TWO PLY%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%PLY MAKING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORRUGATION SHEET PASTING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text) OR ((upper(COALESCE(psr.department_category, ''::text)) <> 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text))) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN 'SHEETS'::text
            ELSE 'UNITS'::text
        END AS plan_unit,
    psr.wo_id,
    psr.wo_date,
    psr.routing_id,
    psr.wo_number,
    psr.so_numbers,
    COALESCE(jsc.so_number, ''::text) AS so_number_display,
    jsc.so_number,
    jsc.line_no,
    jsc.job_reference,
    jsc.job_ups,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(jsc.client_name, ''::text), psr.client_name) AS client_name,
    jsc.product_name,
    psr.product_names,
    jsc.artwork_no,
    psr.artwork_nos,
    psr.process_name,
        CASE
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.department_category, ''::text)) = 'DIGITAL'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text)) THEN 'Printing'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%INSPECTION%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SLITTING%'::text))) THEN 'Inspection/Slitting'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text)) THEN 'Flexo Die Sheeting'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO PRINT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%ONLINE GOLD FOIL%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%ONLINE SILVER FOIL%'::text))) THEN 'Flexo Printing'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(psr.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND ((upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text))) THEN 'Flexo Die Cutting Offline'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(psr.process_name, ''::text)) = 'CORRUGATION SHEET PASTING'::text) THEN 'Sheet Pasting'::text
            ELSE psr.process_name
        END AS process_display_name,
    psr.department,
    psr.planned_machine,
    psr.sequence_no,
    COALESCE(jsc.expected_delivery, psr.expected_delivery) AS expected_delivery,
    COALESCE(jsc.job_priority, psr.job_priority) AS job_priority,
    psr.department_category,
    jsc.planned_qty,
    jsc.produced_qty,
    GREATEST((jsc.planned_qty - jsc.produced_qty), (0)::numeric) AS balance_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (psr.routing_status = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) THEN 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text
            WHEN (psr.routing_status = 'HOLD'::text) THEN 'HOLD'::text
            WHEN ((jsc.planned_qty <= (0)::numeric) AND (jsc.produced_qty <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PENDING'::text
            WHEN (GREATEST((jsc.planned_qty - jsc.produced_qty), (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'COMPLETED'::text
            WHEN (jsc.produced_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING'::text
        END AS status
   FROM (job_stage_calc jsc
     JOIN post_split_routing psr ON ((psr.routing_id = jsc.routing_id)));


--
-- TOC entry 687 (class 1255 OID 228629)
-- Name: production_wo_entry_rows(uuid); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.production_wo_entry_rows(p_wo_id uuid) RETURNS SETOF public.v_production_stage_rows_fast
    LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  if p_wo_id is null then
    raise exception 'WO required';
  end if;

  perform set_config('app.production_wo_id', p_wo_id::text, true);

  return query
  select *
  from public.v_production_stage_rows_fast r
  where r.wo_id = p_wo_id
  order by r.sequence_no, r.row_sort, r.job_sort;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 737 (class 1255 OID 228734)
-- Name: production_wo_entry_source(uuid); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.production_wo_entry_source(p_wo_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
  with target_wo as (
    select wo.id, wo.wo_number, wo.wo_date, wo.snapshot_json
    from public.work_orders wo
    where wo.id = p_wo_id
  ),
  target_jobs as (
    select
      j.wo_id, j.so_number, j.line_no, j.product_name, j.qty, j.category,
      j.artwork_no, j.client_name, j.job_priority, j.expected_delivery,
      j.ups, j.group_ups, j.job_reference
    from public.work_order_jobs j
    where j.wo_id = p_wo_id
  ),
  target_routing as (
    select
      r.id, r.wo_id, r.sequence_no, r.process_name, r.department,
      r.status, r.planned_machine
    from public.work_order_routing r
    where r.wo_id = p_wo_id
  ),
  target_entries as (
    select
      pe.routing_id, pe.so_number, pe.line_no, pe.job_reference,
      pe.produced_qty, pe.rejected_qty, pe.ok_qty, pe.downtime_reason
    from public.production_entries pe
    join target_routing r on r.id = pe.routing_id
  ),
  target_artworks as (
    select distinct a.artwork_no, a.product_type
    from public.artworks a
    join target_jobs j on j.artwork_no = a.artwork_no
  ),
  corr_2ply_details as (
    select d.routing_id, d.set_group_key, d.produced_sheets
    from public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
    join target_routing r on r.id = d.routing_id
  ),
  issue_totals as (
    select
      coalesce(sum(case
        when upper(coalesce(split_part(l.remarks, '|', 5), '')) in ('SHEET', 'SHEETS')
        then coalesce(l.qty_out, 0) else 0 end), 0) as issued_sheet_qty,
      coalesce(sum(case
        when upper(coalesce(split_part(l.remarks, '|', 5), '')) in ('RM', 'R.M.', 'RUNNING METER', 'RUNNING METERS')
        then coalesce(l.qty_out, 0) else 0 end), 0) as issued_rm_qty,
      coalesce(sum(case
        when upper(coalesce(split_part(l.remarks, '|', 5), '')) in ('KG', 'KGS', 'KILOGRAM', 'KILOGRAMS')
        then coalesce(l.qty_out, 0) else 0 end), 0) as issued_kg_qty
    from target_wo wo
    join public.inv_ledger l
      on l.ref_type = 'ISSUE'
     and l.ref_no = wo.wo_number
    where not exists (
      select 1
      from public.inv_ledger rev
      where rev.ref_no = l.id::text
        and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
    )
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'workOrder', coalesce((select to_jsonb(w) from target_wo w), '{}'::jsonb),
    'jobs', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)) from target_jobs j), '[]'::jsonb),
    'routing', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.sequence_no, r.id)
      from target_routing r
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'entries', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) from target_entries e), '[]'::jsonb),
    'artworks', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)) from target_artworks a), '[]'::jsonb),
    'corr2PlyDetails', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) from corr_2ply_details d), '[]'::jsonb),
    'issueTotals', coalesce((select to_jsonb(i) from issue_totals i), '{}'::jsonb)
  );
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 781 (class 1255 OID 181985)
-- Name: protect_audit_events(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.protect_audit_events() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    raise exception 'Audit events cannot be deleted.';
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    raise exception 'Audit events are immutable.';
  end if;

  return old;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 907 (class 1255 OID 173719)
-- Name: protect_work_order_deletion_audit_log(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.protect_work_order_deletion_audit_log() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    raise exception 'Work order deletion audit rows cannot be deleted.';
  end if;

  if old.deletion_status = 'COMPLETED' then
    raise exception 'Completed work order deletion audit rows are immutable.';
  end if;

  if new.wo_id is distinct from old.wo_id
    or new.wo_number is distinct from old.wo_number
    or new.wo_date is distinct from old.wo_date
    or new.wo_status is distinct from old.wo_status
    or new.work_order_type is distinct from old.work_order_type
    or new.deleted_by is distinct from old.deleted_by
    or new.deletion_reason is distinct from old.deletion_reason
    or new.deleted_data is distinct from old.deleted_data
    or new.so_numbers is distinct from old.so_numbers
    or new.created_at is distinct from old.created_at
    or new.deletion_status <> 'COMPLETED'
    or new.completed_at is null
  then
    raise exception 'Only completion of a pending work order deletion audit row is allowed.';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 883 (class 1255 OID 218079)

CREATE FUNCTION public.purchase_rate_override_fingerprint(p_request jsonb) RETURNS text
    LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
  select md5(concat_ws('|',
    upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'context_type', ''))),
    upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'po_no', ''))),
    trim(coalesce(p_request->>'po_line_id', '')),
    upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'pr_no', ''))),
    upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'item_code', ''))),
    upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'rate_key', ''))),
    upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'purchase_uom', ''))),
    upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'vendor_id', ''))),
    upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'vendor_name', ''))),
    round(coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'requested_qty', '')::numeric, 0), 6)::text,
    round(coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'requested_purchase_qty', '')::numeric, 0), 6)::text,
    round(coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'master_rate', '')::numeric, 0), 4)::text,
    round(coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'requested_rate', '')::numeric, 0), 4)::text,
    round(coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'master_tax_pct', '')::numeric, 0), 2)::text,
    round(coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'requested_tax_pct', '')::numeric, 0), 2)::text
  ));
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 763 (class 1255 OID 107536)
-- Name: refresh_sales_order_line_status(uuid); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(p_so_line_id uuid) RETURNS void
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_order_qty numeric := 0;
  v_dispatched_qty numeric := 0;
  v_billed_qty numeric := 0;
  v_header_status text := 'OPEN';
  v_current_status text := 'OPEN';
  v_current_closed_by text := null;
  v_next_status text := 'OPEN';
  v_next_closed_by text := null;
  v_latest_dispatch_by text := null;
  v_latest_invoice_by text := null;
  v_manual_closed boolean := false;
  v_manual_cancelled boolean := false;
  v_is_manual_billing boolean := false;
begin
  if p_so_line_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  select
    coalesce(sol.qty, 0),
    upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')),
    upper(coalesce(sol.status, 'OPEN')),
    nullif(sol.closed_by, ''),
    (
      upper(coalesce(so.order_prefix, '')) = 'MB'
      or upper(coalesce(so.sales_type, '')) = 'MANUAL_BILLING'
      or coalesce(so.so_number, '') ~* '^MB[/-]'
    )
  into v_order_qty, v_header_status, v_current_status, v_current_closed_by, v_is_manual_billing
  from public.sales_order_lines sol
  join public.sales_orders so
    on so.id = sol.so_id
  where sol.id = p_so_line_id;

  if not found then
    return;
  end if;

  v_manual_closed :=
    v_current_status in ('CLOSED', 'SHORT_CLOSED')
    and (
      upper(coalesce(v_current_closed_by, '')) like '%MANUAL%'
      or upper(coalesce(v_current_closed_by, '')) like '%SHORT CLOSE%'
      or upper(coalesce(v_current_closed_by, '')) like '%SHORT_CLOSE%'
      or upper(coalesce(v_current_closed_by, '')) like '%LEGACY%'
    );

  v_manual_cancelled :=
    v_current_status = 'CANCELLED'
    and (
      upper(coalesce(v_current_closed_by, '')) like '%MANUAL%'
      or upper(coalesce(v_current_closed_by, '')) like '%LEGACY%'
    );

  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(dr.dispatch_qty, 0)), 0)
  into v_dispatched_qty
  from public.dispatch_records dr
  where dr.so_line_id = p_so_line_id;

  select nullif(dr.created_by, '')
  into v_latest_dispatch_by
  from public.dispatch_records dr
  where dr.so_line_id = p_so_line_id
  order by coalesce(dr.dispatch_date, dr.created_at) desc nulls last,
           dr.created_at desc nulls last,
           dr.id desc
  limit 1;

  select coalesce(sum(coalesce(il.qty, 0)), 0)
  into v_billed_qty
  from public.invoice_lines il
  left join public.invoices inv
    on inv.id = il.invoice_id
  where il.so_line_id = p_so_line_id
    and upper(coalesce(inv.status, 'DRAFT')) = 'POSTED'
    and upper(coalesce(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE')) <> 'CHALLAN'
    and coalesce(inv.invoice_no, '') not like 'DC-H/%';

  select nullif(inv.created_by, '')
  into v_latest_invoice_by
  from public.invoice_lines il
  left join public.invoices inv
    on inv.id = il.invoice_id
  where il.so_line_id = p_so_line_id
    and upper(coalesce(inv.status, 'DRAFT')) = 'POSTED'
    and upper(coalesce(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE')) <> 'CHALLAN'
    and coalesce(inv.invoice_no, '') not like 'DC-H/%'
  order by coalesce(inv.posted_at, inv.created_at, inv.invoice_date::timestamptz) desc nulls last,
           inv.id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_header_status = 'CANCELLED' then
    v_next_status := 'CANCELLED';
    v_next_closed_by := coalesce(v_current_closed_by, 'System - order cancelled');
  elsif v_manual_cancelled then
    v_next_status := 'CANCELLED';
    v_next_closed_by := v_current_closed_by;
  elsif v_is_manual_billing then
    v_next_status := 'CLOSED';
    v_next_closed_by := coalesce(v_current_closed_by, 'System - manual billing');
  elsif v_manual_closed then
    v_next_status := 'CLOSED';
    v_next_closed_by := v_current_closed_by;
  elsif v_billed_qty >= v_order_qty and v_order_qty > 0 then
    v_next_status := 'CLOSED';
    v_next_closed_by := coalesce(v_latest_invoice_by, 'System - fully billed');
  elsif v_dispatched_qty >= v_order_qty and v_order_qty > 0 then
    v_next_status := 'CLOSED';
    v_next_closed_by := coalesce(v_latest_dispatch_by, 'System - fully dispatched');
  elsif v_dispatched_qty > 0 then
    v_next_status := 'PARTIAL_DISPATCHED';
    v_next_closed_by := null;
  else
    v_next_status := 'OPEN';
    v_next_closed_by := null;
  end if;

  update public.sales_order_lines
  set
    status = v_next_status,
    closed_at = case
      when v_next_status in ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') then coalesce(closed_at, now())
      else null
    end,
    closed_by = case
      when v_next_status = 'CANCELLED' and v_manual_cancelled then v_current_closed_by
      when v_next_status = 'CANCELLED' then v_next_closed_by
      when v_next_status = 'CLOSED' and v_manual_closed then v_current_closed_by
      when v_next_status = 'CLOSED' then v_next_closed_by
      else null
    end,
    status_updated_at = now()
  where id = p_so_line_id
    and (
      upper(coalesce(status, '')) is distinct from v_next_status
      or (v_next_status = 'CANCELLED' and closed_at is null)
      or (v_next_status = 'CANCELLED' and nullif(closed_by, '') is distinct from v_next_closed_by and not v_manual_cancelled)
      or (v_next_status = 'CLOSED' and closed_at is null)
      or (v_next_status = 'CLOSED' and nullif(closed_by, '') is distinct from v_next_closed_by and not v_manual_closed)
      or (v_next_status not in ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') and closed_at is not null)
      or (v_next_status not in ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') and closed_by is not null)
    );
end;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 923 (class 1255 OID 220677)
-- Name: register_opening_kraft_reels(uuid, jsonb, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.register_opening_kraft_reels(p_source_lot_id uuid, p_reels jsonb, p_actor text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $_$
declare
  v_source public.inv_lots%rowtype;
  v_item public.inv_items%rowtype;
  v_reel jsonb;
  v_qty numeric;
  v_total numeric := 0;
  v_reel_no text;
  v_lot_id uuid;
  v_results jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_reels) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_reels) = 0 then
    raise exception 'Enter at least one existing reel';
  end if;

  select * into v_source
  from public.inv_lots
  where id = p_source_lot_id
  for update;

  if not found then raise exception 'Source stock lot was not found'; end if;
  if v_source.is_reel is true then
    raise exception 'Select an aggregate/opening stock lot, not an existing reel';
  end if;
  if upper(coalesce(v_source.location, '')) <> 'MAIN' then
    raise exception 'Existing reels can be registered only from Main Stores stock';
  end if;
  if coalesce(v_source.qty_available, 0) <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Source stock lot has no available quantity';
  end if;

  select * into v_item
  from public.inv_items
  where id = v_source.item_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_item.reel_tracking_enabled is not true then
    raise exception 'Enable reel tracking on the item master before registration';
  end if;
  if upper(coalesce(v_item.uom, '')) <> 'KG'
     or coalesce(v_item.width_mm, 0) <= 0
     or coalesce(v_item.gsm, 0) <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Reel item must use KG and have positive master width and GSM';
  end if;

  for v_reel in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_reels)
  loop
    v_qty := coalesce(nullif(v_reel->>'gross_weight_kg', '')::numeric, 0);
    if v_qty <= 0 then
      raise exception 'Every reel must have a positive gross weight';
    end if;
    v_total := v_total + v_qty;
  end loop;

  if v_total > v_source.qty_available + 0.0001 then
    raise exception 'Reel total % KG exceeds source lot balance % KG',
      round(v_total, 3), round(v_source.qty_available, 3);
  end if;

  for v_reel in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_reels)
  loop
    v_qty := (v_reel->>'gross_weight_kg')::numeric;
    v_reel_no := upper(trim(coalesce(v_reel->>'internal_reel_no', '')));
    if v_reel_no = '' then
      v_reel_no := public.next_internal_reel_no();
    elsif v_reel_no !~ '^KR-[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{2,30}$' then
      raise exception 'Internal reel number % must start with KR- and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens',
        v_reel_no;
    end if;
    if exists (
      select 1 from public.inv_lots where upper(batch_no) = v_reel_no
    ) then
      raise exception 'Internal reel number % already exists', v_reel_no;
    end if;
    if v_reel_no ~ '^KR-[0-9]{6}-[0-9]{6}$' then
      insert into public.inv_reel_sequences (period_key, last_no, updated_at)
      values (
        split_part(v_reel_no, '-', 2),
        split_part(v_reel_no, '-', 3)::bigint,
        now()
      )
      on conflict (period_key) do update
      set last_no = greatest(
            public.inv_reel_sequences.last_no,
            excluded.last_no
          ),
          updated_at = now();
    end if;

    v_lot_id := gen_random_uuid();
    insert into public.inv_lots (
      id, item_id, item_code, batch_no, source_type, source_ref,
      location, receipt_date, qty_received, qty_available, rate,
      department, remarks, created_at, is_reel, reel_status,
      gross_weight_kg, master_width_mm, master_gsm
    ) values (
      v_lot_id, v_source.item_id, v_source.item_code, v_reel_no,
      'OPENING-REEL-REGISTRATION', v_source.id::text, 'MAIN',
      coalesce(v_source.receipt_date, now()), v_qty, v_qty, v_source.rate,
      v_source.department,
      concat_ws(' | ', 'Registered from existing stock', nullif(trim(coalesce(p_note, '')), '')),
      now(), true, 'AVAILABLE', v_qty, v_item.width_mm, v_item.gsm
    );

    insert into public.inv_reel_opening_registrations (
      source_lot_id, reel_lot_id, internal_reel_no, item_id,
      registered_weight_kg, source_batch_no, registration_note, actor
    ) values (
      v_source.id, v_lot_id, v_reel_no, v_source.item_id,
      v_qty, v_source.batch_no, trim(coalesce(p_note, '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_actor, ''))
    );

    insert into public.inv_reel_events (
      lot_id, internal_reel_no, event_type, qty, balance_after,
      location, actor, reason, metadata
    ) values (
      v_lot_id, v_reel_no, 'OPENING_REGISTERED', v_qty, v_qty,
      'MAIN', trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')), trim(coalesce(p_note, '')),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'sourceLotId', v_source.id,
        'sourceBatchNo', coalesce(v_source.batch_no, ''),
        'ledgerQuantityChanged', false
      )
    );

    v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'lotId', v_lot_id,
      'reelNo', v_reel_no,
      'weightKg', v_qty
    ));
  end loop;

  update public.inv_lots
  set qty_available = round(qty_available - v_total, 6),
      remarks = concat_ws(
        ' | ',
        nullif(remarks, ''),
        'Split into internal reels: ' || round(v_total, 3)::text || ' KG'
      )
  where id = v_source.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'sourceLotId', v_source.id,
    'registeredQtyKg', v_total,
    'sourceBalanceKg', round(v_source.qty_available - v_total, 6),
    'reels', v_results
  );
end;
$_$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.register_opening_kraft_reels(p_source_lot_id uuid, p_reels jsonb, p_actor text, p_note text) IS 'Splits an existing aggregate lot into internal reel lots without changing ledger stock quantity.';


--
-- TOC entry 718 (class 1255 OID 217556)
-- Name: release_inventory_reservation(uuid, numeric, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.release_inventory_reservation(p_reservation_id uuid, p_release_qty numeric, p_reason text, p_actor text) RETURNS TABLE(ok boolean, wo_number text, released_qty numeric)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_row inventory_reservations%rowtype;
  v_reason text := trim(coalesce(p_reason, ''));
  v_release numeric;
  v_after numeric;
begin
  if v_reason = '' then raise exception 'Unallocation reason is required.'; end if;
  select * into v_row
    from inventory_reservations
   where id = p_reservation_id
   for update;
  if v_row.id is null then raise exception 'Stock allocation not found.'; end if;
  if v_row.status not in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED') or v_row.reserved_qty <= 0 then
    raise exception 'This stock allocation is no longer active.';
  end if;
  v_release := coalesce(nullif(p_release_qty, 0), v_row.reserved_qty);
  if v_release <= 0 or v_release > v_row.reserved_qty then
    raise exception 'Unallocation quantity must be between 0 and %.', v_row.reserved_qty;
  end if;
  v_after := v_row.reserved_qty - v_release;

  insert into inventory_reservation_audit (
    reservation_id, wo_number, work_order_material_id, material_key, item_id,
    location, action, before_qty, after_qty, changed_qty, reason, changed_by
  ) values (
    v_row.id, v_row.wo_number, v_row.work_order_material_id, v_row.material_key,
    v_row.item_id, v_row.location, 'MANUAL_UNALLOCATE', v_row.reserved_qty, v_after,
    -v_release, v_reason, p_actor
  );

  update inventory_reservations
     set reserved_qty = v_after,
         status = case when v_after > 0 then 'ACTIVE' else 'RELEASED' end,
         updated_by = p_actor,
         updated_at = now(),
         released_at = case when v_after = 0 then now() else null end,
         release_reason = v_reason,
         allocation_blocked = true
   where id = v_row.id;

  return query select true, v_row.wo_number, v_release;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 758 (class 1255 OID 173691)
-- Name: replace_client_credit_snapshot(jsonb, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.replace_client_credit_snapshot(p_rows jsonb, p_source_spreadsheet_id text, p_source_sheet_name text, p_synced_by text DEFAULT NULL::text) RETURNS TABLE(sync_batch_id uuid, synced_at timestamp with time zone, synced_count integer, unmatched_client_count integer)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_batch_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_synced_at timestamp with time zone := now();
  v_count integer := 0;
  v_unmatched integer := 0;
begin
  if p_rows is null or jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'Credit snapshot rows must be a JSON array';
  end if;

  create temporary table tmp_client_credit_snapshot (
    client_code text primary key,
    source_client_name text,
    credit_limit numeric(18,2),
    current_balance numeric(18,2),
    source_row_number integer
  ) on commit drop;

  insert into tmp_client_credit_snapshot (
    client_code,
    source_client_name,
    credit_limit,
    current_balance,
    source_row_number
  )
  select
    upper(trim(x.client_code)),
    nullif(trim(x.client_name), ''),
    x.credit_limit,
    x.current_balance,
    x.source_row_number
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_rows) as x(
    client_code text,
    client_name text,
    credit_limit numeric,
    current_balance numeric,
    source_row_number integer
  )
  where nullif(trim(x.client_code), '') is not null;

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  if v_count = 0 then
    raise exception 'No client credit rows were supplied';
  end if;

  insert into public.client_credit_snapshot (
    client_code,
    source_client_name,
    credit_limit,
    current_balance,
    source_spreadsheet_id,
    source_sheet_name,
    source_row_number,
    sync_batch_id,
    synced_at,
    synced_by
  )
  select
    t.client_code,
    t.source_client_name,
    t.credit_limit,
    t.current_balance,
    p_source_spreadsheet_id,
    p_source_sheet_name,
    t.source_row_number,
    v_batch_id,
    v_synced_at,
    p_synced_by
  from tmp_client_credit_snapshot t
  on conflict (client_code) do update set
    source_client_name = excluded.source_client_name,
    credit_limit = excluded.credit_limit,
    current_balance = excluded.current_balance,
    source_spreadsheet_id = excluded.source_spreadsheet_id,
    source_sheet_name = excluded.source_sheet_name,
    source_row_number = excluded.source_row_number,
    sync_batch_id = excluded.sync_batch_id,
    synced_at = excluded.synced_at,
    synced_by = excluded.synced_by;

  delete from public.client_credit_snapshot c
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from tmp_client_credit_snapshot t
    where t.client_code = c.client_code
  );

  insert into public.client_credit_snapshot_history (
    sync_batch_id,
    client_code,
    source_client_name,
    credit_limit,
    current_balance,
    source_spreadsheet_id,
    source_sheet_name,
    source_row_number,
    synced_at,
    synced_by
  )
  select
    v_batch_id,
    t.client_code,
    t.source_client_name,
    t.credit_limit,
    t.current_balance,
    p_source_spreadsheet_id,
    p_source_sheet_name,
    t.source_row_number,
    v_synced_at,
    p_synced_by
  from tmp_client_credit_snapshot t;

  select count(*)::integer
    into v_unmatched
  from tmp_client_credit_snapshot t
  left join public.clients c
    on upper(trim(c.client_code)) = t.client_code
  where c.id is null;

  return query
  select v_batch_id, v_synced_at, v_count, v_unmatched;
end;
$$;
