-- Name: return_kraft_reel_v2(uuid, text, numeric, numeric, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.return_kraft_reel_v2(p_lot_id uuid, p_wo_no text, p_return_qty numeric, p_process_waste_qty numeric, p_reason text, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_lot public.inv_lots%rowtype;
  v_cycle public.inv_reel_issue_cycles%rowtype;
  v_ledger_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_return_qty numeric := coalesce(p_return_qty, 0);
  v_process_waste numeric := greatest(coalesce(p_process_waste_qty, 0), 0);
  v_consumed numeric := 0;
  v_expected numeric;
  v_variance numeric;
begin
  select * into v_lot
  from public.inv_lots
  where id = p_lot_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_lot.is_reel is not true then
    raise exception 'Kraft reel was not found';
  end if;
  if v_lot.reel_status <> 'ISSUED' then
    raise exception 'Only an issued reel can be returned';
  end if;

  select * into v_cycle
  from public.inv_reel_issue_cycles
  where id = v_lot.current_issue_cycle_id
    and lot_id = v_lot.id
    and status = 'ACTIVE'
  for update;

  if not found then raise exception 'Active reel issue cycle was not found'; end if;
  if coalesce(v_cycle.custody_scope, 'WORK_ORDER') <> 'FLOOR'
     and (
       trim(coalesce(p_wo_no, '')) = ''
       or v_cycle.wo_no <> trim(p_wo_no)
       or trim(coalesce(v_lot.assigned_wo_no, '')) <> trim(p_wo_no)
     ) then
    raise exception 'Return work order does not match the active reel issue';
  end if;

  select
    coalesce(sum(case when d.liner_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id then d.liner_consumed_kg else 0 end), 0)
    + coalesce(sum(case when d.fluting_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id then d.fluting_consumed_kg else 0 end), 0)
  into v_consumed
  from public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
  where d.liner_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id
     or d.fluting_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id;

  v_expected := greatest(v_cycle.issue_qty_kg - v_consumed - v_process_waste, 0);
  if v_return_qty <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Return weight must be positive';
  end if;
  if v_return_qty > v_cycle.issue_qty_kg - v_consumed + 0.0001 then
    raise exception 'Return weight plus production consumption exceeds issued reel weight';
  end if;
  v_variance := v_return_qty - v_expected;
  if abs(v_variance) > 0.0001 and trim(coalesce(p_reason, '')) = '' then
    raise exception 'A return variance reason is required';
  end if;

  insert into public.inv_ledger (
    id, item_id, location, ref_type, ref_no, qty_in, qty_out, rate,
    value, remarks, created_at, department, batch_no
  ) values (
    v_ledger_id, v_lot.item_id, 'MAIN', 'WO-RETURN', v_cycle.wo_no,
    v_return_qty, 0, v_lot.rate, v_return_qty * v_lot.rate,
    concat_ws(' | ', v_cycle.material_key, 'Floor custody return'),
    now(), v_lot.department, v_lot.batch_no
  );

  update public.inv_reel_issue_cycles
  set production_consumed_kg = v_consumed,
      process_waste_kg = v_process_waste,
      expected_return_qty_kg = v_expected,
      actual_return_qty_kg = v_return_qty,
      return_variance_kg = v_variance,
      return_ledger_id = v_ledger_id,
      status = 'RETURNED',
      close_actor = trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
      close_reason = trim(coalesce(p_reason, '')),
      closed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
  where id = v_cycle.id;

  update public.inv_lots
  set qty_available = v_return_qty,
      location = 'MAIN',
      reel_status = 'RETURNED',
      assigned_wo_no = null,
      issued_gross_qty = 0,
      last_calculated_consumption_kg = v_consumed,
      returned_at = now(),
      current_issue_cycle_id = null
  where id = v_lot.id;

  insert into public.inv_reel_events (
    lot_id, internal_reel_no, event_type, wo_no, qty, balance_after,
    location, material_key, reason, actor, metadata, issue_cycle_id
  ) values (
    v_lot.id, v_lot.batch_no, 'WO_RETURN', v_cycle.wo_no,
    v_return_qty, v_return_qty, 'MAIN', v_cycle.material_key,
    trim(coalesce(p_reason, '')), trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'custodyScope', coalesce(v_cycle.custody_scope, 'WORK_ORDER'),
      'initialWoNo', v_cycle.wo_no,
      'issuedGrossQty', v_cycle.issue_qty_kg,
      'productionConsumedKg', v_consumed,
      'processWasteKg', v_process_waste,
      'expectedReturnKg', v_expected,
      'actualReturnKg', v_return_qty,
      'returnVarianceKg', v_variance,
      'returnLedgerId', v_ledger_id
    ),
    v_cycle.id
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'reelNo', v_lot.batch_no,
    'returnQty', v_return_qty,
    'productionConsumedKg', v_consumed,
    'processWasteKg', v_process_waste,
    'expectedReturnKg', v_expected,
    'varianceKg', v_variance,
    'balanceKg', v_return_qty,
    'ledgerId', v_ledger_id,
    'issueCycleId', v_cycle.id
  );
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 922 (class 1255 OID 220684)
-- Name: reverse_kraft_grn(text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.reverse_kraft_grn(p_grn_no text, p_reason text, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_grn public.purchase_grns%rowtype;
  v_receipt public.purchase_po_receipts%rowtype;
  v_ledger public.inv_ledger%rowtype;
  v_lot public.inv_lots%rowtype;
  v_po_line public.purchase_order_lines%rowtype;
  v_reversal_ledger_id uuid;
  v_receipt_count integer := 0;
  v_ledger_count integer := 0;
  v_reason text := trim(coalesce(p_reason, ''));
begin
  if trim(coalesce(p_grn_no, '')) = '' then raise exception 'GRN number is required'; end if;
  if v_reason = '' then raise exception 'GRN reversal reason is required'; end if;

  select * into v_grn
  from public.purchase_grns
  where grn_no = trim(p_grn_no)
  for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'GRN % was not found', trim(p_grn_no); end if;
  if v_grn.reversed_at is not null
     or exists (select 1 from public.purchase_grn_reversals where grn_no = v_grn.grn_no) then
    raise exception 'GRN % is already reversed', v_grn.grn_no;
  end if;

  select count(*) into v_receipt_count
  from public.purchase_po_receipts
  where grn_no = v_grn.grn_no
    and reversed_at is null;
  if v_receipt_count = 0 then raise exception 'GRN has no active receipt lines'; end if;

  -- Lock and validate every affected lot before writing any reversal row.
  for v_ledger in
    select distinct l.*
    from public.purchase_po_receipts r
    join lateral (
      select r.ledger_id as ledger_id
      union
      select gr.ledger_id
      from public.purchase_grn_reels gr
      where gr.receipt_id = r.id
    ) x on x.ledger_id is not null
    join public.inv_ledger l on l.id = x.ledger_id
    where r.grn_no = v_grn.grn_no
      and r.reversed_at is null
    order by l.created_at, l.id
  loop
    select * into v_lot
    from public.inv_lots
    where item_id = v_ledger.item_id
      and batch_no = v_ledger.batch_no
      and location = v_ledger.location
    order by created_at
    limit 1
    for update;
    if not found then
      raise exception 'Receipt lot % was not found', v_ledger.batch_no;
    end if;
    if v_lot.is_reel is true then
      if v_lot.reel_status not in ('AVAILABLE','RETURNED')
         or v_lot.current_issue_cycle_id is not null
         or exists (
           select 1 from public.inv_reel_events e
           where e.lot_id = v_lot.id
             and e.event_type not in ('GRN_RECEIPT')
         ) then
        raise exception 'Reel % has downstream movement and the GRN cannot be reversed',
          v_lot.batch_no;
      end if;
    end if;
    if coalesce(v_lot.qty_available, 0) + 0.0001 < coalesce(v_ledger.qty_in, 0) then
      raise exception 'Batch % has already been consumed; GRN reversal is blocked',
        v_lot.batch_no;
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into public.purchase_grn_reversals (
    grn_id, grn_no, po_no, reason, actor, receipt_snapshot, reel_snapshot
  )
  select
    v_grn.id,
    v_grn.grn_no,
    v_grn.po_no,
    v_reason,
    trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
    coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.created_at)
      from public.purchase_po_receipts r
      where r.grn_no = v_grn.grn_no
        and r.reversed_at is null
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(gr) order by gr.created_at)
      from public.purchase_grn_reels gr
      join public.purchase_po_receipts r on r.id = gr.receipt_id
      where r.grn_no = v_grn.grn_no
        and r.reversed_at is null
    ), '[]'::jsonb);

  for v_receipt in
    select *
    from public.purchase_po_receipts
    where grn_no = v_grn.grn_no
      and reversed_at is null
    order by created_at, id
    for update
  loop
    select * into v_po_line
    from public.purchase_order_lines
    where id = v_receipt.po_line_id;

    for v_ledger in
      select distinct l.*
      from (
        select v_receipt.ledger_id as ledger_id
        union
        select gr.ledger_id
        from public.purchase_grn_reels gr
        where gr.receipt_id = v_receipt.id
      ) x
      join public.inv_ledger l on l.id = x.ledger_id
      where x.ledger_id is not null
    loop
      select * into v_lot
      from public.inv_lots
      where item_id = v_ledger.item_id
        and batch_no = v_ledger.batch_no
        and location = v_ledger.location
      order by created_at
      limit 1
      for update;

      v_reversal_ledger_id := gen_random_uuid();
      insert into public.inv_ledger (
        id, item_id, location, ref_type, ref_no, qty_in, qty_out,
        rate, value, remarks, created_at, department, batch_no
      ) values (
        v_reversal_ledger_id, v_ledger.item_id, v_ledger.location,
        'REV-PO-RECEIPT', v_ledger.id::text, 0, v_ledger.qty_in,
        v_ledger.rate, v_ledger.qty_in * v_ledger.rate,
        'Complete GRN reversal | TXN:' || v_ledger.id::text ||
          ' | GRN:' || v_grn.grn_no || ' | Reason:' || v_reason,
        now(), v_ledger.department, v_ledger.batch_no
      );

      update public.inv_lots
      set qty_received = greatest(qty_received - v_ledger.qty_in, 0),
          qty_available = greatest(qty_available - v_ledger.qty_in, 0),
          reel_status = case when is_reel then 'CLOSED' else reel_status end,
          closed_at = case when is_reel then now() else closed_at end,
          closed_reason = case
            when is_reel then 'GRN reversal: ' || v_reason
            else closed_reason
          end
      where id = v_lot.id;

      if v_lot.is_reel is true then
        insert into public.inv_reel_events (
          lot_id, internal_reel_no, event_type, qty, balance_after,
          location, reason, actor, metadata
        ) values (
          v_lot.id, v_lot.batch_no, 'GRN_REVERSAL', v_ledger.qty_in, 0,
          v_lot.location, v_reason, trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'originalLedgerId', v_ledger.id,
            'reversalLedgerId', v_reversal_ledger_id,
            'grnNo', v_grn.grn_no
          )
        );
      end if;
      v_ledger_count := v_ledger_count + 1;
    end loop;

    if upper(coalesce(v_po_line.source_type, '')) = 'INVENTORY_PR'
       and nullif(trim(coalesce(v_po_line.source_ref, '')), '') is not null then
      update public.inv_purchase_requests
      set received_qty = greatest(coalesce(received_qty, 0) - v_receipt.qty, 0),
          status = case
            when greatest(coalesce(received_qty, 0) - v_receipt.qty, 0) >= requested_qty
              then 'CLOSED'
            else 'OPEN'
          end
      where pr_no = v_po_line.source_ref;
    end if;

    -- Zero quantities make existing PO/PR pending calculations reversal-aware.
    -- The original commercial row is retained in purchase_grn_reversals.receipt_snapshot.
    update public.purchase_po_receipts
    set qty = 0,
        purchase_qty = 0,
        rate_control_status = 'LEGACY_REGULARIZED',
        reversed_at = now(),
        reversed_by = trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
        reversal_reason = v_reason,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = v_receipt.id;
  end loop;

  update public.purchase_grns
  set reversed_at = now(),
      reversed_by = trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
      reversal_reason = v_reason
  where id = v_grn.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'grnNo', v_grn.grn_no,
    'poNo', v_grn.po_no,
    'receiptCount', v_receipt_count,
    'ledgerCount', v_ledger_count
  );
end;
$$;

-- Name: sales_order_line_status_from_dispatch_trg(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.sales_order_line_status_from_dispatch_trg() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if tg_op in ('DELETE', 'UPDATE') and old.so_line_id is not null then
    perform public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(old.so_line_id);
  end if;

  if tg_op in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') and new.so_line_id is not null then
    perform public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(new.so_line_id);
  end if;

  return null;
end;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.sales_order_line_status_from_invoice_trg() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_invoice_id uuid;
  v_line record;
begin
  v_invoice_id := case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old.id else new.id end;

  for v_line in
    select distinct so_line_id
    from public.invoice_lines
    where invoice_id = v_invoice_id
      and so_line_id is not null
  loop
    perform public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(v_line.so_line_id);
  end loop;

  return null;
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 839 (class 1255 OID 107541)
-- Name: sales_order_line_status_from_order_trg(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.sales_order_line_status_from_order_trg() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
declare
  v_line record;
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and upper(coalesce(old.status, 'OPEN')) is not distinct from upper(coalesce(new.status, 'OPEN')) then
    return null;
  end if;

  for v_line in
    select id
    from public.sales_order_lines
    where so_id = new.id
  loop
    perform public.refresh_sales_order_line_status(v_line.id);
  end loop;

  return null;
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 835 (class 1255 OID 99234)
-- Name: sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_id(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_id(p_so_id text) RETURNS void
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if p_so_id is null or btrim(p_so_id) = '' then
    return;
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.sales_orders so
    where so.id::text = p_so_id
  ) then
    delete from public.sales_order_rollup_cache
    where so_id = p_so_id;
    return;
  end if;

  with line_rollup as (
    select
      count(*)::integer as line_count,
      coalesce(sum(coalesce(sol.qty, 0)), 0)::numeric as total_qty,
      max(coalesce(sol.final_delivery, sol.expected_delivery)) as latest_delivery,
      case
        when bool_or(upper(coalesce(sol.accounts_status, '')) = 'REJECTED') then 'REJECTED'
        when bool_or(upper(coalesce(sol.accounts_status, '')) = 'HOLD') then 'HOLD'
        when count(*) > 0 and bool_and(upper(coalesce(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING')) = 'APPROVED') then 'APPROVED'
        else 'PENDING'
      end as accounts_status,
      case
        when bool_or(upper(coalesce(sol.business_status, '')) = 'REJECTED') then 'REJECTED'
        when bool_or(upper(coalesce(sol.business_status, '')) = 'HOLD') then 'HOLD'
        when count(*) > 0 and bool_and(upper(coalesce(sol.business_status, 'PENDING')) = 'APPROVED') then 'APPROVED'
        else 'PENDING'
      end as business_status
    from public.sales_order_lines sol
    where sol.so_id::text = p_so_id
  ),
  wo_rollup as (
    select
      case
        when exists (
          select 1
          from public.work_order_jobs wj
          join public.sales_orders so2
            on so2.so_number = wj.so_number
          where so2.id::text = p_so_id
          limit 1
        ) then 'CREATED'
        else 'PENDING'
      end as wo_status
  )
  insert into public.sales_order_rollup_cache (
    so_id,
    so_number,
    line_count,
    total_qty,
    latest_delivery,
    accounts_status,
    business_status,
    wo_status,
    is_approval_hold,
    can_edit,
    can_hold,
    can_cancel,
    hold_target,
    hold_label,
    updated_at
  )
  select
    so.id::text as so_id,
    so.so_number,
    coalesce(lr.line_count, 0) as line_count,
    coalesce(lr.total_qty, 0) as total_qty,
    lr.latest_delivery,
    coalesce(lr.accounts_status, nullif(upper(coalesce(so.accounts_approved, '')), ''), 'PENDING') as accounts_status,
    coalesce(lr.business_status, nullif(upper(coalesce(so.business_approved, '')), ''), 'PENDING') as business_status,
    case
      when wr.wo_status = 'CREATED' then 'CREATED'
      else coalesce(nullif(upper(coalesce(so.wo_status, '')), ''), 'PENDING')
    end as wo_status,
    (
      coalesce(lr.accounts_status, nullif(upper(coalesce(so.accounts_approved, '')), ''), 'PENDING') = 'HOLD'
      or coalesce(lr.business_status, nullif(upper(coalesce(so.business_approved, '')), ''), 'PENDING') = 'HOLD'
    ) as is_approval_hold,
    case
      when upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')) = 'CANCELLED' then false
      when upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')) = 'HOLD' then true
      when (
        coalesce(lr.accounts_status, nullif(upper(coalesce(so.accounts_approved, '')), ''), 'PENDING') = 'HOLD'
        or coalesce(lr.business_status, nullif(upper(coalesce(so.business_approved, '')), ''), 'PENDING') = 'HOLD'
      ) then true
      when (
        coalesce(lr.accounts_status, nullif(upper(coalesce(so.accounts_approved, '')), ''), 'PENDING') <> 'APPROVED'
        and coalesce(lr.business_status, nullif(upper(coalesce(so.business_approved, '')), ''), 'PENDING') <> 'APPROVED'
      ) then true
      else false
    end as can_edit,
    (upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')) <> 'CANCELLED') as can_hold,
    (upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')) <> 'CANCELLED') as can_cancel,
    case
      when upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')) = 'HOLD' then 'OPEN'
      else 'HOLD'
    end as hold_target,
    case
      when upper(coalesce(so.status, 'OPEN')) = 'HOLD' then 'Reopen'
      else 'Hold'
    end as hold_label,
    now() as updated_at
  from public.sales_orders so
  left join line_rollup lr
    on true
  left join wo_rollup wr
    on true
  where so.id::text = p_so_id
  on conflict (so_id) do update set
    so_number = excluded.so_number,
    line_count = excluded.line_count,
    total_qty = excluded.total_qty,
    latest_delivery = excluded.latest_delivery,
    accounts_status = excluded.accounts_status,
    business_status = excluded.business_status,
    wo_status = excluded.wo_status,
    is_approval_hold = excluded.is_approval_hold,
    can_edit = excluded.can_edit,
    can_hold = excluded.can_hold,
    can_cancel = excluded.can_cancel,
    hold_target = excluded.hold_target,
    hold_label = excluded.hold_label,
    updated_at = excluded.updated_at;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 834 (class 1255 OID 99235)
-- Name: sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_number(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_number(p_so_number text) RETURNS void
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if p_so_number is null or btrim(p_so_number) = '' then
    return;
  end if;

  perform public.sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_id(so.id::text)
  from public.sales_orders so
  where so.so_number = p_so_number;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 690 (class 1255 OID 99237)
-- Name: sales_order_rollup_from_lines_trg(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.sales_order_rollup_from_lines_trg() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if tg_op in ('DELETE', 'UPDATE') then
    perform public.sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_id(old.so_id::text);
  end if;

  if tg_op in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') then
    perform public.sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_id(new.so_id::text);
  end if;

  return null;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 794 (class 1255 OID 99236)
-- Name: sales_order_rollup_from_sales_orders_trg(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.sales_order_rollup_from_sales_orders_trg() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    delete from public.sales_order_rollup_cache
    where so_id = old.id::text;
    return null;
  end if;

  perform public.sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_id(new.id::text);

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.id::text <> new.id::text then
    delete from public.sales_order_rollup_cache
    where so_id = old.id::text;
  end if;

  return null;
end;
$$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.sales_order_rollup_from_work_order_jobs_trg() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql

  end if;

  if tg_op in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') then
    perform public.sales_order_refresh_rollup_by_number(new.so_number);
  end if;

end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 746 (class 1255 OID 223845)
-- Name: save_packing_entries_with_boxes(jsonb, jsonb, jsonb, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.save_packing_entries_with_boxes(p_updates jsonb, p_packing_logs jsonb, p_box_usage jsonb, p_rejections jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_item jsonb;
  v_master public.packing_box_master%rowtype;
  v_box_count integer;
  v_usage_count integer := 0;
  v_require_box_entry boolean := false;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_updates, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_packing_logs, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_box_usage, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array'
     or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_rejections, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'Packing save payload must contain JSON arrays';
  end if;

  select coalesce(require_box_entry, false)
    into v_require_box_entry
    from public.packing_box_settings
   where setting_key = 'DEFAULT';

  if v_require_box_entry then
    for v_item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_packing_logs, '[]'::jsonb))
    loop
      if coalesce((v_item ->> 'packed_qty')::numeric, 0) > 0
         and not exists (
           select 1
           from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_box_usage, '[]'::jsonb)) usage_item
           where usage_item ->> 'packing_entry_id' = v_item ->> 'id'
         ) then
        raise exception 'Packing box allocation is required for every packed quantity entry';
      end if;
    end loop;
  end if;

  for v_item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_box_usage, '[]'::jsonb))
  loop
    v_box_count := coalesce((v_item ->> 'box_count')::integer, 0);
    if v_box_count <= 0 then
      raise exception 'Number of boxes must be greater than zero';
    end if;

    if not exists (
      select 1
      from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_packing_logs, '[]'::jsonb)) log_item
      where log_item ->> 'id' = v_item ->> 'packing_entry_id'
        and log_item ->> 'pack_id' = v_item ->> 'pack_id'
    ) then
      raise exception 'Packing box allocation does not match its packing entry';
    end if;

    select *
      into v_master
      from public.packing_box_master
     where id = (v_item ->> 'box_master_id')::uuid
       and active = true;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Selected packing box is inactive or unavailable';
    end if;
  end loop;

  insert into public.packing_entry_log (
    id, pack_id, so_id, so_line_id, so_number, line_no, product_code, product_name,
    category, department_category, packed_qty, packed_weight_kg, ready_to_dispatch,
    source_stage, remarks, posted_at, posted_by
  )
  select
    (x ->> 'id')::uuid,
    (x ->> 'pack_id')::uuid,
    nullif(x ->> 'so_id', '')::uuid,
    nullif(x ->> 'so_line_id', '')::uuid,
    coalesce(x ->> 'so_number', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'line_no', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'product_code', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'product_name', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'category', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'department_category', ''),
    coalesce((x ->> 'packed_qty')::numeric, 0),
    coalesce((x ->> 'packed_weight_kg')::numeric, 0),
    coalesce((x ->> 'ready_to_dispatch')::boolean, true),
    coalesce(x ->> 'source_stage', 'PACKING'),
    coalesce(x ->> 'remarks', ''),
    coalesce((x ->> 'posted_at')::timestamptz, now()),
    coalesce(x ->> 'posted_by', '')
  from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_packing_logs, '[]'::jsonb)) x;

  insert into public.packing_entry_box_usage (
    id, packing_entry_id, pack_id, so_line_id, box_master_id,
    box_code_snapshot, box_name_snapshot,
    length_mm_snapshot, width_mm_snapshot, height_mm_snapshot,
    material_snapshot, ply_snapshot, rate_per_box_snapshot,
    box_count, posted_at, posted_by
  )
  select
    coalesce(nullif(x ->> 'id', '')::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
    (x ->> 'packing_entry_id')::uuid,
    (x ->> 'pack_id')::uuid,
    nullif(x ->> 'so_line_id', '')::uuid,
    bm.id,
    bm.box_code,
    bm.box_name,
    bm.length_mm,
    bm.width_mm,
    bm.height_mm,
    bm.material,
    bm.ply,
    bm.rate_per_box,
    (x ->> 'box_count')::integer,
    coalesce((x ->> 'posted_at')::timestamptz, now()),
    coalesce(x ->> 'posted_by', '')
  from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_box_usage, '[]'::jsonb)) x
  join public.packing_box_master bm
    on bm.id = (x ->> 'box_master_id')::uuid
   and bm.active = true;

  get diagnostics v_usage_count = row_count;

  insert into public.packing_rejection_log (
    pack_id, so_id, so_line_id, so_number, line_no, product_code, product_name,
    category, department_category, rejected_qty, rejected_weight_kg,
    reason, remarks, posted_at, posted_by
  )
  select
    nullif(x ->> 'pack_id', '')::uuid,
    nullif(x ->> 'so_id', '')::uuid,
    (x ->> 'so_line_id')::uuid,
    coalesce(x ->> 'so_number', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'line_no', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'product_code', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'product_name', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'category', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'department_category', ''),
    coalesce((x ->> 'rejected_qty')::numeric, 0),
    coalesce((x ->> 'rejected_weight_kg')::numeric, 0),
    coalesce(x ->> 'reason', ''),
    coalesce(x ->> 'remarks', ''),
    coalesce((x ->> 'posted_at')::timestamptz, now()),
    coalesce(x ->> 'posted_by', '')
  from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_rejections, '[]'::jsonb)) x;

  for v_item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_updates, '[]'::jsonb))
  loop
    update public.packing_records
       set packed_qty = coalesce((v_item ->> 'packed_qty')::numeric, 0),
           packed_weight_kg = coalesce((v_item ->> 'packed_weight_kg')::numeric, 0),
           produced_qty = coalesce((v_item ->> 'produced_qty')::numeric, 0),
           ready_to_dispatch = coalesce((v_item ->> 'ready_to_dispatch')::boolean, false),
           packed_by = coalesce(v_item ->> 'packed_by', ''),
           packed_at = nullif(v_item ->> 'packed_at', '')::timestamptz
     where id = (v_item ->> 'id')::uuid;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Packing record not found during atomic save';
    end if;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'packingEntryCount', jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_packing_logs, '[]'::jsonb)),
    'boxUsageCount', v_usage_count,
    'rejectionCount', jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_rejections, '[]'::jsonb))
  );
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 869 (class 1255 OID 218112)
-- Name: save_purchase_order_transaction(text, jsonb, jsonb, jsonb, jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.save_purchase_order_transaction(p_mode text, p_header jsonb, p_lines jsonb, p_delete_line_ids jsonb, p_audit_entries jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  mode text := upper(trim(coalesce(p_mode, '')));
  header_id uuid := (p_header->>'id')::uuid;
  po_number text := trim(p_header->>'po_no');
  line_json jsonb;
  delete_json jsonb;
  audit_json jsonb;
  approval_id uuid;
  deleted_count integer;
begin
  if mode not in ('CREATE', 'UPDATE') then
    raise exception 'Purchase order save mode must be CREATE or UPDATE';
  end if;
  if header_id is null or po_number = '' then
    raise exception 'Purchase order header id and number are required';
  end if;

  if mode = 'CREATE' then
    insert into public.purchase_orders (
      id, po_no, order_date, vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_phone,
      vendor_address, payment_terms, freight_terms, freight_value, delivery_terms,
      notes, status, total_qty, basic_total, tax_total, total_value, created_by,
      created_at, updated_at
    ) values (
      header_id, po_number, (p_header->>'order_date')::date,
      (p_header->>'vendor_id')::uuid, coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_name', ''),
      coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_email', ''), coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_phone', ''),
      coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_address', ''), coalesce(p_header->>'payment_terms', ''),
      coalesce(p_header->>'freight_terms', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'freight_value', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(p_header->>'delivery_terms', ''), coalesce(p_header->>'notes', ''),
      coalesce(p_header->>'status', 'OPEN'),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'total_qty', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'basic_total', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'tax_total', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'total_value', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(p_header->>'created_by', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'created_at', '')::timestamptz, now()),
      coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'updated_at', '')::timestamptz, now())
    );
  else
    perform 1
    from public.purchase_orders
    where id = header_id and po_no = po_number
    for update;
    if not found then raise exception 'Purchase order not found'; end if;

    update public.purchase_orders
    set
      vendor_id = (p_header->>'vendor_id')::uuid,
      vendor_name = coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_name', ''),
      vendor_email = coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_email', ''),
      vendor_phone = coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_phone', ''),
      vendor_address = coalesce(p_header->>'vendor_address', ''),
      payment_terms = coalesce(p_header->>'payment_terms', ''),
      freight_terms = coalesce(p_header->>'freight_terms', ''),
      freight_value = coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'freight_value', '')::numeric, 0),
      delivery_terms = coalesce(p_header->>'delivery_terms', ''),
      notes = coalesce(p_header->>'notes', ''),
      total_qty = coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'total_qty', '')::numeric, 0),
      basic_total = coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'basic_total', '')::numeric, 0),
      tax_total = coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'tax_total', '')::numeric, 0),
      total_value = coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'total_value', '')::numeric, 0),
      updated_at = coalesce(nullif(p_header->>'updated_at', '')::timestamptz, now())
    where id = header_id;
  end if;

  for delete_json in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_delete_line_ids, '[]'::jsonb))
  loop
    if exists (
      select 1 from public.purchase_po_receipts
      where po_line_id = trim(both '"' from delete_json::text)::uuid
    ) then
      raise exception 'A purchase order line with receipts cannot be deleted';
    end if;
    delete from public.purchase_order_lines
    where id = trim(both '"' from delete_json::text)::uuid
      and po_id = header_id;
    get diagnostics deleted_count = row_count;
    if deleted_count <> 1 then
      raise exception 'Purchase order line to delete was not found';
    end if;
  end loop;

  for line_json in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_lines, '[]'::jsonb))
  loop
    insert into public.purchase_order_lines (
      id, po_id, po_no, line_no, source_type, source_ref, item_code, item_name,
      qty, stock_qty, stock_uom, purchase_qty, purchase_uom, conversion_type,
      conversion_factor, rate_key, rate_master_id, rate_policy,
      rate_override_approval_id, rate_override_reason, master_rate_ceiling,
      master_tax_pct_snapshot, rate_control_status, rate, tax_pct, amount,
      tax_amount, total_amount, department, job_ref, remarks, created_at
    ) values (
      (line_json->>'id')::uuid, header_id, po_number,
      (line_json->>'line_no')::integer, coalesce(line_json->>'source_type', ''),
      coalesce(line_json->>'source_ref', ''), coalesce(line_json->>'item_code', ''),
      coalesce(line_json->>'item_name', ''), (line_json->>'qty')::numeric,
      coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'stock_qty', '')::numeric, (line_json->>'qty')::numeric),
      coalesce(line_json->>'stock_uom', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'purchase_qty', '')::numeric, (line_json->>'qty')::numeric),
      coalesce(line_json->>'purchase_uom', ''), coalesce(line_json->>'conversion_type', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'conversion_factor', '')::numeric, 1),
      coalesce(line_json->>'rate_key', ''), nullif(line_json->>'rate_master_id', '')::uuid,
      coalesce(line_json->>'rate_policy', 'MANUAL_ALLOWED'),
      nullif(line_json->>'rate_override_approval_id', '')::uuid,
      coalesce(line_json->>'rate_override_reason', ''),
      nullif(line_json->>'master_rate_ceiling', '')::numeric,
      nullif(line_json->>'master_tax_pct_snapshot', '')::numeric,
      coalesce(line_json->>'rate_control_status', 'MANUAL_ALLOWED'),
      (line_json->>'rate')::numeric, coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'tax_pct', '')::numeric, 0),
      (line_json->>'amount')::numeric, coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'tax_amount', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'total_amount', '')::numeric, (line_json->>'amount')::numeric),
      coalesce(line_json->>'department', ''), coalesce(line_json->>'job_ref', ''),
      coalesce(line_json->>'remarks', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(line_json->>'created_at', '')::timestamptz, now())
    )
    on conflict (id) do update set
      line_no = excluded.line_no,
      source_type = excluded.source_type,
      source_ref = excluded.source_ref,
      item_code = excluded.item_code,
      item_name = excluded.item_name,
      qty = excluded.qty,
      stock_qty = excluded.stock_qty,
      stock_uom = excluded.stock_uom,
      purchase_qty = excluded.purchase_qty,
      purchase_uom = excluded.purchase_uom,
      conversion_type = excluded.conversion_type,
      conversion_factor = excluded.conversion_factor,
      rate_key = excluded.rate_key,
      rate_master_id = excluded.rate_master_id,
      rate_policy = excluded.rate_policy,
      rate_override_approval_id = excluded.rate_override_approval_id,
      rate_override_reason = excluded.rate_override_reason,
      master_rate_ceiling = excluded.master_rate_ceiling,
      master_tax_pct_snapshot = excluded.master_tax_pct_snapshot,
      rate_control_status = excluded.rate_control_status,
      rate = excluded.rate,
      tax_pct = excluded.tax_pct,
      amount = excluded.amount,
      tax_amount = excluded.tax_amount,
      total_amount = excluded.total_amount,
      department = excluded.department,
      job_ref = excluded.job_ref,
      remarks = excluded.remarks;
  end loop;

  for audit_json in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_audit_entries, '[]'::jsonb))
  loop
    insert into public.purchase_po_audit_log (
      po_id, po_no, po_line_id, line_no, entity_type, action,
      before_data, after_data, changed_by, changed_at
    ) values (
      header_id, po_number, nullif(audit_json->>'po_line_id', '')::uuid,
      nullif(audit_json->>'line_no', '')::integer,
      audit_json->>'entity_type', audit_json->>'action',
      audit_json->'before_data', audit_json->'after_data',
      coalesce(audit_json->>'changed_by', ''),
      coalesce(nullif(audit_json->>'changed_at', '')::timestamptz, now())
    );
  end loop;

  for line_json in
    select value
    from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_lines, '[]'::jsonb))
    where value->>'rate_control_status' = 'OVERRIDE_APPROVED'
  loop
    approval_id := nullif(line_json->>'rate_override_approval_id', '')::uuid;
    update public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
    set
      status = 'CONSUMED',
      consumed_at = now(),
      consumed_ref = po_number || '/' || (line_json->>'line_no'),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = approval_id
      and status = 'APPROVED'
      and consumed_at is null
      and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now());
    if not found then
      raise exception 'Purchase rate override is not approved, has expired, or was already consumed';
    end if;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'poNo', po_number);
end;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 730 (class 1255 OID 220129)
-- Name: scrap_kraft_reel(uuid, text, text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.scrap_kraft_reel(p_lot_id uuid, p_reason_code text, p_remarks text, p_actor text) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_lot public.inv_lots%rowtype;
  v_ledger_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_reason text := trim(coalesce(p_reason_code, ''));
begin
  select * into v_lot
  from public.inv_lots
  where id = p_lot_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_lot.is_reel is not true then
    raise exception 'Kraft reel was not found';
  end if;
  if v_lot.reel_status = 'ISSUED' then
    raise exception 'Issued reel must be returned to Main Stores before scrap';
  end if;
  if v_lot.reel_status in ('SCRAPPED','CLOSED') or v_lot.qty_available <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Reel has no available balance to scrap';
  end if;
  if v_reason = '' then
    raise exception 'Scrap reason is required';
  end if;

  insert into public.inv_ledger (
    id, item_id, location, ref_type, ref_no, qty_in, qty_out, rate,
    value, remarks, created_at, department, batch_no
  ) values (
    v_ledger_id, v_lot.item_id, 'MAIN', 'REEL-SCRAP', v_lot.batch_no,
    0, v_lot.qty_available, v_lot.rate, v_lot.qty_available * v_lot.rate,
    concat_ws(' | ', v_reason, nullif(trim(coalesce(p_remarks, '')), '')),
    now(), v_lot.department, v_lot.batch_no
  );

  insert into public.inv_reel_events (
    lot_id, internal_reel_no, event_type, qty, balance_after, location,
    reason, actor, metadata
  ) values (
    v_lot.id, v_lot.batch_no, 'SCRAP', v_lot.qty_available, 0, 'MAIN',
    concat_ws(' | ', v_reason, nullif(trim(coalesce(p_remarks, '')), '')),
    trim(coalesce(p_actor, '')),
    jsonb_build_object('scrapLedgerId', v_ledger_id)
  );

  update public.inv_lots
  set qty_available = 0,
      reel_status = 'SCRAPPED',
      assigned_wo_no = null,
      closed_at = now(),
      closed_reason = concat_ws(' | ', v_reason, nullif(trim(coalesce(p_remarks, '')), ''))
  where id = v_lot.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'reelNo', v_lot.batch_no,
    'scrappedQty', v_lot.qty_available,
    'ledgerId', v_ledger_id
  );
end;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 857 (class 1255 OID 218109)
-- Name: submit_purchase_rate_override(jsonb); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.submit_purchase_rate_override(p_request jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  fingerprint text := public.purchase_rate_override_fingerprint(p_request);
  request_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  inserted public.purchase_rate_override_approvals%rowtype;
  existing public.purchase_rate_override_approvals%rowtype;
begin
  select * into existing
  from public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
  where request_fingerprint = fingerprint
    and status in ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
  order by requested_at
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'duplicate', true, 'request', to_jsonb(existing));
  end if;

  begin
    insert into public.purchase_rate_override_approvals (
      id, request_ref, request_fingerprint, client_request_key, status, context_type,
      po_no, po_line_id, pr_no, grn_no, item_code, item_name, rate_key,
      purchase_uom, stock_uom, master_rate, requested_rate, master_tax_pct,
      requested_tax_pct, requested_qty, requested_purchase_qty, vendor_id,
      vendor_name, reason, ceiling_source, payload_json, requested_by,
      requested_by_user_id, requested_at, created_at, updated_at
    ) values (
      request_id,
      'PRO-' || upper(substr(replace(request_id::text, '-', ''), 1, 8)),
      fingerprint,
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'client_request_key', '')), ''),
      'PENDING',
      upper(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'context_type', ''))),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'po_no', '')),
      nullif(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'po_line_id', '')), '')::uuid,
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'pr_no', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'grn_no', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'item_code', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'item_name', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'rate_key', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'purchase_uom', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'stock_uom', '')),
      coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'master_rate', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'requested_rate', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'master_tax_pct', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'requested_tax_pct', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'requested_qty', '')::numeric, 0),
      coalesce(nullif(p_request->>'requested_purchase_qty', '')::numeric, 0),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'vendor_id', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'vendor_name', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'reason', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'ceiling_source', 'RATE_MASTER')),
      coalesce(p_request->'payload_json', '{}'::jsonb),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'requested_by', '')),
      trim(coalesce(p_request->>'requested_by_user_id', '')),
      now(), now(), now()
    )
    returning * into inserted;
  exception
    when unique_violation then
      select * into existing
      from public.purchase_rate_override_approvals
      where (
          request_fingerprint = fingerprint
          and status in ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
        )
        or (
          nullif(trim(coalesce(p_request->>'client_request_key', '')), '') is not null
          and client_request_key = trim(p_request->>'client_request_key')
        )
      order by requested_at
      limit 1;
      if not found then raise; end if;
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'duplicate', true, 'request', to_jsonb(existing));
  end;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'duplicate', false, 'request', to_jsonb(inserted));
end;
$$;

--
-- TOC entry 873 (class 1255 OID 217291)
-- Name: sync_work_order_stock_reservations(text, text, boolean); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.sync_work_order_stock_reservations(p_wo_number text, p_actor text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_confirm_release boolean DEFAULT false) RETURNS TABLE(work_order_material_id uuid, material_key text, item_code text, item_name text, required_qty numeric, physical_stock_qty numeric, allocated_other_qty numeric, allocated_this_wo_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric, free_stock_qty numeric, shortage_qty numeric, allocation_status text, release_confirmation_required boolean)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_wo_id uuid;
  v_row record;
  v_existing inventory_reservations%rowtype;
  v_physical numeric;
  v_other numeric;
  v_target numeric;
  v_net_issued numeric;
  v_reservation_id uuid;
begin
  select id into v_wo_id
    from work_orders
   where wo_number = trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, ''))
   for update;
  if v_wo_id is null then
    raise exception 'Work Order not found: %', p_wo_number;
  end if;

  -- Serialise allocation decisions for the same inventory items.
  perform 1
    from inv_items i
   where i.id in (
     select item_id from work_order_materials
      where wo_id = v_wo_id and item_id is not null
   )
   order by i.id
   for update;

  for v_row in
    select wom.*
      from work_order_materials wom
     where wom.wo_id = v_wo_id and wom.item_id is not null
     order by wom.id
  loop
    select coalesce(max(net_issued_qty), 0) into v_net_issued
     from inv_wo_issue_requirement_v
     where wo_number = trim(p_wo_number)
       and material_key = v_row.material_key;

    select * into v_existing
      from inventory_reservations
     where wo_number = trim(p_wo_number)
       and material_key = v_row.material_key
       and item_id = v_row.item_id
       and location = 'MAIN'
     for update;

    if found
       and v_existing.allocation_blocked then
      update inventory_reservations
         set work_order_material_id = v_row.id,
             required_qty = greatest(coalesce(v_row.required_qty, 0), 0),
             updated_by = p_actor,
             updated_at = now()
       where id = v_existing.id;
      continue;
    end if;

    if found
       and v_existing.reserved_qty > greatest(coalesce(v_row.required_qty, 0) - v_net_issued, 0)
       and not p_confirm_release then
      update inventory_reservations
         set work_order_material_id = v_row.id,
             required_qty = greatest(coalesce(v_row.required_qty, 0), 0),
             updated_by = p_actor,
             updated_at = now()
       where id = v_existing.id;
      continue;
    end if;

    select coalesce(sum(s.qty), 0) into v_physical
      from inv_stock_mv s
     where s.item_id = v_row.item_id and s.location = 'MAIN';

    select coalesce(sum(ir.reserved_qty), 0) into v_other
      from inventory_reservations ir
     where ir.item_id = v_row.item_id
       and ir.location = 'MAIN'
       and ir.status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED')
       and (v_existing.id is null or ir.id <> v_existing.id);

    v_target := least(
      greatest(coalesce(v_row.required_qty, 0) - v_net_issued, 0),
      greatest(v_physical - v_other, 0)
    );

    if v_existing.id is null then
      insert into inventory_reservations (
        wo_id, wo_number, work_order_material_id, material_key, item_id,
        location, required_qty, reserved_qty, uom, status, created_by, updated_by
      ) values (
        v_wo_id, trim(p_wo_number), v_row.id, v_row.material_key, v_row.item_id,
        'MAIN', greatest(coalesce(v_row.required_qty, 0), 0), v_target, v_row.uom,
        'ACTIVE', p_actor, p_actor
      ) returning id into v_reservation_id;

      insert into inventory_reservation_audit (
        reservation_id, wo_number, work_order_material_id, material_key, item_id,
        location, action, before_qty, after_qty, changed_qty, reason, changed_by
      ) values (
        v_reservation_id, trim(p_wo_number), v_row.id, v_row.material_key, v_row.item_id,
        'MAIN', case when v_target > 0 then 'AUTO_ALLOCATE' else 'SHORTAGE' end,
        0, v_target, v_target, 'Automatic allocation during Work Order save', p_actor
      );
    else
      v_reservation_id := v_existing.id;
      update inventory_reservations
         set work_order_material_id = v_row.id,
             required_qty = greatest(coalesce(v_row.required_qty, 0), 0),
             reserved_qty = v_target,
             material_key = v_row.material_key,
             uom = v_row.uom,
             status = case when v_target > 0 then 'ACTIVE' else 'RELEASED' end,
             updated_by = p_actor,
             updated_at = now(),
             released_at = case when v_target = 0 then now() else null end,
             release_reason = case when v_target < v_existing.reserved_qty
                                   then 'Requirement reduced during Work Order edit' else null end
       where id = v_existing.id;

      if v_target <> v_existing.reserved_qty then
        insert into inventory_reservation_audit (
          reservation_id, wo_number, work_order_material_id, material_key, item_id,
          location, action, before_qty, after_qty, changed_qty, reason, changed_by
        ) values (
          v_existing.id, trim(p_wo_number), v_row.id, v_row.material_key, v_row.item_id,
          'MAIN',
          case when v_target < v_existing.reserved_qty then 'RELEASE' else 'AUTO_INCREASE' end,
          v_existing.reserved_qty, v_target, v_target - v_existing.reserved_qty,
          'Automatic reconciliation during Work Order save', p_actor
        );
      end if;
    end if;
  end loop;

  if p_confirm_release then
    insert into inventory_reservation_audit (
      reservation_id, wo_number, work_order_material_id, material_key, item_id,
      location, action, before_qty, after_qty, changed_qty, reason, changed_by
    )
    select ir.id, ir.wo_number, ir.work_order_material_id, ir.material_key, ir.item_id,
           ir.location, 'RELEASE_REMOVED_MATERIAL', ir.reserved_qty, 0, -ir.reserved_qty,
           'Material removed during Work Order edit', p_actor
      from inventory_reservations ir
     where ir.wo_number = trim(p_wo_number)
       and ir.work_order_material_id is null
       and ir.status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED')
       and ir.reserved_qty > 0;

    update inventory_reservations
       set reserved_qty = 0,
           status = 'RELEASED',
           updated_by = p_actor,
           updated_at = now(),
           released_at = now(),
           release_reason = 'Material removed during Work Order edit'
     where wo_number = trim(p_wo_number)
       and work_order_material_id is null
       and status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED');
  end if;

  return query
  select s.work_order_material_id, s.material_key, s.item_code, s.item_name,
         s.required_qty, s.physical_stock_qty, s.allocated_other_qty,
         s.allocated_this_wo_qty, s.issued_qty, s.free_stock_qty, s.shortage_qty,
         s.allocation_status,
         exists (
           select 1
             from inventory_reservations ir
             left join work_order_materials wom on wom.id = ir.work_order_material_id
            where ir.wo_number = trim(p_wo_number)
              and (
                ir.work_order_material_id is null
                or ir.reserved_qty > greatest(
                  wom.required_qty - coalesce((
                    select max(v.net_issued_qty)
                      from inv_wo_issue_requirement_v v
                     where v.wo_number = trim(p_wo_number)
                       and v.material_key = wom.material_key
                  ), 0),
                  0
                )
              )
         )
    from wo_stock_allocation_summary(p_wo_number) s;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 915 (class 1255 OID 232198)
-- Name: trace_allocate_invoice_line(uuid); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.trace_allocate_invoice_line(p_invoice_line_id uuid) RETURNS void
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  il public.invoice_lines%rowtype;
  remaining numeric(18,3);
  r record;
  take_qty numeric(18,3);
begin
  select * into il from public.invoice_lines where id = p_invoice_line_id;
  if not found then return; end if;
  delete from public.trace_invoice_dispatch_allocations where invoice_line_id = il.id;
  remaining := greatest(coalesce(il.qty, 0), 0);

  for r in
    select d.id,
           greatest(coalesce(d.dispatch_qty, 0) - coalesce(x.used_qty, 0), 0) as available_qty
    from public.dispatch_records d
    left join (
      select a.dispatch_record_id, sum(a.allocated_qty) as used_qty
      from public.trace_invoice_dispatch_allocations a
      join public.invoice_lines used_il on used_il.id = a.invoice_line_id
      join public.invoices used_inv on used_inv.id = used_il.invoice_id
      where upper(coalesce(used_inv.status, 'DRAFT')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'VOID', 'DELETED')
      group by a.dispatch_record_id
    ) x on x.dispatch_record_id = d.id
    where d.so_line_id = il.so_line_id
      and upper(coalesce(d.status, 'DISPATCHED')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'VOID', 'DELETED')
    order by d.dispatch_date, d.created_at, d.id
  loop
    exit when remaining <= 0;
    take_qty := least(remaining, r.available_qty);
    if take_qty > 0 then
      insert into public.trace_invoice_dispatch_allocations (
        invoice_line_id, dispatch_record_id, allocated_qty, allocation_method
      ) values (il.id, r.id, take_qty, 'FIFO_SO_LINE');
      remaining := remaining - take_qty;
    end if;
  end loop;
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 799 (class 1255 OID 232201)
-- Name: trace_dispatch_reallocate_invoices(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.trace_dispatch_reallocate_invoices() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare r record;
begin
  delete from public.trace_invoice_dispatch_allocations a
  using public.invoice_lines il
  where il.id = a.invoice_line_id
    and il.so_line_id = new.so_line_id;
  for r in
    select il.id
    from public.invoice_lines il
    join public.invoices i on i.id = il.invoice_id
    where il.so_line_id = new.so_line_id
      and upper(coalesce(i.status, 'DRAFT')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'VOID', 'DELETED')
    order by i.invoice_date, i.created_at, il.id
  loop
    perform public.trace_allocate_invoice_line(r.id);
  end loop;
  return new;
end;
$$;

-- TOC entry 767 (class 1255 OID 232199)
-- Name: trace_invoice_line_after_write(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.trace_invoice_line_after_write() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare r record;
begin
  delete from public.trace_invoice_dispatch_allocations a
  using public.invoice_lines il
  where il.id = a.invoice_line_id
    and il.so_line_id = new.so_line_id;
  for r in
    select il.id
    from public.invoice_lines il
    join public.invoices i on i.id = il.invoice_id
    where il.so_line_id = new.so_line_id
      and upper(coalesce(i.status, 'DRAFT')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'VOID', 'DELETED')
    order by i.invoice_date, i.created_at, il.id
  loop
    perform public.trace_allocate_invoice_line(r.id);
  end loop;
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.so_line_id is distinct from new.so_line_id then
    delete from public.trace_invoice_dispatch_allocations a
    using public.invoice_lines il
    where il.id = a.invoice_line_id
      and il.so_line_id = old.so_line_id;
    for r in
      select il.id
      from public.invoice_lines il
      join public.invoices i on i.id = il.invoice_id
      where il.so_line_id = old.so_line_id
        and upper(coalesce(i.status, 'DRAFT')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'VOID', 'DELETED')
      order by i.invoice_date, i.created_at, il.id
    loop
      perform public.trace_allocate_invoice_line(r.id);
    end loop;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 805 (class 1255 OID 232203)
-- Name: trace_invoice_status_reallocate(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.trace_invoice_status_reallocate() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  line_ref record;
  invoice_ref record;
begin
  if old.status is not distinct from new.status then return new; end if;
  for line_ref in
    select distinct il.so_line_id from public.invoice_lines il where il.invoice_id = new.id
  loop
    delete from public.trace_invoice_dispatch_allocations a
    using public.invoice_lines il
    where il.id = a.invoice_line_id and il.so_line_id = line_ref.so_line_id;
    for invoice_ref in
      select il.id
      from public.invoice_lines il
      join public.invoices i on i.id = il.invoice_id
      where il.so_line_id = line_ref.so_line_id
        and upper(coalesce(i.status, 'DRAFT')) not in ('CANCELLED', 'VOID', 'DELETED')
      order by i.invoice_date, i.created_at, il.id
    loop
      perform public.trace_allocate_invoice_line(invoice_ref.id);
    end loop;
  end loop;
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 905 (class 1255 OID 232195)
-- Name: trace_register_dispatch(uuid); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.trace_register_dispatch(p_dispatch_id uuid) RETURNS void
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  d public.dispatch_records%rowtype;
  resolved_wo uuid;
  candidate_count integer;
  fg_id uuid;
  pack_qty numeric(18,3);
begin
  select * into d from public.dispatch_records where id = p_dispatch_id;
  if not found then return; end if;

  resolved_wo := d.wo_id;
  if resolved_wo is null then
    select count(distinct woj.wo_id), (array_agg(woj.wo_id))[1]
      into candidate_count, resolved_wo
    from public.work_order_jobs woj
    where woj.so_number = d.so_number
      and woj.line_no = d.line_no
      and woj.wo_id is not null;
    if candidate_count <> 1 then
      update public.dispatch_records
      set trace_status = case when candidate_count > 1 then 'MULTIPLE_WO_REVIEW' else 'WO_NOT_FOUND' end
      where id = d.id;
      return;
    end if;
  end if;

  if d.pack_id is null then
    select (array_agg(p.id))[1], max(p.packed_qty)
      into d.pack_id, pack_qty
    from public.packing_records p
    where p.so_line_id = d.so_line_id
    having count(*) = 1;
  else
    select p.packed_qty into pack_qty from public.packing_records p where p.id = d.pack_id;
  end if;

  update public.dispatch_records
  set wo_id = resolved_wo,
      pack_id = coalesce(dispatch_records.pack_id, d.pack_id),
      trace_status = case when coalesce(dispatch_records.pack_id, d.pack_id) is null then 'WO_LINKED_NO_PACK' else 'WO_PACK_LINKED' end
  where id = d.id;

  if d.pack_id is null then return; end if;

  insert into public.trace_fg_batches (
    source_key, fg_batch_no, pack_id, wo_id, so_id, so_line_id,
    produced_qty, source_type, confidence
  ) values (
    'PACK|' || d.pack_id::text || '|WO|' || resolved_wo::text,
    'PACK-' || upper(substr(replace(d.pack_id::text, '-', ''), 1, 12)),
    d.pack_id, resolved_wo, d.so_id, d.so_line_id,
    coalesce(pack_qty, d.packed_qty, 0), 'PACKING', 'WO_GENEALOGY'
  )
  on conflict (source_key) do update
  set produced_qty = greatest(public.trace_fg_batches.produced_qty, excluded.produced_qty)
  returning id into fg_id;

  insert into public.trace_fg_material_sources (
    fg_batch_id, lot_allocation_id, issue_ledger_id, rm_lot_id,
    issued_qty_snapshot, confidence
  )
  select fg_id, a.id, a.ledger_id, a.lot_id, a.qty, 'WO_GENEALOGY'
  from public.inv_lot_allocations a
  join public.inv_ledger l on l.id = a.ledger_id
  join public.work_orders wo on wo.id = resolved_wo
  where upper(coalesce(l.ref_type, '')) = 'ISSUE'
    and l.ref_no = wo.wo_number
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.inv_ledger rev
      where rev.ref_no = l.id::text and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
    )
  on conflict (fg_batch_id, lot_allocation_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.trace_dispatch_fg_allocations (
    dispatch_record_id, fg_batch_id, allocated_qty, allocation_method
  ) values (d.id, fg_id, coalesce(d.dispatch_qty, 0), 'PACK_WO_LINK')
  on conflict (dispatch_record_id, fg_batch_id) do update
  set allocated_qty = excluded.allocated_qty;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 840 (class 1255 OID 232098)
-- Name: trace_work_order_job_resolve_so_ids(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.trace_work_order_job_resolve_so_ids() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  if new.so_id is null or new.so_line_id is null then
    select sol.so_id, sol.id into new.so_id, new.so_line_id
    from public.sales_order_lines sol
    join public.sales_orders so on so.id = sol.so_id
    where so.so_number = new.so_number and sol.line_no = new.line_no
    limit 1;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 777 (class 1255 OID 220687)
-- Name: validate_corrugation_reel_consumption(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.validate_corrugation_reel_consumption() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cycle public.inv_reel_issue_cycles%rowtype;
  v_lot public.inv_lots%rowtype;
  v_across integer;
  v_other numeric;
begin
  if coalesce(new.produced_sheets, 0) < 0 then
    raise exception 'Produced sheets cannot be negative';
  end if;
  if coalesce(new.cut_size_mm, 0) <= 0 or coalesce(new.deckle_mm, 0) <= 0 then
    raise exception 'Cut size and deckle are required for reel consumption';
  end if;

  if new.liner_reel_lot_id is not null then
    select * into v_lot
    from public.inv_lots
    where id = new.liner_reel_lot_id;
    if not found or v_lot.is_reel is not true then
      raise exception 'Liner reel was not found';
    end if;

    select * into v_cycle
    from public.inv_reel_issue_cycles c
    where c.id = coalesce(new.liner_issue_cycle_id, v_lot.current_issue_cycle_id)
      and c.id = v_lot.current_issue_cycle_id
      and c.lot_id = new.liner_reel_lot_id
      and c.status = 'ACTIVE'
      and (
        (c.custody_scope = 'FLOOR'
          and upper(coalesce(c.custody_location, '')) = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR'
          and upper(coalesce(v_lot.location, '')) = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR')
        or (coalesce(c.custody_scope, 'WORK_ORDER') = 'WORK_ORDER' and c.wo_id = new.wo_id)
      );
    if not found then
      raise exception 'Liner reel has no active Corrugation Floor custody cycle';
    end if;

    new.liner_issue_cycle_id := v_cycle.id;
    new.liner_reel_width_mm := v_lot.master_width_mm;
    new.liner_actual_gsm := v_lot.master_gsm;
    v_across := greatest(floor(v_lot.master_width_mm / new.deckle_mm)::integer, 1);
    new.liner_across_count := v_across;
    new.liner_trim_width_mm := greatest(v_lot.master_width_mm - (v_across * new.deckle_mm), 0);
    new.liner_consumed_kg := round(
      ceil(coalesce(new.produced_sheets, 0)::numeric / v_across)
      * v_lot.master_width_mm * new.cut_size_mm * v_lot.master_gsm / 1000000000,
      3
    );

    select
      coalesce(sum(case when d.liner_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id then d.liner_consumed_kg else 0 end), 0)
      + coalesce(sum(case when d.fluting_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id then d.fluting_consumed_kg else 0 end), 0)
    into v_other
    from public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
    where (d.liner_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id or d.fluting_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id)
      and d.id is distinct from new.id;
    v_other := coalesce(v_other, 0) + coalesce(new.liner_consumed_kg, 0);
    if new.fluting_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id then
      v_other := v_other + coalesce(new.fluting_consumed_kg, 0);
    end if;
    if v_other > v_cycle.issue_qty_kg + 0.001 then
      raise exception 'Liner reel consumption exceeds issued gross weight';
    end if;
  end if;

  if new.fluting_reel_lot_id is not null then
    select * into v_lot
    from public.inv_lots
    where id = new.fluting_reel_lot_id;
    if not found or v_lot.is_reel is not true then
      raise exception 'Fluting reel was not found';
    end if;

    select * into v_cycle
    from public.inv_reel_issue_cycles c
    where c.id = coalesce(new.fluting_issue_cycle_id, v_lot.current_issue_cycle_id)
      and c.id = v_lot.current_issue_cycle_id
      and c.lot_id = new.fluting_reel_lot_id
      and c.status = 'ACTIVE'
      and (
        (c.custody_scope = 'FLOOR'
          and upper(coalesce(c.custody_location, '')) = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR'
          and upper(coalesce(v_lot.location, '')) = 'CORRUGATION FLOOR')
        or (coalesce(c.custody_scope, 'WORK_ORDER') = 'WORK_ORDER' and c.wo_id = new.wo_id)
      );
    if not found then
      raise exception 'Fluting reel has no active Corrugation Floor custody cycle';
    end if;

    new.fluting_issue_cycle_id := v_cycle.id;
    new.fluting_reel_width_mm := v_lot.master_width_mm;
    new.fluting_actual_gsm := v_lot.master_gsm;
    v_across := greatest(floor(v_lot.master_width_mm / new.deckle_mm)::integer, 1);
    new.fluting_across_count := v_across;
    new.fluting_trim_width_mm := greatest(v_lot.master_width_mm - (v_across * new.deckle_mm), 0);
    new.fluting_consumed_kg := round(
      ceil(coalesce(new.produced_sheets, 0)::numeric / v_across)
      * v_lot.master_width_mm * new.cut_size_mm * v_lot.master_gsm
      * public.kraft_reel_flute_factor(new.flute) / 1000000000,
      3
    );

    select
      coalesce(sum(case when d.liner_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id then d.liner_consumed_kg else 0 end), 0)
      + coalesce(sum(case when d.fluting_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id then d.fluting_consumed_kg else 0 end), 0)
    into v_other
    from public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
    where (d.liner_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id or d.fluting_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id)
      and d.id is distinct from new.id;
    v_other := coalesce(v_other, 0) + coalesce(new.fluting_consumed_kg, 0);
    if new.liner_issue_cycle_id = v_cycle.id then
      v_other := v_other + coalesce(new.liner_consumed_kg, 0);
    end if;
    if v_other > v_cycle.issue_qty_kg + 0.001 then
      raise exception 'Fluting reel consumption exceeds issued gross weight';
    end if;
  end if;

  new.total_consumed_kg :=
    round(coalesce(new.liner_consumed_kg, 0) + coalesce(new.fluting_consumed_kg, 0), 3);
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 773 (class 1255 OID 231328)
-- Name: validate_legacy_reel_alignment_request(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.validate_legacy_reel_alignment_request() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  new.internal_reel_no := upper(trim(new.internal_reel_no));
  if new.status <> 'PENDING' then return new; end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(new.internal_reel_no, 0));
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.inv_legacy_reel_alignment_requests r
    where r.status = 'PENDING'
      and r.internal_reel_no = new.internal_reel_no
      and (r.wo_id <> new.wo_id or r.item_id <> new.item_id)
  ) then
    raise exception 'Legacy reel % is already pending for another item or work order', new.internal_reel_no;
  end if;
  if exists (
    select 1 from public.inv_legacy_reel_alignments a
    where a.internal_reel_no = new.internal_reel_no
  ) then
    raise exception 'Legacy reel % has already been aligned; refresh production reel data', new.internal_reel_no;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 827 (class 1255 OID 218105)
-- Name: validate_purchase_order_line_rate_override(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.validate_purchase_order_line_rate_override() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  po_row public.purchase_orders%rowtype;
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE'
     and old.po_id is not distinct from new.po_id
     and old.po_no is not distinct from new.po_no
     and old.source_ref is not distinct from new.source_ref
     and old.item_code is not distinct from new.item_code
     and old.qty is not distinct from new.qty
     and old.rate is not distinct from new.rate
     and old.tax_pct is not distinct from new.tax_pct
     and old.purchase_uom is not distinct from new.purchase_uom
     and old.rate_key is not distinct from new.rate_key
     and old.rate_policy is not distinct from new.rate_policy
     and old.rate_override_approval_id is not distinct from new.rate_override_approval_id
     and old.master_rate_ceiling is not distinct from new.master_rate_ceiling
     and old.master_tax_pct_snapshot is not distinct from new.master_tax_pct_snapshot
     and old.rate_control_status is not distinct from new.rate_control_status then
    return new;
  end if;

  if coalesce(new.rate_policy, 'MANUAL_ALLOWED') <> 'RATE_CONTROLLED' then
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.rate <= coalesce(new.master_rate_ceiling, 0) + 0.0001 then
    if new.rate_control_status = 'OVERRIDE_APPROVED' then
      raise exception 'Within-ceiling PO lines cannot consume a rate override';
    end if;
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.rate_control_status <> 'OVERRIDE_APPROVED' or new.rate_override_approval_id is null then
    raise exception 'Rate above the purchase ceiling requires an approved override';
  end if;

  select * into po_row
  from public.purchase_orders
  where id = new.po_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Purchase order header was not found for rate validation';
  end if;

  perform public.assert_purchase_rate_override(
    new.rate_override_approval_id,
    'PO_RATE',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'po_no', new.po_no,
      'po_line_id', new.id,
      'pr_no', new.source_ref,
      'item_code', new.item_code,
      'rate_key', new.rate_key,
      'purchase_uom', new.purchase_uom,
      'rate', new.rate,
      'tax_pct', new.tax_pct,
      'qty', new.qty,
      'master_rate', new.master_rate_ceiling,
      'master_tax_pct', new.master_tax_pct_snapshot,
      'vendor_id', po_row.vendor_id,
      'vendor_name', po_row.vendor_name
    )
  );
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 735 (class 1255 OID 218107)
-- Name: validate_purchase_receipt_rate_override(); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.validate_purchase_receipt_rate_override() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  line_row public.purchase_order_lines%rowtype;
  po_row public.purchase_orders%rowtype;
  ceiling numeric;
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE'
     and old.po_id is not distinct from new.po_id
     and old.po_no is not distinct from new.po_no
     and old.po_line_id is not distinct from new.po_line_id
     and old.qty is not distinct from new.qty
     and old.rate is not distinct from new.rate
     and old.tax_pct is not distinct from new.tax_pct
     and old.rate_override_approval_id is not distinct from new.rate_override_approval_id
     and old.rate_ceiling_snapshot is not distinct from new.rate_ceiling_snapshot
     and old.rate_control_status is not distinct from new.rate_control_status
     and old.purchase_uom is not distinct from new.purchase_uom then
    return new;
  end if;

  select * into line_row
  from public.purchase_order_lines
  where id = new.po_line_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Purchase order line was not found for GRN rate validation';
  end if;

  if coalesce(line_row.rate_policy, 'MANUAL_ALLOWED') <> 'RATE_CONTROLLED'
     or new.rate_control_status = 'LEGACY_REGULARIZED' then
    return new;
  end if;

  ceiling := case
    when coalesce(line_row.master_rate_ceiling, 0) > 0
      then line_row.master_rate_ceiling
    else coalesce(line_row.rate, 0)
  end;

  if abs(coalesce(new.tax_pct, 0) - coalesce(line_row.tax_pct, 0)) > 0.0001 then
    raise exception 'GRN GST must match the purchase order GST';
  end if;

  if new.rate <= ceiling + 0.0001 then
    if new.rate_control_status = 'OVERRIDE_APPROVED' then
      raise exception 'Within-ceiling GRN lines cannot consume a rate override';
    end if;
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.rate_control_status <> 'OVERRIDE_APPROVED' or new.rate_override_approval_id is null then
    raise exception 'GRN rate above the allowed ceiling requires an approved override';
  end if;

  select * into po_row
  from public.purchase_orders
  where id = line_row.po_id;

  perform public.assert_purchase_rate_override(
    new.rate_override_approval_id,
    'GRN_RATE',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'po_no', line_row.po_no,
      'po_line_id', line_row.id,
      'item_code', line_row.item_code,
      'rate_key', line_row.rate_key,
      'purchase_uom', line_row.purchase_uom,
      'rate', new.rate,
      'tax_pct', new.tax_pct,
      'qty', new.qty,
      'master_rate', ceiling,
      'master_tax_pct', line_row.tax_pct,
      'vendor_id', po_row.vendor_id,
      'vendor_name', po_row.vendor_name
    )
  );
  return new;
end;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 791 (class 1255 OID 21140)
-- Name: wo_material_issue_status(text, text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.wo_material_issue_status(p_wo_no text, p_material_key text) RETURNS TABLE(required_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric)
    LANGUAGE sql
    AS $$
  select
    sum(wom.required_qty) as required_qty,
    coalesce(sum(l.qty_out), 0) as issued_qty
  from work_orders wo
  join work_order_materials wom on wom.wo_id = wo.id
  left join inv_ledger l
    on l.ref_type = 'ISSUE'
   and l.ref_no = wo.wo_number
   and l.remarks = wom.material_key
  where wo.wo_number = p_wo_no
    and wom.material_key = p_material_key;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 934 (class 1255 OID 217290)
-- Name: wo_stock_allocation_summary(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.wo_stock_allocation_summary(p_wo_number text) RETURNS TABLE(work_order_material_id uuid, material_key text, item_id uuid, item_code text, item_name text, location text, uom text, required_qty numeric, issued_qty numeric, physical_stock_qty numeric, allocated_other_qty numeric, allocated_this_wo_qty numeric, free_stock_qty numeric, shortage_qty numeric, allocation_status text)
    LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
  with target as (
    select wo.id as wo_id, wo.wo_number, wom.id as material_id,
           wom.material_key, wom.item_id, wom.item_code, wom.item_name,
           wom.uom, greatest(coalesce(wom.required_qty, 0), 0) as required_qty
      from work_orders wo
      join work_order_materials wom on wom.wo_id = wo.id
     where wo.wo_number = trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, ''))
  ),
  stock as (
    select item_id, location, sum(coalesce(qty, 0)) as qty
      from inv_stock_mv
     group by item_id, location
  ),
  reservations as (
    select item_id, location,
           sum(reserved_qty) as all_qty,
           sum(reserved_qty) filter (where wo_number <> trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, ''))) as other_qty
      from inventory_reservations
     where status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED') and reserved_qty > 0
     group by item_id, location
  ),
  issued as (
    select material_key, max(coalesce(net_issued_qty, 0)) as issued_qty
      from inv_wo_issue_requirement_v
     where wo_number = trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, ''))
     group by material_key
  )
  select t.material_id, t.material_key, t.item_id, coalesce(t.item_code, ''),
         coalesce(t.item_name, ''), 'MAIN'::text, t.uom, t.required_qty,
         coalesce(ix.issued_qty, 0),
         coalesce(s.qty, 0),
         coalesce(r.other_qty, 0),
         coalesce(ir.reserved_qty, 0),
         greatest(coalesce(s.qty, 0) - coalesce(r.all_qty, 0), 0),
         greatest(t.required_qty - coalesce(ix.issued_qty, 0) - coalesce(ir.reserved_qty, 0), 0),
         case
           when t.item_id is null then 'ITEM_NOT_MAPPED'
           when coalesce(ir.reserved_qty, 0) + coalesce(ix.issued_qty, 0) >= t.required_qty then 'FULL'
           when coalesce(ir.reserved_qty, 0) > 0 then 'PARTIAL'
           else 'NOT_ALLOCATED'
         end
    from target t
    left join stock s on s.item_id = t.item_id and s.location = 'MAIN'
    left join reservations r on r.item_id = t.item_id and r.location = 'MAIN'
    left join issued ix on ix.material_key = t.material_key
    left join inventory_reservations ir
      on ir.work_order_material_id = t.material_id
     and ir.status in ('ACTIVE','PARTIALLY_ISSUED')
   order by t.item_name, t.material_key;
$$;


--
-- TOC entry 864 (class 1255 OID 200738)
-- Name: work_order_has_open_material_issue(text); Type: FUNCTION; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE FUNCTION public.work_order_has_open_material_issue(p_wo_number text) RETURNS boolean
    LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path TO 'public'
    AS $$
  with live_material_ledger as (
    select
      il.item_id,
      coalesce(il.remarks, '') as material_key,
      upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) as ref_type,
      coalesce(il.qty_in, 0::numeric) as qty_in,
      coalesce(il.qty_out, 0::numeric) as qty_out
    from public.inv_ledger il
    where trim(coalesce(il.ref_no, '')) = trim(coalesce(p_wo_number, ''))
      and upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) in ('ISSUE', 'WO-RETURN')
      and (
        (upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) = 'ISSUE' and coalesce(il.qty_out, 0::numeric) > 0)
        or (upper(coalesce(il.ref_type, '')) = 'WO-RETURN' and coalesce(il.qty_in, 0::numeric) > 0)
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.inv_ledger rev
        where rev.ref_no = il.id::text
          and upper(coalesce(rev.ref_type, '')) like 'REV-%'
      )
  ),
  net_material_ledger as (
    select
      item_id,
      material_key,
      sum(
        case
          when ref_type = 'WO-RETURN' then -1 * qty_in
          else qty_out
        end
      ) as net_issue_qty
    from live_material_ledger
    group by item_id, material_key
  )
  select exists (
    select 1
    from net_material_ledger
    where coalesce(net_issue_qty, 0::numeric) > 0.0001
  );
$$;
