-- Name: v_inv_item_purchase_uom_setup; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_inv_item_purchase_uom_setup WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT (i.id)::text AS item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS category,
    COALESCE(i.department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(i.active, true) AS item_active,
    COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS stock_uom,
    COALESCE(i.size_profile, ''::text) AS size_profile,
    COALESCE(i.rm_type, ''::text) AS rm_type,
    i.length_mm,
    i.width_mm,
    i.height_mm,
    COALESCE(i.length_unit, i.width_unit, i.height_unit, 'MM'::text) AS dimension_unit,
    i.gsm,
    COALESCE(r.purchase_uom, i.uom, ''::text) AS purchase_uom,
    COALESCE(r.conversion_type, 'SAME_AS_STOCK'::text) AS conversion_type,
    r.fixed_factor,
    COALESCE(r.width_mm, i.width_mm) AS rule_width_mm,
    COALESCE(r.length_mm, i.length_mm) AS rule_length_mm,
    COALESCE(r.height_mm, i.height_mm) AS rule_height_mm,
    COALESCE(r.gsm, i.gsm) AS rule_gsm,
    COALESCE(r.notes, ''::text) AS rule_notes,
    COALESCE(r.active, true) AS rule_active,
    r.updated_at,
    COALESCE(r.updated_by, ''::text) AS updated_by,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.id IS NULL) THEN 'MISSING'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(r.purchase_uom, ''::text) = ''::text) THEN 'MISSING'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(r.conversion_type, ''::text) = ''::text) THEN 'MISSING'::text
            WHEN ((r.conversion_type = 'FIXED_FACTOR'::text) AND (COALESCE(r.fixed_factor, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'INCOMPLETE'::text
            WHEN ((r.conversion_type = ANY (ARRAY['AREA_WIDTH'::text, 'WEIGHT_GSM_RM'::text, 'WEIGHT_GSM'::text])) AND (COALESCE(r.width_mm, i.width_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'INCOMPLETE'::text
            WHEN ((r.conversion_type = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET_AREA'::text, 'WEIGHT_GSM_SHEET'::text])) AND ((COALESCE(r.width_mm, i.width_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(r.length_mm, i.length_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric))) THEN 'INCOMPLETE'::text
            WHEN ((r.conversion_type = ANY (ARRAY['WEIGHT_GSM_RM'::text, 'WEIGHT_GSM_SHEET'::text, 'WEIGHT_GSM'::text])) AND (COALESCE(r.gsm, i.gsm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'INCOMPLETE'::text
            ELSE 'COMPLETE'::text
        END AS setup_status,
    COALESCE(im.product_category, ''::text) AS product_category
   FROM ((public.inv_items i
     LEFT JOIN public.items im ON ((upper(im.item_code) = upper(i.item_code))))
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_item_purchase_uom_rules r ON ((upper(r.item_code) = upper(i.item_code))));


--
-- TOC entry 622 (class 1259 OID 216146)
-- Name: v_purchase_rate_master_setup_v2; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_rate_master_setup_v2 WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT (i.id)::text AS item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS category,
    COALESCE(i.department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(i.rm_type, ''::text) AS rm_type,
    COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS stock_uom,
    COALESCE(u.purchase_uom, i.uom, ''::text) AS purchase_uom,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.rate_key, ''::text), i.rm_type, ''::text) AS rate_key,
    COALESCE(p.control_policy,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(i.rm_type, ''::text) = ''::text) THEN 'MANUAL_ALLOWED'::text
            ELSE 'TEMP_EXCEPTION'::text
        END) AS control_policy,
    COALESCE(p.notes, ''::text) AS policy_notes,
    (m.id)::text AS rate_master_id,
    COALESCE(m.rate_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.rate_key, ''::text), i.rm_type, ''::text)) AS rate_name,
    m.rate,
    COALESCE(m.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) AS tax_pct,
    m.effective_from,
    m.effective_to,
    COALESCE(m.status, ''::text) AS rate_status,
    COALESCE(m.notes, ''::text) AS rate_notes,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(p.control_policy,
            CASE
                WHEN (COALESCE(i.rm_type, ''::text) = ''::text) THEN 'MANUAL_ALLOWED'::text
                ELSE 'TEMP_EXCEPTION'::text
            END) = ANY (ARRAY['MANUAL_ALLOWED'::text, 'TEMP_EXCEPTION'::text])) THEN 'MANUAL_ALLOWED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(NULLIF(p.rate_key, ''::text), i.rm_type, ''::text) = ''::text) THEN 'MISSING_RATE_KEY'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(u.purchase_uom, i.uom, ''::text) = ''::text) THEN 'MISSING_PURCHASE_UOM'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(u.rule_active, false) = false) OR (COALESCE(u.setup_status, 'MISSING'::text) <> 'COMPLETE'::text)) THEN 'INCOMPLETE_CONVERSION'::text
            WHEN ((m.id IS NULL) AND (last_rm.effective_to IS NOT NULL) AND (last_rm.effective_to < CURRENT_DATE)) THEN 'EXPIRED_RATE'::text
            WHEN (m.id IS NULL) THEN 'MISSING_RATE'::text
            ELSE 'READY'::text
        END AS setup_status,
    COALESCE(u.setup_status, 'MISSING'::text) AS conversion_setup_status,
    COALESCE(u.rule_active, false) AS conversion_rule_active,
    COALESCE(u.conversion_type, 'SAME_AS_STOCK'::text) AS conversion_type
   FROM ((((public.inv_items i
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_rate_item_policies p ON ((upper(p.item_code) = upper(i.item_code))))
     LEFT JOIN public.v_inv_item_purchase_uom_setup u ON ((upper(u.item_code) = upper(i.item_code))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rm.id,
            rm.rate_key,
            rm.rate_name,
            rm.purchase_uom,
            rm.rate,
            rm.tax_pct,
            rm.effective_from,
            rm.effective_to,
            rm.status,
            rm.notes,
            rm.created_at,
            rm.created_by,
            rm.updated_at,
            rm.updated_by
           FROM public.purchase_rate_masters rm
          WHERE ((upper(rm.rate_key) = upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(p.rate_key, ''::text), i.rm_type, ''::text))) AND (upper(rm.purchase_uom) = upper(COALESCE(u.purchase_uom, i.uom, ''::text))) AND (rm.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (rm.effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE) AND ((rm.effective_to IS NULL) OR (rm.effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE)))
          ORDER BY rm.effective_from DESC, rm.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) m ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT rm.id,
            rm.rate_key,
            rm.rate_name,
            rm.purchase_uom,
            rm.rate,
            rm.tax_pct,
            rm.effective_from,
            rm.effective_to,
            rm.status,
            rm.notes,
            rm.created_at,
            rm.created_by,
            rm.updated_at,
            rm.updated_by
           FROM public.purchase_rate_masters rm
          WHERE ((upper(rm.rate_key) = upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(p.rate_key, ''::text), i.rm_type, ''::text))) AND (upper(rm.purchase_uom) = upper(COALESCE(u.purchase_uom, i.uom, ''::text))) AND (rm.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))
          ORDER BY rm.effective_from DESC, rm.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) last_rm ON (true));


--
-- TOC entry 491 (class 1259 OID 122041)
-- Name: v_inventory_transaction_register; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_inventory_transaction_register WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH latest_po_tax AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON ((upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM pol.item_code)))) upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM pol.item_code)) AS item_code,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(pol.master_tax_pct_snapshot, (0)::numeric)) AS tax_pct
           FROM public.purchase_order_lines pol
          WHERE ((NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM pol.item_code), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(NULLIF(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(pol.master_tax_pct_snapshot, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric))
          ORDER BY (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM pol.item_code))), pol.created_at DESC, pol.line_no DESC
        ), item_tax AS (
         SELECT i_1.id AS item_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(prm.tax_pct, (0)::numeric), lpt.tax_pct, NULLIF(sm.gst_pct, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS tax_pct
           FROM (((public.inv_items i_1
             LEFT JOIN public.v_purchase_rate_master_setup_v2 prm ON ((upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM prm.item_code)) = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM i_1.item_code)))))
             LEFT JOIN latest_po_tax lpt ON ((lpt.item_code = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM i_1.item_code)))))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.gst_pct
                   FROM public.items m
                  WHERE (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(m.item_code, ''::text))) = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(i_1.item_code, ''::text))))
                  ORDER BY m.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
                 LIMIT 1) sm ON (true))
        ), receipt_tax_by_lot AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.lot_id) r.lot_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(r.tax_pct, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(pol.master_tax_pct_snapshot, (0)::numeric), it.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) AS tax_pct
           FROM (((public.purchase_po_receipts r
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_order_lines pol ON ((pol.id = r.po_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.inv_lots lot ON ((lot.id = r.lot_id)))
             LEFT JOIN item_tax it ON ((it.item_id = lot.item_id)))
          WHERE ((r.lot_id IS NOT NULL) AND (r.reversed_at IS NULL))
          ORDER BY r.lot_id, r.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.created_at DESC
        ), direct_receipt_tax AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.ledger_id) r.ledger_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(r.tax_pct, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(pol.master_tax_pct_snapshot, (0)::numeric), it.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) AS tax_pct
           FROM (((public.purchase_po_receipts r
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_order_lines pol ON ((pol.id = r.po_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.inv_ledger l_1 ON ((l_1.id = r.ledger_id)))
             LEFT JOIN item_tax it ON ((it.item_id = l_1.item_id)))
          WHERE ((r.ledger_id IS NOT NULL) AND (r.reversed_at IS NULL))
          ORDER BY r.ledger_id, r.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.created_at DESC
        ), allocation_tax AS (
         SELECT a.ledger_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN (sum(abs((COALESCE(a.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(a.rate, (0)::numeric)))) > (0)::numeric) THEN (sum((abs((COALESCE(a.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(a.rate, (0)::numeric))) * COALESCE(rt.tax_pct, it.tax_pct, (0)::numeric))) / sum(abs((COALESCE(a.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(a.rate, (0)::numeric)))))
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS tax_pct
           FROM ((public.inv_lot_allocations a
             LEFT JOIN receipt_tax_by_lot rt ON ((rt.lot_id = a.lot_id)))
             LEFT JOIN item_tax it ON ((it.item_id = a.item_id)))
          WHERE (a.ledger_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY a.ledger_id
        ), ledger_values AS (
         SELECT l_1.id,
            l_1.item_id,
            l_1.location,
            l_1.ref_type,
            l_1.ref_no,
            l_1.qty_in,
            l_1.qty_out,
            l_1.rate,
            l_1.value,
            l_1.remarks,
            l_1.created_at,
            l_1.department,
            l_1.batch_no,
            COALESCE(drt.tax_pct, atx.tax_pct, it.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) AS effective_gst_pct
           FROM ((((public.inv_ledger l_1
             LEFT JOIN public.inv_items i_1 ON ((i_1.id = l_1.item_id)))
             LEFT JOIN direct_receipt_tax drt ON ((drt.ledger_id = l_1.id)))
             LEFT JOIN allocation_tax atx ON ((atx.ledger_id = l_1.id)))
             LEFT JOIN item_tax it ON ((it.item_id = l_1.item_id)))
        )
 SELECT l.id,
    l.item_id,
    l.created_at,
    upper(COALESCE(l.ref_type, ''::text)) AS ref_type,
    l.ref_no,
    COALESCE(i.item_code, ''::text) AS item_code,
    COALESCE(i.item_name, ''::text) AS item_name,
    COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS uom,
    COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS category,
    COALESCE(l.department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) AS qty_in,
    COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric) AS qty_out,
    COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
    COALESCE(l.value, (0)::numeric) AS value,
    COALESCE(l.location, ''::text) AS location,
    COALESCE(l.batch_no, ''::text) AS batch_no,
    COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text) AS remarks,
    round(COALESCE(l.value, (0)::numeric), 2) AS basic_value,
    round(COALESCE(l.effective_gst_pct, (0)::numeric), 2) AS gst_pct,
    round(((COALESCE(l.value, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l.effective_gst_pct, (0)::numeric)) / 100.0), 2) AS gst_value,
    round((COALESCE(l.value, (0)::numeric) * ((1)::numeric + (COALESCE(l.effective_gst_pct, (0)::numeric) / 100.0))), 2) AS gst_inclusive_value
   FROM (ledger_values l
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = l.item_id)));

--
-- TOC entry 450 (class 1259 OID 89121)
-- Name: inv_stock_mv; Type: MATERIALIZED VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.inv_stock_mv AS
 WITH ledger_balance AS (
         SELECT l.item_id,
            upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            sum((COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric))) AS qty,
            max(l.created_at) AS last_movement_at,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN COALESCE(l.value, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS inbound_value,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS inbound_qty
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          GROUP BY l.item_id, (upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)))
        ), lot_balance AS (
         SELECT lt.item_id,
            upper(COALESCE(lt.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(lt.qty_available, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN COALESCE(lt.qty_available, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS lot_qty,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(lt.qty_available, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (COALESCE(lt.qty_available, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(lt.rate, (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS lot_value
           FROM public.inv_lots lt
          GROUP BY lt.item_id, (upper(COALESCE(lt.location, 'MAIN'::text)))
        )
 SELECT i.id AS item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS category,
    COALESCE(i.department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS uom,
    lb.location,
    lb.qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((lotb.lot_value / NULLIF(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric)), 6)
            WHEN (COALESCE(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((lb.inbound_value / NULLIF(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric)), 6)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS avg_rate,
    round((lb.qty *
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (lotb.lot_value / NULLIF(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric))
            WHEN (COALESCE(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (lb.inbound_value / NULLIF(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), 2) AS value,
    lb.last_movement_at
   FROM ((ledger_balance lb
     JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = lb.item_id)))
     LEFT JOIN lot_balance lotb ON (((lotb.item_id = lb.item_id) AND (lotb.location = lb.location))))
  WHERE (lb.qty <> (0)::numeric)
  WITH NO DATA;


--
-- TOC entry 451 (class 1259 OID 89135)
-- Name: inv_stock_analytics_mv; Type: MATERIALIZED VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.inv_stock_analytics_mv AS
 WITH lot_ranked AS (
         SELECT lt_1.item_id,
            upper(COALESCE(lt_1.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(lt_1.batch_no, ''::text)) AS batch_no,
            lt_1.receipt_date,
            lt_1.created_at,
            COALESCE(lt_1.qty_available, (0)::numeric) AS qty_available,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lt_1.item_id, (upper(COALESCE(lt_1.location, 'MAIN'::text))) ORDER BY lt_1.receipt_date, lt_1.created_at, lt_1.id) AS rn
           FROM public.inv_lots lt_1
          WHERE (COALESCE(lt_1.qty_available, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)
        ), lot_agg AS (
         SELECT lr.item_id,
            lr.location,
            (count(*))::integer AS batch_count,
            min(lr.receipt_date) AS oldest_receipt_at,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (lr.rn = 1) THEN lr.batch_no
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS next_batch_no
           FROM lot_ranked lr
          GROUP BY lr.item_id, lr.location
        ), issue_30 AS (
         SELECT l.item_id,
            upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            sum(COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric)) AS issue_qty_30
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          WHERE ((l.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (l.created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)))
          GROUP BY l.item_id, (upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)))
        ), pr_first_receipt AS (
         SELECT l.item_id,
            upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            l.ref_no AS pr_no,
            min(l.created_at) AS first_receipt_at
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          WHERE ((l.ref_type = 'PR-RECEIPT'::text) AND (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (l.ref_no IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY l.item_id, (upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text))), l.ref_no
        ), lead_time AS (
         SELECT pr.item_id,
            r.location,
            avg(GREATEST((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (r.first_receipt_at - pr.created_at)) / 86400.0), (0)::numeric)) AS avg_lead_time_days
           FROM (public.inv_purchase_requests pr
             JOIN pr_first_receipt r ON (((r.pr_no = pr.pr_no) AND (r.item_id = pr.item_id))))
          GROUP BY pr.item_id, r.location
        )
 SELECT s.item_id,
    s.location,
    s.last_movement_at,
    la.oldest_receipt_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(la.oldest_receipt_at, s.last_movement_at) IS NULL) THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE (ceil((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(la.oldest_receipt_at, s.last_movement_at))) / 86400.0)))::integer
        END AS ageing_days,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(la.oldest_receipt_at, s.last_movement_at) IS NULL) THEN 'UNKNOWN'::text
            WHEN (ceil((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(la.oldest_receipt_at, s.last_movement_at))) / 86400.0)) > (60)::numeric) THEN 'NON_MOVING'::text
            WHEN (ceil((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(la.oldest_receipt_at, s.last_movement_at))) / 86400.0)) > (30)::numeric) THEN 'SLOW_MOVING'::text
            ELSE 'FAST_MOVING'::text
        END AS movement_class,
    COALESCE(la.next_batch_no, ''::text) AS next_batch_no,
    COALESCE(la.batch_count, 0) AS batch_count,
    round((COALESCE(i30.issue_qty_30, (0)::numeric) / 30.0), 4) AS avg_daily_consumption,
    round(COALESCE(lt.avg_lead_time_days, (7)::numeric), 2) AS avg_lead_time_days,
    1.2 AS safety_factor,
    round(((COALESCE(lt.avg_lead_time_days, (7)::numeric) * (COALESCE(i30.issue_qty_30, (0)::numeric) / 30.0)) * 1.2), 2) AS minimum_stock_level
   FROM (((public.inv_stock_mv s
     LEFT JOIN lot_agg la ON (((la.item_id = s.item_id) AND (la.location = s.location))))
     LEFT JOIN issue_30 i30 ON (((i30.item_id = s.item_id) AND (i30.location = s.location))))
     LEFT JOIN lead_time lt ON (((lt.item_id = s.item_id) AND (lt.location = s.location))))
  WITH NO DATA;


--
-- TOC entry 520 (class 1259 OID 140237)
-- Name: inv_stock_reconciled_v; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.inv_stock_reconciled_v WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH ledger_balance AS (
         SELECT l.item_id,
            upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            sum((COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric))) AS ledger_qty,
            max(l.created_at) AS last_movement_at,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN COALESCE(l.value, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS inbound_value,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS inbound_qty
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          GROUP BY l.item_id, (upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)))
        ), lot_balance AS (
         SELECT lt.item_id,
            upper(COALESCE(lt.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(lt.qty_available, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN COALESCE(lt.qty_available, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS lot_qty,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(lt.qty_available, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (COALESCE(lt.qty_available, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(lt.rate, (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS lot_value,
            max(lt.created_at) AS last_lot_movement_at
           FROM public.inv_lots lt
          GROUP BY lt.item_id, (upper(COALESCE(lt.location, 'MAIN'::text)))
        ), keys AS (
         SELECT ledger_balance.item_id,
            ledger_balance.location
           FROM ledger_balance
        UNION
         SELECT lot_balance.item_id,
            lot_balance.location
           FROM lot_balance
          WHERE (COALESCE(lot_balance.lot_qty, (0)::numeric) <> (0)::numeric)
        )
 SELECT i.id AS item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS category,
    COALESCE(i.department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS uom,
    k.location,
    COALESCE(lb.ledger_qty, (0)::numeric) AS ledger_qty,
    COALESCE(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric) AS lot_qty,
    round(COALESCE(lb.ledger_qty, (0)::numeric), 6) AS qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((lotb.lot_value / NULLIF(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric)), 6)
            WHEN (COALESCE(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((lb.inbound_value / NULLIF(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric)), 6)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS avg_rate,
    round((COALESCE(lb.ledger_qty, (0)::numeric) *
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (lotb.lot_value / NULLIF(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric))
            WHEN (COALESCE(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (lb.inbound_value / NULLIF(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), 2) AS value,
    round((COALESCE(lotb.lot_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(lb.ledger_qty, (0)::numeric)), 6) AS qty_gap,
    round((COALESCE(lotb.lot_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE((COALESCE(lb.ledger_qty, (0)::numeric) *
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (lb.inbound_value / NULLIF(lb.inbound_qty, (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric)), 2) AS value_gap,
    COALESCE(lotb.last_lot_movement_at, lb.last_movement_at) AS last_movement_at
   FROM (((keys k
     JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = k.item_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ledger_balance lb ON (((lb.item_id = k.item_id) AND (lb.location = k.location))))
     LEFT JOIN lot_balance lotb ON (((lotb.item_id = k.item_id) AND (lotb.location = k.location))));

                       FROM public.work_order_routing wor

                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                            CASE
                                WHEN (jsonb_typeof((wo.snapshot_json -> 'routing'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN (wo.snapshot_json -> 'routing'::text)

            extra_snapshot.required_qty
           FROM extra_snapshot
        )
 SELECT wo_id,
    wo_number,
    status,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(raw_department) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'Flexo'::text
            WHEN (upper(raw_department) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
            WHEN (upper(raw_department) = 'FLAT'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
            WHEN (upper(raw_department) ~~ '%FLAT%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
            WHEN (upper(raw_department) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'Digital'::text
            WHEN (upper(raw_department) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'Corrugation'::text

            ELSE COALESCE(source_uom, ''::text)

            ELSE required_qty
        END AS required_qty,
    item_code
   FROM raw_rows
  WHERE ((NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM item_label), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(required_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric));


--
-- TOC entry 524 (class 1259 OID 142431)
-- Name: inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v AS
 WITH issued_rows AS (
         SELECT il.ref_no AS wo_number,
            il.remarks AS material_key,
            upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 1), ''::text)) AS item_label_key,
            COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 2), ''::text) AS gsm_key,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 3), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS deckle_key,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 4), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS cut_key,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'R.M.'::text, 'RUNNING METER'::text, 'RUNNING METERS'::text])) THEN 'RM'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])) THEN 'KG'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET'::text, 'SHEETS'::text])) THEN 'SHEET'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text))
                END AS uom_key,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty_out, (0)::numeric)) AS issued_qty
           FROM public.inv_ledger il
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(il.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (COALESCE(il.qty_out, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(il.remarks, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_ledger rev
                  WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (il.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
          GROUP BY il.ref_no, il.remarks, (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 1), ''::text))), COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 2), ''::text), COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 3), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric), COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 4), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric),
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'R.M.'::text, 'RUNNING METER'::text, 'RUNNING METERS'::text])) THEN 'RM'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])) THEN 'KG'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET'::text, 'SHEETS'::text])) THEN 'SHEET'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text))
                END
        ), returned_rows AS (
         SELECT il.ref_no AS wo_number,
            il.remarks AS material_key,
            upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 1), ''::text)) AS item_label_key,
            COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 2), ''::text) AS gsm_key,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 3), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS deckle_key,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 4), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS cut_key,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'R.M.'::text, 'RUNNING METER'::text, 'RUNNING METERS'::text])) THEN 'RM'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])) THEN 'KG'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET'::text, 'SHEETS'::text])) THEN 'SHEET'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text))
                END AS uom_key,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty_in, (0)::numeric)) AS returned_qty
           FROM public.inv_ledger il
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(il.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'WO-RETURN'::text) AND (COALESCE(il.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(il.remarks, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_ledger rev
                  WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (il.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
          GROUP BY il.ref_no, il.remarks, (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 1), ''::text))), COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 2), ''::text), COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 3), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric), COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 4), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric),
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'R.M.'::text, 'RUNNING METER'::text, 'RUNNING METERS'::text])) THEN 'RM'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])) THEN 'KG'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET'::text, 'SHEETS'::text])) THEN 'SHEET'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text))
                END
        )
 SELECT src.wo_id,
    src.wo_number,
    src.status,
    src.issue_department,
    src.material_key,
    src.item_label,
    src.gsm,
    src.deckle_mm,
    src.cut_mm,
    src.uom,
    src.required_qty,
    COALESCE(ir.issued_qty, (0)::numeric) AS issued_qty,
    GREATEST((src.required_qty - GREATEST((COALESCE(ir.issued_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rr.returned_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS remaining_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (GREATEST((src.required_qty - GREATEST((COALESCE(ir.issued_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rr.returned_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) > 0.0001) THEN 'PENDING'::text
            ELSE 'ISSUED'::text
        END AS line_status,
    COALESCE(rr.returned_qty, (0)::numeric) AS returned_qty,
    GREATEST((COALESCE(ir.issued_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rr.returned_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS net_issued_qty,
    GREATEST((GREATEST((COALESCE(ir.issued_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rr.returned_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) - src.required_qty), (0)::numeric) AS excess_qty,
    src.item_code
   FROM ((public.inv_wo_issue_material_source_v src
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(ir0.issued_qty) AS issued_qty
           FROM issued_rows ir0
          WHERE ((ir0.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND ((ir0.material_key = src.material_key) OR ((NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM issued_rows exact_ir
                  WHERE ((exact_ir.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND (exact_ir.material_key = src.material_key))))) AND (ir0.item_label_key = ANY (ARRAY[upper(COALESCE(src.item_label, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(src.item_code, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(split_part(src.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text))])))) AND ((COALESCE(src.gsm, ''::text) = ''::text) OR (ir0.gsm_key = ''::text) OR (ir0.gsm_key = COALESCE(src.gsm, ''::text))) AND ((COALESCE(src.deckle_mm, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (ir0.deckle_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((ir0.deckle_key - COALESCE(src.deckle_mm, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((COALESCE(src.cut_mm, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (ir0.cut_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((ir0.cut_key - COALESCE(src.cut_mm, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((ir0.uom_key = upper(COALESCE(src.uom, ''::text))) OR ((src.issue_department = 'Flexo'::text) AND (src.uom = 'RM'::text) AND (ir0.uom_key = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'KG'::text])))))) ir ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(rr0.returned_qty) AS returned_qty
           FROM returned_rows rr0
          WHERE ((rr0.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND ((rr0.material_key = src.material_key) OR ((NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM returned_rows exact_rr
                  WHERE ((exact_rr.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND (exact_rr.material_key = src.material_key))))) AND (rr0.item_label_key = ANY (ARRAY[upper(COALESCE(src.item_label, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(src.item_code, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(split_part(src.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text))])))) AND ((COALESCE(src.gsm, ''::text) = ''::text) OR (rr0.gsm_key = ''::text) OR (rr0.gsm_key = COALESCE(src.gsm, ''::text))) AND ((COALESCE(src.deckle_mm, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (rr0.deckle_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((rr0.deckle_key - COALESCE(src.deckle_mm, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((COALESCE(src.cut_mm, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (rr0.cut_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((rr0.cut_key - COALESCE(src.cut_mm, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((rr0.uom_key = upper(COALESCE(src.uom, ''::text))) OR ((src.issue_department = 'Flexo'::text) AND (src.uom = 'RM'::text) AND (rr0.uom_key = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'KG'::text])))))) rr ON (true));

-- Name: inv_wo_issue_requirement_reconciled_v; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE VIEW public.inv_wo_issue_requirement_reconciled_v AS
 WITH source_rows AS (
         SELECT src.wo_id,
            src.wo_number,
            src.status,
            src.issue_department,
            src.material_key,
            src.item_label,
            src.gsm,
            src.deckle_mm,
            src.cut_mm,
            src.uom,
            src.required_qty,
            src.item_code,
            ii.id AS source_item_id,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY src.wo_number, ii.id) AS source_item_line_count
           FROM (public.inv_wo_issue_material_source_v src
             LEFT JOIN public.inv_items ii ON ((upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(ii.item_code, ''::text))) = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(src.item_code, ''::text))))))
        ), active_ledger AS (
         SELECT TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(il.ref_no, ''::text)) AS wo_number,
            upper(COALESCE(il.ref_type, ''::text)) AS ref_type,
            il.remarks AS material_key,
            il.item_id,
            COALESCE(il.qty_out, (0)::numeric) AS qty_out,
            COALESCE(il.qty_in, (0)::numeric) AS qty_in,
            upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 1), ''::text)) AS item_label_key,
            COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 2), ''::text) AS gsm_key
           FROM public.inv_ledger il
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(il.ref_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ISSUE'::text, 'WO-RETURN'::text])) AND (((upper(COALESCE(il.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (COALESCE(il.qty_out, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) OR ((upper(COALESCE(il.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'WO-RETURN'::text) AND (COALESCE(il.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_ledger rev
                  WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (il.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
        ), key_totals AS (
         SELECT active_ledger.wo_number,
            active_ledger.ref_type,
            active_ledger.material_key,
            sum(active_ledger.qty_out) AS issued_qty,
            sum(active_ledger.qty_in) AS returned_qty
           FROM active_ledger
          GROUP BY active_ledger.wo_number, active_ledger.ref_type, active_ledger.material_key
        ), item_totals AS (
         SELECT active_ledger.wo_number,
            active_ledger.ref_type,
            active_ledger.item_id,
            sum(active_ledger.qty_out) AS issued_qty,
            sum(active_ledger.qty_in) AS returned_qty
           FROM active_ledger
          WHERE (active_ledger.item_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY active_ledger.wo_number, active_ledger.ref_type, active_ledger.item_id
        ), legacy_label_totals AS (
         SELECT active_ledger.wo_number,
            active_ledger.ref_type,
            active_ledger.item_label_key,
            active_ledger.gsm_key,
            sum(active_ledger.qty_out) AS issued_qty,
            sum(active_ledger.qty_in) AS returned_qty
           FROM active_ledger
          WHERE (COALESCE(active_ledger.material_key, ''::text) <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY active_ledger.wo_number, active_ledger.ref_type, active_ledger.item_label_key, active_ledger.gsm_key
        ), prepared AS (
         SELECT src.wo_id,
            src.wo_number,
            src.status,
            src.issue_department,
            src.material_key,
            src.item_label,
            src.gsm,
            src.deckle_mm,
            src.cut_mm,
            src.uom,
            src.required_qty,
            src.item_code,
            src.source_item_id,
            src.source_item_line_count,
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((src.source_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (src.source_item_line_count = 1)) THEN legacy_issue.issued_qty
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((src.source_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (src.source_item_line_count = 1)) THEN item_issue.issued_qty
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END, key_issue.issued_qty, legacy_issue.issued_qty, (0)::numeric) AS issued_qty,
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN ((src.source_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (src.source_item_line_count = 1)) THEN legacy_return.returned_qty
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((src.source_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (src.source_item_line_count = 1)) THEN item_return.returned_qty
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END, key_return.returned_qty, legacy_return.returned_qty, (0)::numeric) AS returned_qty
           FROM ((((((source_rows src
             LEFT JOIN key_totals key_issue ON (((key_issue.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND (key_issue.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (key_issue.material_key = src.material_key))))
             LEFT JOIN key_totals key_return ON (((key_return.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND (key_return.ref_type = 'WO-RETURN'::text) AND (key_return.material_key = src.material_key))))
             LEFT JOIN item_totals item_issue ON (((item_issue.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND (item_issue.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (item_issue.item_id = src.source_item_id))))
             LEFT JOIN item_totals item_return ON (((item_return.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND (item_return.ref_type = 'WO-RETURN'::text) AND (item_return.item_id = src.source_item_id))))
             LEFT JOIN legacy_label_totals legacy_issue ON (((legacy_issue.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND (legacy_issue.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (((legacy_issue.item_label_key = upper(COALESCE(src.item_label, ''::text))) OR (legacy_issue.item_label_key = upper(COALESCE(src.item_code, ''::text)))) OR (legacy_issue.item_label_key = upper(COALESCE(split_part(src.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text)))) AND ((COALESCE(src.gsm, ''::text) = ''::text) OR (legacy_issue.gsm_key = ''::text) OR (legacy_issue.gsm_key = COALESCE(src.gsm, ''::text))))))
             LEFT JOIN legacy_label_totals legacy_return ON (((legacy_return.wo_number = src.wo_number) AND (legacy_return.ref_type = 'WO-RETURN'::text) AND (((legacy_return.item_label_key = upper(COALESCE(src.item_label, ''::text))) OR (legacy_return.item_label_key = upper(COALESCE(src.item_code, ''::text)))) OR (legacy_return.item_label_key = upper(COALESCE(split_part(src.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text)))) AND ((COALESCE(src.gsm, ''::text) = ''::text) OR (legacy_return.gsm_key = ''::text) OR (legacy_return.gsm_key = COALESCE(src.gsm, ''::text))))))
        )
 SELECT wo_id,
    wo_number,
    status,
    issue_department,
    material_key,
    item_label,
    gsm,
    deckle_mm,
    cut_mm,
    uom,
    required_qty,
    issued_qty,
    returned_qty,
    GREATEST((issued_qty - returned_qty), (0)::numeric) AS net_issued_qty,
    GREATEST((required_qty - GREATEST((issued_qty - returned_qty), (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS remaining_qty,
    GREATEST((GREATEST((issued_qty - returned_qty), (0)::numeric) - required_qty), (0)::numeric) AS excess_qty,
    item_code
   FROM prepared;

                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET'::text, 'SHEETS'::text])) THEN 'SHEET'::text

                  WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (il.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
          GROUP BY il.ref_no, il.remarks, (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 1), ''::text))), COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 2), ''::text), COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 3), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric), COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 4), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric),
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'R.M.'::text, 'RUNNING METER'::text, 'RUNNING METERS'::text])) THEN 'RM'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])) THEN 'KG'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET'::text, 'SHEETS'::text])) THEN 'SHEET'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text))
                END
        ), wo_base AS (
         SELECT wo.id,
            wo.wo_number,
            wo.status,
            wo.snapshot_json,
            NULLIF(upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{flexoDetails,itemCode}'::text[]), ''::text))), ''::text) AS flexo_item_code,
            NULLIF(upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{flexoDetails,itemName}'::text[]), ''::text))), ''::text) AS flexo_item_name,
            COALESCE((NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{flexoDetails,totalRunningMeter}'::text[]), ''::text))::numeric, (NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{flexoDetails,baseRunningMeter}'::text[]), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS flexo_running_meter,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{departmentCategory}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,category}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,type}'::text[]), ''::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{departmentCategory}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,category}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,type}'::text[]), ''::text), ''::text)
                    WHEN ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM public.work_order_routing wor
                      WHERE ((wor.wo_id = wo.id) AND ((upper(COALESCE(wor.department, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(wor.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(wor.planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(wor.planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%CANON%'::text))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                            CASE
                                WHEN (jsonb_typeof((wo.snapshot_json -> 'routing'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN (wo.snapshot_json -> 'routing'::text)
                                ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                            END) rt("row")
                      WHERE ((upper(concat_ws(' '::text, (rt."row" ->> 'dept'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'department'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'operation'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'process_name'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'machine'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'planned_machine'::text))) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (upper(concat_ws(' '::text, (rt."row" ->> 'machine'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'planned_machine'::text))) ~~ '%CANON%'::text))))) THEN 'Digital'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{departmentCategory}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,category}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,type}'::text[]), ''::text), ''::text)
                END AS raw_department
           FROM public.work_orders wo
          WHERE (COALESCE(upper(wo.status), ''::text) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CANCELED'::text, 'VOID'::text, 'DELETED'::text]))
        ), prepared AS (
         SELECT wb.id AS wo_id,
            wb.wo_number,
            wb.status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'Flexo'::text
                    WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
                    WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) = 'FLAT'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
                    WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%FLAT%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
                    WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'Digital'::text
                    WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'Corrugation'::text
                    ELSE 'Offset'::text
                END AS issue_department,
            mr.material_key,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.item_name, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text), ''::text) AS item_label,
            mr.gsm,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.deckle, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 3), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS deckle_mm,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.cut_size, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 4), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS cut_mm,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) AND (wb.flexo_running_meter > (0)::numeric) AND (((upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.item_name, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text), ''::text)) = COALESCE(wb.flexo_item_code, '##'::text)) OR (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.item_name, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text), ''::text)) = COALESCE(wb.flexo_item_name, '##'::text))) OR (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.uom, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 5), ''::text))) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])))) THEN 'RM'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.uom, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 5), ''::text), ''::text)
                END AS uom,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) AND (wb.flexo_running_meter > (0)::numeric) AND (((upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.item_name, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text), ''::text)) = COALESCE(wb.flexo_item_code, '##'::text)) OR (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.item_name, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text), ''::text)) = COALESCE(wb.flexo_item_name, '##'::text))) OR (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.uom, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 5), ''::text))) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])))) THEN wb.flexo_running_meter
                    ELSE COALESCE(mr.required_qty, (0)::numeric)
                END AS required_qty,
            COALESCE(ir.issued_qty, (0)::numeric) AS issued_qty,
            COALESCE(rr.returned_qty, (0)::numeric) AS returned_qty,
            mr.item_code
           FROM (((wo_base wb
             JOIN material_rows mr ON ((mr.wo_id = wb.id)))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(ir0.issued_qty) AS issued_qty
                   FROM issued_rows ir0
                  WHERE ((ir0.wo_number = wb.wo_number) AND ((ir0.material_key = mr.material_key) OR ((NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM issued_rows exact_ir
                          WHERE ((exact_ir.wo_number = wb.wo_number) AND (exact_ir.material_key = mr.material_key))))) AND (ir0.item_label_key = ANY (ARRAY[upper(COALESCE(mr.item_name, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(mr.item_code, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text))])))) AND ((COALESCE((mr.gsm)::text, ''::text) = ''::text) OR (ir0.gsm_key = ''::text) OR (ir0.gsm_key = COALESCE((mr.gsm)::text, ''::text))) AND ((COALESCE(mr.deckle, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (ir0.deckle_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((ir0.deckle_key - COALESCE(mr.deckle, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((COALESCE(mr.cut_size, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (ir0.cut_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((ir0.cut_key - COALESCE(mr.cut_size, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((ir0.uom_key = upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.uom, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 5), ''::text), ''::text))) OR ((upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) AND (ir0.uom_key = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'KG'::text])))))) ir ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(rr0.returned_qty) AS returned_qty
                   FROM returned_rows rr0
                  WHERE ((rr0.wo_number = wb.wo_number) AND ((rr0.material_key = mr.material_key) OR ((NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM returned_rows exact_rr
                          WHERE ((exact_rr.wo_number = wb.wo_number) AND (exact_rr.material_key = mr.material_key))))) AND (rr0.item_label_key = ANY (ARRAY[upper(COALESCE(mr.item_name, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(mr.item_code, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text))])))) AND ((COALESCE((mr.gsm)::text, ''::text) = ''::text) OR (rr0.gsm_key = ''::text) OR (rr0.gsm_key = COALESCE((mr.gsm)::text, ''::text))) AND ((COALESCE(mr.deckle, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (rr0.deckle_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((rr0.deckle_key - COALESCE(mr.deckle, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((COALESCE(mr.cut_size, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (rr0.cut_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((rr0.cut_key - COALESCE(mr.cut_size, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((rr0.uom_key = upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(mr.uom, ''::text), NULLIF(split_part(mr.material_key, '|'::text, 5), ''::text), ''::text))) OR ((upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) AND (rr0.uom_key = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'KG'::text])))))) rr ON (true))
        )
 SELECT wo_id,
    wo_number,
    status,
    issue_department,
    material_key,
    item_label,
    gsm,
    deckle_mm,
    cut_mm,
    uom,
    required_qty,
    issued_qty,
    GREATEST((required_qty - GREATEST((issued_qty - returned_qty), (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS remaining_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (GREATEST((required_qty - GREATEST((issued_qty - returned_qty), (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) > 0.0001) THEN 'PENDING'::text
            ELSE 'ISSUED'::text
        END AS line_status,
    returned_qty,
    GREATEST((issued_qty - returned_qty), (0)::numeric) AS net_issued_qty,
    GREATEST((GREATEST((issued_qty - returned_qty), (0)::numeric) - required_qty), (0)::numeric) AS excess_qty,
    item_code
   FROM prepared;

CREATE VIEW public.inv_wo_issue_status_fast_v AS
 WITH wo_base AS (
         SELECT wo.id AS wo_id,
            wo.wo_number,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{departmentCategory}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,category}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,type}'::text[]), ''::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{departmentCategory}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,category}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,type}'::text[]), ''::text), ''::text)
                    WHEN ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM public.work_order_routing wor
                      WHERE ((wor.wo_id = wo.id) AND ((upper(COALESCE(wor.department, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(wor.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(wor.planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(wor.planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%CANON%'::text))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                            CASE
                                WHEN (jsonb_typeof((wo.snapshot_json -> 'routing'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN (wo.snapshot_json -> 'routing'::text)
                                ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                            END) rt("row")
                      WHERE ((upper(concat_ws(' '::text, (rt."row" ->> 'dept'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'department'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'operation'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'process_name'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'machine'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'planned_machine'::text))) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (upper(concat_ws(' '::text, (rt."row" ->> 'machine'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'planned_machine'::text))) ~~ '%CANON%'::text))))) THEN 'Digital'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{department}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{departmentCategory}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,category}'::text[]), ''::text), NULLIF((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,type}'::text[]), ''::text), ''::text)
                END AS raw_department
           FROM public.work_orders wo
          WHERE (COALESCE(upper(wo.status), ''::text) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CANCELED'::text, 'VOID'::text, 'DELETED'::text]))
        ), req_status AS (
         SELECT inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.wo_number,
            max(inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.issue_department) AS issue_department,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or((inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.line_status = 'PENDING'::text)) THEN 'PENDING'::text
                    ELSE 'ISSUED'::text
                END AS material_status,
            sum(inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.required_qty) AS required_qty,
            sum(inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.issued_qty) AS issued_qty,
            sum(inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.returned_qty) AS returned_qty,
            sum(inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.net_issued_qty) AS net_issued_qty,
            sum(inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.remaining_qty) AS remaining_qty,
            sum(inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.excess_qty) AS excess_qty,
            count(*) AS line_count
           FROM public.inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v
          GROUP BY inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v.wo_number
        )
 SELECT wb.wo_number,
    COALESCE(rs.issue_department,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'Flexo'::text
            WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
            WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) = 'FLAT'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
            WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%FLAT%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
            WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'Digital'::text
            WHEN (upper(wb.raw_department) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'Corrugation'::text
            ELSE 'Offset'::text
        END) AS issue_department,
    COALESCE(rs.material_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS material_status,
    COALESCE(rs.required_qty, (0)::numeric) AS required_qty,
    COALESCE(rs.issued_qty, (0)::numeric) AS issued_qty,
    COALESCE(rs.remaining_qty, (0)::numeric) AS remaining_qty,
    COALESCE(rs.line_count, (0)::bigint) AS line_count,
    COALESCE(rs.returned_qty, (0)::numeric) AS returned_qty,
    COALESCE(rs.net_issued_qty, (0)::numeric) AS net_issued_qty,
    COALESCE(rs.excess_qty, (0)::numeric) AS excess_qty
   FROM (wo_base wb
     LEFT JOIN req_status rs ON ((rs.wo_number = wb.wo_number)));

CREATE VIEW public.inv_wo_issue_status_v AS
 SELECT wo_number,
    max(issue_department) AS issue_department,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_or((line_status = 'PENDING'::text)) THEN 'PENDING'::text
            ELSE 'ISSUED'::text
        END AS material_status,
    sum(required_qty) AS required_qty,
    sum(issued_qty) AS issued_qty,
    sum(remaining_qty) AS remaining_qty,
    sum(returned_qty) AS returned_qty,
    sum(net_issued_qty) AS net_issued_qty,
    sum(excess_qty) AS excess_qty
   FROM public.inv_wo_issue_requirement_v
  GROUP BY wo_number;

-- TOC entry 617 (class 1259 OID 212588)
-- Name: inv_wo_issue_variance_export_v; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.inv_wo_issue_variance_export_v AS
 WITH job_rollup AS (
         SELECT woj.wo_id,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM woj.job_reference), ''::text), ' / '::text) AS job_card_no,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM woj.so_number), ''::text), ' / '::text) AS sales_orders,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM woj.client_name), ''::text), ' / '::text) AS client,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM woj.product_name), ''::text), ' / '::text) AS product,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM woj.artwork_no), ''::text), ' / '::text) AS artwork_no
           FROM public.work_order_jobs woj
          GROUP BY woj.wo_id
        ), ledger_rows AS (
         SELECT upper(COALESCE(il.ref_type, ''::text)) AS ref_type,
            il.ref_no AS wo_number,
            il.remarks AS material_key,
            upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 1), ''::text)) AS item_label_key,
            COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 2), ''::text) AS gsm_key,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 3), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS deckle_key,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 4), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric) AS cut_key,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'R.M.'::text, 'RUNNING METER'::text, 'RUNNING METERS'::text])) THEN 'RM'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['KG'::text, 'KGS'::text, 'KILOGRAM'::text, 'KILOGRAMS'::text])) THEN 'KG'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['SHEET'::text, 'SHEETS'::text])) THEN 'SHEET'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(split_part(il.remarks, '|'::text, 5), ''::text))
                END AS uom_key,
            COALESCE(il.qty_out, (0)::numeric) AS qty_out,
            COALESCE(il.qty_in, (0)::numeric) AS qty_in,
            il.batch_no,
            il.created_at
           FROM public.inv_ledger il
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(il.ref_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ISSUE'::text, 'WO-RETURN'::text])) AND (COALESCE(il.remarks, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND ((COALESCE(il.qty_out, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(il.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_ledger rev
                  WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (il.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
        ), ledger_rollup AS (
         SELECT lr.wo_number,
            lr.item_label_key,
            lr.gsm_key,
            lr.deckle_key,
            lr.cut_key,
            lr.uom_key,
            array_agg(DISTINCT lr.material_key) AS material_keys,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM lr.batch_no), ''::text), ', '::text) FILTER (WHERE (lr.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text)) AS issue_batches,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM lr.batch_no), ''::text), ', '::text) FILTER (WHERE (lr.ref_type = 'WO-RETURN'::text)) AS return_batches,
            sum(COALESCE(lr.qty_out, (0)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (lr.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text)) AS issued_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(lr.qty_in, (0)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (lr.ref_type = 'WO-RETURN'::text)) AS returned_qty,
            max(lr.created_at) FILTER (WHERE (lr.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text)) AS last_issue_date,
            max(lr.created_at) FILTER (WHERE (lr.ref_type = 'WO-RETURN'::text)) AS last_return_date
           FROM ledger_rows lr
          GROUP BY lr.wo_number, lr.item_label_key, lr.gsm_key, lr.deckle_key, lr.cut_key, lr.uom_key
        ), requirement_export AS (
         SELECT wo.wo_date,
            r.wo_number AS wo_no,
            COALESCE(j.job_card_no, ''::text) AS job_card_no,
            COALESCE(j.sales_orders, ''::text) AS sales_orders,
            COALESCE(j.client, ''::text) AS client,
            COALESCE(j.product, ''::text) AS product,
            COALESCE(j.artwork_no, ''::text) AS artwork_no,
            r.issue_department AS department,
            r.material_key,
            r.item_label AS material,
            r.gsm,
            r.deckle_mm,
            r.cut_mm,
            r.uom,
            r.required_qty,
            r.issued_qty,
            r.returned_qty,
            r.net_issued_qty,
            r.remaining_qty AS pending_qty,
            r.excess_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(r.excess_qty, (0)::numeric) > 0.0001) THEN 'EXCESS'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(r.remaining_qty, (0)::numeric) > 0.0001) THEN 'PENDING'::text
                    ELSE 'OK'::text
                END AS status,
            COALESCE(l.issue_batches, ''::text) AS issue_batches,
            COALESCE(l.return_batches, ''::text) AS return_batches,
            l.last_issue_date,
            l.last_return_date
           FROM (((public.inv_wo_issue_requirement_fast_v r
             LEFT JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = r.wo_id)))
             LEFT JOIN job_rollup j ON ((j.wo_id = r.wo_id)))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM l0.issue_batches), ''::text), ', '::text) AS issue_batches,
                    string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM l0.return_batches), ''::text), ', '::text) AS return_batches,
                    max(l0.last_issue_date) AS last_issue_date,
                    max(l0.last_return_date) AS last_return_date
                   FROM ledger_rollup l0
                  WHERE ((l0.wo_number = r.wo_number) AND ((r.material_key = ANY (l0.material_keys)) OR (l0.item_label_key = ANY (ARRAY[upper(COALESCE(r.item_label, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(r.item_code, ''::text)), upper(COALESCE(split_part(r.material_key, '|'::text, 1), ''::text))]))) AND ((COALESCE(r.gsm, ''::text) = ''::text) OR (l0.gsm_key = ''::text) OR (l0.gsm_key = COALESCE(r.gsm, ''::text))) AND ((COALESCE(r.deckle_mm, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (l0.deckle_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((l0.deckle_key - COALESCE(r.deckle_mm, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((COALESCE(r.cut_mm, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) OR (l0.cut_key = (0)::numeric) OR (abs((l0.cut_key - COALESCE(r.cut_mm, (0)::numeric))) <= 0.01)) AND ((l0.uom_key = upper(COALESCE(r.uom, ''::text))) OR ((r.issue_department = 'Flexo'::text) AND (r.uom = 'RM'::text) AND (l0.uom_key = ANY (ARRAY['RM'::text, 'KG'::text])))))) l ON (true))
        )
 SELECT wo_date,
    wo_no,
    job_card_no,
    sales_orders,
    client,
    product,
    artwork_no,
    department,
    material_key,
    material,
    gsm,
    deckle_mm,
    cut_mm,
    uom,
    required_qty,
    issued_qty,
    returned_qty,
    net_issued_qty,
    pending_qty,
    excess_qty,
    status,
    issue_batches,
    return_batches,
    last_issue_date,
    last_return_date
   FROM requirement_export;

    COALESCE(so.advance_payment_received, false) AS advance_payment_received
   FROM ((public.sales_orders so
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines l ON (((l.so_id = so.id) AND (l.line_no = 1))));

CREATE VIEW public.v_artwork_jobs WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT a.id,
    so.so_number,
    so.so_date,
    so.created_at AS so_created_at,
    to_char(COALESCE(((so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text), (so.so_date)::timestamp without time zone), 'HH24:MI'::text) AS so_time,
    so.sales_rep,
    sol.line_no,
    c.client_name,
    sol.product_code,
    sol.product_name,
    sol.category,
    sol.division,
    sol.qty,
    sol.unit,
    a.artwork_no,
    a.product_type,
    a.plate_status,
    a.die_status,
    a.plate_size,
    a.plate_count,
    a.has_hybrid_plate,
    a.hybrid_plate_size,
    a.hybrid_plate_count,
    a.die_count,
    a.sheet_length,
    a.sheet_width,
    a.sheet_ups,
    a.printing_colors,
    a.across_ups,
    a.along_ups,
    a.total_ups,
    a.across_width,
    a.teeth,
    a.across_gap_mm,
    a.along_gap_mm,
    a.status,
    a.artwork_at,
    a.approved_at,
    sol.accounts_status,
    sol.business_status,
    COALESCE(a.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric) AS stock_qty_to_bill,
    COALESCE(sol.job_type, ''::text) AS job_type
   FROM (((public.artworks a
     JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = a.so_id) AND (sol.line_no = a.line_no))))
     JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = a.so_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)));


--
-- TOC entry 474 (class 1259 OID 120505)
-- Name: v_artwork_groups; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_artwork_groups WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT v_artwork_jobs.id,
            v_artwork_jobs.so_number,
            v_artwork_jobs.so_date,
            v_artwork_jobs.so_created_at,
            v_artwork_jobs.so_time,
            v_artwork_jobs.sales_rep,
            v_artwork_jobs.line_no,
            v_artwork_jobs.client_name,
            v_artwork_jobs.product_code,
            v_artwork_jobs.product_name,
            v_artwork_jobs.category,
            v_artwork_jobs.division,
            v_artwork_jobs.qty,
            v_artwork_jobs.unit,
            v_artwork_jobs.artwork_no,
            v_artwork_jobs.product_type,
            v_artwork_jobs.plate_status,
            v_artwork_jobs.die_status,
            v_artwork_jobs.plate_size,
            v_artwork_jobs.plate_count,
            v_artwork_jobs.has_hybrid_plate,
            v_artwork_jobs.hybrid_plate_size,
            v_artwork_jobs.hybrid_plate_count,
            v_artwork_jobs.die_count,
            v_artwork_jobs.sheet_length,
            v_artwork_jobs.sheet_width,
            v_artwork_jobs.sheet_ups,
            v_artwork_jobs.printing_colors,
            v_artwork_jobs.across_ups,
            v_artwork_jobs.along_ups,
            v_artwork_jobs.total_ups,
            v_artwork_jobs.across_width,
            v_artwork_jobs.teeth,
            v_artwork_jobs.across_gap_mm,
            v_artwork_jobs.along_gap_mm,
            v_artwork_jobs.status,
            v_artwork_jobs.artwork_at,
            v_artwork_jobs.approved_at,
            v_artwork_jobs.accounts_status,
            v_artwork_jobs.business_status,
            v_artwork_jobs.stock_qty_to_bill,
            v_artwork_jobs.job_type
           FROM public.v_artwork_jobs
          WHERE (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM v_artwork_jobs.artwork_no), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
        ), rollup AS (
         SELECT b.artwork_no,
            min(b.so_date) AS so_date,
            max(NULLIF(b.product_type, ''::text)) AS product_type,
            max(NULLIF(b.plate_status, ''::text)) AS plate_status,
            max(NULLIF(b.die_status, ''::text)) AS die_status,
            max(NULLIF(b.plate_size, ''::text)) AS plate_size,
            max(b.plate_count) AS plate_count,
            bool_or(COALESCE(b.has_hybrid_plate, false)) AS has_hybrid_plate,
            max(NULLIF(b.hybrid_plate_size, ''::text)) AS hybrid_plate_size,
            max(b.hybrid_plate_count) AS hybrid_plate_count,
            max(b.die_count) AS die_count,
            max(b.sheet_length) AS sheet_length,
            max(b.sheet_width) AS sheet_width,
            max(NULLIF(b.printing_colors, ''::text)) AS printing_colors,
            max(b.across_ups) AS across_ups,
            max(b.along_ups) AS along_ups,
            max(b.total_ups) AS total_ups,
            max(b.across_width) AS across_width,
            max(b.teeth) AS teeth,
            max(b.across_gap_mm) AS across_gap_mm,
            max(b.along_gap_mm) AS along_gap_mm,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and((upper(COALESCE(b.status, 'NO_ART'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN 'APPROVED'::text
                    WHEN bool_or((upper(COALESCE(b.status, 'NO_ART'::text)) = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text)) THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text
                    WHEN bool_or((upper(COALESCE(b.status, 'NO_ART'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text
                    ELSE 'NO_ART'::text
                END AS status,
            min(b.artwork_at) AS artwork_at,
            max(b.approved_at) AS approved_at,
            count(*) AS job_count,
            COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(b.qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS total_qty,
            min(COALESCE(b.sheet_ups, (0)::numeric)) AS min_sheet_ups,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(b.so_number, ''::text) ORDER BY NULLIF(b.so_number, ''::text)), NULL::text) AS so_list,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(b.client_name, ''::text) ORDER BY NULLIF(b.client_name, ''::text)), NULL::text) AS client_list,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(b.division, ''::text) ORDER BY NULLIF(b.division, ''::text)), NULL::text) AS division_list,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(b.sales_rep, ''::text) ORDER BY NULLIF(b.sales_rep, ''::text)), NULL::text) AS sales_rep_list,
            array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(b.job_type, ''::text) ORDER BY NULLIF(b.job_type, ''::text)), NULL::text) AS job_type_list
           FROM base b
          GROUP BY b.artwork_no
        )
 SELECT artwork_no,
    so_date,
    product_type,
    plate_status,
    die_status,
    plate_size,
    plate_count,
    has_hybrid_plate,
    hybrid_plate_size,
    hybrid_plate_count,
    die_count,
    sheet_length,
    sheet_width,
    printing_colors,
    across_ups,
    along_ups,
    total_ups,
    across_width,
    teeth,
    across_gap_mm,
    along_gap_mm,
    status,
    artwork_at,
    approved_at,
    job_count,
    total_qty,
    so_list,
    client_list,
    division_list,
    sales_rep_list,
    job_type_list,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(product_type, ''::text)) = 'DIGITAL'::text) THEN ((product_type IS NOT NULL) AND (min_sheet_ups > (0)::numeric))
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(product_type, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) THEN ((product_type IS NOT NULL) AND (plate_status IS NOT NULL) AND (die_status IS NOT NULL) AND (printing_colors IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(across_ups, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(along_ups, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(total_ups, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(across_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(teeth, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(across_gap_mm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(along_gap_mm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND ((upper(COALESCE(plate_status, ''::text)) <> 'NEW'::text) OR (COALESCE(plate_count, 0) > 0)) AND ((upper(COALESCE(die_status, ''::text)) <> 'NEW'::text) OR (COALESCE(die_count, 0) > 0)) AND (min_sheet_ups > (0)::numeric))
            ELSE ((product_type IS NOT NULL) AND (plate_status IS NOT NULL) AND (die_status IS NOT NULL) AND (printing_colors IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(sheet_length, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(sheet_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND ((upper(COALESCE(plate_status, ''::text)) <> 'NEW'::text) OR ((plate_size IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(plate_count, 0) > 0) AND ((NOT has_hybrid_plate) OR ((hybrid_plate_size IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(hybrid_plate_count, 0) > 0))))) AND ((upper(COALESCE(die_status, ''::text)) <> 'NEW'::text) OR (COALESCE(die_count, 0) > 0)) AND (min_sheet_ups > (0)::numeric))
        END AS is_ready
   FROM rollup;
