CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_po_active_receipts AS
 WITH active_receipt_ledger AS (
         SELECT (l.id)::text AS receipt_id,
            l.ref_no AS po_no,
            NULLIF("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'POLine:([^ |]+)'::text), ''::text) AS po_line_id,
            l.created_at,
            l.qty_in,
            l.rate,
            l.department,
            l.remarks
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(l.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'PO-RECEIPT'::text) AND (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_ledger rev
                  WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (l.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
        )
 SELECT receipt_id,
    po_no,
    po_line_id,
    (created_at)::date AS receipt_date,
    created_at,
    (COALESCE(qty_in, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS qty,
    (COALESCE(rate, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS rate,
    COALESCE(department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(remarks, ''::text) AS remarks
   FROM active_receipt_ledger;


--
-- TOC entry 573 (class 1259 OID 175879)
-- Name: v_purchase_requests_read_model; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_requests_read_model AS
 WITH receipt_by_line AS (
         SELECT ar.po_line_id,
            (sum(COALESCE(ar.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty
           FROM public.v_purchase_po_active_receipts ar
          WHERE (COALESCE(ar.po_line_id, ''::text) <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY ar.po_line_id
        ), po_line_alloc AS (
         SELECT pol.id,
            pol.po_id,
            pol.po_no,
            pol.line_no,
            pol.source_type,
            pol.source_ref,
            pol.item_code,
            pol.item_name,
            pol.qty,
            pol.rate,
            pol.amount,
            pol.department,
            pol.job_ref,
            pol.remarks,
            pol.created_at,
            pol.tax_pct,
            pol.tax_amount,
            pol.total_amount,
            (COALESCE(r.received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(pol.remarks, ''::text) ~* '\[PO_SHORT_CLOSE'::text) THEN LEAST(GREATEST((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(r.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), COALESCE((NULLIF("substring"(COALESCE(pol.remarks, ''::text), '\[PO_SHORT_CLOSE[^\]]*qty=([0-9.]+)'::text), ''::text))::numeric, GREATEST((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(r.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END)::numeric(14,4) AS short_closed_qty
           FROM (public.purchase_order_lines pol
             LEFT JOIN receipt_by_line r ON ((r.po_line_id = (pol.id)::text)))
        ), po_alloc_base AS (
         SELECT pol.source_ref AS pr_no,
            (sum(COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS ordered_qty,
            (sum(COALESCE(pol.short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS short_closed_qty,
            (sum(GREATEST(((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pol.received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pol.short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS open_po_qty,
            (max(pol.rate))::numeric(18,2) AS po_rate,
            (max(pol.tax_pct))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_pct,
            min(po_1.order_date) AS first_po_date,
            max(po_1.order_date) AS latest_po_date,
            string_agg(DISTINCT pol.po_no, ', '::text ORDER BY pol.po_no) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(pol.po_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS po_refs
           FROM (po_line_alloc pol
             JOIN public.purchase_orders po_1 ON ((po_1.id = pol.po_id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = 'INVENTORY_PR'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
          GROUP BY pol.source_ref
        )
 SELECT pr.pr_no,
    pr.created_at,
    (pr.item_id)::text AS item_id,
    COALESCE(pr.item_code, ''::text) AS item_code,
    COALESCE(pr.item_name, ''::text) AS item_name,
    COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS uom,
    (COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS requested_qty,
    (COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS stored_received_qty,
    (GREATEST((COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pending_receipt_qty,
    COALESCE(pr.department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(pr.job_ref, ''::text) AS job_ref,
    COALESCE(pr.remarks, ''::text) AS remarks,
    COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS stored_status,
    (COALESCE(po.ordered_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS ordered_qty,
    (COALESCE(po.open_po_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS open_po_qty,
    (COALESCE(po.po_rate, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS po_rate,
    (COALESCE(po.tax_pct, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_pct,
    COALESCE((po.first_po_date)::text, ''::text) AS first_po_date,
    COALESCE((po.latest_po_date)::text, ''::text) AS latest_po_date,
    (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(po.open_po_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS available_to_order_qty,
    COALESCE(po.po_refs, ''::text) AS po_refs,
    (COALESCE(po.short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS short_closed_qty
   FROM ((public.inv_purchase_requests pr
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.item_code = pr.item_code)))
     LEFT JOIN po_alloc_base po ON ((po.pr_no = pr.pr_no)));


--
-- TOC entry 603 (class 1259 OID 192351)
-- Name: v_inventory_replenishment_snapshot; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_inventory_replenishment_snapshot WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH stock_rows AS (
         SELECT s.item_id,
            s.item_code,
            s.item_name,
            s.category,
            s.department,
            s.uom,
            upper(COALESCE(s.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            COALESCE(s.qty, (0)::numeric) AS current_stock_qty,
            COALESCE(s.avg_rate, (0)::numeric) AS avg_rate,
            COALESCE(s.value, (0)::numeric) AS stock_value
           FROM public.inv_stock_mv s
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(s.location, ''::text)) <> 'FG'::text)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT i.id AS item_id,
            i.item_code,
            i.item_name,
            COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS category,
            COALESCE(i.department, ''::text) AS department,
            COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS uom,
            'MAIN'::text AS location,
            (0)::numeric AS current_stock_qty,
            (0)::numeric AS avg_rate,
            (0)::numeric AS stock_value
           FROM public.inv_items i
          WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_stock_mv s
                  WHERE ((s.item_id = i.id) AND (upper(COALESCE(s.location, ''::text)) <> 'FG'::text)))))
        ), issue_30 AS (
         SELECT l.item_id,
            upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)) AS location,
            sum(COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric)) AS issue_qty_30
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          WHERE ((l.ref_type = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (l.created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)))
          GROUP BY l.item_id, (upper(COALESCE(l.location, 'MAIN'::text)))
        ), open_procurement AS (
         SELECT pr.item_id,
            'MAIN'::text AS location,
            (sum(COALESCE(pr.pending_receipt_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS pipeline_qty,
            (sum(COALESCE(pr.available_to_order_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS open_pr_qty,
            (sum(COALESCE(pr.open_po_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS open_po_qty,
            string_agg(DISTINCT pr.pr_no, ', '::text ORDER BY pr.pr_no) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(pr.pr_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS existing_pr_nos,
            string_agg(DISTINCT pr.po_refs, ', '::text ORDER BY pr.po_refs) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(pr.po_refs, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS existing_po_nos
           FROM public.v_purchase_requests_read_model pr
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(pr.stored_status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text])) AND (COALESCE(pr.pending_receipt_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(pr.item_id, ''::text) <> ''::text))
          GROUP BY pr.item_id
        ), base AS (
         SELECT s.item_id,
            s.item_code,
            s.item_name,
            s.category,
            s.department,
            s.uom,
            s.location,
            COALESCE(i.active, true) AS is_active,
            COALESCE(i.stock_managed, true) AS stock_managed,
            COALESCE(i.is_consumable, false) AS is_consumable,
            (i.lead_time_days)::numeric AS manual_lead_time_days,
            COALESCE(i.moq_qty, (0)::numeric) AS raw_moq_qty,
            COALESCE(i30.issue_qty_30, (0)::numeric) AS total_consumption_qty,
            round((COALESCE(i30.issue_qty_30, (0)::numeric) / 30.0), 4) AS avg_daily_consumption,
            1.2 AS safety_factor,
            s.current_stock_qty,
            s.avg_rate,
            s.stock_value,
            COALESCE(op.open_pr_qty, (0)::numeric) AS open_pr_qty,
            COALESCE(op.open_po_qty, (0)::numeric) AS open_po_qty,
            COALESCE(op.pipeline_qty, (0)::numeric) AS pipeline_qty,
            COALESCE(op.existing_pr_nos, ''::text) AS existing_pr_nos,
            COALESCE(op.existing_po_nos, ''::text) AS existing_po_nos,
            (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(s.uom, ''::text))) = ANY (ARRAY['PCS'::text, 'PC'::text, 'PIECE'::text, 'PIECES'::text, 'NOS'::text, 'NO'::text, 'NO.'::text, 'EA'::text, 'EACH'::text, 'UNIT'::text, 'UNITS'::text])) AS integer_uom
           FROM (((stock_rows s
             JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = s.item_id)))
             LEFT JOIN issue_30 i30 ON (((i30.item_id = s.item_id) AND (i30.location = s.location))))
             LEFT JOIN open_procurement op ON (((op.item_id = (s.item_id)::text) AND (op.location = s.location))))
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT b.item_id,
            b.item_code,
            b.item_name,
            b.category,
            b.department,
            b.uom,
            b.location,
            b.is_active,
            b.stock_managed,
            b.is_consumable,
            b.manual_lead_time_days,
            b.raw_moq_qty,
            b.total_consumption_qty,
            b.avg_daily_consumption,
            b.safety_factor,
            b.current_stock_qty,
            b.avg_rate,
            b.stock_value,
            b.open_pr_qty,
            b.open_po_qty,
            b.pipeline_qty,
            b.existing_pr_nos,
            b.existing_po_nos,
            b.integer_uom,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.manual_lead_time_days IS NOT NULL) AND (b.manual_lead_time_days > (0)::numeric)) THEN round(((b.manual_lead_time_days * b.avg_daily_consumption) * b.safety_factor), 2)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS raw_msl,
            round((b.current_stock_qty + b.pipeline_qty), 3) AS net_available_qty
           FROM base b
        ), rounded AS (
         SELECT c.item_id,
            c.item_code,
            c.item_name,
            c.category,
            c.department,
            c.uom,
            c.location,
            c.is_active,
            c.stock_managed,
            c.is_consumable,
            c.manual_lead_time_days,
            c.raw_moq_qty,
            c.total_consumption_qty,
            c.avg_daily_consumption,
            c.safety_factor,
            c.current_stock_qty,
            c.avg_rate,
            c.stock_value,
            c.open_pr_qty,
            c.open_po_qty,
            c.pipeline_qty,
            c.existing_pr_nos,
            c.existing_po_nos,
            c.integer_uom,
            c.raw_msl,
            c.net_available_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.integer_uom THEN ceil(c.raw_msl)
                    ELSE c.raw_msl
                END AS minimum_stock_level,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.integer_uom THEN ceil(c.raw_moq_qty)
                    ELSE round(c.raw_moq_qty, 3)
                END AS moq_qty
           FROM calc c
        ), shortage AS (
         SELECT r.item_id,
            r.item_code,
            r.item_name,
            r.category,
            r.department,
            r.uom,
            r.location,
            r.is_active,
            r.stock_managed,
            r.is_consumable,
            r.manual_lead_time_days,
            r.raw_moq_qty,
            r.total_consumption_qty,
            r.avg_daily_consumption,
            r.safety_factor,
            r.current_stock_qty,
            r.avg_rate,
            r.stock_value,
            r.open_pr_qty,
            r.open_po_qty,
            r.pipeline_qty,
            r.existing_pr_nos,
            r.existing_po_nos,
            r.integer_uom,
            r.raw_msl,
            r.net_available_qty,
            r.minimum_stock_level,
            r.moq_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.integer_uom THEN ceil(GREATEST((r.minimum_stock_level - r.net_available_qty), (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE round(GREATEST((r.minimum_stock_level - r.net_available_qty), (0)::numeric), 3)
                END AS shortage_qty
           FROM rounded r
        ), suggested AS (
         SELECT s.item_id,
            s.item_code,
            s.item_name,
            s.category,
            s.department,
            s.uom,
            s.location,
            s.is_active,
            s.stock_managed,
            s.is_consumable,
            s.manual_lead_time_days,
            s.raw_moq_qty,
            s.total_consumption_qty,
            s.avg_daily_consumption,
            s.safety_factor,
            s.current_stock_qty,
            s.avg_rate,
            s.stock_value,
            s.open_pr_qty,
            s.open_po_qty,
            s.pipeline_qty,
            s.existing_pr_nos,
            s.existing_po_nos,
            s.integer_uom,
            s.raw_msl,
            s.net_available_qty,
            s.minimum_stock_level,
            s.moq_qty,
            s.shortage_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((s.shortage_qty > (0)::numeric) AND s.integer_uom) THEN ceil(GREATEST(s.shortage_qty, s.moq_qty))
                    WHEN (s.shortage_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN round(GREATEST(s.shortage_qty, s.moq_qty), 3)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS suggested_pr_qty
           FROM shortage s
        )
 SELECT (item_id)::text AS item_id,
    item_code,
    item_name,
    category,
    department,
    uom,
    location,
    is_active,
    stock_managed,
    is_consumable,
    integer_uom,
    manual_lead_time_days,
    manual_lead_time_days AS effective_lead_time_days,
    moq_qty,
    30 AS consumption_window_days,
    total_consumption_qty,
    avg_daily_consumption,
    safety_factor,
    minimum_stock_level,
    round(current_stock_qty, 3) AS current_stock_qty,
    open_pr_qty,
    open_po_qty,
    pipeline_qty,
    (0)::numeric AS reserved_qty,
    net_available_qty,
    shortage_qty,
    suggested_pr_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN ((NOT stock_managed) OR (NOT is_active)) THEN 'INACTIVE'::text
            WHEN ((manual_lead_time_days IS NULL) OR (manual_lead_time_days <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'MISSING_LEAD_TIME'::text
            WHEN (avg_daily_consumption <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'NO_CONSUMPTION'::text
            WHEN ((suggested_pr_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (current_stock_qty <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'CRITICAL'::text
            WHEN (suggested_pr_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'REORDER'::text
            WHEN (current_stock_qty < minimum_stock_level) THEN 'WATCH'::text
            ELSE 'OK'::text
        END AS alert_level,
    (is_active AND stock_managed AND (COALESCE(manual_lead_time_days, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (avg_daily_consumption > (0)::numeric) AND (suggested_pr_qty > (0)::numeric)) AS can_create_pr,
    existing_pr_nos,
    existing_po_nos,
        CASE
            WHEN ((manual_lead_time_days IS NULL) OR (manual_lead_time_days <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'Lead time missing in item master'::text
            WHEN (avg_daily_consumption <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'No issue consumption in the selected window'::text
            WHEN ((current_stock_qty < minimum_stock_level) AND (suggested_pr_qty <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'Stock is below MSL but open PR/PO covers the gap'::text
            WHEN (suggested_pr_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PR required for uncovered MSL shortage'::text
            ELSE 'OK'::text
        END AS reason
   FROM suggested;

--
-- TOC entry 636 (class 1259 OID 220131)
-- Name: v_kraft_reel_register; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_kraft_reel_register WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT l.id AS lot_id,
    l.batch_no AS internal_reel_no,
    l.item_id,
    l.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    i.rm_type,
    i.category,
    i.department,
    i.uom,
    l.gross_weight_kg,
    l.qty_received,
    l.qty_available,
    l.issued_gross_qty,
    l.last_calculated_consumption_kg,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(d.liner_consumed_kg) AS sum
           FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
          WHERE (d.liner_reel_lot_id = l.id)), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(( SELECT sum(d.fluting_consumed_kg) AS sum
           FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
          WHERE (d.fluting_reel_lot_id = l.id)), (0)::numeric)) AS production_consumed_kg,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(d.liner_consumed_kg) AS sum
           FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
          WHERE (d.liner_issue_cycle_id = c.id)), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(( SELECT sum(d.fluting_consumed_kg) AS sum
           FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
          WHERE (d.fluting_issue_cycle_id = c.id)), (0)::numeric)) AS current_wo_production_consumed_kg,
    l.master_width_mm,
    l.master_gsm,
    l.reel_status,
    l.assigned_wo_no,
    l.location,
    l.rate,
    l.source_ref AS po_no,
    l.receipt_date,
    l.issued_at,
    l.returned_at,
    l.closed_at,
    l.closed_reason,
    gr.grn_id,
    pg.grn_no,
    pg.invoice_no,
    pg.vendor_name,
    l.created_at,
    l.current_issue_cycle_id,
    c.issue_qty_kg AS cycle_issued_qty_kg,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(d.liner_consumed_kg) AS sum
           FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
          WHERE (d.liner_issue_cycle_id = c.id)), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(( SELECT sum(d.fluting_consumed_kg) AS sum
           FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details d
          WHERE (d.fluting_issue_cycle_id = c.id)), (0)::numeric)) AS cycle_production_consumed_kg,
    c.process_waste_kg AS cycle_process_waste_kg,
    c.expected_return_qty_kg AS cycle_expected_return_qty_kg,
    c.actual_return_qty_kg AS cycle_actual_return_qty_kg,
    c.return_variance_kg AS cycle_return_variance_kg,
    c.material_key AS cycle_material_key,
    c.status AS cycle_status
   FROM ((((public.inv_lots l
     JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = l.item_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_grn_reels gr ON ((gr.lot_id = l.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_grns pg ON ((pg.id = gr.grn_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_reel_issue_cycles c ON ((c.id = l.current_issue_cycle_id)))
  WHERE (l.is_reel IS TRUE);

--
-- TOC entry 665 (class 1259 OID 233721)
-- Name: v_kraft_reel_register_v2; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_kraft_reel_register_v2 WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH production_by_lot AS (
         SELECT x.lot_id,
            sum(x.consumed_kg) AS consumed_kg
           FROM ( SELECT corrugation_2ply_entry_details.liner_reel_lot_id AS lot_id,
                    COALESCE(corrugation_2ply_entry_details.liner_consumed_kg, (0)::numeric) AS consumed_kg
                   FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details
                  WHERE (corrugation_2ply_entry_details.liner_reel_lot_id IS NOT NULL)
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT corrugation_2ply_entry_details.fluting_reel_lot_id,
                    COALESCE(corrugation_2ply_entry_details.fluting_consumed_kg, (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details
                  WHERE (corrugation_2ply_entry_details.fluting_reel_lot_id IS NOT NULL)) x
          GROUP BY x.lot_id
        ), production_by_cycle AS (
         SELECT x.issue_cycle_id,
            sum(x.consumed_kg) AS consumed_kg
           FROM ( SELECT corrugation_2ply_entry_details.liner_issue_cycle_id AS issue_cycle_id,
                    COALESCE(corrugation_2ply_entry_details.liner_consumed_kg, (0)::numeric) AS consumed_kg
                   FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details
                  WHERE (corrugation_2ply_entry_details.liner_issue_cycle_id IS NOT NULL)
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT corrugation_2ply_entry_details.fluting_issue_cycle_id,
                    COALESCE(corrugation_2ply_entry_details.fluting_consumed_kg, (0)::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM public.corrugation_2ply_entry_details
                  WHERE (corrugation_2ply_entry_details.fluting_issue_cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) x
          GROUP BY x.issue_cycle_id
        )
 SELECT l.id AS lot_id,
    l.batch_no AS internal_reel_no,
    l.item_id,
    l.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    i.rm_type,
    i.category,
    i.department,
    i.uom,
    l.gross_weight_kg,
    l.qty_received,
    l.qty_available,
    l.issued_gross_qty,
    l.last_calculated_consumption_kg,
    COALESCE(pl.consumed_kg, (0)::numeric) AS production_consumed_kg,
    COALESCE(pc.consumed_kg, (0)::numeric) AS current_wo_production_consumed_kg,
    l.master_width_mm,
    l.master_gsm,
    l.reel_status,
    l.assigned_wo_no,
    l.location,
    l.rate,
    l.source_ref AS po_no,
    l.receipt_date,
    l.issued_at,
    l.returned_at,
    l.closed_at,
    l.closed_reason,
    gr.grn_id,
    gr.grn_no,
    gr.invoice_no,
    gr.vendor_name,
    l.created_at,
    l.current_issue_cycle_id,
    c.issue_qty_kg AS cycle_issued_qty_kg,
    COALESCE(pc.consumed_kg, (0)::numeric) AS cycle_production_consumed_kg,
    c.process_waste_kg AS cycle_process_waste_kg,
    c.expected_return_qty_kg AS cycle_expected_return_qty_kg,
    c.actual_return_qty_kg AS cycle_actual_return_qty_kg,
    c.return_variance_kg AS cycle_return_variance_kg,
    c.material_key AS cycle_material_key,
    c.status AS cycle_status,
    ((l.reel_status = ANY (ARRAY['AVAILABLE'::text, 'RETURNED'::text])) AND (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM l.location)) = 'MAIN'::text) AND (l.qty_available > (0)::numeric) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.inv_reel_issue_cycles active_cycle
          WHERE ((active_cycle.lot_id = l.id) AND (active_cycle.status = 'ACTIVE'::text)))))) AS issue_eligible,
        CASE
            WHEN (l.reel_status <> ALL (ARRAY['AVAILABLE'::text, 'RETURNED'::text])) THEN ('STATUS_'::text || l.reel_status)
            WHEN (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM l.location)) <> 'MAIN'::text) THEN ('LOCATION_'::text || COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM l.location), ''::text), 'BLANK'::text))
            WHEN (l.qty_available <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'NO_AVAILABLE_BALANCE'::text
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM public.inv_reel_issue_cycles active_cycle
              WHERE ((active_cycle.lot_id = l.id) AND (active_cycle.status = 'ACTIVE'::text)))) THEN 'ACTIVE_ISSUE_CYCLE'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS issue_block_reason
   FROM (((((public.inv_lots l
     JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = l.item_id)))
     LEFT JOIN production_by_lot pl ON ((pl.lot_id = l.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_reel_issue_cycles c ON ((c.id = l.current_issue_cycle_id)))
     LEFT JOIN production_by_cycle pc ON ((pc.issue_cycle_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pgr.grn_id,
            pg.grn_no,
            pg.invoice_no,
            pg.vendor_name
           FROM (public.purchase_grn_reels pgr
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_grns pg ON ((pg.id = pgr.grn_id)))
          WHERE (pgr.lot_id = l.id)
          ORDER BY pgr.created_at DESC, pgr.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) gr ON (true))
  WHERE (l.is_reel IS TRUE);

-- Name: VIEW v_kraft_reel_register_v2; Type: COMMENT; Schema: public; Owner: -

COMMENT ON VIEW public.v_kraft_reel_register_v2 IS 'Versioned reel register including recovered historical registrations and explicit issue eligibility.';


--
-- TOC entry 503 (class 1259 OID 124988)
-- Name: v_pr_po_receipt_cycle; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_pr_po_receipt_cycle WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH receipt_by_line AS (
         SELECT r_1.po_line_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS receipt_count,
            (sum(COALESCE(r_1.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS line_received_qty,
            max(r_1.receipt_date) AS latest_receipt_date,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('receiptId', (r_1.id)::text, 'poId', COALESCE((r_1.po_id)::text, ''::text), 'poNo', COALESCE(r_1.po_no, ''::text), 'poLineId', COALESCE((r_1.po_line_id)::text, ''::text), 'lineNo', COALESCE(r_1.line_no, 0), 'sourceType', COALESCE(r_1.source_type, ''::text), 'receiptDate', r_1.receipt_date, 'challanNo', COALESCE(r_1.challan_no, ''::text), 'qty', COALESCE(r_1.qty, (0)::numeric), 'rate', COALESCE(r_1.rate, (0)::numeric), 'remarks', COALESCE(r_1.remarks, ''::text), 'createdAt', r_1.created_at) ORDER BY r_1.receipt_date DESC, r_1.created_at DESC, r_1.id DESC) AS receipt_entries
           FROM public.purchase_po_receipts r_1
          GROUP BY r_1.po_line_id
        ), po_line_alloc AS (
         SELECT pol_1.id,
            pol_1.po_id,
            pol_1.po_no,
            pol_1.line_no,
            pol_1.source_type,
            pol_1.source_ref,
            pol_1.item_code,
            pol_1.item_name,
            pol_1.qty,
            pol_1.rate,
            pol_1.amount,
            pol_1.department,
            pol_1.job_ref,
            pol_1.remarks,
            pol_1.created_at,
            pol_1.tax_pct,
            pol_1.tax_amount,
            pol_1.total_amount,
            (COALESCE(rbl_1.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS line_received_qty,
            rbl_1.latest_receipt_date AS line_latest_receipt_date,
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(pol_1.remarks, ''::text) ~* '\[PO_SHORT_CLOSE'::text) THEN LEAST(GREATEST((COALESCE(pol_1.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rbl_1.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), COALESCE((NULLIF("substring"(COALESCE(pol_1.remarks, ''::text), '\[PO_SHORT_CLOSE[^\]]*qty=([0-9.]+)'::text), ''::text))::numeric, GREATEST((COALESCE(pol_1.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rbl_1.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END)::numeric(14,4) AS line_short_closed_qty
           FROM (public.purchase_order_lines pol_1
             LEFT JOIN receipt_by_line rbl_1 ON ((rbl_1.po_line_id = pol_1.id)))
        ), po_by_pr AS (
         SELECT pol_1.source_ref AS pr_no,
            (count(DISTINCT pol_1.po_id) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)))::integer AS po_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)))::integer AS po_line_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT pol_1.po_no, ', '::text ORDER BY pol_1.po_no) FILTER (WHERE ((COALESCE(pol_1.po_no, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))) AS po_refs,
            (sum(COALESCE(pol_1.qty, (0)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)))::numeric(14,4) AS total_ordered_qty,
            (sum(COALESCE(rbl_1.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)))::numeric(14,4) AS total_po_received_qty,
            (sum(COALESCE(pol_1.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)))::numeric(14,4) AS total_po_short_closed_qty,
            max(rbl_1.latest_receipt_date) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)) AS latest_po_receipt_date,
            (count(DISTINCT pol_1.po_id) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text)))::integer AS cancelled_po_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT pol_1.po_no, ', '::text ORDER BY pol_1.po_no) FILTER (WHERE ((COALESCE(pol_1.po_no, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text))) AS cancelled_po_refs
           FROM ((po_line_alloc pol_1
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po_1 ON ((po_1.id = pol_1.po_id)))
             LEFT JOIN receipt_by_line rbl_1 ON ((rbl_1.po_line_id = pol_1.id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(pol_1.source_type, ''::text)) = 'INVENTORY_PR'::text) AND (COALESCE(pol_1.source_ref, ''::text) <> ''::text))
          GROUP BY pol_1.source_ref
        ), direct_pr_receipts AS (
         SELECT l.ref_no AS pr_no,
            (count(*))::integer AS direct_receipt_count,
            (sum(COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS direct_received_qty,
            max(l.created_at) AS latest_direct_receipt_at
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(l.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'PR-RECEIPT'::text) AND (COALESCE(l.ref_no, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric))
          GROUP BY l.ref_no
        )
 SELECT (pr.id)::text AS pr_id,
    pr.pr_no,
    pr.created_at AS pr_created_at,
    pr.closed_at AS pr_closed_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text) THEN 'CANCELLED'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) THEN 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CLOSED'::text) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (GREATEST(COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(dpr.direct_received_qty, (0)::numeric))) >= COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric))) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pbp.total_po_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pbp.total_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)
        END AS pr_status,
    COALESCE(pr.item_code, i.item_code, ''::text) AS pr_item_code,
    COALESCE(pr.item_name, i.item_name, ''::text) AS pr_item_name,
    COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS item_category,
    COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS uom,
    COALESCE(pr.department, ''::text) AS pr_department,
    COALESCE(pr.job_ref, ''::text) AS pr_job_ref,
    COALESCE(pr.remarks, ''::text) AS pr_remarks,
    (COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_requested_qty,
    (GREATEST(COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(dpr.direct_received_qty, (0)::numeric))))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_received_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text])) THEN (0)::numeric(14,4)
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pbp.total_po_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pbp.total_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN (0)::numeric(14,4)
            ELSE (GREATEST((COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - GREATEST(COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(dpr.direct_received_qty, (0)::numeric)))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4)
        END AS pr_pending_receipt_qty,
    (COALESCE(pbp.total_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_ordered_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text])) THEN (0)::numeric(14,4)
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pbp.total_po_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pbp.total_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN (0)::numeric(14,4)
            ELSE (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - GREATEST(COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(dpr.direct_received_qty, (0)::numeric)))) - GREATEST(((COALESCE(pbp.total_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4)
        END AS pr_pending_to_order_qty,
    (COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_po_received_qty,
    (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pbp.total_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pbp.total_po_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_open_po_qty,
    (COALESCE(dpr.direct_received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_direct_received_qty,
    COALESCE(pbp.po_count, 0) AS pr_po_count,
    COALESCE(pbp.po_line_count, 0) AS pr_po_line_count,
    COALESCE(dpr.direct_receipt_count, 0) AS pr_direct_receipt_count,
    COALESCE(pbp.po_refs, ''::text) AS pr_po_refs,
    pbp.latest_po_receipt_date AS pr_latest_po_receipt_date,
    dpr.latest_direct_receipt_at AS pr_latest_direct_receipt_at,
    (po.id)::text AS po_id,
    po.po_no,
    po.order_date AS po_order_date,
    COALESCE(po.status, ''::text) AS po_status,
    (po.vendor_id)::text AS vendor_id,
    COALESCE(po.vendor_name, v.vendor_name, ''::text) AS vendor_name,
    COALESCE(v.vendor_code, ''::text) AS vendor_code,
    COALESCE(v.gstin, ''::text) AS vendor_gstin,
    COALESCE(po.payment_terms, ''::text) AS payment_terms,
    COALESCE(po.delivery_terms, ''::text) AS delivery_terms,
    COALESCE(po.freight_terms, ''::text) AS freight_terms,
    (COALESCE(po.freight_value, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS freight_value,
    COALESCE(po.created_by, ''::text) AS po_created_by,
    po.created_at AS po_created_at,
    po.updated_at AS po_updated_at,
    (pol.id)::text AS po_line_id,
    pol.line_no AS po_line_no,
    COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text) AS po_source_type,
    COALESCE(pol.source_ref, ''::text) AS po_source_ref,
    COALESCE(pol.item_code, ''::text) AS po_item_code,
    COALESCE(pol.item_name, ''::text) AS po_item_name,
    COALESCE(pol.department, ''::text) AS po_line_department,
    COALESCE(pol.job_ref, ''::text) AS po_line_job_ref,
    COALESCE(pol.remarks, ''::text) AS po_line_remarks,
    (COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS po_line_ordered_qty,
    (COALESCE(pol.rate, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS po_line_rate,
    (COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric))::numeric(8,2) AS po_line_tax_pct,
    (COALESCE(pol.amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS po_line_amount,
    (COALESCE(pol.tax_amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS po_line_tax_amount,
    (COALESCE(pol.total_amount, pol.amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS po_line_total_amount,
    (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS po_line_received_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text) THEN (0)::numeric(14,4)
            ELSE (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pol.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4)
        END AS po_line_pending_qty,
    (GREATEST((COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS po_line_over_received_qty,
    COALESCE(rbl.receipt_count, 0) AS po_line_receipt_count,
    rbl.latest_receipt_date AS po_line_latest_receipt_date,
    COALESCE(rbl.receipt_entries, '[]'::jsonb) AS po_line_receipt_entries,
    (r.id)::text AS receipt_id,
    r.receipt_date,
    r.created_at AS receipt_created_at,
    COALESCE(r.challan_no, ''::text) AS receipt_challan_no,
    (COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS receipt_qty,
    (COALESCE(r.rate, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS receipt_rate,
    ((COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(r.rate, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(18,2) AS receipt_value,
    COALESCE(r.remarks, ''::text) AS receipt_remarks,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text) THEN 'PR_CANCELLED'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) THEN 'PR_SHORT_CLOSED'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CLOSED'::text) THEN 'PR_CLOSED'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (pol.id IS NULL) AND (GREATEST(COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(dpr.direct_received_qty, (0)::numeric))) >= COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric))) THEN 'PR_DIRECT_RECEIVED'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text) THEN 'PO_CANCELLED'::text
            WHEN (pol.id IS NULL) THEN 'PR_PENDING_PO'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pol.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pol.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PO_SHORT_CLOSED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(pol.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PO_PARTIAL_SHORT_CLOSED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'PO_PENDING_RECEIPT'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) < COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PO_PARTIAL_RECEIPT'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) = COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PO_RECEIVED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) > COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PO_OVER_RECEIVED'::text
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'::text
        END AS cycle_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text) THEN 8
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text])) THEN 4
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (pol.id IS NULL) AND (GREATEST(COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(pbp.total_po_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(dpr.direct_received_qty, (0)::numeric))) >= COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric))) THEN 4
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text) THEN 8
            WHEN (pol.id IS NULL) THEN 1
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pol.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pol.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 4
            WHEN (COALESCE(pol.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN 3
            WHEN (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) THEN 2
            WHEN (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) < COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)) THEN 3
            WHEN (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) = COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)) THEN 4
            WHEN (COALESCE(rbl.line_received_qty, (0)::numeric) > COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)) THEN 5
            ELSE 9
        END AS cycle_status_rank,
    (COALESCE(pol.line_short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS po_line_short_closed_qty
   FROM ((((((((public.inv_purchase_requests pr
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = pr.item_id)))
     LEFT JOIN po_by_pr pbp ON ((pbp.pr_no = pr.pr_no)))
     LEFT JOIN direct_pr_receipts dpr ON ((dpr.pr_no = pr.pr_no)))
     LEFT JOIN po_line_alloc pol ON (((upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = 'INVENTORY_PR'::text) AND (pol.source_ref = pr.pr_no))))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON ((po.id = pol.po_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_vendors v ON ((v.id = po.vendor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN receipt_by_line rbl ON ((rbl.po_line_id = pol.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_po_receipts r ON ((r.po_line_id = pol.id)));


--
-- TOC entry 7652 (class 0 OID 0)
-- Dependencies: 503
-- Name: VIEW v_pr_po_receipt_cycle; Type: COMMENT; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

COMMENT ON VIEW public.v_pr_po_receipt_cycle IS 'End-to-end inventory purchase traceability from PR to PO line to PO receipt, preserving PRs without PO and PO lines without receipt.';


--
-- TOC entry 593 (class 1259 OID 184867)
-- Name: v_material_indent_line_status; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_material_indent_line_status WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH link_by_line AS (
         SELECT l_1.indent_line_id,
            (sum(COALESCE(l_1.pr_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS linked_pr_qty,
            string_agg(DISTINCT l_1.pr_no, ', '::text ORDER BY l_1.pr_no) AS linked_pr_nos
           FROM public.material_indent_pr_links l_1
          GROUP BY l_1.indent_line_id
        ), pr_cycle_distinct AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT c.pr_no,
            c.pr_status,
            c.pr_requested_qty,
            c.pr_received_qty,
            c.pr_pending_receipt_qty,
            c.pr_po_refs,
            c.pr_latest_po_receipt_date
           FROM public.v_pr_po_receipt_cycle c
          WHERE (COALESCE(c.pr_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)
        ), pr_cycle_by_link AS (
         SELECT l_1.indent_line_id,
            (sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.pr_requested_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN LEAST(COALESCE(l_1.pr_qty, (0)::numeric), ((COALESCE(c.pr_received_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l_1.pr_qty, (0)::numeric)) / c.pr_requested_qty))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_received_qty,
            (sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.pr_requested_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN GREATEST((COALESCE(l_1.pr_qty, (0)::numeric) - LEAST(COALESCE(l_1.pr_qty, (0)::numeric), ((COALESCE(c.pr_received_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l_1.pr_qty, (0)::numeric)) / c.pr_requested_qty))), (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE COALESCE(l_1.pr_qty, (0)::numeric)
                END))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_pending_receipt_qty,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(c.pr_po_refs, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(c.pr_po_refs, ''::text)) AS po_refs,
            max(c.pr_latest_po_receipt_date) AS latest_receipt_date,
            string_agg(DISTINCT c.pr_status, ', '::text ORDER BY c.pr_status) AS pr_cycle_statuses
           FROM (public.material_indent_pr_links l_1
             LEFT JOIN pr_cycle_distinct c ON ((c.pr_no = l_1.pr_no)))
          GROUP BY l_1.indent_line_id
        ), stock_by_item AS (
         SELECT s.item_id,
            (sum(COALESCE(s.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS current_stock_qty
           FROM public.inv_stock_mv s
          GROUP BY s.item_id
        )
 SELECT (h.id)::text AS indent_id,
    h.indent_no,
    h.requester_user_id,
    h.requester_name,
    h.requester_email,
    h.department AS indent_department,
    h.required_date,
    h.purpose,
    h.remarks AS indent_remarks,
    h.status AS indent_status,
    h.created_at AS indent_created_at,
    h.updated_at AS indent_updated_at,
    (l.id)::text AS indent_line_id,
    l.line_no,
    (l.item_id)::text AS item_id,
    l.item_code,
    l.item_name,
    l.uom,
    (COALESCE(l.requested_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS requested_qty,
    (COALESCE(l.stock_available_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS stock_available_qty,
    (GREATEST((COALESCE(l.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(l.stock_available_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS shortage_qty,
    (COALESCE(lb.linked_pr_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS linked_pr_qty,
    (GREATEST(((COALESCE(l.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(l.stock_available_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(lb.linked_pr_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pending_pr_qty,
    (COALESCE(st.current_stock_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS current_stock_qty,
    COALESCE(l.stock_status, 'PENDING_REVIEW'::text) AS stock_status,
    COALESCE(l.pr_status, 'NOT_RELEASED'::text) AS pr_status,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'SUBMITTED'::text) AS line_status,
    COALESCE(l.job_ref, ''::text) AS job_ref,
    COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text) AS line_remarks,
    COALESCE(l.stores_remarks, ''::text) AS stores_remarks,
    COALESCE(lb.linked_pr_nos, ''::text) AS linked_pr_nos,
    COALESCE(pc.po_refs, ''::text) AS po_refs,
    (COALESCE(pc.pr_received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_received_qty,
    (COALESCE(pc.pr_pending_receipt_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pr_pending_receipt_qty,
    pc.latest_receipt_date,
    COALESCE(pc.pr_cycle_statuses, ''::text) AS pr_cycle_statuses,
        CASE
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(h.status, ''::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(l.status, ''::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text)) THEN 'CANCELLED'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(l.status, ''::text)) = 'REJECTED'::text) THEN 'REJECTED'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(pc.pr_received_qty, (0)::numeric) >= GREATEST((COALESCE(l.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(l.stock_available_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) AND (GREATEST((COALESCE(l.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(l.stock_available_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'RECEIVED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(pc.pr_received_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(lb.linked_pr_qty, (0)::numeric) >= GREATEST((COALESCE(l.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(l.stock_available_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) AND (GREATEST((COALESCE(l.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(l.stock_available_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PR_RELEASED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(lb.linked_pr_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PARTIAL_PR_RELEASED'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(l.stock_status, ''::text)) = 'STOCK_AVAILABLE'::text) THEN 'STOCK_AVAILABLE'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(l.stock_status, ''::text)) = 'PARTIAL_STOCK_AVAILABLE'::text) THEN 'PARTIAL_STOCK_AVAILABLE'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(l.stock_status, ''::text)) = 'NOT_AVAILABLE'::text) THEN 'NOT_AVAILABLE'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING_REVIEW'::text
        END AS lifecycle_status
   FROM ((((public.material_indents h
     JOIN public.material_indent_lines l ON ((l.indent_id = h.id)))
     LEFT JOIN link_by_line lb ON ((lb.indent_line_id = l.id)))
     LEFT JOIN pr_cycle_by_link pc ON ((pc.indent_line_id = l.id)))
     LEFT JOIN stock_by_item st ON ((st.item_id = l.item_id)));

CREATE VIEW public.v_npd_request_register AS
 SELECT r.id,
    r.sampling_id,
    r.status,
    r.current_version_no,
    r.current_version_id,
    r.client_id,
    r.client_code,
    r.client_name,
    r.manual_client_name,
    r.job_ref,
    r.sales_user_id,
    r.sample_required,
    r.sample_qty,
    r.latest_customer_result,
    v.product_dimension_uom,
    v.product_length,
    v.product_width,
    v.product_height,
    v.sheet_size_uom,
    v.sheet_length,
    v.sheet_width,
    v.ups,
    v.ply,
    v.printing_colors,
    v.printing_type,
    v.job_type,
    v.binding_type,
    c.costing_no,
    c.unit_rate,
    c.total_estimated_value,
    swo.sample_wo_no,
    swo.status AS sample_wo_status,
    ver.result AS verification_result,
    cs.customer_result,
    r.created_at,
    r.created_by,
    r.updated_at,
    r.updated_by
   FROM (((((public.npd_requests r
     LEFT JOIN public.npd_request_versions v ON ((v.id = r.current_version_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ce.id,
            ce.request_id,
            ce.version_id,
            ce.status,
            ce.costing_no,
            ce.raw_material_value,
            ce.process_value,
            ce.tooling_value,
            ce.sample_cost,
            ce.unit_rate,
            ce.total_estimated_value,
            ce.remarks,
            ce.calc_json,
            ce.submitted_at,
            ce.submitted_by,
            ce.approved_at,
            ce.approved_by,
            ce.created_at,
            ce.created_by,
            ce.updated_at,
            ce.updated_by
           FROM public.npd_costing_evaluations ce
          WHERE (ce.version_id = r.current_version_id)
          ORDER BY ce.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) c ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT wo.id,
            wo.request_id,
            wo.version_id,
            wo.sample_wo_no,
            wo.status,
            wo.planned_sample_qty,
            wo.produced_qty,
            wo.accepted_qty,
            wo.rejected_qty,
            wo.process_plan_json,
            wo.released_at,
            wo.released_by,
            wo.linked_wo_id,
            wo.created_at,
            wo.created_by,
            wo.updated_at,
            wo.updated_by
           FROM public.npd_sample_work_orders wo
          WHERE (wo.version_id = r.current_version_id)
          ORDER BY wo.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) swo ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sv.id,
            sv.request_id,
            sv.version_id,
            sv.sample_wo_id,
            sv.required_specs_json,
            sv.actual_specs_json,
            sv.result,
            sv.checked_qty,
            sv.accepted_qty,
            sv.rejected_qty,
            sv.remarks,
            sv.verified_at,
            sv.verified_by,
            sv.created_at,
            sv.created_by
           FROM public.npd_sample_verifications sv
          WHERE (sv.version_id = r.current_version_id)
          ORDER BY sv.verified_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) ver ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sub.id,
            sub.request_id,
            sub.version_id,
            sub.submitted_qty,
            sub.submitted_at,
            sub.submitted_by,
            sub.customer_result,
            sub.feedback,
            sub.resubmission_required,
            sub.next_version_id,
            sub.created_at,
            sub.created_by
           FROM public.npd_customer_submissions sub
          WHERE (sub.version_id = r.current_version_id)
          ORDER BY sub.submitted_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) cs ON (true));

-- TOC entry 560 (class 1259 OID 162961)
-- Name: v_npd_dashboard_summary; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_npd_dashboard_summary AS
 SELECT (count(*))::integer AS total_requests,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status <> ALL (ARRAY['CUSTOMER_APPROVED'::text, 'CLOSED_NO_SAMPLE'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text]))))::integer AS open_requests,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['SUBMITTED_BY_SALES'::text, 'COSTING_IN_PROGRESS'::text]))))::integer AS costing_pending,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((sample_required = true) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['COSTING_SUBMITTED'::text, 'SAMPLE_PLANNING'::text, 'SAMPLE_WO_RELEASED'::text, 'SAMPLE_PRODUCED'::text])))))::integer AS sample_pending,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'SAMPLE_VERIFIED'::text)))::integer AS verified_pending_customer,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'SUBMITTED_TO_CUSTOMER'::text)))::integer AS customer_decision_pending,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'CUSTOMER_APPROVED'::text)))::integer AS customer_approved,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['CUSTOMER_REJECTED'::text, 'RESUBMISSION_REQUIRED'::text]))))::integer AS rework_required,
    (COALESCE(round(avg((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (updated_at - created_at)) / 86400.0)), 2), (0)::numeric))::numeric(12,2) AS avg_age_days
   FROM public.v_npd_request_register;

-- TOC entry 420 (class 1259 OID 60574)
-- Name: v_packing_board; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_packing_board WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH prod AS (
         SELECT pe.wo_id,
            pe.routing_id,
            pe.produced_qty,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pe.wo_id ORDER BY pe.created_at DESC) AS rn
           FROM public.production_entries pe
        ), pack AS (
         SELECT packing_records.so_number,
            packing_records.line_no,
            sum(packing_records.packed_qty) AS packed_qty
           FROM public.packing_records
          GROUP BY packing_records.so_number, packing_records.line_no
        )
 SELECT woj.wo_id,
    woj.so_number,
    woj.line_no,
    woj.product_name,
    woj.client_name,
    woj.artwork_no,
    woj.qty AS order_qty,
    COALESCE(prod.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS produced_qty,
    COALESCE(pack.packed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS packed_qty,
    (COALESCE(prod.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pack.packed_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS balance_qty
   FROM ((public.work_order_jobs woj
     LEFT JOIN prod ON (((prod.wo_id = woj.wo_id) AND (prod.rn = 1))))
     LEFT JOIN pack ON (((pack.so_number = woj.so_number) AND (pack.line_no = woj.line_no))))
  WHERE (COALESCE(prod.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) > COALESCE(pack.packed_qty, (0)::numeric));


--
-- TOC entry 647 (class 1259 OID 223836)
-- Name: v_packing_box_cost_by_entry; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_packing_box_cost_by_entry AS
 SELECT pel.id AS packing_entry_id,
    pel.pack_id,
    pel.so_id,
    pel.so_line_id,
    pel.so_number,
    pel.line_no,
    pel.product_code,
    pel.product_name,
    pel.packed_qty,
    pel.posted_at,
    pel.posted_by,
    COALESCE(sum(pebu.box_count), (0)::bigint) AS box_count,
    COALESCE(sum(pebu.total_cost), (0)::numeric) AS packing_box_cost,
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('boxMasterId', pebu.box_master_id, 'boxCode', pebu.box_code_snapshot, 'boxName', pebu.box_name_snapshot, 'size', concat_ws(' x '::text, pebu.length_mm_snapshot, pebu.width_mm_snapshot, pebu.height_mm_snapshot), 'boxCount', pebu.box_count, 'ratePerBox', pebu.rate_per_box_snapshot, 'totalCost', pebu.total_cost) ORDER BY pebu.box_code_snapshot) FILTER (WHERE (pebu.id IS NOT NULL)), '[]'::jsonb) AS box_usage
   FROM (public.packing_entry_log pel
     LEFT JOIN public.packing_entry_box_usage pebu ON ((pebu.packing_entry_id = pel.id)))
  GROUP BY pel.id, pel.pack_id, pel.so_id, pel.so_line_id, pel.so_number, pel.line_no, pel.product_code, pel.product_name, pel.packed_qty, pel.posted_at, pel.posted_by;

--
-- TOC entry 631 (class 1259 OID 219723)
-- Name: v_packing_queue_finished_v2; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_packing_queue_finished_v2 AS
 WITH artwork_category AS (
         SELECT a.artwork_no,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS department_category
           FROM public.artworks a
          WHERE (COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY a.artwork_no
        ), job_lines AS (
         SELECT woj.wo_id,
            wo.wo_number,
            wo.wo_date,
            wo.snapshot_json,
            woj.so_number,
            woj.line_no,
            sum(GREATEST(COALESCE(woj.qty, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric)) AS job_qty,
            max(NULLIF(woj.artwork_no, ''::text)) AS artwork_no,
            max(NULLIF(woj.client_name, ''::text)) AS client_name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(max(COALESCE(woj.ups, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS job_ups,
            string_agg(DISTINCT woj.product_name, ' / '::text ORDER BY woj.product_name) AS product_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(max(ac.department_category),
                    CASE
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                        WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                        ELSE max(woj.category)
                    END)
                END AS department_category,
            COALESCE((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'flexoDetails'::text) ->> 'repeatMm'::text), ''::text))::numeric, ((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'flexoDetails'::text) ->> 'cylinderTeeth'::text), ''::text))::numeric * 3.175), ((NULLIF(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'artworkRef'::text) ->> 'teeth'::text), ''::text))::numeric * 3.175), (0)::numeric) AS repeat_mm
           FROM ((public.work_order_jobs woj
             JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
             LEFT JOIN artwork_category ac ON ((ac.artwork_no = woj.artwork_no)))
          GROUP BY woj.wo_id, wo.wo_number, wo.wo_date, wo.snapshot_json, woj.so_number, woj.line_no
        ), job_stats AS (
         SELECT jl.wo_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS job_line_count,
            sum(jl.job_qty) AS wo_order_qty
           FROM job_lines jl
          GROUP BY jl.wo_id
        ), final_production_routing AS (
         SELECT r.wo_id,
            r.id AS routing_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), ''::text) AS process_name,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.wo_id ORDER BY r.sequence_no DESC, r.id DESC) AS rn
           FROM public.work_order_routing r
          WHERE (upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), ''::text))) <> ALL (ARRAY['PACKING'::text, 'DISPATCH'::text, 'CUTTING PRE'::text, 'CUTTING POST'::text, 'QC'::text]))
        ), production_line_totals AS (
         SELECT pe.routing_id,
            pe.so_number,
            pe.line_no,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS produced_qty
           FROM public.production_entries pe
          WHERE ((COALESCE(pe.so_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(pe.line_no, ''::text) <> ''::text))
          GROUP BY pe.routing_id, pe.so_number, pe.line_no
        ), production_identity_stats AS (
         SELECT plt.routing_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS identified_line_count
           FROM production_line_totals plt
          GROUP BY plt.routing_id
        ), production_totals AS (
         SELECT pe.routing_id,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS produced_qty
           FROM public.production_entries pe
          GROUP BY pe.routing_id
        ), packing_totals AS (
         SELECT pr.so_line_id,
            pr.so_number,
            pr.line_no,
            (array_agg(pr.id ORDER BY pr.packed_at DESC NULLS LAST, pr.id))[1] AS pack_id,
            sum(COALESCE(pr.packed_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS packed_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(pr.packed_weight_kg, (0)::numeric)) AS packed_weight_kg,
            bool_or((pr.ready_to_dispatch = true)) AS ready_to_dispatch
           FROM public.packing_records pr
          GROUP BY pr.so_line_id, pr.so_number, pr.line_no
        ), quantity_basis AS (
         SELECT jl.wo_id,
            jl.wo_number,
            jl.wo_date,
            jl.snapshot_json,
            jl.so_number,
            jl.line_no,
            jl.job_qty,
            jl.artwork_no,
            jl.client_name,
            jl.job_ups,
            jl.product_name,
            jl.department_category,
            jl.repeat_mm,
            js.job_line_count,
            js.wo_order_qty,
            fr.routing_id,
            fr.process_name AS source_process_name,
            COALESCE(plt.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS line_source_qty,
            COALESCE(prod.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS combined_source_qty,
            COALESCE(pis.identified_line_count, 0) AS identified_line_count,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(jl.department_category, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) THEN 'RM'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%PRINT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%COAT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE CUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIECUT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE SHEET%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%2 PLY%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%TWO PLY%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%PLY MAKING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.process_name, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHEET PASTING%'::text)) THEN 'SHEETS'::text
                    ELSE 'PCS'::text
                END AS source_uom
           FROM (((((job_lines jl
             JOIN job_stats js ON ((js.wo_id = jl.wo_id)))
             LEFT JOIN final_production_routing fr ON (((fr.wo_id = jl.wo_id) AND (fr.rn = 1))))
             LEFT JOIN production_line_totals plt ON (((plt.routing_id = fr.routing_id) AND (plt.so_number = jl.so_number) AND (plt.line_no = (jl.line_no)::text))))
             LEFT JOIN production_identity_stats pis ON ((pis.routing_id = fr.routing_id)))
             LEFT JOIN production_totals prod ON ((prod.routing_id = fr.routing_id)))
        ), quantity_source AS (
         SELECT qb.wo_id,
            qb.wo_number,
            qb.wo_date,
            qb.snapshot_json,
            qb.so_number,
            qb.line_no,
            qb.job_qty,
            qb.artwork_no,
            qb.client_name,
            qb.job_ups,
            qb.product_name,
            qb.department_category,
            qb.repeat_mm,
            qb.job_line_count,
            qb.wo_order_qty,
            qb.routing_id,
            qb.source_process_name,
            qb.line_source_qty,
            qb.combined_source_qty,
            qb.identified_line_count,
            qb.source_uom,
                CASE
                    WHEN (qb.identified_line_count > 0) THEN qb.line_source_qty
                    WHEN (qb.source_uom = 'SHEETS'::text) THEN qb.combined_source_qty
                    WHEN (qb.job_line_count <= 1) THEN qb.combined_source_qty
                    WHEN (qb.wo_order_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN floor(((qb.combined_source_qty * qb.job_qty) / qb.wo_order_qty))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS source_produced_qty
           FROM quantity_basis qb
        ), quantity_converted AS (
         SELECT qs.wo_id,
            qs.wo_number,
            qs.wo_date,
            qs.snapshot_json,
            qs.so_number,
            qs.line_no,
            qs.job_qty,
            qs.artwork_no,
            qs.client_name,
            qs.job_ups,
            qs.product_name,
            qs.department_category,
            qs.repeat_mm,
            qs.job_line_count,
            qs.wo_order_qty,
            qs.routing_id,
            qs.source_process_name,
            qs.line_source_qty,
            qs.combined_source_qty,
            qs.identified_line_count,
            qs.source_uom,
            qs.source_produced_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN (qs.source_uom = 'RM'::text) THEN 'RM_TO_PCS'::text
                    WHEN (qs.source_uom = 'SHEETS'::text) THEN 'SHEETS_TO_PCS'::text
                    ELSE 'DIRECT_PCS'::text
                END AS conversion_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((qs.source_uom = 'RM'::text) AND (qs.job_ups > (0)::numeric) AND (qs.repeat_mm > (0)::numeric)) THEN ((qs.job_ups * (1000)::numeric) / qs.repeat_mm)
                    WHEN ((qs.source_uom = 'SHEETS'::text) AND (qs.job_ups > (0)::numeric)) THEN qs.job_ups
                    WHEN (qs.source_uom = 'PCS'::text) THEN (1)::numeric
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS conversion_factor,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((qs.source_uom = 'RM'::text) AND (NOT ((qs.job_ups > (0)::numeric) AND (qs.repeat_mm > (0)::numeric)))) THEN 'MISSING_FLEXO_UPS_OR_REPEAT'::text
                    WHEN ((qs.source_uom = 'SHEETS'::text) AND (NOT (qs.job_ups > (0)::numeric))) THEN 'MISSING_JOB_UPS'::text
                    ELSE 'OK'::text
                END AS conversion_status
           FROM quantity_source qs
        )
 SELECT pt.pack_id,
    so.id AS so_id,
    sol.id AS so_line_id,
    qc.so_number,
    qc.line_no,
    sol.product_code,
    COALESCE(sol.product_name, qc.product_name) AS product_name,
    qc.client_name,
    COALESCE(sol.category, qc.department_category) AS category,
    qc.department_category,
    COALESCE(sol.qty, qc.job_qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (qc.conversion_status = 'OK'::text) THEN floor((qc.source_produced_qty * qc.conversion_factor))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS produced_qty,
    COALESCE(pt.packed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS packed_qty,
    COALESCE(pt.ready_to_dispatch, false) AS ready_to_dispatch,
    sol.expected_delivery,
    sol.final_delivery,
    sol.division,
    sol.quote_no,
    sol.pm_code,
    sol.product_remarks,
    sol.prepress_remarks,
    so.remarks AS so_remarks,
    qc.artwork_no,
    qc.wo_number,
    qc.wo_date,
    COALESCE((qc.snapshot_json ->> 'modeOfTransport'::text), ''::text) AS transport_mode,
    COALESCE(pt.packed_weight_kg, (0)::numeric) AS packed_weight_kg,
    qc.source_produced_qty,
    qc.source_uom,
    qc.conversion_type,
    qc.conversion_factor,
    qc.conversion_status,
    qc.source_process_name
   FROM (((quantity_converted qc
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.so_number = qc.so_number)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = so.id) AND ((sol.line_no)::text = (qc.line_no)::text))))
     LEFT JOIN packing_totals pt ON (((pt.so_line_id = sol.id) OR ((pt.so_line_id IS NULL) AND (pt.so_number = qc.so_number) AND ((pt.line_no)::text = (qc.line_no)::text)))));

-- TOC entry 632 (class 1259 OID 219728)
-- Name: v_packing_quantity_conversion_audit_v2; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE VIEW public.v_packing_quantity_conversion_audit_v2 AS
 SELECT corrected.wo_number,
    corrected.so_number,
    corrected.line_no,
    corrected.department_category,
    corrected.source_process_name,
    corrected.source_produced_qty,
    corrected.source_uom,
    corrected.conversion_type,
    corrected.conversion_factor,
    corrected.conversion_status,
    COALESCE(legacy.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS legacy_produced_qty,
    corrected.produced_qty AS corrected_produced_qty,
    (corrected.produced_qty - COALESCE(legacy.produced_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS quantity_difference
   FROM (public.v_packing_queue_finished_v2 corrected
     LEFT JOIN public.v_packing_queue_fast legacy ON (((legacy.so_line_id = corrected.so_line_id) OR ((legacy.so_line_id IS NULL) AND (legacy.so_number = corrected.so_number) AND ((legacy.line_no)::text = (corrected.line_no)::text)))));

--
-- TOC entry 461 (class 1259 OID 103606)
-- Name: v_production_jobcard_lookup_fast; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_production_jobcard_lookup_fast WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH artwork_category AS (
         SELECT a.artwork_no,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS department_category
           FROM public.artworks a
          WHERE (COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY a.artwork_no
        )
 SELECT woj.wo_id,
    wo.wo_number,
    wo.wo_date,
    string_agg(DISTINCT woj.artwork_no, ', '::text ORDER BY woj.artwork_no) AS artwork_nos,
    max(NULLIF(woj.client_name, ''::text)) AS client_name,
    string_agg(DISTINCT woj.product_name, ' / '::text ORDER BY woj.product_name) AS product_names,
    string_agg(DISTINCT woj.so_number, ', '::text ORDER BY woj.so_number) AS so_numbers,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(max(ac.department_category),
            CASE
                WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                WHEN (upper(COALESCE(((wo.snapshot_json -> 'jobDetails'::text) ->> 'type'::text), ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                WHEN (upper(COALESCE(max(woj.category), ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                ELSE NULL::text
            END)
        END AS department_category
   FROM ((public.work_order_jobs woj
     JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
     LEFT JOIN artwork_category ac ON ((ac.artwork_no = woj.artwork_no)))
  GROUP BY woj.wo_id, wo.wo_number, wo.wo_date, wo.snapshot_json;

-- TOC entry 609 (class 1259 OID 209924)
-- Name: v_production_summary_fast; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_production_summary_fast AS
 SELECT wo_date,
    department_category,
    process_display_name,
    status,
    count(*) AS total_rows,
    sum(COALESCE(balance_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS pending_qty,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(status, ''::text)) = 'IN_PROGRESS'::text) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS in_progress_rows,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(status, ''::text)) = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS short_closed_rows
   FROM public.v_production_stage_rows_fast
  GROUP BY wo_date, department_category, process_display_name, status;
