-- TOC entry 494 (class 1259 OID 122634)
-- Name: v_purchase_order_summary; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_order_summary AS
 WITH receipt_by_line AS (
         SELECT r.po_line_id,
            (sum(COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty
           FROM public.purchase_po_receipts r
          GROUP BY r.po_line_id
        ), line_stats AS (
         SELECT (pol.po_id)::text AS po_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS line_count,
            (sum(COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS total_qty,
            (sum(COALESCE(rb.received_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
            (sum(GREATEST((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rb.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS pending_qty,
            bool_or((upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text]))) AS has_artwork,
            bool_or((upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text]))) AS has_plate,
            bool_or((upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text]))) AS has_die
           FROM (public.purchase_order_lines pol
             LEFT JOIN receipt_by_line rb ON ((rb.po_line_id = pol.id)))
          GROUP BY (pol.po_id)::text
        )
 SELECT (po.id)::text AS po_id,
    po.po_no,
    po.order_date,
    (po.vendor_id)::text AS vendor_id,
    COALESCE(po.vendor_name, ''::text) AS vendor_name,
    COALESCE(v.gstin, ''::text) AS vendor_gstin,
    COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS status,
    COALESCE(ls.line_count, 0) AS line_count,
    (COALESCE(ls.total_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS total_qty,
    (COALESCE(ls.received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
    (COALESCE(ls.pending_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pending_qty,
    (COALESCE(po.basic_total, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS basic_total,
    (COALESCE(po.tax_total, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_total,
    (COALESCE(po.total_value, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS total_value,
    COALESCE(po.created_by, ''::text) AS created_by,
    COALESCE(po.payment_terms, ''::text) AS payment_terms,
    COALESCE(po.freight_terms, ''::text) AS freight_terms,
    (COALESCE(po.freight_value, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS freight_value,
    COALESCE(po.delivery_terms, ''::text) AS delivery_terms,
    COALESCE(po.notes, ''::text) AS notes,
    po.created_at,
    po.updated_at,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(ls.has_artwork, false) THEN 'ARTWORK_PROCUREMENT'::text
            ELSE 'INVENTORY_PROCUREMENT'::text
        END AS workflow,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(ls.has_plate, false) AND COALESCE(ls.has_die, false)) THEN 'MIXED'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(ls.has_die, false) THEN 'DIE'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(ls.has_plate, false) THEN 'PLATE'::text
            ELSE 'INVENTORY'::text
        END AS artwork_type
   FROM ((public.purchase_orders po
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_vendors v ON ((v.id = po.vendor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN line_stats ls ON ((ls.po_id = (po.id)::text)));


--
-- TOC entry 427 (class 1259 OID 71501)
-- Name: v_purchase_requests_open; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_requests_open AS
 WITH receipt_by_line AS (
         SELECT v_purchase_po_active_receipts.po_line_id,
            (sum(COALESCE(v_purchase_po_active_receipts.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty
           FROM public.v_purchase_po_active_receipts
          GROUP BY v_purchase_po_active_receipts.po_line_id
        ), po_line_alloc AS (
         SELECT pol.id,
            pol.po_id,
            pol.po_no,
            pol.line_no,
            pol.source_type,
            pol.source_ref,
            pol.item_code,
            pol.item_name,
            pol.qty,
            pol.rate,
            pol.amount,
            pol.department,
            pol.job_ref,
            pol.remarks,
            pol.created_at,
            pol.tax_pct,
            pol.tax_amount,
            pol.total_amount,
            (COALESCE(r.received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(pol.remarks, ''::text) ~* '\[PO_SHORT_CLOSE'::text) THEN LEAST(GREATEST((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(r.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), COALESCE((NULLIF("substring"(COALESCE(pol.remarks, ''::text), '\[PO_SHORT_CLOSE[^\]]*qty=([0-9.]+)'::text), ''::text))::numeric, GREATEST((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(r.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END)::numeric(14,4) AS short_closed_qty
           FROM (public.purchase_order_lines pol
             LEFT JOIN receipt_by_line r ON ((r.po_line_id = (pol.id)::text)))
        ), po_alloc_base AS (
         SELECT pol.source_ref AS pr_no,
            (sum(COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS ordered_qty,
            (sum(COALESCE(pol.short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS short_closed_qty,
            (sum(GREATEST(((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pol.received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(pol.short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS open_po_qty,
            (max(pol.rate))::numeric(18,2) AS po_rate,
            (max(pol.tax_pct))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_pct,
            min(po_1.order_date) AS first_po_date,
            max(po_1.order_date) AS latest_po_date,
            string_agg(DISTINCT pol.po_no, ', '::text ORDER BY pol.po_no) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(pol.po_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS po_refs
           FROM (po_line_alloc pol
             JOIN public.purchase_orders po_1 ON ((po_1.id = pol.po_id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = 'INVENTORY_PR'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(po_1.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
          GROUP BY pol.source_ref
        )
 SELECT pr.pr_no,
    pr.created_at,
    COALESCE(pr.item_code, ''::text) AS item_code,
    COALESCE(pr.item_name, ''::text) AS item_name,
    (COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS requested_qty,
    (COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
    COALESCE(pr.department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(pr.job_ref, ''::text) AS job_ref,
    COALESCE(pr.remarks, ''::text) AS remarks,
    COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS status,
    COALESCE(po.ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) AS pending_qty,
    (COALESCE(po.open_po_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS open_po_qty,
    (COALESCE(po.po_rate, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS po_rate,
    (COALESCE(po.tax_pct, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_pct,
    (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pr.requested_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pr.received_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(po.open_po_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS available_to_order_qty,
    COALESCE(po.po_refs, ''::text) AS po_refs,
    (COALESCE(po.short_closed_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS short_closed_qty
   FROM (public.inv_purchase_requests pr
     LEFT JOIN po_alloc_base po ON ((po.pr_no = pr.pr_no)))
  WHERE (upper(COALESCE(pr.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CLOSED'::text);


--
-- TOC entry 495 (class 1259 OID 122639)
-- Name: v_purchase_dashboard_core_metrics; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_dashboard_core_metrics AS
 SELECT (COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.v_purchase_requests_open r
          WHERE (COALESCE(r.available_to_order_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)), (0)::bigint))::integer AS pending_req_count,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(COALESCE(r.available_to_order_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS sum
           FROM public.v_purchase_requests_open r
          WHERE (COALESCE(r.available_to_order_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pending_req_qty,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.v_purchase_order_summary s
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(s.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text]))), (0)::bigint))::integer AS open_po_count,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(COALESCE(s.pending_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS sum
           FROM public.v_purchase_order_summary s
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(s.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text]))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS open_po_pending_qty,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(COALESCE(s.total_value, (0)::numeric)) AS sum
           FROM public.v_purchase_order_summary s), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS total_po_value,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(COALESCE(s.total_value, (0)::numeric)) AS sum
           FROM public.v_purchase_order_summary s
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(s.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text]))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS open_po_value,
    (COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.purchase_vendors v
          WHERE COALESCE(v.is_active, true)), (0)::bigint))::integer AS active_vendors;

--
-- TOC entry 489 (class 1259 OID 121857)
-- Name: v_purchase_orders_read_model; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_orders_read_model AS
 WITH receipt_source AS (
         SELECT (r.po_line_id)::text AS po_line_id,
            (COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS qty,
            r.receipt_date,
            r.created_at,
            (r.id)::text AS receipt_id,
            jsonb_build_object('id', (r.id)::text, 'poId', COALESCE((r.po_id)::text, ''::text), 'poNo', COALESCE(r.po_no, ''::text), 'poLineId', COALESCE((r.po_line_id)::text, ''::text), 'lineNo', COALESCE(r.line_no, 0), 'sourceType', COALESCE(r.source_type, ''::text), 'receiptDate', r.receipt_date, 'challanNo', COALESCE(r.challan_no, ''::text), 'qty', COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric), 'rate', COALESCE(r.rate, (0)::numeric), 'remarks', COALESCE(r.remarks, ''::text), 'createdAt', r.created_at) AS entry
           FROM (public.purchase_po_receipts r
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_order_lines pol_1 ON ((pol_1.id = r.po_line_id)))
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(pol_1.source_type, r.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text]))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ar.po_line_id,
            (COALESCE(ar.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS qty,
            ar.receipt_date,
            ar.created_at,
            ar.receipt_id,
            jsonb_build_object('id', ar.receipt_id, 'poId', '', 'poNo', COALESCE(ar.po_no, ''::text), 'poLineId', COALESCE(ar.po_line_id, ''::text), 'lineNo', 0, 'sourceType', 'INVENTORY_PR', 'receiptDate', ar.receipt_date, 'challanNo', '', 'qty', COALESCE(ar.qty, (0)::numeric), 'rate', COALESCE(ar.rate, (0)::numeric), 'remarks', COALESCE(ar.remarks, ''::text), 'createdAt', ar.created_at) AS entry
           FROM public.v_purchase_po_active_receipts ar
          WHERE (COALESCE(ar.po_line_id, ''::text) <> ''::text)
        ), receipt_by_line AS (
         SELECT receipt_source.po_line_id,
            (sum(receipt_source.qty))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
            max(receipt_source.receipt_date) AS latest_receipt_date,
            jsonb_agg(receipt_source.entry ORDER BY receipt_source.receipt_date DESC, receipt_source.created_at DESC, receipt_source.receipt_id DESC) AS receipt_entries
           FROM receipt_source
          GROUP BY receipt_source.po_line_id
        )
 SELECT (po.id)::text AS po_id,
    po.po_no,
    po.order_date,
    (po.vendor_id)::text AS vendor_id,
    po.vendor_name,
    COALESCE(v.gstin, ''::text) AS vendor_gstin,
    po.vendor_email,
    po.vendor_phone,
    po.vendor_address,
    po.payment_terms,
    po.freight_terms,
    (COALESCE(po.freight_value, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS freight_value,
    po.delivery_terms,
    po.notes,
    po.status,
    (COALESCE(po.total_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS total_qty,
    (COALESCE(po.basic_total, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS basic_total,
    (COALESCE(po.tax_total, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_total,
    (COALESCE(po.total_value, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS total_value,
    po.created_by,
    po.created_at,
    po.updated_at,
    (pol.id)::text AS line_id,
    pol.line_no,
    pol.source_type,
    pol.source_ref,
    pol.item_code,
    pol.item_name,
    (COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS qty,
    (COALESCE(pol.rate, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS rate,
    (COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_pct,
    (COALESCE(pol.amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS amount,
    (COALESCE(pol.tax_amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_amount,
    (COALESCE(pol.total_amount, pol.amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS total_amount,
    pol.department,
    pol.job_ref,
    pol.remarks,
    pol.created_at AS line_created_at,
    (COALESCE(rb.received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
    (GREATEST((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(rb.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pending_qty,
    (GREATEST((COALESCE(rb.received_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS over_received_qty,
    COALESCE(rb.latest_receipt_date, NULL::date) AS latest_receipt_date,
    COALESCE(rb.receipt_entries, '[]'::jsonb) AS receipt_entries
   FROM (((public.purchase_orders po
     JOIN public.purchase_order_lines pol ON ((pol.po_id = po.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_vendors v ON ((v.id = po.vendor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN receipt_by_line rb ON ((rb.po_line_id = (pol.id)::text)));

--
-- TOC entry 642 (class 1259 OID 220973)
-- Name: v_purchase_orders_rate_control_v2; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_orders_rate_control_v2 WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH exact_receipts AS (
         SELECT (pol.id)::text AS line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(ar.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS exact_stock_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(r.purchase_qty, (COALESCE(ar.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(pol.conversion_factor, (1)::numeric)))) AS exact_purchase_qty
           FROM ((public.v_purchase_po_active_receipts ar
             JOIN public.purchase_order_lines pol ON (((pol.id)::text = ar.po_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_po_receipts r ON ((((r.ledger_id)::text = ar.receipt_id) AND (r.po_line_id = pol.id))))
          WHERE (COALESCE(ar.po_line_id, ''::text) <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY pol.id
        ), balances AS (
         SELECT b.po_id,
            b.po_no,
            b.order_date,
            b.vendor_id,
            b.vendor_name,
            b.vendor_gstin,
            b.vendor_email,
            b.vendor_phone,
            b.vendor_address,
            b.payment_terms,
            b.freight_terms,
            b.freight_value,
            b.delivery_terms,
            b.notes,
            b.status,
            b.total_qty,
            b.basic_total,
            b.tax_total,
            b.total_value,
            b.created_by,
            b.created_at,
            b.updated_at,
            b.line_id,
            b.line_no,
            b.source_type,
            b.source_ref,
            b.item_code,
            b.item_name,
            b.qty,
            b.rate,
            b.tax_pct,
            b.amount,
            b.tax_amount,
            b.total_amount,
            b.department,
            b.job_ref,
            b.remarks,
            b.line_created_at,
            b.received_qty,
            b.pending_qty,
            b.over_received_qty,
            b.latest_receipt_date,
            b.receipt_entries,
            b.stock_qty,
            b.stock_uom,
            b.purchase_qty,
            b.purchase_uom,
            b.conversion_type,
            b.conversion_factor,
            b.rate_key,
            b.rate_master_id,
            b.rate_policy,
            b.rate_override_approval_id,
            b.rate_override_reason,
            b.master_rate_ceiling,
            b.master_tax_pct_snapshot,
            b.rate_control_status,
            (COALESCE(er.exact_purchase_qty, (0)::numeric) + (GREATEST((COALESCE(b.received_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(er.exact_stock_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(b.conversion_factor, (1)::numeric))) AS calculated_received_purchase_qty
           FROM (public.v_purchase_orders_rate_control_v1 b
             LEFT JOIN exact_receipts er ON ((er.line_id = b.line_id)))
        )
 SELECT po_id,
    po_no,
    order_date,
    vendor_id,
    vendor_name,
    vendor_gstin,
    vendor_email,
    vendor_phone,
    vendor_address,
    payment_terms,
    freight_terms,
    freight_value,
    delivery_terms,
    notes,
    status,
    total_qty,
    basic_total,
    tax_total,
    total_value,
    created_by,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    line_id,
    line_no,
    source_type,
    source_ref,
    item_code,
    item_name,
    qty,
    rate,
    tax_pct,
    amount,
    tax_amount,
    total_amount,
    department,
    job_ref,
    remarks,
    line_created_at,
    received_qty,
    pending_qty,
    over_received_qty,
    latest_receipt_date,
    receipt_entries,
    stock_qty,
    stock_uom,
    purchase_qty,
    purchase_uom,
    conversion_type,
    conversion_factor,
    rate_key,
    rate_master_id,
    rate_policy,
    rate_override_approval_id,
    rate_override_reason,
    master_rate_ceiling,
    master_tax_pct_snapshot,
    rate_control_status,
    calculated_received_purchase_qty,
    round(calculated_received_purchase_qty, 6) AS received_purchase_qty,
    round(GREATEST((COALESCE(purchase_qty, qty, (0)::numeric) - calculated_received_purchase_qty), (0)::numeric), 6) AS pending_purchase_qty
   FROM balances;

--
-- TOC entry 583 (class 1259 OID 180071)
-- Name: v_purchase_po_cancel_check; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_po_cancel_check AS
 WITH receipt_by_po AS (
         SELECT pol.po_no,
            (sum(COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS receipt_qty
           FROM (public.purchase_order_lines pol
             JOIN public.purchase_po_receipts r ON ((r.po_line_id = pol.id)))
          WHERE (COALESCE(pol.po_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY pol.po_no
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ar.po_no,
            (sum(COALESCE(ar.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS receipt_qty
           FROM public.v_purchase_po_active_receipts ar
          WHERE (COALESCE(ar.po_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY ar.po_no
        ), receipt_totals AS (
         SELECT receipt_by_po.po_no,
            (sum(receipt_by_po.receipt_qty))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty
           FROM receipt_by_po
          GROUP BY receipt_by_po.po_no
        )
 SELECT (po.id)::text AS po_id,
    po.po_no,
    po.status,
    po.notes,
    (COALESCE(rt.received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty
   FROM (public.purchase_orders po
     LEFT JOIN receipt_totals rt ON ((rt.po_no = po.po_no)));

    (COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS qty,
    (COALESCE(pol.rate, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS rate,
    (COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_pct,
    (COALESCE(pol.amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS amount,
    (COALESCE(pol.tax_amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS tax_amount,
    (COALESCE(pol.total_amount, pol.amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS total_amount,
    COALESCE(pol.department, ''::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(pol.job_ref, ''::text) AS job_ref,
    COALESCE(pol.remarks, ''::text) AS remarks,
    ''::text AS hsn_code,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) THEN 'PCS'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(i.uom, ''::text), ''::text)
        END AS stock_unit
   FROM (((public.purchase_orders po
     JOIN public.purchase_order_lines pol ON ((pol.po_id = po.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_vendors v ON ((v.id = po.vendor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.item_code = pol.item_code)));

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_to_dispatch_traceability WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT lot.batch_no AS rm_batch_no,
    lot.item_code AS rm_item_code,
    item.item_name AS rm_item_name,
    item.uom AS rm_uom,
    lot.receipt_date,
    lot.qty_received AS rm_received_qty,
    lot.rate AS rm_rate,
    pr.grn_no,
    pr.po_no,
    pr.receipt_date AS grn_date,
    COALESCE(NULLIF("substring"(COALESCE(receipt_ledger.remarks, ''::text), 'INV:([^|]+)'::text), ''::text), ''::text) AS supplier_invoice_no,
    po.vendor_name AS supplier_name,
    COALESCE(src.issued_qty_snapshot, issue_alloc.qty) AS rm_issued_qty_to_wo,
    wo.id AS wo_id,
    wo.wo_number,
    wo.wo_date,
    fg.fg_batch_no,
    fg.produced_qty AS fg_batch_qty,
    fg.confidence AS material_to_fg_confidence,
    d.dispatch_no,
    d.dispatch_date,
    d.dispatch_qty,
    d.trace_status,
    d.so_number,
    d.line_no,
    so.client_code,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, inv.client_name, so.client_code) AS client_name,
    d.product_code,
    d.product_name,
    ida.allocated_qty AS invoice_dispatch_qty,
    inv.invoice_no,
    inv.invoice_date,
    inv.status AS invoice_status,
    il.qty AS invoice_line_qty,
    il.line_total AS invoice_line_total,
        CASE
            WHEN (d.id IS NULL) THEN 'RM_TO_WO_ONLY'::text
            WHEN ((fg.confidence = 'WO_GENEALOGY'::text) AND (ida.id IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'WO_GENEALOGY_AND_COMMERCIAL_EXACT'::text
            WHEN (fg.id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'WO_GENEALOGY_UNBILLED'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(d.trace_status, 'UNTRACED'::text)
        END AS trace_confidence,
    concat_ws(' '::text, lot.batch_no, lot.item_code, item.item_name, pr.grn_no, pr.po_no, po.vendor_name, wo.wo_number, d.dispatch_no, d.so_number, c.client_name, inv.invoice_no) AS match_text,
    concat_ws(' '::text, d.trace_status, fg.confidence, inv.status) AS status_text
   FROM ((((((((((((((((public.inv_lot_allocations issue_alloc
     JOIN public.inv_ledger issue_ledger ON ((issue_ledger.id = issue_alloc.ledger_id)))
     JOIN public.inv_lots lot ON ((lot.id = issue_alloc.lot_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_items item ON ((item.id = lot.item_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.trace_fg_material_sources src ON ((src.lot_allocation_id = issue_alloc.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.trace_fg_batches fg ON ((fg.id = src.fg_batch_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((((fg.id IS NOT NULL) AND (wo.id = fg.wo_id)) OR ((fg.id IS NULL) AND (wo.wo_number = issue_ledger.ref_no)))))
     LEFT JOIN public.trace_dispatch_fg_allocations dfa ON ((dfa.fg_batch_id = fg.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.dispatch_records d ON ((d.id = dfa.dispatch_record_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = d.so_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN public.trace_invoice_dispatch_allocations ida ON ((ida.dispatch_record_id = d.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.invoice_lines il ON ((il.id = ida.invoice_line_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_po_receipts pr ON (((pr.lot_id = lot.id) AND (pr.reversed_at IS NULL))))
     LEFT JOIN public.inv_ledger receipt_ledger ON ((receipt_ledger.id = pr.ledger_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON ((po.id = pr.po_id)))
  WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(issue_ledger.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.inv_ledger rev
          WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (issue_ledger.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))));

-- TOC entry 526 (class 1259 OID 147363)
-- Name: v_purchase_tooling_register_search; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE VIEW public.v_purchase_tooling_register_search AS
 WITH base_rows AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(aj.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text), ((COALESCE((aj.id)::text, ''::text) || '||'::text) || COALESCE((aj.line_no)::text, ''::text))) AS artwork_key,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(aj.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text), 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS artwork_no,
            (aj.id)::text AS so_id,
            COALESCE(aj.so_number, ''::text) AS so_number,
            aj.so_date,
            (aj.line_no)::text AS line_no,
            COALESCE(aj.client_name, ''::text) AS client_name,
            COALESCE(aj.product_name, ''::text) AS product_name,
            (COALESCE(aj.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS qty,
            COALESCE(aj.unit, ''::text) AS unit,
            (COALESCE(aj.sheet_ups, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS sheet_ups,
            COALESCE(aj.plate_status, ''::text) AS plate_status,
            COALESCE(aj.die_status, ''::text) AS die_status,
            COALESCE(aj.plate_size, ''::text) AS plate_size,
            (COALESCE(aj.plate_count, 0))::numeric(14,4) AS plate_count,
            COALESCE(aj.hybrid_plate_size, ''::text) AS hybrid_plate_size,
            (COALESCE(aj.hybrid_plate_count, 0))::numeric(14,4) AS hybrid_plate_count,
            (COALESCE(aj.die_count, 0))::numeric(14,4) AS die_count
           FROM ((public.v_artwork_jobs aj
             JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.so_number = aj.so_number)))
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = so.id) AND ((sol.line_no)::text = (aj.line_no)::text))))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(aj.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))
        ), base_grouped AS (
         SELECT base_rows.artwork_key AS id,
            base_rows.artwork_key,
            max(base_rows.artwork_no) AS artwork_no,
            min(base_rows.so_date) AS so_date,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT base_rows.so_number, ', '::text ORDER BY base_rows.so_number), ''::text) AS so,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT base_rows.line_no, ', '::text ORDER BY base_rows.line_no), ''::text) AS line_no,
            ''::text AS wo_nos,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT base_rows.client_name, ', '::text ORDER BY base_rows.client_name), ''::text) AS client,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT base_rows.product_name, ' / '::text ORDER BY base_rows.product_name), ''::text) AS product_name,
            (sum(COALESCE(base_rows.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS qty,
            max(COALESCE(base_rows.unit, ''::text)) AS unit,
            (max(COALESCE(base_rows.sheet_ups, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS artwork_ups,
            jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('soId', base_rows.so_id, 'soNo', base_rows.so_number, 'lineNo', base_rows.line_no, 'artworkNo', base_rows.artwork_no, 'sheetUps', base_rows.sheet_ups)) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(base_rows.so_id, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS member_refs,
            max(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(base_rows.plate_status), ''::text), ''::text)) AS plate_status_raw,
            max(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(base_rows.die_status), ''::text), ''::text)) AS die_status_raw,
            bool_or(((upper(base_rows.plate_status) = ANY (ARRAY['NEW'::text, 'YES'::text, 'REQUIRED'::text, 'SELECTED'::text])) OR (upper(base_rows.plate_status) ~~ '%NEW%'::text))) AS plate_is_new,
            bool_or(((upper(base_rows.die_status) = ANY (ARRAY['NEW'::text, 'YES'::text, 'REQUIRED'::text, 'SELECTED'::text])) OR (upper(base_rows.die_status) ~~ '%NEW%'::text))) AS die_is_new,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(base_rows.plate_size), ''::text)) AS plate_size,
            (max(COALESCE(base_rows.plate_count, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS plate_count,
            (max(COALESCE(base_rows.hybrid_plate_count, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS hybrid_plate_count,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(base_rows.hybrid_plate_size), ''::text)) AS hybrid_plate_size,
            (max(COALESCE(base_rows.die_count, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS die_count,
            array_agg(DISTINCT base_rows.so_number ORDER BY base_rows.so_number) FILTER (WHERE (base_rows.so_number <> ''::text)) AS so_list,
            array_agg(DISTINCT base_rows.line_no ORDER BY base_rows.line_no) FILTER (WHERE (base_rows.line_no <> ''::text)) AS line_list,
            ARRAY[]::text[] AS wo_list,
            array_agg(DISTINCT base_rows.client_name ORDER BY base_rows.client_name) FILTER (WHERE (base_rows.client_name <> ''::text)) AS client_list,
            array_agg(DISTINCT base_rows.product_name ORDER BY base_rows.product_name) FILTER (WHERE (base_rows.product_name <> ''::text)) AS product_list,
            (count(DISTINCT base_rows.so_number))::integer AS so_count
           FROM base_rows
          GROUP BY base_rows.artwork_key
        ), receipt_by_line AS (
         SELECT purchase_po_receipts.po_line_id,
            (sum(COALESCE(purchase_po_receipts.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
            max(purchase_po_receipts.receipt_date) AS last_receipt_date,
            string_agg(DISTINCT purchase_po_receipts.challan_no, ', '::text ORDER BY purchase_po_receipts.challan_no) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(purchase_po_receipts.challan_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS challan_nos
           FROM public.purchase_po_receipts
          GROUP BY purchase_po_receipts.po_line_id
        ), po_tooling_lines AS (
         SELECT pol.source_ref AS artwork_key,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) THEN 'DIE'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text])) THEN 'PLATE'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS tooling_type,
            pol.po_no,
            po.order_date,
            COALESCE(po.vendor_name, ''::text) AS vendor_name,
            (COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS ordered_qty,
            (COALESCE(r.received_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
            (GREATEST((COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(r.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS pending_qty,
            r.last_receipt_date,
            r.challan_nos
           FROM ((public.purchase_order_lines pol
             JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON ((po.po_no = pol.po_no)))
             LEFT JOIN receipt_by_line r ON ((r.po_line_id = pol.id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) AND (COALESCE(pol.source_ref, ''::text) <> ''::text))
        ), po_pivot AS (
         SELECT po_tooling_lines.artwork_key,
            sum(po_tooling_lines.ordered_qty) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_ordered_qty,
            sum(po_tooling_lines.received_qty) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_received_qty,
            sum(po_tooling_lines.pending_qty) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_pending_qty,
            min(po_tooling_lines.order_date) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_ordered_on,
            max(po_tooling_lines.last_receipt_date) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_received_on,
            string_agg(DISTINCT po_tooling_lines.po_no, ', '::text ORDER BY po_tooling_lines.po_no) FILTER (WHERE ((po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text) AND (po_tooling_lines.po_no <> ''::text))) AS plate_po_refs,
            string_agg(DISTINCT po_tooling_lines.vendor_name, ', '::text ORDER BY po_tooling_lines.vendor_name) FILTER (WHERE ((po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text) AND (po_tooling_lines.vendor_name <> ''::text))) AS plate_vendor,
            string_agg(DISTINCT po_tooling_lines.challan_nos, ', '::text ORDER BY po_tooling_lines.challan_nos) FILTER (WHERE ((po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text) AND (COALESCE(po_tooling_lines.challan_nos, ''::text) <> ''::text))) AS plate_challan_no,
            sum(po_tooling_lines.ordered_qty) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_ordered_qty,
            sum(po_tooling_lines.received_qty) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_received_qty,
            sum(po_tooling_lines.pending_qty) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_pending_qty,
            min(po_tooling_lines.order_date) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_ordered_on,
            max(po_tooling_lines.last_receipt_date) FILTER (WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_received_on,
            string_agg(DISTINCT po_tooling_lines.po_no, ', '::text ORDER BY po_tooling_lines.po_no) FILTER (WHERE ((po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text) AND (po_tooling_lines.po_no <> ''::text))) AS die_po_refs,
            string_agg(DISTINCT po_tooling_lines.vendor_name, ', '::text ORDER BY po_tooling_lines.vendor_name) FILTER (WHERE ((po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text) AND (po_tooling_lines.vendor_name <> ''::text))) AS die_vendor,
            string_agg(DISTINCT po_tooling_lines.challan_nos, ', '::text ORDER BY po_tooling_lines.challan_nos) FILTER (WHERE ((po_tooling_lines.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text) AND (COALESCE(po_tooling_lines.challan_nos, ''::text) <> ''::text))) AS die_challan_no
           FROM po_tooling_lines
          WHERE (po_tooling_lines.tooling_type <> ''::text)
          GROUP BY po_tooling_lines.artwork_key
        ), manual_proc AS (
         SELECT purchase_artwork_procurement.artwork_key,
            upper(COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.type, ''::text)) AS tooling_type,

            max(purchase_artwork_procurement.received_on) AS received_on,
            string_agg(DISTINCT purchase_artwork_procurement.challan_no, ', '::text ORDER BY purchase_artwork_procurement.challan_no) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.challan_no, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS challan_no,
            (sum(COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.count, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS ordered_qty,
            (sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (purchase_artwork_procurement.received_on IS NOT NULL) THEN COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.count, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END))::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
            max(purchase_artwork_procurement.cost) AS cost
           FROM public.purchase_artwork_procurement
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.status, 'ACTIVE'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)
          GROUP BY purchase_artwork_procurement.artwork_key, (upper(COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.type, ''::text)))
        ), manual_pivot AS (
         SELECT manual_proc.artwork_key,
            max(manual_proc.vendor) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_vendor,
            min(manual_proc.ordered_on) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_ordered_on,
            max(manual_proc.received_on) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_received_on,
            max(manual_proc.challan_no) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_challan_no,

            sum(manual_proc.received_qty) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_received_qty,
            max(manual_proc.cost) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text)) AS plate_cost,
            max(manual_proc.vendor) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_vendor,
            min(manual_proc.ordered_on) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_ordered_on,
            max(manual_proc.received_on) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_received_on,
            max(manual_proc.challan_no) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_challan_no,
            sum(manual_proc.ordered_qty) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_ordered_qty,
            sum(manual_proc.received_qty) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_received_qty,
            max(manual_proc.cost) FILTER (WHERE (manual_proc.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text)) AS die_cost
           FROM manual_proc
          GROUP BY manual_proc.artwork_key
        ), numbers AS (
         SELECT bg.id,
            bg.artwork_key,
            bg.artwork_no,
            bg.so_date,
            bg.so,
            bg.line_no,
            bg.wo_nos,
            bg.client,
            bg.product_name,
            bg.qty,
            bg.unit,
            bg.artwork_ups,
            bg.member_refs,
            bg.plate_status_raw,
            bg.die_status_raw,
            bg.plate_is_new,
            bg.die_is_new,
            bg.plate_size,
            bg.plate_count,
            bg.hybrid_plate_count,
            bg.hybrid_plate_size,
            bg.die_count,
            bg.so_list,
            bg.line_list,
            bg.wo_list,
            bg.client_list,
            bg.product_list,
            bg.so_count,
            concat_ws(', '::text, NULLIF(pp.plate_vendor, ''::text), NULLIF(mp.plate_vendor, ''::text)) AS plate_vendor,
            COALESCE(pp.plate_ordered_on, mp.plate_ordered_on) AS plate_ordered_on,
            COALESCE(pp.plate_received_on, mp.plate_received_on) AS plate_received_on,
            COALESCE(pp.plate_challan_no, mp.plate_challan_no, ''::text) AS plate_challan_no,
            COALESCE(mp.plate_cost, (0)::numeric) AS plate_cost,
            ((COALESCE(pp.plate_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(mp.plate_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS plate_ordered_qty,
            ((COALESCE(pp.plate_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(mp.plate_received_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS plate_received_qty,
            (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pp.plate_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(mp.plate_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric)) - (COALESCE(pp.plate_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(mp.plate_received_qty, (0)::numeric))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS plate_pending_qty,
            COALESCE(pp.plate_po_refs, ''::text) AS plate_po_refs,
            concat_ws(', '::text, NULLIF(pp.die_vendor, ''::text), NULLIF(mp.die_vendor, ''::text)) AS die_vendor,
            COALESCE(pp.die_ordered_on, mp.die_ordered_on) AS die_ordered_on,
            COALESCE(pp.die_received_on, mp.die_received_on) AS die_received_on,
            COALESCE(pp.die_challan_no, mp.die_challan_no, ''::text) AS die_challan_no,
            COALESCE(mp.die_cost, (0)::numeric) AS die_cost,
            ((COALESCE(pp.die_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(mp.die_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS die_ordered_qty,
            ((COALESCE(pp.die_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(mp.die_received_qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(14,4) AS die_received_qty,
            (GREATEST(((COALESCE(pp.die_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(mp.die_ordered_qty, (0)::numeric)) - (COALESCE(pp.die_received_qty, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(mp.die_received_qty, (0)::numeric))), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,4) AS die_pending_qty,
            COALESCE(pp.die_po_refs, ''::text) AS die_po_refs
           FROM ((base_grouped bg
             LEFT JOIN po_pivot pp ON ((pp.artwork_key = bg.artwork_key)))
             LEFT JOIN manual_pivot mp ON ((mp.artwork_key = bg.artwork_key)))
        ), final_rows AS (
         SELECT numbers.id,
            numbers.artwork_key,
            numbers.artwork_no,
            numbers.so_date,
            numbers.so,
            numbers.line_no,
            numbers.wo_nos,
            numbers.client,
            numbers.product_name,
            numbers.qty,
            numbers.unit,
            numbers.artwork_ups,
            numbers.member_refs,
            numbers.plate_status_raw,
            numbers.die_status_raw,
            numbers.plate_is_new,
            numbers.die_is_new,
            numbers.plate_vendor,
            numbers.plate_ordered_on,
            numbers.plate_received_on,
            numbers.plate_challan_no,
            numbers.plate_size,
            numbers.plate_count,
            numbers.hybrid_plate_count,
            numbers.hybrid_plate_size,
            (COALESCE(numbers.plate_cost, (0)::numeric))::text AS plate_cost,
            numbers.plate_ordered_qty,
            numbers.plate_received_qty,
            numbers.plate_pending_qty,
            numbers.plate_po_refs,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((numbers.plate_ordered_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (numbers.plate_pending_qty <= (0)::numeric) AND (numbers.plate_received_qty > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'RECEIVED'::text
                    WHEN ((numbers.plate_ordered_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (numbers.plate_received_qty > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PARTIAL'::text
                    WHEN (numbers.plate_ordered_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'ORDERED'::text
                    WHEN numbers.plate_is_new THEN 'PENDING'::text
                    WHEN (NULLIF(btrim(numbers.plate_status_raw), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) THEN upper(numbers.plate_status_raw)
                    ELSE 'NA'::text
                END AS status_plate,
            numbers.die_vendor,
            numbers.die_ordered_on,
            numbers.die_received_on,
            numbers.die_challan_no,
            numbers.die_count,
            (COALESCE(numbers.die_cost, (0)::numeric))::text AS die_cost,
            numbers.die_ordered_qty,
            numbers.die_received_qty,
            numbers.die_pending_qty,
            numbers.die_po_refs,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((numbers.die_ordered_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (numbers.die_pending_qty <= (0)::numeric) AND (numbers.die_received_qty > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'RECEIVED'::text
                    WHEN ((numbers.die_ordered_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (numbers.die_received_qty > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PARTIAL'::text
                    WHEN (numbers.die_ordered_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'ORDERED'::text
                    WHEN numbers.die_is_new THEN 'PENDING'::text
                    WHEN (NULLIF(btrim(numbers.die_status_raw), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) THEN upper(numbers.die_status_raw)
                    ELSE 'NA'::text
                END AS status_die,
            numbers.so_list,
            numbers.line_list,
            numbers.wo_list,
            numbers.client_list,
            numbers.product_list,
            numbers.so_count
           FROM numbers
        )
 SELECT id,
    artwork_key,
    artwork_no,
    so_date,
    so,
    line_no,
    wo_nos,
    client,
    product_name,
    qty,
    unit,
    artwork_ups,
    member_refs,
    plate_status_raw,
    die_status_raw,
    plate_is_new,
    die_is_new,
    plate_vendor,
    plate_ordered_on,
    plate_received_on,
    plate_challan_no,
    plate_size,
    plate_count,
    hybrid_plate_count,
    hybrid_plate_size,
    plate_cost,
    plate_ordered_qty,
    plate_received_qty,
    plate_pending_qty,
    plate_po_refs,
    status_plate,
    die_vendor,
    die_ordered_on,
    die_received_on,
    die_challan_no,
    die_count,
    die_cost,
    die_ordered_qty,
    die_received_qty,
    die_pending_qty,
    die_po_refs,
    status_die,
    so_list,
    line_list,
    wo_list,
    client_list,
    product_list,
    so_count,
        CASE
            WHEN plate_is_new THEN 'NEW'::text
            WHEN (NULLIF(btrim(plate_status_raw), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) THEN upper(plate_status_raw)
            ELSE 'NA'::text
        END AS plate_requirement_status,
        CASE
            WHEN die_is_new THEN 'NEW'::text
            WHEN (NULLIF(btrim(die_status_raw), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) THEN upper(die_status_raw)
            ELSE 'NA'::text
        END AS die_requirement_status,
    ((plate_is_new AND (upper(COALESCE(status_plate, ''::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['RECEIVED'::text, 'NA'::text]))) OR (upper(COALESCE(status_plate, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ORDERED'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text]))) AS plate_action_required,
    ((die_is_new AND (upper(COALESCE(status_die, ''::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['RECEIVED'::text, 'NA'::text]))) OR (upper(COALESCE(status_die, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ORDERED'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text]))) AS die_action_required
   FROM final_rows;

--
-- TOC entry 576 (class 1259 OID 176557)
-- Name: v_report_billing_register; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_billing_register AS
 WITH line_base AS (
         SELECT il.id AS invoice_line_id,
            il.invoice_id,
            inv.invoice_no,
            inv.invoice_date,
            inv.created_at,
            inv.posted_at,
            upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) AS invoice_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['INVOICE'::text, 'CHALLAN'::text])) THEN upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, ''::text))
                    ELSE 'INVOICE'::text
                END AS document_type,
            COALESCE(inv.billing_mode, ''::text) AS billing_mode,
            COALESCE(inv.client_code, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_code,
            COALESCE(inv.client_name, c.client_name, inv.client_code, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            il.so_id,
            il.so_line_id,
            COALESCE(il.so_number, so.so_number) AS so_number,
            so.so_date,
            COALESCE(il.line_no, sol.line_no) AS line_no,
            COALESCE(so.sales_rep, ''::text) AS sales_rep,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(sol.division), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(il.division), ''::text), ''::text) AS division,
            COALESCE(sol.product_code, il.product_code, ''::text) AS product_code,
            COALESCE(sol.product_name, il.product_name, ''::text) AS product_name,
            COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text) AS category,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
            COALESCE(il.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
            COALESCE(il.taxable_amount, il.line_amount, (COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(il.rate, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS billed_value,
            COALESCE(il.line_total, (((COALESCE(il.taxable_amount, il.line_amount, (COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(il.rate, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(il.cgst_amt, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(il.sgst_amt, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(il.igst_amt, (0)::numeric))) AS line_total,
            GREATEST(COALESCE(inv.grand_total, (0)::numeric), ((COALESCE(inv.subtotal, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(inv.tax_total, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(inv.freight, (0)::numeric))) AS document_complete_amount,
            COALESCE(inv.freight, (0)::numeric) AS document_freight,
            sol.expected_delivery,
            sol.final_delivery
           FROM ((((public.invoice_lines il
             JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.id = il.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = COALESCE(il.so_id, sol.so_id))))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = COALESCE(inv.client_code, so.client_code))))
          WHERE ((il.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text))
        ), metrics AS (
         SELECT lb.invoice_line_id,
            lb.invoice_id,
            lb.invoice_no,
            lb.invoice_date,
            lb.created_at,
            lb.posted_at,
            lb.invoice_status,
            lb.document_type,
            lb.billing_mode,
            lb.client_code,
            lb.client_name,
            lb.so_id,
            lb.so_line_id,
            lb.so_number,
            lb.so_date,
            lb.line_no,
            lb.sales_rep,
            lb.division,
            lb.product_code,
            lb.product_name,
            lb.category,
            lb.order_qty,
            lb.billed_qty,
            lb.rate,
            lb.billed_value,
            lb.line_total,
            lb.document_complete_amount,
            lb.document_freight,
            lb.expected_delivery,
            lb.final_delivery,
            COALESCE(sum(lb.line_total) OVER (PARTITION BY lb.invoice_id), (0)::numeric) AS invoice_line_total,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.invoice_id ORDER BY lb.invoice_line_id) AS invoice_line_rn,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lb.invoice_id) AS invoice_line_count
           FROM line_base lb
        ), alloc_pre AS (
         SELECT m.invoice_line_id,
            m.invoice_id,
            m.invoice_no,
            m.invoice_date,
            m.created_at,
            m.posted_at,
            m.invoice_status,
            m.document_type,
            m.billing_mode,
            m.client_code,
            m.client_name,
            m.so_id,
            m.so_line_id,
            m.so_number,
            m.so_date,
            m.line_no,
            m.sales_rep,
            m.division,
            m.product_code,
            m.product_name,
            m.category,
            m.order_qty,
            m.billed_qty,
            m.rate,
            m.billed_value,
            m.line_total,
            m.document_complete_amount,
            m.document_freight,
            m.expected_delivery,
            m.final_delivery,
            m.invoice_line_total,
            m.invoice_line_rn,
            m.invoice_line_count,
            GREATEST((COALESCE(m.document_complete_amount, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(m.invoice_line_total, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS header_extra,
                CASE
                    WHEN (GREATEST((COALESCE(m.document_complete_amount, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(m.invoice_line_total, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) THEN (0)::numeric
                    WHEN (COALESCE(m.invoice_line_total, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round(((GREATEST((COALESCE(m.document_complete_amount, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(m.invoice_line_total, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(m.line_total, (0)::numeric)) / NULLIF(m.invoice_line_total, (0)::numeric)), 2)
                    ELSE round((GREATEST((COALESCE(m.document_complete_amount, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(m.invoice_line_total, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) / (NULLIF(m.invoice_line_count, 0))::numeric), 2)
                END AS proportional_header_allocation
           FROM metrics m
        ), alloc_final AS (
         SELECT ap.invoice_line_id,
            ap.invoice_id,
            ap.invoice_no,
            ap.invoice_date,
            ap.created_at,
            ap.posted_at,
            ap.invoice_status,
            ap.document_type,
            ap.billing_mode,
            ap.client_code,
            ap.client_name,
            ap.so_id,
            ap.so_line_id,
            ap.so_number,
            ap.so_date,
            ap.line_no,
            ap.sales_rep,
            ap.division,
            ap.product_code,
            ap.product_name,
            ap.category,
            ap.order_qty,
            ap.billed_qty,
            ap.rate,
            ap.billed_value,
            ap.line_total,
            ap.document_complete_amount,
            ap.document_freight,
            ap.expected_delivery,
            ap.final_delivery,
            ap.invoice_line_total,
            ap.invoice_line_rn,
            ap.invoice_line_count,
            ap.header_extra,
            ap.proportional_header_allocation,
                CASE
                    WHEN (ap.invoice_line_rn = ap.invoice_line_count) THEN GREATEST((ap.header_extra - COALESCE(sum(ap.proportional_header_allocation) FILTER (WHERE (ap.invoice_line_rn < ap.invoice_line_count)) OVER (PARTITION BY ap.invoice_id), (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE ap.proportional_header_allocation
                END AS header_charge_allocation
           FROM alloc_pre ap
        )
 SELECT invoice_line_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_no,
    invoice_date,
    created_at,
    posted_at,
    invoice_status,
    document_type,
    billing_mode,
    client_code,
    client_name,
    so_id,
    so_line_id,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    line_no,
    sales_rep,
    division,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    category,
    order_qty,
    billed_qty,
    rate,
    billed_value,
    line_total,
    expected_delivery,
    final_delivery,
    round(header_charge_allocation, 2) AS header_charge_allocation,
    round((COALESCE(line_total, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(header_charge_allocation, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS complete_line_value,
    round(document_complete_amount, 2) AS document_complete_amount,
    round(document_freight, 2) AS document_freight
   FROM alloc_final;


--
-- TOC entry 441 (class 1259 OID 83805)
-- Name: v_report_delivery_performance; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_delivery_performance AS
 WITH dispatch_base AS (
         SELECT dr.so_line_id,
            max(dr.dispatch_date) AS last_dispatch_date,
            sum(COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS dispatched_qty
           FROM public.dispatch_records dr
          GROUP BY dr.so_line_id
        )
 SELECT so.so_number,
    sol.line_no,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code) AS client_name,
    sol.product_name,
    COALESCE(sol.final_delivery, sol.expected_delivery) AS delivery_date,
    db.last_dispatch_date,
    COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
    COALESCE(db.dispatched_qty, (0)::numeric) AS dispatched_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (db.last_dispatch_date IS NULL) THEN 'PENDING'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(sol.final_delivery, sol.expected_delivery) IS NULL) THEN 'DISPATCHED'::text
            WHEN (db.last_dispatch_date <= COALESCE(sol.final_delivery, sol.expected_delivery)) THEN 'ON_TIME'::text
            ELSE 'DELAYED'::text
        END AS delivery_status,
        CASE
            WHEN ((db.last_dispatch_date IS NULL) OR (COALESCE(sol.final_delivery, sol.expected_delivery) IS NULL)) THEN 0
            ELSE GREATEST((db.last_dispatch_date - COALESCE(sol.final_delivery, sol.expected_delivery)), 0)
        END AS delay_days
   FROM (((public.sales_orders so
     JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN dispatch_base db ON ((db.so_line_id = sol.id)))
  WHERE (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text);


--
-- TOC entry 604 (class 1259 OID 194094)
-- Name: v_report_department_material_issue; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_department_material_issue AS
 WITH issue_ledger AS (
         SELECT l.id AS ledger_id,
            'ISSUE'::text AS transaction_type,
            ''::text AS source_issue_id,
            l.item_id,
            l.location,
            l.ref_no,
            COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric) AS issue_qty,
            COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric) AS issue_rate,
            abs(COALESCE(NULLIF(l.value, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric)))) AS basic_value,
            COALESCE(l.department, ''::text) AS ledger_department,
            COALESCE(l.batch_no, ''::text) AS batch_no,
            COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text) AS remarks,
            l.created_at AS issue_created_at
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(l.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'ISSUE'::text) AND (COALESCE(l.qty_out, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT l.id AS ledger_id,
            'WO-RETURN'::text AS transaction_type,
            ''::text AS source_issue_id,
            l.item_id,
            l.location,
            l.ref_no,
            (('-1'::integer)::numeric * COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric)) AS issue_qty,
            COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric) AS issue_rate,
            (('-1'::integer)::numeric * abs(COALESCE(NULLIF(l.value, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric))))) AS basic_value,
            COALESCE(l.department, ''::text) AS ledger_department,
            COALESCE(l.batch_no, ''::text) AS batch_no,
            COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text) AS remarks,
            l.created_at AS issue_created_at
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(l.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'WO-RETURN'::text) AND (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_ledger rev
                  WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (l.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT rev.id AS ledger_id,
            'REV-ISSUE'::text AS transaction_type,
            (orig.id)::text AS source_issue_id,
            COALESCE(rev.item_id, orig.item_id) AS item_id,
            COALESCE(rev.location, orig.location) AS location,
            orig.ref_no,
            (('-1'::integer)::numeric * COALESCE(NULLIF(rev.qty_in, (0)::numeric), orig.qty_out, (0)::numeric)) AS issue_qty,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(rev.rate, (0)::numeric), orig.rate, (0)::numeric) AS issue_rate,
            (('-1'::integer)::numeric * abs(COALESCE(NULLIF(rev.value, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(NULLIF(rev.qty_in, (0)::numeric), orig.qty_out, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(NULLIF(rev.rate, (0)::numeric), orig.rate, (0)::numeric))))) AS basic_value,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(rev.department, ''::text), orig.department, ''::text) AS ledger_department,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(rev.batch_no, ''::text), orig.batch_no, ''::text) AS batch_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(rev.remarks, ''::text), ('Reversal of issue '::text || (orig.id)::text)) AS remarks,
            rev.created_at AS issue_created_at
           FROM (public.inv_ledger rev
             JOIN public.inv_ledger orig ON ((((orig.id)::text = rev.ref_no) AND (upper(COALESCE(orig.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'ISSUE'::text))))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) = 'REV-ISSUE'::text) AND (COALESCE(rev.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric))
        ), wo_context_raw AS (
         SELECT wo.wo_number,
            woj.so_number,
            woj.line_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.division, ''::text), NULLIF(sol.category, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.category, ''::text), ''::text) AS department_candidate,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.product_name, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.product_name, ''::text), ''::text) AS product_name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(c.client_name, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.client_name, ''::text), so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(sol.job_reference, ''::text), ''::text) AS job_reference
           FROM ((((public.work_orders wo
             JOIN public.work_order_jobs woj ON ((woj.wo_id = wo.id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.so_number = woj.so_number)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = so.id) AND (sol.line_no = woj.line_no))))
        ), wo_context AS (
         SELECT wo_context_raw.wo_number,
            count(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo_context_raw.department_candidate, ''::text)) AS department_count,
            max(NULLIF(wo_context_raw.department_candidate, ''::text)) AS single_department,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo_context_raw.department_candidate, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo_context_raw.department_candidate, ''::text)) AS department_list,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo_context_raw.so_number, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo_context_raw.so_number, ''::text)) AS so_numbers,
            string_agg(DISTINCT (wo_context_raw.line_no)::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (wo_context_raw.line_no)::text) FILTER (WHERE (wo_context_raw.line_no IS NOT NULL)) AS line_numbers,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo_context_raw.job_reference, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo_context_raw.job_reference, ''::text)) AS job_references,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo_context_raw.product_name, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo_context_raw.product_name, ''::text)) AS product_names,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo_context_raw.client_name, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo_context_raw.client_name, ''::text)) AS client_names
           FROM wo_context_raw
          GROUP BY wo_context_raw.wo_number
        ), latest_item_tax AS (
         SELECT x.item_code,
            x.tax_pct
           FROM ( SELECT upper(btrim(COALESCE(pol.item_code, ''::text))) AS item_code,
                    COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) AS tax_pct,
                    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (upper(btrim(COALESCE(pol.item_code, ''::text)))) ORDER BY COALESCE(pol.created_at, now()) DESC, pol.id DESC) AS rn
                   FROM public.purchase_order_lines pol
                  WHERE ((COALESCE(pol.item_code, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric))) x
          WHERE (x.rn = 1)
        ), prepared AS (
         SELECT il.ledger_id,
            il.transaction_type,
            il.source_issue_id,
            il.item_id,
            COALESCE(i.item_code, ''::text) AS item_code,
            COALESCE(i.item_name, ''::text) AS item_name,
            COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS item_category,
            COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS uom,
            COALESCE(i.department, ''::text) AS item_department,
            COALESCE(im.gst_pct, lit.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) AS gst_pct,
            il.location,
            il.ref_no AS wo_number,
            il.issue_qty,
            il.issue_rate,
            il.basic_value,
            il.ledger_department,
            il.batch_no,
            il.remarks,
            il.issue_created_at,
            wc.so_numbers,
            wc.line_numbers,
            wc.job_references,
            wc.product_names,
            wc.client_names,
            wc.department_list,
                CASE
                    WHEN (wc.department_count = 1) THEN wc.single_department
                    WHEN (wc.department_count > 1) THEN 'Mixed'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS wo_department
           FROM ((((issue_ledger il
             LEFT JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = il.item_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.items im ON ((upper(btrim(COALESCE(im.item_code, ''::text))) = upper(btrim(COALESCE(i.item_code, ''::text))))))
             LEFT JOIN latest_item_tax lit ON ((lit.item_code = upper(btrim(COALESCE(i.item_code, ''::text))))))
             LEFT JOIN wo_context wc ON ((wc.wo_number = il.ref_no)))
        )
 SELECT (ledger_id)::text AS issue_id,
    (timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, issue_created_at))::date AS issue_date,
    timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, issue_created_at) AS issue_datetime,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(ledger_department), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(wo_department), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(item_department), ''::text), 'Unassigned'::text) AS department,
    COALESCE(department_list, ''::text) AS wo_department_list,
    COALESCE(wo_number, ''::text) AS wo_number,
    COALESCE(so_numbers, ''::text) AS so_numbers,
    COALESCE(line_numbers, ''::text) AS line_numbers,
    COALESCE(job_references, ''::text) AS job_references,
    COALESCE(client_names, ''::text) AS client_names,
    COALESCE(product_names, ''::text) AS product_names,
    (item_id)::text AS item_id,
    item_code,
    item_name,
    item_category,
    uom,
    location,
    batch_no,
    (issue_qty)::numeric(18,4) AS issue_qty,
    (issue_rate)::numeric(18,6) AS issue_rate,
    round(basic_value, 2) AS basic_value,
    (gst_pct)::numeric(8,2) AS gst_pct,
    round(((basic_value * gst_pct) / 100.0), 2) AS gst_value,
    round((basic_value + ((basic_value * gst_pct) / 100.0)), 2) AS total_value,
    remarks,
    transaction_type,
    source_issue_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (transaction_type = 'REV-ISSUE'::text) THEN 'REVERSAL'::text
            WHEN (transaction_type = 'WO-RETURN'::text) THEN 'RETURN'::text
            ELSE 'ISSUE'::text
        END AS issue_row_type
   FROM prepared p;

COMMENT ON VIEW public.v_report_department_material_issue IS 'Department-wise material issue report from inventory ISSUE ledger rows, WO-RETURN leftover returns, and REV-ISSUE adjustments. total_value is GST-inclusive using items.gst_pct or latest purchase_order_lines.tax_pct by item code.';

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_department_purchase_grn AS
 WITH receipt_ledger AS (
         SELECT l.id AS ledger_id,
            l.item_id,
            l.location,
            upper(COALESCE(l.ref_type, ''::text)) AS receipt_type,
            l.ref_no AS source_ref,
            COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) AS receipt_qty,
            COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric) AS receipt_rate,
            abs(COALESCE(NULLIF(l.value, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric)))) AS basic_value,
            COALESCE(l.department, ''::text) AS ledger_department,
            COALESCE(l.batch_no, ''::text) AS batch_no,
            COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text) AS remarks,
            l.created_at AS receipt_created_at,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'GRN:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS grn_no,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'INV:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS supplier_invoice_no,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'InvoiceDate:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS supplier_invoice_date_text,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'PO:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS note_po_no,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'Vendor:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS note_vendor_name,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'ChallanNo:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS challan_no,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'ChallanDate:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS challan_date_text,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'Pay:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS payment_terms_note,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'Freight:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS freight_terms_note,
            NULLIF(btrim("substring"(COALESCE(l.remarks, ''::text), 'TaxPct:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text) AS tax_pct_text
           FROM public.inv_ledger l
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(l.ref_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['PO-RECEIPT'::text, 'PR-RECEIPT'::text, 'DIRECT-RECEIPT'::text])) AND (COALESCE(l.qty_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_ledger rev
                  WHERE ((rev.ref_no = (l.id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
        ), inventory_prepared AS (
         SELECT rl.ledger_id,
            rl.item_id,
            rl.location,
            rl.receipt_type,
            rl.source_ref,
            rl.receipt_qty,
            rl.receipt_rate,
            rl.basic_value,
            rl.ledger_department,
            rl.batch_no,
            rl.remarks,
            rl.receipt_created_at,
            rl.grn_no,
            rl.supplier_invoice_no,
            rl.supplier_invoice_date_text,
            rl.note_po_no,
            rl.note_vendor_name,
            rl.challan_no,
            rl.challan_date_text,
            rl.payment_terms_note,
            rl.freight_terms_note,
            rl.tax_pct_text,
            i.item_code,
            i.item_name,
            COALESCE(i.category, ''::text) AS item_category,
            COALESCE(i.uom, ''::text) AS item_uom,
                CASE
                    WHEN (rl.receipt_type = 'PO-RECEIPT'::text) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(rl.note_po_no, ''::text), rl.source_ref)
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS po_no_for_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN (rl.tax_pct_text ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'::text) THEN (rl.tax_pct_text)::numeric
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS tax_pct
           FROM (receipt_ledger rl
             LEFT JOIN public.inv_items i ON ((i.id = rl.item_id)))
        ), inventory_enriched AS (
         SELECT p.ledger_id,
            p.item_id,
            p.location,
            p.receipt_type,
            p.source_ref,
            p.receipt_qty,
            p.receipt_rate,
            p.basic_value,
            p.ledger_department,
            p.batch_no,
            p.remarks,
            p.receipt_created_at,

            p.supplier_invoice_no,

            p.note_po_no,
            p.note_vendor_name,
            p.challan_no,
            p.challan_date_text,
            p.payment_terms_note,

            p.tax_pct,
            po.id AS po_id,
            po.order_date AS po_date,
            COALESCE(po.status, ''::text) AS po_status,
            COALESCE(po.vendor_name, p.note_vendor_name, ''::text) AS po_vendor_name,
            COALESCE(po.payment_terms, p.payment_terms_note, ''::text) AS payment_terms,
            COALESCE(po.freight_terms, p.freight_terms_note, ''::text) AS freight_terms,
            pol.id AS po_line_id,
            pol.line_no AS po_line_no,
            COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text) AS po_source_type,
            COALESCE(pol.source_ref, ''::text) AS po_source_ref,
            COALESCE(pol.department, ''::text) AS po_line_department,
            COALESCE(pol.job_ref, ''::text) AS po_line_job_ref,
            pr.pr_no,
            COALESCE(pr.department, ''::text) AS pr_department,

           FROM (((inventory_prepared p
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON (((p.receipt_type = 'PO-RECEIPT'::text) AND (po.po_no = p.po_no_for_match))))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pol1.id,

                  ORDER BY
                        CASE
                            WHEN (COALESCE(pol1.department, ''::text) = COALESCE(p.ledger_department, ''::text)) THEN 0
                            ELSE 1
                        END, pol1.line_no, pol1.id
                 LIMIT 1) pol ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN public.inv_purchase_requests pr ON ((((p.receipt_type = 'PR-RECEIPT'::text) AND (pr.pr_no = p.source_ref)) OR ((p.receipt_type = 'PO-RECEIPT'::text) AND (pr.pr_no = pol.source_ref)))))
        ), inventory_rows AS (
         SELECT (e.ledger_id)::text AS receipt_id,
            COALESCE(e.grn_no, (e.ledger_id)::text) AS grn_no,
            (timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, e.receipt_created_at))::date AS grn_date,
            timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, e.receipt_created_at) AS grn_datetime,
            e.receipt_type,
            e.source_ref,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(e.po_no_for_match, ''::text), ''::text) AS po_no,
            (e.po_id)::text AS po_id,

            e.po_status,
            (e.po_line_id)::text AS po_line_id,

            e.po_source_ref,
            COALESCE(e.pr_no,
                CASE
                    WHEN (e.receipt_type = 'PR-RECEIPT'::text) THEN e.source_ref
                    ELSE ''::text
                END, ''::text) AS pr_no,
            e.pr_status,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(e.ledger_department), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(e.po_line_department), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(e.pr_department), ''::text), 'Unassigned'::text) AS department,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(e.po_line_job_ref), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(e.pr_job_ref), ''::text), ''::text) AS job_ref,
            COALESCE(e.item_code, ''::text) AS item_code,
            COALESCE(e.item_name, ''::text) AS item_name,
            e.item_category,
            e.item_uom AS uom,
            e.location,
            e.batch_no,
            (e.receipt_qty)::numeric(18,4) AS receipt_qty,
            (e.receipt_rate)::numeric(18,4) AS receipt_rate,
            (e.basic_value)::numeric(18,2) AS basic_value,
            (e.tax_pct)::numeric(8,2) AS tax_pct,
            round(((e.basic_value * e.tax_pct) / 100.0), 2) AS tax_value,
            round((e.basic_value + ((e.basic_value * e.tax_pct) / 100.0)), 2) AS total_value,
            COALESCE(e.po_vendor_name, ''::text) AS vendor_name,
            COALESCE(e.supplier_invoice_no, ''::text) AS supplier_invoice_no,
            e.supplier_invoice_date_text AS supplier_invoice_date,
            COALESCE(e.challan_no, ''::text) AS challan_no,
            e.challan_date_text AS challan_date,
            COALESCE(e.payment_terms, ''::text) AS payment_terms,
            COALESCE(e.freight_terms, ''::text) AS freight_terms,
            e.remarks
           FROM inventory_enriched e
        ), tooling_artwork AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text), (((a.so_id)::text || '||'::text) || (a.line_no)::text)) AS artwork_key,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text)) AS artwork_no,
            max(a.product_type) AS artwork_product_type,
            max(so.so_number) AS so_number,
            max(sol.line_no) AS so_line_no,
            max(sol.division) AS so_line_division,

             LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = a.so_id)))

          WHERE (COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text), (((a.so_id)::text || '||'::text) || (a.line_no)::text)) IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text), (((a.so_id)::text || '||'::text) || (a.line_no)::text))
        ), tooling_receipts AS (

            ''::text AS pr_no,
            ''::text AS pr_status,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(ta.so_line_division), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(ta.artwork_product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'Flexo'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(ta.artwork_product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'Digital'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(ta.artwork_product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'Corrugation'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(ta.artwork_product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(ta.artwork_product_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLAT%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(ta.artwork_product_type, ''::text)
