                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(btrim(COALESCE(pol.department, ''::text))) = ANY (ARRAY['TOOLING'::text, 'PREPRESS'::text, 'PRE-PRESS'::text, 'PRE PRESS'::text, 'PLATE'::text, 'DIE'::text])) THEN NULL::text
                    ELSE NULLIF(btrim(pol.department), ''::text)
                END, 'Tooling'::text) AS department,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(r.job_ref), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(pol.job_ref), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(r.so_refs), ''::text), ''::text) AS job_ref,
            COALESCE(pol.item_code, ''::text) AS item_code,
            COALESCE(pol.item_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(r.source_type, pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text])) THEN 'Plate'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(r.source_type, pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) THEN 'Die'::text
                    ELSE 'Plate / Die'::text
                END, ''::text) AS item_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(r.source_type, pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text])) THEN 'Plate'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(r.source_type, pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) THEN 'Die'::text
                    ELSE 'Tooling'::text
                END AS item_category,
            'Pcs'::text AS uom,
            ''::text AS location,
            ''::text AS batch_no,
            (COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,4) AS receipt_qty,
            (COALESCE(r.rate, pol.rate, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,4) AS receipt_rate,
            (abs((COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(NULLIF(r.rate, (0)::numeric), pol.rate, (0)::numeric))))::numeric(18,2) AS basic_value,
            (COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric))::numeric(8,2) AS tax_pct,
            round(((abs((COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(NULLIF(r.rate, (0)::numeric), pol.rate, (0)::numeric))) * COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric)) / 100.0), 2) AS tax_value,
            round((abs((COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(NULLIF(r.rate, (0)::numeric), pol.rate, (0)::numeric))) * ((1)::numeric + (COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) / 100.0))), 2) AS total_value,
            COALESCE(po.vendor_name, ''::text) AS vendor_name,
            ''::text AS supplier_invoice_no,
            NULL::text AS supplier_invoice_date,
            COALESCE(r.challan_no, ''::text) AS challan_no,
            (r.receipt_date)::text AS challan_date,
            COALESCE(po.payment_terms, ''::text) AS payment_terms,
            COALESCE(po.freight_terms, ''::text) AS freight_terms,
            COALESCE(r.remarks, ''::text) AS remarks
           FROM (((public.purchase_po_receipts r
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_order_lines pol ON ((pol.id = r.po_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON ((po.po_no = COALESCE(r.po_no, pol.po_no))))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ta1.artwork_key,
                    ta1.artwork_no,
                    ta1.artwork_product_type,
                    ta1.so_number,
                    ta1.so_line_no,
                    ta1.so_line_division,
                    ta1.so_line_category
                   FROM tooling_artwork ta1
                  WHERE ((ta1.artwork_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(r.artwork_no, ''::text), NULLIF(r.source_ref, ''::text), NULLIF(pol.source_ref, ''::text))) OR (ta1.artwork_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(r.artwork_no, ''::text), NULLIF(r.source_ref, ''::text), NULLIF(pol.source_ref, ''::text))))
                  ORDER BY
                        CASE
                            WHEN (ta1.artwork_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(r.artwork_no, ''::text), NULLIF(r.source_ref, ''::text), NULLIF(pol.source_ref, ''::text))) THEN 0
                            ELSE 1
                        END
                 LIMIT 1) ta ON (true))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(r.source_type, pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) AND (COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (upper(COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        )
 SELECT inventory_rows.receipt_id,

-- TOC entry 537 (class 1259 OID 149760)
-- Name: v_report_dispatch_discrepancy_lines; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_dispatch_discrepancy_lines WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH billing_base AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            min(inv.invoice_date) AS first_invoice_date,
            max(inv.invoice_date) AS last_invoice_date,
            max(inv.created_at) AS last_billed_at,
            (count(DISTINCT il.invoice_id))::integer AS invoice_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(inv.invoice_no, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(inv.invoice_no, ''::text)) AS invoice_nos,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS billed_qty
           FROM (public.invoice_lines il
             JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
          WHERE ((il.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) <> 'CHALLAN'::text) AND (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) !~~ 'DC-H/%'::text))
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        ), packing_base AS (
         SELECT pr.so_line_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS packing_entry_count,
            sum(COALESCE(pr.packed_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS packed_qty,
            max(COALESCE(pr.produced_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS packing_produced_qty,
            max(pr.packed_at) AS last_packed_at
           FROM public.packing_records pr
          WHERE (pr.so_line_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY pr.so_line_id
        ), packing_queue_base AS (
         SELECT pq.so_line_id,
            max(NULLIF(pq.department_category, ''::text)) AS department_category,
            max(NULLIF(pq.artwork_no, ''::text)) AS artwork_no,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(pq.wo_number, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(pq.wo_number, ''::text)) AS packing_queue_wo_numbers,
            max(pq.wo_date) AS latest_packing_queue_wo_date,
            max(COALESCE(pq.produced_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS queue_produced_qty,
            max(COALESCE(pq.packed_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS queue_packed_qty
           FROM public.v_packing_queue_fast pq
          WHERE (pq.so_line_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY pq.so_line_id
        ), wo_base AS (
         SELECT sol.id AS so_line_id,
            (count(DISTINCT woj.wo_id))::integer AS wo_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo.wo_number, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo.wo_number, ''::text)) AS wo_numbers,
            min(wo.wo_date) AS first_wo_date,
            max(wo.wo_date) AS latest_wo_date
           FROM (((public.sales_order_lines sol
             JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = sol.so_id)))
             JOIN public.work_order_jobs woj ON (((woj.so_number = so.so_number) AND ((woj.line_no)::text = (sol.line_no)::text))))
             LEFT JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
          GROUP BY sol.id
        ), production_direct AS (
         SELECT pe.so_number,
            pe.line_no,
            (count(*))::integer AS production_entry_count,
            max(pe.entry_datetime) AS last_production_at,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS direct_ok_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS direct_produced_qty
           FROM public.production_entries pe
          WHERE ((COALESCE(pe.so_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(pe.line_no, ''::text) <> ''::text))
          GROUP BY pe.so_number, pe.line_no
        ), artwork_ranked AS (
         SELECT a.so_id,
            a.line_no,
            a.artwork_no,
            a.product_type,
            a.status AS artwork_status,
            a.artwork_at,
            a.approved_at AS artwork_approved_at,
            COALESCE(a.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric) AS stock_qty_to_bill,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.so_id, a.line_no ORDER BY a.approved_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.artwork_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.id DESC) AS rn
           FROM public.artworks a
        ), base AS (
         SELECT so.id AS so_id,
            sol.id AS so_line_id,
            so.so_number,
            so.so_date,
            so.po_number,
            so.po_date,
            so.sales_rep,
            COALESCE(c_1.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            sol.line_no,
            sol.product_code,
            sol.product_name,
            sol.category,
            sol.division,
            COALESCE(pq.department_category, ar.product_type, sol.division, sol.category, 'Unassigned'::text) AS department,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            sol.unit,
            COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
            COALESCE(sol.net_amount, sol.amount, sol.total_amount, sol.line_total, (COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS order_value,
            COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_line_status,
            COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_status,
            ar.artwork_no,
            ar.product_type,
            COALESCE(ar.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text) AS artwork_status,
            ar.artwork_at,
            ar.artwork_approved_at,
            COALESCE(ar.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric) AS stock_qty_to_bill,
            COALESCE(wb.wo_count, 0) AS wo_count,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wb.wo_numbers, ''::text), pq.packing_queue_wo_numbers, ''::text) AS wo_numbers,
            wb.first_wo_date,
            COALESCE(wb.latest_wo_date, pq.latest_packing_queue_wo_date) AS latest_wo_date,
            COALESCE(pb.packing_entry_count, 0) AS packing_entry_count,
            COALESCE(pb.packed_qty, pq.queue_packed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS packed_qty,
            GREATEST(COALESCE(pb.packing_produced_qty, (0)::numeric), COALESCE(pq.queue_produced_qty, (0)::numeric), COALESCE(pd.direct_ok_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS production_completed_qty,
            pb.last_packed_at,
            COALESCE(pd.production_entry_count, 0) AS production_entry_count,
            COALESCE(pd.direct_ok_qty, (0)::numeric) AS production_entry_ok_qty,
            COALESCE(pd.direct_produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS production_entry_produced_qty,
            pd.last_production_at,
            COALESCE(bb.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count,
            COALESCE(bb.invoice_nos, ''::text) AS invoice_nos,
            COALESCE(bb.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
            bb.first_invoice_date,
            bb.last_invoice_date,
            bb.last_billed_at
           FROM ((((((((billing_base bb
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.id = bb.so_line_id)))
             JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = sol.so_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c_1 ON ((c_1.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN artwork_ranked ar ON (((ar.so_id = so.id) AND (ar.line_no = sol.line_no) AND (ar.rn = 1))))
             LEFT JOIN wo_base wb ON ((wb.so_line_id = sol.id)))
             LEFT JOIN packing_base pb ON ((pb.so_line_id = sol.id)))
             LEFT JOIN packing_queue_base pq ON ((pq.so_line_id = sol.id)))
             LEFT JOIN production_direct pd ON (((pd.so_number = so.so_number) AND (pd.line_no = (sol.line_no)::text))))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.remarks, ''::text)) !~~ '%SYSTEM GENERATED FOR MANUAL BILLING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT b.so_id,
            b.so_line_id,
            b.so_number,
            b.so_date,
            b.po_number,
            b.po_date,
            b.sales_rep,
            b.client_name,
            b.line_no,
            b.product_code,
            b.product_name,
            b.category,
            b.division,
            b.department,
            b.order_qty,
            b.unit,
            b.rate,
            b.order_value,
            b.so_line_status,
            b.so_status,
            b.artwork_no,
            b.product_type,
            b.artwork_status,
            b.artwork_at,
            b.artwork_approved_at,
            b.stock_qty_to_bill,
            b.wo_count,
            b.wo_numbers,
            b.first_wo_date,
            b.latest_wo_date,
            b.packing_entry_count,
            b.packed_qty,
            b.production_completed_qty,
            b.last_packed_at,
            b.production_entry_count,
            b.production_entry_ok_qty,
            b.production_entry_produced_qty,
            b.last_production_at,
            b.invoice_count,
            b.invoice_nos,
            b.billed_qty,
            b.first_invoice_date,
            b.last_invoice_date,
            b.last_billed_at,
            b.last_invoice_date AS review_date,
            COALESCE(b.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS review_qty,
            GREATEST((COALESCE(b.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(b.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS required_current_process_qty,
            GREATEST(((COALESCE(b.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(b.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(b.production_completed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS production_short_qty,
            GREATEST(((COALESCE(b.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(b.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(b.packed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS packing_short_qty,
            (0)::numeric AS billed_without_dispatch_qty,
            GREATEST((COALESCE(b.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(b.order_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS over_dispatch_qty
           FROM base b
        )
 SELECT so_id,
    so_line_id,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    po_number,
    po_date,
    sales_rep,
    client_name,
    line_no,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    category,
    division,
    department,
    order_qty,
    unit,
    rate,
    round(order_value, 2) AS order_value,
    so_status,
    so_line_status,
    artwork_no,
    product_type,
    artwork_status,
    artwork_at,
    artwork_approved_at,
    wo_count,
    wo_numbers,
    first_wo_date,
    latest_wo_date,
    NULL::date AS first_dispatch_date,
    NULL::date AS last_dispatch_date,
    review_date,
    NULL::timestamp without time zone AS last_dispatch_at,
    0 AS dispatch_entry_count,
    ''::text AS dispatch_nos,
    ''::text AS dispatch_dates,
    (0)::numeric AS dispatched_qty,
    invoice_count,
    invoice_nos,
    round(billed_qty, 3) AS billed_qty,
    first_invoice_date,
    last_invoice_date,
    last_billed_at,
    production_entry_count,
    round(production_entry_ok_qty, 3) AS production_entry_ok_qty,
    round(production_entry_produced_qty, 3) AS production_entry_produced_qty,
    round(production_completed_qty, 3) AS production_completed_qty,
    last_production_at,
    packing_entry_count,
    round(packed_qty, 3) AS packed_qty,
    last_packed_at,
    round(stock_qty_to_bill, 3) AS stock_qty_to_bill,
    round(review_qty, 3) AS review_qty,
    round(required_current_process_qty, 3) AS required_current_process_qty,
    round(production_short_qty, 3) AS production_short_qty,
    round(packing_short_qty, 3) AS packing_short_qty,
    round(billed_without_dispatch_qty, 3) AS billed_without_dispatch_qty,
    round(over_dispatch_qty, 3) AS over_dispatch_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN ((production_short_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (packing_short_qty > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PRODUCTION_AND_PACKING_SHORT'::text
            WHEN (production_short_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PRODUCTION_SHORT'::text
            WHEN (packing_short_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PACKING_SHORT'::text
            WHEN (over_dispatch_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'BILLED_MORE_THAN_ORDER'::text
            ELSE 'OK'::text
        END AS discrepancy_status,
    concat_ws(' | '::text,
        CASE
            WHEN (production_short_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN ('Production short '::text || (round(production_short_qty, 3))::text)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (packing_short_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN ('Packing short '::text || (round(packing_short_qty, 3))::text)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (over_dispatch_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN ('Billed > order by '::text || (round(over_dispatch_qty, 3))::text)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END) AS discrepancy_reason
   FROM calc c
  WHERE ((production_short_qty > (0)::numeric) OR (packing_short_qty > (0)::numeric) OR (over_dispatch_qty > (0)::numeric));


--
-- TOC entry 509 (class 1259 OID 128101)
-- Name: v_report_dispatch_register; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_dispatch_register AS
 WITH dispatch_line_base AS (
         SELECT dr_1.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(dr_1.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS line_dispatched_qty
           FROM public.dispatch_records dr_1
          WHERE (dr_1.so_line_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY dr_1.so_line_id
        ), invoice_base AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS billed_qty
           FROM public.invoice_lines il
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        )
 SELECT dr.id AS dispatch_id,
    dr.dispatch_no,
    dr.dispatch_date,
    dr.created_at,
    dr.so_id,
    dr.so_line_id,
    COALESCE(dr.so_number, so.so_number) AS so_number,
    so.so_date,
    COALESCE(dr.line_no, sol.line_no) AS line_no,
    so.client_code,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code) AS client_name,
    so.sales_rep,
    COALESCE(sol.division, ''::text) AS division,
    COALESCE(sol.product_code, dr.product_code, ''::text) AS product_code,
    COALESCE(sol.product_name, dr.product_name, ''::text) AS product_name,
    COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text) AS category,
    COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
    COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric) AS dispatch_qty,
    COALESCE(dlb.line_dispatched_qty, COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS line_dispatched_qty,
    COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
    GREATEST((COALESCE(dlb.line_dispatched_qty, COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS unbilled_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(dlb.line_dispatched_qty, COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) >= COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric))) THEN 'FULLY_DISPATCHED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(dlb.line_dispatched_qty, COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PARTIAL_DISPATCHED'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING'::text
        END AS dispatch_status,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) >= COALESCE(dlb.line_dispatched_qty, COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric))) AND (COALESCE(dlb.line_dispatched_qty, COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'BILLED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PARTIAL_BILLED'::text
            ELSE 'UNBILLED'::text
        END AS billing_status,
    sol.expected_delivery,
    sol.final_delivery,
    dr.transporter,
    dr.vehicle_no,
    dr.lr_no
   FROM (((((public.dispatch_records dr
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.id = dr.so_line_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = COALESCE(dr.so_id, sol.so_id))))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN dispatch_line_base dlb ON ((dlb.so_line_id = dr.so_line_id)))
     LEFT JOIN invoice_base ib ON ((ib.so_line_id = dr.so_line_id)))
  WHERE ((COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text));


--
-- TOC entry 563 (class 1259 OID 171850)
-- Name: v_report_job_process_cost_lines; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_job_process_cost_lines AS
 WITH line_base AS (
         SELECT so.id AS so_id,
            sol.id AS so_line_id,
            so.so_number,
            COALESCE(so.so_date, (so.created_at)::date) AS so_date,
            so.client_code,
            COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code) AS client_name,
            so.sales_rep,
            sol.line_no,
            sol.division,
            sol.product_code,
            sol.product_name,
            sol.category,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            COALESCE(sol.unit, ''::text) AS unit,
            COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
            COALESCE(sol.job_reference, ''::text) AS sales_job_reference,
            COALESCE(i.length_mm, (0)::numeric) AS item_length_mm,
            COALESCE(i.width_mm, (0)::numeric) AS item_width_mm,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(i.length_mm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(i.width_mm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN (COALESCE(i.length_mm, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(i.width_mm, (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS job_area_mm2,
            COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_line_status
           FROM (((public.sales_orders so
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN public.items i ON ((upper(i.item_code) = upper(sol.product_code))))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        ), entry_raw AS (
         SELECT pe.id AS production_entry_id,
            pe.wo_id AS entry_wo_id,
            pe.routing_id,
            COALESCE(pe.wo_id, wor.wo_id) AS wo_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.so_number, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'SO:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text), NULLIF(wor.so_number, ''::text)) AS entry_so_number,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.line_no, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'LINE:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text), NULLIF(wor.line_no, ''::text)) AS entry_line_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM "substring"(COALESCE(pe.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'JOBREF:([^|]+)'::text)), ''::text)) AS entry_job_reference,
            pe.entry_datetime,
            pe.start_datetime,
            pe.end_datetime,
            pe.run_hours,
            pe.downtime_reason,
            pe.downtime_minutes,
            pe.machine,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(wor.department, ''::text), 'Production'::text) AS production_stage,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.planned_machine, ''::text), NULLIF(pe.machine, ''::text), 'Unassigned'::text) AS production_machine,
            wor.sequence_no AS stage_sequence,
            COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) AS good_qty,
            COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS produced_qty,
            COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric) AS rejected_qty
           FROM (public.production_entries pe
             LEFT JOIN public.work_order_routing wor ON ((wor.id = pe.routing_id)))
          WHERE ((pe.entry_datetime IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) > (0)::numeric))
        ), entry_candidates_exact AS (

            COALESCE(NULLIF(er.entry_job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(lb.sales_job_reference, ''::text), ''::text) AS job_reference,

                UNION ALL
                 SELECT NULL::text AS job_reference,
                    GREATEST(COALESCE(lb.order_qty, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS job_qty
                  WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM public.work_order_jobs woj2
                          WHERE ((woj2.wo_id = er.wo_id) AND (woj2.so_number = lb.so_number) AND ((woj2.line_no)::text = (lb.line_no)::text) AND ((COALESCE(er.entry_job_reference, ''::text) = ''::text) OR (COALESCE(woj2.job_reference, ''::text) = er.entry_job_reference))))))) woj ON (true))
        ), entry_candidates_wo_fallback AS (

          WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM line_base exact_lb
                  WHERE ((exact_lb.so_number = er.entry_so_number) AND ((exact_lb.line_no)::text = btrim(er.entry_line_no))))))
        ), entry_candidates AS (

            entry_candidates_wo_fallback.so_id,

        ), entry_base AS (
         SELECT ec.so_id,
            ec.so_line_id,
            ec.so_number,
            ec.so_date,
            ec.client_code,
            ec.client_name,
            ec.sales_rep,
            ec.line_no,
            ec.division,
            ec.product_code,
            ec.product_name,
            ec.category,
            ec.order_qty,
            ec.unit,
            ec.rate,
            ec.so_line_status,
            ec.item_length_mm,
            ec.item_width_mm,
            ec.job_area_mm2,
            ec.candidate_area_mm2,
            ec.entry_share,
            ec.cost_allocation_basis,
            ec.job_key,
            ec.job_reference,
            ec.production_entry_id,
            ec.routing_id,
            ec.production_stage,
            ec.production_machine,
            regexp_replace(upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(ec.production_machine, ''::text), 'UNASSIGNED'::text)), '[^A-Z0-9]+'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) AS machine_key,
            ec.stage_sequence,
            (timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, COALESCE(ec.end_datetime, ec.entry_datetime)))::date AS production_date,
            timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, COALESCE(ec.end_datetime, ec.entry_datetime)) AS entry_local_ts,
            (ec.good_qty * ec.entry_share) AS good_qty,
            (ec.produced_qty * ec.entry_share) AS produced_qty,
            (ec.rejected_qty * ec.entry_share) AS rejected_qty,
            (GREATEST(COALESCE(ec.downtime_minutes, (NULLIF("substring"(COALESCE(ec.downtime_reason, ''::text), 'DOWN:[[:space:]]*([0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*)[[:space:]]*min'::text), ''::text))::numeric, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) * ec.entry_share) AS downtime_minutes,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(ec.run_hours, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (ec.run_hours * ec.entry_share)
                    WHEN ((ec.start_datetime IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(ec.end_datetime, ec.entry_datetime) > ec.start_datetime)) THEN ((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(ec.end_datetime, ec.entry_datetime) - ec.start_datetime)) / 3600.0) * ec.entry_share)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS entry_run_hours

                    ec_1.produced_qty,
                    ec_1.rejected_qty,
                    ec_1.so_id,
                    ec_1.so_line_id,
                    ec_1.so_number,
                    ec_1.so_date,
                    ec_1.client_code,
                    ec_1.client_name,
                    ec_1.sales_rep,
                    ec_1.line_no,
                    ec_1.division,
                    ec_1.product_code,
                    ec_1.product_name,
                    ec_1.category,
                    ec_1.order_qty,
                    ec_1.unit,
                    ec_1.rate,
                    ec_1.so_line_status,
                    ec_1.item_length_mm,
                    ec_1.item_width_mm,
                    ec_1.job_area_mm2,
                    ec_1.job_key,
                    ec_1.job_reference,
                    ec_1.candidate_qty,
                    ec_1.candidate_area_mm2,
                        CASE
                            WHEN ((count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ec_1.production_entry_id) > 0) AND (min(COALESCE(ec_1.candidate_area_mm2, (0)::numeric)) OVER (PARTITION BY ec_1.production_entry_id) > (0)::numeric)) THEN (ec_1.candidate_area_mm2 / NULLIF(sum(ec_1.candidate_area_mm2) OVER (PARTITION BY ec_1.production_entry_id), (0)::numeric))
                            ELSE ((1)::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ec_1.production_entry_id), 0))::numeric)
                        END AS entry_share,
                        CASE
                            WHEN ((count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ec_1.production_entry_id) > 0) AND (min(COALESCE(ec_1.candidate_area_mm2, (0)::numeric)) OVER (PARTITION BY ec_1.production_entry_id) > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'JOB_AREA'::text
                            ELSE 'EQUAL_FALLBACK_MISSING_SIZE'::text
                        END AS cost_allocation_basis
                   FROM entry_candidates ec_1) ec
        ), entry_with_net_hours AS (
         SELECT eb.so_id,
            eb.so_line_id,
            eb.so_number,
            eb.so_date,
            eb.client_code,
            eb.client_name,
            eb.sales_rep,
            eb.line_no,
            eb.division,
            eb.product_code,
            eb.product_name,
            eb.category,
            eb.order_qty,
            eb.unit,
            eb.rate,
            eb.so_line_status,
            eb.item_length_mm,
            eb.item_width_mm,
            eb.job_area_mm2,
            eb.candidate_area_mm2,
            eb.entry_share,
            eb.cost_allocation_basis,
            eb.job_key,
            eb.job_reference,
            eb.production_entry_id,
            eb.routing_id,
            eb.production_stage,
            eb.production_machine,
            eb.machine_key,
            eb.stage_sequence,
            eb.production_date,
            eb.entry_local_ts,

            eb.rejected_qty,
            eb.downtime_minutes,
            eb.entry_run_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN (eb.entry_run_hours IS NOT NULL) THEN GREATEST((eb.entry_run_hours - (COALESCE(eb.downtime_minutes, (0)::numeric) / 60.0)), (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS entry_net_hours
           FROM entry_base eb
        ), machine_day_totals AS (
         SELECT eb.production_date,
            eb.machine_key,
            eb.production_machine,
            max(eb.entry_local_ts) AS last_entry_local_ts,
            sum(eb.good_qty) AS machine_day_good_qty,
            (sum(eb.downtime_minutes) / 60.0) AS machine_day_downtime_hours,
            sum(eb.entry_net_hours) FILTER (WHERE (eb.entry_net_hours IS NOT NULL)) AS machine_day_actual_net_hours,
            count(DISTINCT eb.production_entry_id) FILTER (WHERE (eb.entry_net_hours IS NOT NULL)) AS machine_day_actual_hour_entry_count
           FROM entry_with_net_hours eb
          GROUP BY eb.production_date, eb.machine_key, eb.production_machine
        ), machine_day_hours AS (
         SELECT mdt.production_date,
            mdt.machine_key,
            mdt.production_machine,
            mdt.last_entry_local_ts,
            mdt.machine_day_good_qty,
            mdt.machine_day_downtime_hours,

            mdt.machine_day_actual_hour_entry_count,
            round(((8)::numeric +
                CASE
                    WHEN ((mdt.last_entry_local_ts)::time without time zone > '17:30:00'::time without time zone) THEN (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (mdt.last_entry_local_ts - ((mdt.production_date)::timestamp without time zone + ('17:30:00'::time without time zone)::interval))) / 3600.0)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END), 2) AS working_hours,
            round(GREATEST((((8)::numeric +
                CASE
                    WHEN ((mdt.last_entry_local_ts)::time without time zone > '17:30:00'::time without time zone) THEN (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (mdt.last_entry_local_ts - ((mdt.production_date)::timestamp without time zone + ('17:30:00'::time without time zone)::interval))) / 3600.0)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) - COALESCE(mdt.machine_day_downtime_hours, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), 2) AS net_production_hours
           FROM machine_day_totals mdt
        ), job_stage_day AS (
         SELECT eb.so_id,
            eb.so_line_id,
            eb.so_number,
            eb.so_date,
            eb.client_code,
            eb.client_name,
            eb.sales_rep,
            eb.line_no,

            sum(eb.entry_net_hours) FILTER (WHERE (eb.entry_net_hours IS NOT NULL)) AS actual_process_hours,
            sum(eb.good_qty) AS good_qty,

          GROUP BY eb.so_id, eb.so_line_id, eb.so_number, eb.so_date, eb.client_code, eb.client_name, eb.sales_rep, eb.line_no, eb.division, eb.product_code, eb.product_name, eb.category, eb.order_qty, eb.unit, eb.rate, eb.so_line_status, eb.item_length_mm, eb.item_width_mm, eb.job_area_mm2, eb.cost_allocation_basis, eb.job_key, eb.job_reference, eb.routing_id, eb.production_stage, eb.production_machine, eb.machine_key, eb.stage_sequence, eb.production_date
        ), cost_base AS (
         SELECT jsd.so_id,
            jsd.so_line_id,
            jsd.so_number,
            jsd.so_date,
            jsd.client_code,
            jsd.client_name,
            jsd.sales_rep,
            jsd.line_no,
            jsd.division,
            jsd.product_code,
            jsd.product_name,
            jsd.category,
            jsd.order_qty,
            jsd.unit,
            jsd.rate,
            jsd.so_line_status,
            jsd.item_length_mm,
            jsd.item_width_mm,
            jsd.job_area_mm2,
            jsd.cost_allocation_basis,
            jsd.job_key,
            jsd.job_reference,
            jsd.routing_id,
            jsd.production_stage,
            jsd.production_machine,
            jsd.machine_key,
            jsd.stage_sequence,
            jsd.production_date,
            jsd.production_entry_count,
            jsd.actual_hour_entry_count,
            jsd.actual_process_hours,
            jsd.good_qty,
            jsd.produced_qty,
            jsd.rejected_qty,
            jsd.first_production_at,
            jsd.last_production_at,
            mdh.working_hours,
            mdh.machine_day_downtime_hours,
            mdh.net_production_hours AS machine_day_net_hours,
            mdh.machine_day_actual_net_hours,
            mdh.machine_day_actual_hour_entry_count,
            mdh.machine_day_good_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(mdh.machine_day_good_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((mdh.net_production_hours * jsd.good_qty) / NULLIF(mdh.machine_day_good_qty, (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS allocated_process_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((jsd.actual_hour_entry_count = jsd.production_entry_count) AND (jsd.production_entry_count > 0)) THEN COALESCE(jsd.actual_process_hours, (0)::numeric)
                    WHEN (jsd.actual_hour_entry_count > 0) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN (COALESCE(mdh.machine_day_good_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((mdh.net_production_hours * jsd.good_qty) / NULLIF(mdh.machine_day_good_qty, (0)::numeric))
                        ELSE (0)::numeric
                    END
                    ELSE
                    CASE
                        WHEN (COALESCE(mdh.machine_day_good_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((mdh.net_production_hours * jsd.good_qty) / NULLIF(mdh.machine_day_good_qty, (0)::numeric))
                        ELSE (0)::numeric
                    END
                END AS process_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((jsd.actual_hour_entry_count = jsd.production_entry_count) AND (jsd.production_entry_count > 0)) THEN 'ACTUAL_ENTRY_HOURS'::text
                    WHEN (jsd.actual_hour_entry_count > 0) THEN 'ALLOCATED_PARTIAL_ACTUAL'::text
                    ELSE 'ALLOCATED_MACHINE_DAY'::text
                END AS hours_source
           FROM (job_stage_day jsd
             JOIN machine_day_hours mdh ON (((mdh.production_date = jsd.production_date) AND (mdh.machine_key = jsd.machine_key))))
        )
 SELECT cb.so_id,
    cb.so_line_id,
    cb.so_number,
    cb.so_date,
    cb.client_code,
    cb.client_name,
    cb.sales_rep,
    cb.line_no,
    cb.division,
    cb.product_code,
    cb.product_name,
    cb.category,
    cb.order_qty,
    cb.unit,
    cb.rate,
    cb.so_line_status,
    cb.job_key,
    cb.job_reference,
    cb.routing_id,
    cb.production_stage,
    cb.production_machine,
    cb.machine_key,
    cb.stage_sequence,
    cb.production_date,
    cb.production_entry_count,
    cb.actual_hour_entry_count,
    cb.hours_source,
    round(cb.good_qty, 3) AS good_qty,
    round(cb.produced_qty, 3) AS produced_qty,
    round(cb.rejected_qty, 3) AS rejected_qty,
    round(cb.working_hours, 2) AS machine_day_working_hours,
    round(cb.machine_day_downtime_hours, 2) AS machine_day_downtime_hours,
    round(cb.machine_day_net_hours, 2) AS machine_day_net_hours,
    round(COALESCE(cb.machine_day_actual_net_hours, (0)::numeric), 4) AS machine_day_actual_net_hours,
    cb.machine_day_actual_hour_entry_count,
    round(cb.machine_day_good_qty, 3) AS machine_day_good_qty,
    round(COALESCE(cb.actual_process_hours, (0)::numeric), 4) AS actual_process_hours,
    round(COALESCE(cb.allocated_process_hours, (0)::numeric), 4) AS allocated_process_hours,
    round(COALESCE(cb.process_hours, (0)::numeric), 4) AS process_hours,
    COALESCE(mhr.mhr, (0)::numeric) AS mhr,
    round((COALESCE(cb.process_hours, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(mhr.mhr, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS process_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN (mhr.id IS NULL) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS mhr_missing,
    cb.first_production_at,
    cb.last_production_at,
    round(COALESCE(cb.item_length_mm, (0)::numeric), 3) AS job_length_mm,
    round(COALESCE(cb.item_width_mm, (0)::numeric), 3) AS job_width_mm,
    round(COALESCE(cb.job_area_mm2, (0)::numeric), 3) AS job_area_mm2,
    COALESCE(cb.cost_allocation_basis, ''::text) AS cost_allocation_basis
   FROM (cost_base cb
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.id,
            r.mhr
           FROM public.machine_hour_rates r
          WHERE ((r.active = true) AND (r.machine_key = cb.machine_key) AND (r.effective_from <= cb.production_date) AND ((r.effective_to IS NULL) OR (r.effective_to >= cb.production_date)))
          ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC, r.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) mhr ON (true));

                    WHEN bool_or((COALESCE(r.remaining_qty, (0)::numeric) > 0.0001)) THEN 'PENDING'::text
                    ELSE 'ISSUED'::text
                END AS rm_material_status,
            string_agg(concat_ws(': '::text, NULLIF(COALESCE(r.item_label, r.material_key, ''::text), ''::text), ((((('Req '::text || (round(COALESCE(r.required_qty, (0)::numeric), 3))::text) || ', Issued '::text) || (round(COALESCE(r.net_issued_qty, (0)::numeric), 3))::text) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(r.remaining_qty, (0)::numeric) > 0.0001) THEN (', Pending '::text || (round(COALESCE(r.remaining_qty, (0)::numeric), 3))::text)
                    ELSE ''::text

                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(r.excess_qty, (0)::numeric) > 0.0001) THEN (', Excess '::text || (round(COALESCE(r.excess_qty, (0)::numeric), 3))::text)
                    ELSE ''::text
                END)), ' | '::text ORDER BY r.item_label, r.material_key) AS rm_material_detail
           FROM public.inv_wo_issue_requirement_reconciled_v r
          GROUP BY r.wo_id
        ), job_rm_cost AS (
         SELECT wjs.so_line_id,
            wjs.job_key,
            max(COALESCE(wjs.job_area_mm2, (0)::numeric)) AS job_area_mm2,
            max(COALESCE(wjs.total_wo_job_area_mm2, (0)::numeric)) AS total_wo_job_area_mm2,
            max(COALESCE(wjs.wo_share, (0)::numeric)) AS wo_cost_allocation_share,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wjs.cost_allocation_basis, ''::text), ', '::text) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(wjs.cost_allocation_basis, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS cost_allocation_basis,
            sum(COALESCE(ib.issued_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS rm_issued_qty,
            sum((COALESCE(ib.issued_value, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(wjs.wo_share, (0)::numeric))) AS rm_issued_value,
            sum(COALESCE(mb.rm_required_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS rm_required_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(mb.rm_net_issued_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS rm_net_issued_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(mb.rm_pending_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS rm_pending_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(mb.rm_excess_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS rm_excess_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(mb.rm_pending_material_lines, (0)::bigint)) AS rm_pending_material_lines,
            sum(COALESCE(mb.rm_excess_material_lines, (0)::bigint)) AS rm_excess_material_lines,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or((COALESCE(mb.rm_material_status, ''::text) = 'EXCESS'::text)) THEN 'EXCESS'::text
                    WHEN bool_or((COALESCE(mb.rm_material_status, ''::text) = 'PENDING'::text)) THEN 'PENDING'::text
                    WHEN bool_or((COALESCE(mb.rm_material_status, ''::text) = 'ISSUED'::text)) THEN 'ISSUED'::text
                    ELSE 'NO_MATERIAL'::text
                END AS rm_material_status,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(mb.rm_material_detail, ''::text), ' | '::text) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(mb.rm_material_detail, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS rm_material_detail
           FROM ((wo_job_share wjs
             LEFT JOIN issue_base ib ON ((ib.wo_id = wjs.wo_id)))
             LEFT JOIN material_base mb ON ((mb.wo_id = wjs.wo_id)))
          GROUP BY wjs.so_line_id, wjs.job_key
        ), production_stage_base AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(lb.sales_job_reference, ''::text), ((lb.so_number || '||'::text) || (lb.line_no)::text)) AS job_key,
            pe.routing_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(wor.department, ''::text), 'Production'::text) AS stage_name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.planned_machine, ''::text), NULLIF(pe.machine, ''::text), ''::text) AS stage_machine,
            wor.sequence_no,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS ok_qty,
            max(COALESCE(pe.entry_datetime, pe.created_at)) AS last_entry_at
           FROM (((public.production_entries pe
             JOIN line_base lb ON (((lb.so_number = pe.so_number) AND ((lb.line_no)::text = btrim(pe.line_no)))))
             LEFT JOIN public.work_order_routing wor ON ((wor.id = pe.routing_id)))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT woj1.job_reference
                   FROM public.work_order_jobs woj1
                  WHERE ((woj1.wo_id = pe.wo_id) AND (woj1.so_number = pe.so_number) AND ((woj1.line_no)::text = btrim(pe.line_no)))
                  ORDER BY
                        CASE
                            WHEN (COALESCE(woj1.job_reference, ''::text) = COALESCE(pe.job_reference, ''::text)) THEN 0
                            ELSE 1
                        END, woj1.id
                 LIMIT 1) woj ON (true))
          WHERE ((COALESCE(pe.so_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(pe.line_no, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) > (0)::numeric))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(lb.sales_job_reference, ''::text), ((lb.so_number || '||'::text) || (lb.line_no)::text)), pe.routing_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(wor.department, ''::text), 'Production'::text), COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.planned_machine, ''::text), NULLIF(pe.machine, ''::text), ''::text), wor.sequence_no
        ), production_stage_ranked AS (
         SELECT psb.so_line_id,
            psb.job_key,
            psb.routing_id,
            psb.stage_name,
            psb.stage_machine,
            psb.sequence_no,
            psb.ok_qty,
            psb.last_entry_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY psb.so_line_id, psb.job_key ORDER BY psb.sequence_no DESC NULLS LAST, psb.last_entry_at DESC NULLS LAST, psb.stage_name) AS rn
           FROM production_stage_base psb
        ), latest_production AS (
         SELECT production_stage_ranked.so_line_id,
            production_stage_ranked.job_key,
            production_stage_ranked.stage_name AS latest_production_stage,
            production_stage_ranked.stage_machine AS latest_production_machine,
            production_stage_ranked.ok_qty AS latest_stage_ok_qty,
            production_stage_ranked.last_entry_at AS latest_production_at
           FROM production_stage_ranked
          WHERE (production_stage_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), po_tooling_base AS (
         SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) THEN 'DIE'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text])) THEN 'PLATE'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS tooling_type,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pol.source_ref, ''::text), ''::text) AS source_ref,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pol.job_ref, ''::text), ''::text) AS job_ref,
            COALESCE(po.order_date, (pol.created_at)::date) AS event_date,
            abs(COALESCE(pol.amount, (0)::numeric)) AS basic_amount
           FROM (public.purchase_order_lines pol
             LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON ((po.po_no = pol.po_no)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        ), manual_tooling_base AS (
         SELECT upper(COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.type, ''::text)) AS tooling_type,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(purchase_artwork_procurement.artwork_key, ''::text), ''::text) AS artwork_key,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(purchase_artwork_procurement.artwork_no, ''::text), ''::text) AS artwork_no,
            COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.ordered_on, purchase_artwork_procurement.received_on, (purchase_artwork_procurement.created_at)::date) AS event_date,
            abs(COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.cost, (0)::numeric)) AS basic_amount
           FROM public.purchase_artwork_procurement
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(purchase_artwork_procurement.status, 'ACTIVE'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)
        ), line_tooling_direct AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text) THEN pt.basic_amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS plate_direct_cost,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text) THEN pt.basic_amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS die_direct_cost
           FROM (line_base lb
             LEFT JOIN po_tooling_base pt ON ((pt.source_ref = lb.fallback_artwork_key)))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id
        ), line_tooling_manual_direct AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (mt.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text) THEN mt.basic_amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS plate_manual_direct_cost,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (mt.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text) THEN mt.basic_amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS die_manual_direct_cost
           FROM (line_base lb
             LEFT JOIN manual_tooling_base mt ON ((mt.artwork_key = lb.fallback_artwork_key)))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id
        ), line_tooling_shared_po AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text) THEN pt.basic_amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS plate_shared_po_cost,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (pt.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text) THEN pt.basic_amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS die_shared_po_cost
           FROM (line_base lb
             LEFT JOIN po_tooling_base pt ON (((lb.artwork_no <> ''::text) AND (pt.source_ref = lb.artwork_no) AND ((pt.job_ref = ''::text) OR (pt.job_ref ~~* (((('%'::text || lb.so_number) || '/'::text) || (lb.line_no)::text) || '%'::text))) AND ((pt.job_ref ~~* (((('%'::text || lb.so_number) || '/'::text) || (lb.line_no)::text) || '%'::text)) OR ((pt.event_date >= lb.so_date) AND (pt.event_date <= (lb.so_date + '120 days'::interval)))))))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id
        ), line_tooling_shared_manual AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (mt.tooling_type = 'PLATE'::text) THEN mt.basic_amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS plate_shared_manual_cost,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN (mt.tooling_type = 'DIE'::text) THEN mt.basic_amount
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END) AS die_shared_manual_cost
           FROM (line_base lb
             LEFT JOIN manual_tooling_base mt ON (((lb.artwork_no <> ''::text) AND ((mt.artwork_key = lb.artwork_no) OR (mt.artwork_no = lb.artwork_no)) AND ((mt.event_date >= lb.so_date) AND (mt.event_date <= (lb.so_date + '120 days'::interval))))))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id
        ), line_tooling AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            (((COALESCE(ld.plate_direct_cost, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(md.plate_manual_direct_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sp.plate_shared_po_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sm.plate_shared_manual_cost, (0)::numeric)) AS plate_cost,
            (((COALESCE(ld.die_direct_cost, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(md.die_manual_direct_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sp.die_shared_po_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sm.die_shared_manual_cost, (0)::numeric)) AS die_cost
           FROM ((((line_base lb
             LEFT JOIN line_tooling_direct ld ON ((ld.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN line_tooling_manual_direct md ON ((md.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN line_tooling_shared_po sp ON ((sp.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN line_tooling_shared_manual sm ON ((sm.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
        ), final_base AS (
         SELECT ljs.so_id,
            ljs.so_line_id,
            ljs.so_number,
            ljs.so_date,
            ljs.client_code,
            ljs.client_name,
            ljs.sales_rep,
            ljs.line_no,
            ljs.division,
            ljs.product_code,
            ljs.product_name,
            ljs.category,
            ljs.item_length_mm,
            ljs.item_width_mm,
            COALESCE(jrm.job_area_mm2, ljs.job_area_mm2, (0)::numeric) AS job_area_mm2,
            COALESCE(jrm.total_wo_job_area_mm2, ljs.total_job_area_mm2, (0)::numeric) AS total_job_area_mm2,
            COALESCE(jrm.wo_cost_allocation_share, ljs.job_area_share, ljs.job_share, (0)::numeric) AS job_area_share,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(jrm.cost_allocation_basis, ''::text), ljs.cost_allocation_basis, ''::text) AS cost_allocation_basis,
            ljs.unit,
            ljs.rate,
            ljs.job_type,
            ljs.so_line_status,
            ljs.job_key,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(ljs.job_reference, ''::text), ljs.job_key) AS job_reference,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(ljs.artwork_no, ''::text), ''::text) AS artwork_no,
            ljs.wo_count,
            COALESCE(ljs.wo_numbers, ''::text) AS wo_numbers,
            round((COALESCE(ljs.order_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(ljs.job_share, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS order_qty,
            round((COALESCE(db.dispatched_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(ljs.job_share, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS dispatched_qty,
            round((COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(ljs.job_share, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS billed_qty,
            round((COALESCE(ljs.order_value, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(ljs.job_share, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS order_value,
            round((COALESCE(ib.billed_value, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(ljs.job_share, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS billed_value,
            round(COALESCE(jrm.rm_issued_qty, (0)::numeric), 3) AS rm_issued_qty,
            round(COALESCE(jrm.rm_issued_value, (0)::numeric), 2) AS rm_issued_value,
            round(COALESCE(jrm.rm_required_qty, (0)::numeric), 3) AS rm_required_qty,
            round(COALESCE(jrm.rm_net_issued_qty, (0)::numeric), 3) AS rm_net_issued_qty,
            round(COALESCE(jrm.rm_pending_qty, (0)::numeric), 3) AS rm_pending_qty,
            round(COALESCE(jrm.rm_excess_qty, (0)::numeric), 3) AS rm_excess_qty,
            COALESCE(jrm.rm_material_status, 'NO_MATERIAL'::text) AS rm_material_status,
            COALESCE(jrm.rm_pending_material_lines, (0)::numeric) AS rm_pending_material_lines,
            COALESCE(jrm.rm_excess_material_lines, (0)::numeric) AS rm_excess_material_lines,
            COALESCE(jrm.rm_material_detail, ''::text) AS rm_material_detail,
            round((COALESCE(lt.plate_cost, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(jrm.wo_cost_allocation_share, ljs.job_area_share, ljs.job_share, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS plate_cost,
            round((COALESCE(lt.die_cost, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(jrm.wo_cost_allocation_share, ljs.job_area_share, ljs.job_share, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS die_cost,
            COALESCE(lp.latest_production_stage, ''::text) AS latest_production_stage,
            COALESCE(lp.latest_production_machine, ''::text) AS latest_production_machine,
            round(COALESCE(lp.latest_stage_ok_qty, (0)::numeric), 3) AS latest_stage_ok_qty,
            round((COALESCE(lp.latest_stage_ok_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(ljs.rate, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS produced_goods_value,
            lp.latest_production_at,
            ib.invoice_nos,
            ib.first_invoice_date,
            ib.last_invoice_date,
            db.last_dispatch_date
           FROM (((((line_job_share ljs
             LEFT JOIN dispatch_base db ON ((db.so_line_id = ljs.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN invoice_base ib ON ((ib.so_line_id = ljs.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN job_rm_cost jrm ON (((jrm.so_line_id = ljs.so_line_id) AND (jrm.job_key = ljs.job_key))))
             LEFT JOIN line_tooling lt ON ((lt.so_line_id = ljs.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN latest_production lp ON (((lp.so_line_id = ljs.so_line_id) AND (lp.job_key = ljs.job_key))))
        )
 SELECT so_id,
    so_line_id,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    client_code,
    client_name,
    sales_rep,
    line_no,
    division,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    category,
    unit,
    rate,
    job_type,
    so_line_status,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(billed_qty, (0)::numeric) >= COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric)) AND (COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING'::text
        END AS billing_status,
    job_key,
    job_reference,
    artwork_no,
    wo_count,
    wo_numbers,
    order_qty,
    dispatched_qty,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((COALESCE(dispatched_qty, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF(order_qty, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS dispatched_pct,
    billed_qty,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((COALESCE(billed_qty, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF(order_qty, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS billed_pct,
    order_value,
    billed_value,
    rm_issued_qty,
    rm_issued_value,
    plate_cost,
    die_cost,
    round((COALESCE(plate_cost, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(die_cost, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS tooling_cost,
    round(((COALESCE(rm_issued_value, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(plate_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(die_cost, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS actual_cost_till_date,
    round((COALESCE(order_value, (0)::numeric) - ((COALESCE(rm_issued_value, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(plate_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(die_cost, (0)::numeric))), 2) AS profit_on_order_value,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(order_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (((COALESCE(order_value, (0)::numeric) - ((COALESCE(rm_issued_value, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(plate_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(die_cost, (0)::numeric))) / NULLIF(order_value, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS profit_pct_on_order_value,
    round((COALESCE(billed_value, (0)::numeric) - ((COALESCE(rm_issued_value, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(plate_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(die_cost, (0)::numeric))), 2) AS profit_on_billed_value,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(billed_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (((COALESCE(billed_value, (0)::numeric) - ((COALESCE(rm_issued_value, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(plate_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(die_cost, (0)::numeric))) / NULLIF(billed_value, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS profit_pct_on_billed_value,
    COALESCE(invoice_nos, ''::text) AS invoice_nos,
    first_invoice_date,
    last_invoice_date,
    last_dispatch_date,
    latest_production_stage,
    latest_production_machine,
    latest_stage_ok_qty,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((COALESCE(latest_stage_ok_qty, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF(order_qty, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS latest_stage_produced_pct,
    latest_production_at,
    produced_goods_value,
    round((COALESCE(produced_goods_value, (0)::numeric) - ((COALESCE(rm_issued_value, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(plate_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(die_cost, (0)::numeric))), 2) AS profit_on_produced_value,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(produced_goods_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (((COALESCE(produced_goods_value, (0)::numeric) - ((COALESCE(rm_issued_value, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(plate_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(die_cost, (0)::numeric))) / NULLIF(produced_goods_value, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS profit_pct_on_produced_value,
    round(COALESCE(item_length_mm, (0)::numeric), 3) AS job_length_mm,
    round(COALESCE(item_width_mm, (0)::numeric), 3) AS job_width_mm,
    round(COALESCE(job_area_mm2, (0)::numeric), 3) AS job_area_mm2,
    round(COALESCE(total_job_area_mm2, (0)::numeric), 3) AS total_job_area_mm2,
    round((COALESCE(job_area_share, (0)::numeric) * 100.0), 4) AS cost_allocation_pct,
    COALESCE(cost_allocation_basis, ''::text) AS cost_allocation_basis,
    rm_required_qty,
    rm_net_issued_qty,
    rm_pending_qty,
    rm_excess_qty,
    rm_material_status,
    rm_pending_material_lines,
    rm_excess_material_lines,
    rm_material_detail
   FROM final_base fb;


--
-- TOC entry 579 (class 1259 OID 176582)
-- Name: v_report_job_profitability_complete; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_job_profitability_complete AS
 WITH job_work_orders AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT sol.id AS so_line_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(sol.job_reference, ''::text), ((so.so_number || '||'::text) || (sol.line_no)::text)) AS job_key,
            wo.id AS wo_id,
            wo.snapshot_json
           FROM (((public.sales_orders so
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
             JOIN public.work_order_jobs woj ON (((woj.so_number = so.so_number) AND (woj.line_no = sol.line_no))))
             JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
        ), route_rows AS (
         SELECT jwo.so_line_id,
            jwo.job_key,
            jwo.wo_id,
            jwo.snapshot_json,
            rt."row" AS route_row,
            upper(concat_ws(' '::text, (rt."row" ->> 'dept'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'department'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'operation'::text), (rt."row" ->> 'process_name'::text))) AS route_name
           FROM (job_work_orders jwo
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((jwo.snapshot_json -> 'routing'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN (jwo.snapshot_json -> 'routing'::text)
                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                END) rt("row") ON (true))
        ), finishing_raw AS (
         SELECT rr.so_line_id,
            rr.job_key,
            bool_or(((rr.route_name ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.work_order_routing wor
                  WHERE ((wor.wo_id = rr.wo_id) AND (upper(concat_ws(' '::text, wor.department, wor.process_name)) ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text)))))) AS has_lamination,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim((rr.route_row ->> 'material'::text)), ''::text), ', '::text) FILTER (WHERE (rr.route_name ~~ '%LAMINAT%'::text)) AS lamination_materials,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim((rr.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,coating}'::text[])), ''::text), ', '::text) FILTER (WHERE (upper(btrim(COALESCE((rr.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,coating}'::text[]), ''::text))) <> ALL (ARRAY[''::text, 'NONE'::text, 'NO'::text, 'N/A'::text, 'NA'::text]))) AS job_card_coating,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim((rr.route_row ->> 'material'::text)), ''::text), ', '::text) FILTER (WHERE ((rr.route_name ~~ '%COAT%'::text) OR (rr.route_name ~~ '%VARNISH%'::text))) AS routing_coating
           FROM route_rows rr
          GROUP BY rr.so_line_id, rr.job_key
        ), finishing_selected AS (
         SELECT fr.so_line_id,
            fr.job_key,
            fr.has_lamination,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NOT fr.has_lamination) THEN ''::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(fr.lamination_materials, ''::text)) ~~ '%THERMAL%'::text) THEN 'Thermal'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(fr.lamination_materials, ''::text)) ~~ '%MATT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(fr.lamination_materials, ''::text)) ~~ '%MATTE%'::text)) THEN 'Matt'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(fr.lamination_materials, ''::text)) ~~ '%GLOSS%'::text) THEN 'Gloss'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(fr.lamination_materials, ''::text)) ~~ '%BOPP%'::text) THEN 'BOPP'::text
                    ELSE 'Gloss'::text
                END AS lamination_type,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(fr.job_card_coating, ''::text), NULLIF(fr.routing_coating, ''::text), ''::text) AS coating_type_raw
           FROM finishing_raw fr
        ), finishing_normalized AS (
         SELECT fs.so_line_id,
            fs.job_key,
            fs.has_lamination,
            fs.lamination_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(fs.coating_type_raw) ~~ '%AQUAS%'::text) OR (upper(fs.coating_type_raw) ~~ '%AQUEOUS%'::text)) THEN 'Aquas'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(replace(fs.coating_type_raw, '-'::text, ' '::text)) ~~ '%DRIP OFF%'::text) OR (upper(replace(fs.coating_type_raw, ' '::text, ''::text)) ~~ '%DRIPOFF%'::text)) THEN 'Drip Off'::text
                    WHEN (upper(fs.coating_type_raw) ~~ '%UV%'::text) THEN 'UV'::text
                    ELSE btrim(fs.coating_type_raw)
                END AS varnish_type
           FROM finishing_selected fs
        ), quantity_rate AS (

            round((COALESCE(jp.job_area_mm2, (0)::numeric) / 645.16), 4) AS job_area_sq_in,
            COALESCE(jp.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS finishing_billing_qty,
            COALESCE(fn.has_lamination, false) AS has_lamination,
            COALESCE(fn.lamination_type, ''::text) AS lamination_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN (fn.lamination_type = 'Gloss'::text) THEN (0.01 / (3)::numeric)
                    WHEN (fn.lamination_type = ANY (ARRAY['Thermal'::text, 'Matt'::text])) THEN 0.01
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS lamination_rate_per_sq_in,
            COALESCE(fn.varnish_type, ''::text) AS varnish_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN (fn.varnish_type = 'Aquas'::text) THEN (0.01 / (4)::numeric)
                    WHEN (fn.varnish_type = 'Drip Off'::text) THEN (0.01 / 1.5)
                    WHEN (fn.varnish_type = 'UV'::text) THEN (0.01 / 2.5)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS varnish_rate_per_sq_in
           FROM (public.v_report_job_profitability_phase1 jp
             LEFT JOIN finishing_normalized fn ON (((fn.so_line_id = jp.so_line_id) AND (fn.job_key = jp.job_key))))
        ), costed AS (
         SELECT qr.so_id,
            qr.so_line_id,
            qr.so_number,
            qr.so_date,
            qr.client_code,
            qr.client_name,
            qr.sales_rep,
            qr.line_no,

            qr.last_dispatch_date,
            qr.latest_production_stage,

            round(
                CASE
                    WHEN qr.has_lamination THEN (qr.job_area_sq_in * qr.finishing_billing_qty)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END, 3) AS lamination_sq_in,
            round(
                CASE
                    WHEN qr.has_lamination THEN ((qr.job_area_sq_in * qr.finishing_billing_qty) * qr.lamination_rate_per_sq_in)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END, 2) AS lamination_cost,
            round(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(qr.varnish_type, ''::text) <> ''::text) THEN (qr.job_area_sq_in * qr.finishing_billing_qty)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END, 3) AS varnish_sq_in,
            round(
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(qr.varnish_type, ''::text) <> ''::text) THEN ((qr.job_area_sq_in * qr.finishing_billing_qty) * qr.varnish_rate_per_sq_in)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END, 2) AS varnish_cost
           FROM quantity_rate qr
        ), finishing_costed AS (
         SELECT c.so_id,
            c.so_line_id,
            c.so_number,

            c.client_code,

            c.rm_issued_qty,

            c.lamination_sq_in,
            c.lamination_cost,
            c.varnish_sq_in,
            c.varnish_cost,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NOT c.has_lamination) THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text
                    WHEN (c.job_area_sq_in <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'SIZE_MISSING'::text
                    WHEN (c.finishing_billing_qty <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'BILLING_QTY_ZERO'::text
                    WHEN (c.lamination_rate_per_sq_in <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'RATE_MISSING'::text
                    ELSE 'COSTED'::text
                END AS lamination_cost_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.varnish_type, ''::text) = ''::text) THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text
                    WHEN (c.job_area_sq_in <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'SIZE_MISSING'::text
                    WHEN (c.finishing_billing_qty <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'BILLING_QTY_ZERO'::text
                    WHEN (c.varnish_rate_per_sq_in <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'RATE_MISSING'::text
                    ELSE 'COSTED'::text
                END AS varnish_cost_status,
            round((COALESCE(c.lamination_cost, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(c.varnish_cost, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS finishing_cost
           FROM costed c
        ), process_cost_by_job AS (
         SELECT pc.so_line_id,
            pc.job_key,
            round(sum(COALESCE(pc.process_hours, (0)::numeric)), 4) AS process_hours,
            round(sum(COALESCE(pc.process_cost, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS process_cost,
            count(*) AS process_cost_line_count,
            sum(COALESCE(pc.production_entry_count, (0)::bigint)) AS production_entry_count,
            sum(COALESCE(pc.actual_hour_entry_count, (0)::bigint)) AS actual_hour_entry_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (pc.mhr_missing = true)) AS mhr_missing_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(pc.production_machine, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(pc.production_machine, ''::text)) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(pc.production_machine, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS process_cost_machines,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(pc.machine_key, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(pc.machine_key, ''::text)) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(pc.machine_key, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS process_cost_machine_keys,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(pc.hours_source, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(pc.hours_source, ''::text)) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(pc.hours_source, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS process_hours_source,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(pc.cost_allocation_basis, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(pc.cost_allocation_basis, ''::text)) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(pc.cost_allocation_basis, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS process_cost_allocation_basis
           FROM public.v_report_job_process_cost_lines pc
          GROUP BY pc.so_line_id, pc.job_key
        ), complete_base AS (
         SELECT jp.so_id,
            jp.so_line_id,

            jp.varnish_cost,
            jp.lamination_cost_status,
            jp.varnish_cost_status,
            jp.finishing_cost,
            COALESCE(pcj.process_hours, (0)::numeric) AS process_hours,
            COALESCE(pcj.process_cost, (0)::numeric) AS process_cost,
            COALESCE(pcj.process_cost_line_count, (0)::bigint) AS process_cost_line_count,
            COALESCE(pcj.production_entry_count, (0)::numeric) AS process_cost_entry_count,
            COALESCE(pcj.actual_hour_entry_count, (0)::numeric) AS actual_hour_entry_count,
            COALESCE(pcj.mhr_missing_count, (0)::bigint) AS mhr_missing_count,
            COALESCE(pcj.process_cost_machines, ''::text) AS process_cost_machines,
            COALESCE(pcj.process_cost_machine_keys, ''::text) AS process_cost_machine_keys,
            COALESCE(pcj.process_hours_source, ''::text) AS process_hours_source,
            COALESCE(pcj.process_cost_allocation_basis, ''::text) AS process_cost_allocation_basis,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(pcj.mhr_missing_count, (0)::bigint) > 0) THEN 'MHR_MISSING'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(pcj.process_cost, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN 'COSTED'::text
                    ELSE 'NO_COST'::text
                END AS process_cost_status,
            round(((COALESCE(jp.actual_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(pcj.process_cost, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(jp.finishing_cost, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS complete_cost_till_date
           FROM (finishing_costed jp
             LEFT JOIN process_cost_by_job pcj ON (((pcj.so_line_id = jp.so_line_id) AND (pcj.job_key = jp.job_key))))

    profit_pct_on_order_value,
    profit_on_billed_value,
    profit_pct_on_billed_value,
    round((COALESCE(produced_goods_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(complete_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS profit_on_produced_complete,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(produced_goods_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (((COALESCE(produced_goods_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(complete_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric)) / NULLIF(produced_goods_value, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS profit_pct_on_produced_complete,
    round((COALESCE(order_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(complete_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS profit_on_order_complete,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(order_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (((COALESCE(order_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(complete_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric)) / NULLIF(order_value, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS profit_pct_on_order_complete,
    round((COALESCE(billed_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(complete_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS profit_on_billed_complete,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(billed_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (((COALESCE(billed_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(complete_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric)) / NULLIF(billed_value, (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS profit_pct_on_billed_complete,
