CREATE VIEW public.v_report_job_profitability_production_stages AS
 WITH line_base AS (
         SELECT so.id AS so_id,
            sol.id AS so_line_id,
            so.so_number,
            COALESCE(so.so_date, (so.created_at)::date) AS so_date,
            so.client_code,
            COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code) AS client_name,
            so.sales_rep,
            sol.line_no,
            sol.division,
            sol.product_code,
            sol.product_name,
            sol.category,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            COALESCE(sol.unit, ''::text) AS unit,
            COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
            COALESCE(sol.job_reference, ''::text) AS sales_job_reference,
            COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_line_status
           FROM ((public.sales_orders so
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        ), production_stage_base AS (
         SELECT lb.so_id,
            lb.so_line_id,
            lb.so_number,
            lb.so_date,
            lb.client_code,
            lb.client_name,
            lb.sales_rep,
            lb.line_no,
            lb.division,
            lb.product_code,
            lb.product_name,
            lb.category,
            lb.order_qty,
            lb.unit,
            lb.rate,
            lb.so_line_status,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(lb.sales_job_reference, ''::text), ((lb.so_number || '||'::text) || (lb.line_no)::text)) AS job_key,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(lb.sales_job_reference, ''::text), ''::text) AS job_reference,
            pe.routing_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(wor.department, ''::text), 'Production'::text) AS production_stage,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.planned_machine, ''::text), NULLIF(pe.machine, ''::text), ''::text) AS production_machine,
            wor.sequence_no AS stage_sequence,
            count(*) AS production_entry_count,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS ok_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS produced_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS rejected_qty,
            min(COALESCE(pe.entry_datetime, pe.created_at)) AS first_production_at,
            max(COALESCE(pe.entry_datetime, pe.created_at)) AS last_production_at
           FROM (((public.production_entries pe
             JOIN line_base lb ON (((lb.so_number = pe.so_number) AND ((lb.line_no)::text = btrim(pe.line_no)))))
             LEFT JOIN public.work_order_routing wor ON ((wor.id = pe.routing_id)))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT woj1.job_reference
                   FROM public.work_order_jobs woj1
                  WHERE ((woj1.wo_id = pe.wo_id) AND (woj1.so_number = pe.so_number) AND ((woj1.line_no)::text = btrim(pe.line_no)))
                  ORDER BY
                        CASE
                            WHEN (COALESCE(woj1.job_reference, ''::text) = COALESCE(pe.job_reference, ''::text)) THEN 0
                            ELSE 1
                        END, woj1.id
                 LIMIT 1) woj ON (true))
          WHERE ((COALESCE(pe.so_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(pe.line_no, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) > (0)::numeric))
          GROUP BY lb.so_id, lb.so_line_id, lb.so_number, lb.so_date, lb.client_code, lb.client_name, lb.sales_rep, lb.line_no, lb.division, lb.product_code, lb.product_name, lb.category, lb.order_qty, lb.unit, lb.rate, lb.so_line_status, COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(lb.sales_job_reference, ''::text), ((lb.so_number || '||'::text) || (lb.line_no)::text)), COALESCE(NULLIF(pe.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), NULLIF(lb.sales_job_reference, ''::text), ''::text), pe.routing_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(wor.department, ''::text), 'Production'::text), COALESCE(NULLIF(wor.planned_machine, ''::text), NULLIF(pe.machine, ''::text), ''::text), wor.sequence_no
        ), production_stage_ranked AS (
         SELECT psb.so_id,
            psb.so_line_id,
            psb.so_number,
            psb.so_date,
            psb.client_code,
            psb.client_name,
            psb.sales_rep,
            psb.line_no,
            psb.division,
            psb.product_code,
            psb.product_name,
            psb.category,
            psb.order_qty,
            psb.unit,
            psb.rate,
            psb.so_line_status,
            psb.job_key,
            psb.job_reference,
            psb.routing_id,
            psb.production_stage,
            psb.production_machine,
            psb.stage_sequence,
            psb.production_entry_count,
            psb.ok_qty,
            psb.produced_qty,
            psb.rejected_qty,
            psb.first_production_at,
            psb.last_production_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY psb.so_line_id, psb.job_key ORDER BY psb.stage_sequence DESC NULLS LAST, psb.last_production_at DESC NULLS LAST, psb.production_stage) AS latest_rank
           FROM production_stage_base psb
        )
 SELECT psr.so_id,
    psr.so_line_id,
    psr.so_number,
    psr.so_date,
    psr.client_code,
    psr.client_name,
    psr.sales_rep,
    psr.line_no,
    psr.division,
    psr.product_code,
    psr.product_name,
    psr.category,
    psr.order_qty,
    psr.unit,
    psr.rate,
    psr.so_line_status,
    COALESCE(jp.billing_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS billing_status,
    psr.job_key,
    psr.job_reference,
    jp.artwork_no,
    COALESCE(jp.wo_numbers, ''::text) AS wo_numbers,
    psr.routing_id,
    psr.production_stage,
    psr.production_machine,
    psr.stage_sequence,
        CASE
            WHEN (psr.latest_rank = 1) THEN 'LATEST'::text
            ELSE 'STAGE'::text
        END AS stage_position,
    psr.production_entry_count,
    round(psr.ok_qty, 3) AS ok_qty,
    round(psr.produced_qty, 3) AS produced_qty,
    round(psr.rejected_qty, 3) AS rejected_qty,
    round((psr.ok_qty * COALESCE(psr.rate, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS produced_goods_value,
    round(COALESCE(jp.actual_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric), 2) AS actual_cost_till_date,
    round(((psr.ok_qty * COALESCE(psr.rate, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(jp.actual_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS profit_on_stage_value,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN ((psr.ok_qty * COALESCE(psr.rate, (0)::numeric)) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((((psr.ok_qty * COALESCE(psr.rate, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(jp.actual_cost_till_date, (0)::numeric)) / NULLIF((psr.ok_qty * COALESCE(psr.rate, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) * 100.0)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS profit_pct_on_stage_value,
    psr.first_production_at,
    psr.last_production_at
   FROM (production_stage_ranked psr
     LEFT JOIN public.v_report_job_profitability_phase1 jp ON (((jp.so_line_id = psr.so_line_id) AND (jp.job_key = psr.job_key))));

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_job_wastage_complete WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH work_order_job_rollup AS (
         SELECT woj.wo_id,
            btrim(woj.so_number) AS so_number,
            woj.line_no,
            sum(GREATEST(COALESCE(woj.qty, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric)) AS wo_job_qty,
            max(NULLIF(woj.unit, ''::text)) AS wo_job_unit,
            COALESCE(max(NULLIF(woj.ups, (0)::numeric)), max(NULLIF(woj.group_ups, (0)::numeric))) AS job_ups,
            count(*) AS job_record_count,
            count(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(woj.ups, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(woj.group_ups, (0)::numeric))) AS distinct_ups_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(woj.job_reference), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(btrim(woj.job_reference), ''::text)) AS wo_job_references,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(woj.artwork_no), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(btrim(woj.artwork_no), ''::text)) AS artwork_nos,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(woj.category), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(btrim(woj.category), ''::text)) AS wo_categories,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(woj.client_name), ''::text)) AS wo_client_name,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(woj.product_name), ''::text)) AS wo_product_name
           FROM public.work_order_jobs woj
          WHERE ((NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(woj.so_number, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (woj.line_no IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY woj.wo_id, (btrim(woj.so_number)), woj.line_no
        ), work_order_context_raw AS (
         SELECT COALESCE((sol.id)::text, ((j.so_number || '||'::text) || (j.line_no)::text)) AS so_line_key,
            (sol.id)::text AS so_line_id,
            j.wo_id,
            wo.wo_number,
            wo.wo_date,
            COALESCE(wo.status, ''::text) AS wo_status,
            j.so_number,
            j.line_no,

            COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.division, ''::text), NULLIF(sol.category, ''::text), NULLIF(j.wo_categories, ''::text), 'Unassigned'::text) AS division,
            COALESCE(sol.product_code, ''::text) AS product_code,

            COALESCE(NULLIF(j.wo_job_references, ''::text), NULLIF(sol.job_reference, ''::text), ''::text) AS job_reference,
            COALESCE(j.artwork_nos, ''::text) AS artwork_nos,

            COALESCE(j.wo_job_unit, ''::text) AS wo_job_unit,

                CASE

                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS process_wastage_sheets,
            (upper(concat_ws(' '::text, sol.division, sol.category, j.wo_categories, (wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,department}'::text[]), (wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,category}'::text[]), (wo.snapshot_json #>> '{departmentCategory}'::text[]))) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) AS is_flexo
           FROM ((((work_order_job_rollup j
             JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = j.wo_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.so_number = j.so_number)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = so.id) AND (sol.line_no = j.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(wo.status, ''::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CANCELED'::text, 'VOID'::text, 'DELETED'::text]))
        ), work_order_context AS (
         SELECT w.so_line_key,
            w.so_line_id,
            w.wo_id,

            w.so_number,
            w.line_no,
            w.so_date,
            w.sales_rep,
            w.client_code,
            w.client_name,
            w.division,

            w.product_name,

            w.job_record_count,
            w.distinct_ups_count,
            w.process_wastage_sheets,
            w.is_flexo,
                CASE
                    WHEN w.is_flexo THEN 'RM'::text
                    ELSE 'SHEETS'::text
                END AS production_unit,
                CASE
                    WHEN (w.is_flexo OR (COALESCE(w.job_ups, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN NULL::numeric
                    ELSE ceil((w.wo_job_qty / w.job_ups))
                END AS core_sheets,
                CASE
                    WHEN (w.distinct_ups_count > 1) THEN 'MIXED_UPS'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(w.job_ups, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'UPS_MISSING'::text
                    ELSE 'UPS_AVAILABLE'::text
                END AS ups_status
           FROM work_order_context_raw w
        ), route_production_totals AS (
         SELECT pe.routing_id,
            count(*) AS production_entry_count,

            sum(GREATEST(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) AS production_ok_qty,

            COALESCE(rpt.production_entry_count, (0)::bigint) AS production_entry_count,
            COALESCE(rpt.production_gross_qty, (0)::numeric) AS production_gross_qty,
            COALESCE(rpt.production_rejected_qty, (0)::numeric) AS production_rejected_qty,
            COALESCE(rpt.production_ok_qty, (0)::numeric) AS production_ok_qty,
            rpt.first_print_at,

            COALESCE(rpt.print_machines, NULLIF(wor.planned_machine, ''::text), ''::text) AS print_machines,

          GROUP BY l.original_invoice_line_id
        ), billing_by_so_line AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,

                END AS printed_input_pcs,
            pr.first_print_at,
            pr.last_print_at

             LEFT JOIN printing_routes_ranked pr ON (((pr.wo_id = w.wo_id) AND (pr.route_rank = 1))))
        ), detail_with_billing AS (

            d_1.printed_input_pcs,
            d_1.first_print_at,
            d_1.last_print_at,
            COALESCE(b.gross_billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS gross_billed_qty,
            COALESCE(b.credited_qty, (0)::numeric) AS credited_qty,
            COALESCE(b.net_billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS net_billed_qty,
            COALESCE(b.invoice_nos, ''::text) AS invoice_nos,
            COALESCE(b.credit_note_nos, ''::text) AS credit_note_nos,

        ), so_line_totals AS (
         SELECT d_1.so_line_key,

            string_agg(DISTINCT (d_1.job_ups)::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (d_1.job_ups)::text) FILTER (WHERE (d_1.job_ups IS NOT NULL)) AS so_ups_list,

            sum(d_1.process_wastage_sheets) FILTER (WHERE (NOT d_1.is_flexo)) AS so_total_process_wastage_sheets,
            sum(d_1.core_sheets) AS so_total_core_sheets,
            sum(d_1.planned_input_sheets) AS so_total_planned_input_sheets,
            sum(d_1.qty_with_wastage_pcs) AS so_total_qty_with_wastage_pcs,
            sum(d_1.printed_gross_sheets) AS so_total_printed_gross_sheets,
            sum(d_1.printed_rejected_sheets) AS so_total_printed_rejected_sheets,
            sum(d_1.printed_ok_sheets) AS so_total_printed_ok_sheets,
            sum(d_1.printed_input_pcs) AS so_total_printed_input_pcs,
            sum(d_1.production_entry_count) AS so_production_entry_count,
            min(d_1.first_print_at) AS so_first_print_at,
            max(d_1.last_print_at) AS so_last_print_at,
            bool_or(d_1.is_flexo) AS has_flexo,
            bool_or(((d_1.job_ups IS NULL) OR (d_1.job_ups <= (0)::numeric))) AS has_missing_ups,
            bool_or((d_1.print_routing_id IS NULL)) AS has_missing_print_route,
            max(d_1.gross_billed_qty) AS gross_billed_qty,
            max(d_1.credited_qty) AS credited_qty,
            max(d_1.net_billed_qty) AS net_billed_qty,
            max(d_1.invoice_nos) AS invoice_nos,
            max(d_1.credit_note_nos) AS credit_note_nos,
            min(d_1.first_invoice_date) AS first_invoice_date,
            max(d_1.last_invoice_date) AS last_invoice_date,
            max(d_1.last_credit_note_date) AS last_credit_note_date
           FROM detail_with_billing d_1
          GROUP BY d_1.so_line_key
        )
 SELECT d.so_line_key,
    COALESCE(d.so_line_id, ''::text) AS so_line_id,
    d.so_number,
    d.line_no,
    d.so_date,
    d.so_line_status,
    d.sales_rep,
    d.client_code,
    d.client_name,
    d.division,
    d.product_code,
    d.product_name,
    d.category,
    d.job_type,
    d.job_reference,
    d.artwork_nos,
    round(d.order_qty, 3) AS order_qty,
    d.order_unit,
        CASE
            WHEN ((d.order_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (s.net_billed_qty >= d.order_qty)) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(d.so_line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text])) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
            WHEN (s.net_billed_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PARTIAL'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING'::text
        END AS billing_status,
    round(s.gross_billed_qty, 3) AS gross_billed_qty,
    round(s.credited_qty, 3) AS credited_qty,
    round(s.net_billed_qty, 3) AS net_billed_qty,
    COALESCE(s.invoice_nos, ''::text) AS invoice_nos,
    COALESCE(s.credit_note_nos, ''::text) AS credit_note_nos,
    s.first_invoice_date,
    s.last_invoice_date,
    s.last_credit_note_date,
    (d.wo_id)::text AS wo_id,
    d.wo_number,
    d.wo_date,
    d.wo_status,
    round(d.wo_job_qty, 3) AS wo_job_qty,
    d.wo_job_unit,
    round(d.job_ups, 4) AS job_ups,
    d.job_record_count,
    d.ups_status,
    round(d.process_wastage_sheets, 3) AS process_wastage_sheets,
    round(d.core_sheets, 3) AS core_sheets,
    round(d.planned_input_sheets, 3) AS planned_input_sheets,
    round(d.qty_with_wastage_pcs, 3) AS qty_with_wastage_pcs,
    COALESCE((d.print_routing_id)::text, ''::text) AS print_routing_id,
    d.print_process,
    d.print_sequence_no,
    d.print_route_count,
    d.print_machines,
    d.production_entry_count,
    d.production_unit,
    round(d.production_gross_qty, 3) AS production_gross_qty,
    round(d.production_rejected_qty, 3) AS production_rejected_qty,
    round(d.production_ok_qty, 3) AS production_ok_qty,
    round(d.printed_gross_sheets, 3) AS printed_gross_sheets,
    round(d.printed_rejected_sheets, 3) AS printed_rejected_sheets,
    round(d.printed_ok_sheets, 3) AS printed_ok_sheets,
    round(d.printed_input_pcs, 3) AS printed_input_pcs,
    timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, d.first_print_at) AS first_print_datetime,
    timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, d.last_print_at) AS last_print_datetime,
    (timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, d.last_print_at))::date AS last_print_date,
    s.so_wo_count,
    COALESCE(s.so_wo_numbers, ''::text) AS so_wo_numbers,
    COALESCE(s.so_ups_list, ''::text) AS so_ups_list,
    round(s.so_total_wo_job_qty, 3) AS so_total_wo_job_qty,
    round(s.so_total_process_wastage_sheets, 3) AS so_total_process_wastage_sheets,
    round(s.so_total_core_sheets, 3) AS so_total_core_sheets,
    round(s.so_total_planned_input_sheets, 3) AS so_total_planned_input_sheets,
    round(s.so_total_qty_with_wastage_pcs, 3) AS so_total_qty_with_wastage_pcs,
    round(s.so_total_printed_gross_sheets, 3) AS so_total_printed_gross_sheets,
    round(s.so_total_printed_rejected_sheets, 3) AS so_total_printed_rejected_sheets,
    round(s.so_total_printed_ok_sheets, 3) AS so_total_printed_ok_sheets,
    round(s.so_total_printed_input_pcs, 3) AS so_total_printed_input_pcs,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(s.so_total_printed_input_pcs, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((s.so_total_printed_input_pcs - s.net_billed_qty), 3)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS wastage_qty_pcs,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(s.so_total_printed_input_pcs, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((((s.so_total_printed_input_pcs - s.net_billed_qty) / s.so_total_printed_input_pcs) * (100)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS wastage_pct,
    s.so_production_entry_count,
    timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, s.so_first_print_at) AS so_first_print_datetime,
    timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, s.so_last_print_at) AS so_last_print_datetime,
    (timezone('Asia/Kolkata'::text, s.so_last_print_at))::date AS so_last_print_date,
        CASE
            WHEN s.has_flexo THEN 'FLEXO_CONVERSION_PENDING'::text
            WHEN s.has_missing_ups THEN 'UPS_MISSING'::text
            WHEN s.has_missing_print_route THEN 'PRINT_ROUTING_MISSING'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(s.so_production_entry_count, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(s.so_total_printed_input_pcs, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PRODUCTION_PENDING'::text
            WHEN (s.net_billed_qty <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'BILLING_PENDING'::text
            WHEN (s.net_billed_qty > s.so_total_printed_input_pcs) THEN 'BILLING_EXCEEDS_PRINTED_INPUT'::text
            WHEN ((d.order_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (s.net_billed_qty >= d.order_qty)) THEN 'FINAL'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(d.so_line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text])) THEN 'FINAL'::text
            ELSE 'PROVISIONAL'::text
        END AS calculation_status,
    lower(concat_ws(' '::text, d.so_number, (d.line_no)::text, d.client_name, d.division, d.product_code, d.product_name, d.job_reference, d.artwork_nos, d.wo_number, d.print_process, d.print_machines, s.invoice_nos, s.credit_note_nos)) AS match_text,
    lower(concat_ws(' '::text, d.so_line_status, d.wo_status, d.division, d.ups_status,
        CASE
            WHEN s.has_flexo THEN 'FLEXO_CONVERSION_PENDING'::text
            WHEN s.has_missing_ups THEN 'UPS_MISSING'::text
            WHEN s.has_missing_print_route THEN 'PRINT_ROUTING_MISSING'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(s.so_production_entry_count, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(s.so_total_printed_input_pcs, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'PRODUCTION_PENDING'::text
            WHEN (s.net_billed_qty <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'BILLING_PENDING'::text
            WHEN (s.net_billed_qty > s.so_total_printed_input_pcs) THEN 'BILLING_EXCEEDS_PRINTED_INPUT'::text
            WHEN ((d.order_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (s.net_billed_qty >= d.order_qty)) THEN 'FINAL'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(d.so_line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text])) THEN 'FINAL'::text
            ELSE 'PROVISIONAL'::text
        END)) AS status_text
   FROM (detail_with_billing d
     JOIN so_line_totals s ON ((s.so_line_key = d.so_line_key)));

                    WHEN (((qb.raw_process_upper ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) AND ((qb.raw_process_upper ~~ '%DIE%'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper ~~ '%CUT%'::text))) OR ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) AND ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%CUT%'::text)))) THEN 'FLEXODIE'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_process_upper ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MARKANY%'::text)) THEN 'FLEXOPRINT'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%CANON%'::text)) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                    WHEN (((qb.raw_machine_upper = 'PRINTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper = 'OFFSET PRINTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper = 'PRINTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper = 'OFFSET PRINTING'::text)) AND (qb.raw_category_upper ~~ '%CORRUGATION%'::text)) THEN 'CD102'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper = 'PRINTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper = 'OFFSET PRINTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper = 'PRINTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper = 'OFFSET PRINTING'::text)) THEN 'SM74'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper = 'AUTOMATIC'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper = 'AUTO'::text)) THEN '2PLY'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%2 PLY%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%TWO PLY%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%PLY MAKING%'::text)) THEN '2PLY'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%ROTARY%'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper ~~ '%ROTARY%'::text)) THEN 'ROTARY'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%FMZ%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%FLUTE%'::text)) THEN 'FMZ'::text
                    WHEN (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL SHEET PASTING%'::text) THEN 'MSP1'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper = 'PASTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper = 'SIDE PASTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper = 'PASTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper = 'SIDE PASTING'::text)) THEN 'FOLDER'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL PASTING%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL SHEET PASTING 2%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL SHEET PASTING - 2%'::text)) THEN 'MSP2'::text
                    WHEN (((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL DIE CUTTING 05%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING MANUAL 2%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING MANUAL - 2%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL DIE%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING MANUAL%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL DIE CUTTING 04%'::text)) AND (qb.raw_category_upper ~~ '%CORRUGATION%'::text)) THEN 'DICORR'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL DIE CUTTING 05%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING MANUAL 2%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING MANUAL - 2%'::text)) THEN 'DCMAN2'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL DIE%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING MANUAL%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%MANUAL DIE CUTTING 04%'::text)) THEN 'DCMAN1'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_process_upper ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) AND (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%AUTOMATIC DIE%'::text)) THEN 'FLEXODIE'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%AUTOMATIC DIE%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%AUTO DIE%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING AUTO%'::text)) THEN 'DCAUTO'::text
                    WHEN (((qb.raw_machine_upper = 'DIE CUTTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper = 'DIE CUTTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING 01%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING-01%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-CUTTING-01%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-1%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DYE-1%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING 02%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING-02%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-CUTTING-02%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-2%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DYE-2%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING 03%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING-03%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-CUTTING-03%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-3%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DYE-3%'::text)) AND (qb.raw_category_upper ~~ '%CORRUGATION%'::text)) THEN 'DICORR'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper = 'DIE CUTTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_process_upper = 'DIE CUTTING'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING 01%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING-01%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-CUTTING-01%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-1%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DYE-1%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING 02%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING-02%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-CUTTING-02%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-2%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DYE-2%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING 03%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING-03%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-CUTTING-03%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-3%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DYE-3%'::text)) THEN 'DIEOFFSET'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING 04%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-4%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DYE-4%'::text)) THEN 'DIE4'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE CUTTING 05%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DIE-5%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%DYE-5%'::text)) THEN 'DIE5'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%STITCHING MANUAL 02%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%STITCHING MANUAL - 2%'::text)) THEN 'STMAN2'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%STITCHING MANUAL%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%STITCHING MANUAL 01%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%STITCHING MANUAL - 1%'::text)) THEN 'STMAN1'::text
                    WHEN ((qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%AUTO STITCH%'::text) OR (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%STITCHING AUTO%'::text)) THEN 'STAUTO'::text
                    WHEN (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%FOLDER GLUER%'::text) THEN 'FOLDER'::text
                    WHEN (qb.raw_machine_upper ~~ '%RS4%'::text) THEN 'RS4'::text
                    ELSE regexp_replace(qb.raw_machine_upper, '[^A-Z0-9]+'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text)
                END AS machine_key
           FROM queue_base qb
        ), load_base AS (
         SELECT qn.routing_id,
            qn.wo_id,
            qn.wo_number,
            qn.wo_date,
            qn.so_numbers,
            qn.line_nos,
            qn.artwork_nos,
            qn.client_name,
            qn.product_names,
            qn.department_category,
            qn.process_name,
            qn.department,
            qn.planned_machine,
            qn.sequence_no,
            qn.expected_delivery,
            qn.job_priority,
            qn.planned_qty,
            qn.produced_qty,
            qn.balance_qty,
            qn.status,
            qn.plan_unit,
            qn.flexo_total_rm,
            qn.flexo_total_job_qty,
            qn.raw_machine,
            qn.raw_machine_upper,
            qn.raw_process_upper,
            qn.raw_category_upper,
            qn.machine_key,
            COALESCE(ms.machine, NULLIF(qn.planned_machine, ''::text), qn.raw_machine) AS normalized_machine,
            COALESCE(ms.standard_make_ready_minutes, (0)::numeric) AS standard_make_ready_minutes,
            COALESCE(ms.target_output, (0)::numeric) AS target_output,
                CASE
                    WHEN (qn.machine_key = ANY (ARRAY['FLEXOPRINT'::text, 'FLEXODIE'::text, 'FLEXOSLIT'::text])) THEN 'meter/min'::text
                    ELSE 'qty/hour'::text
                END AS target_unit,
                CASE
                    WHEN (qn.machine_key = ANY (ARRAY['FLEXOPRINT'::text, 'FLEXODIE'::text, 'FLEXOSLIT'::text])) THEN (COALESCE(ms.target_output, (0)::numeric) * (60)::numeric)
                    ELSE COALESCE(ms.target_output, (0)::numeric)
                END AS target_hourly_capacity,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(qn.balance_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN COALESCE(qn.balance_qty, (0)::numeric)
                    ELSE COALESCE(qn.planned_qty, (0)::numeric)
                END AS base_load_qty
           FROM (queue_normalized qn
             LEFT JOIN machine_standards ms ON ((ms.machine_key = qn.machine_key)))
        ), load_unit_calc AS (
         SELECT lb.routing_id,
            lb.wo_id,
            lb.wo_number,
            lb.wo_date,
            lb.so_numbers,
            lb.line_nos,
            lb.artwork_nos,
            lb.client_name,
            lb.product_names,
            lb.department_category,
            lb.process_name,
            lb.department,
            lb.planned_machine,
            lb.sequence_no,
            lb.expected_delivery,
            lb.job_priority,
            lb.planned_qty,
            lb.produced_qty,
            lb.balance_qty,
            lb.status,
            lb.plan_unit,
            lb.flexo_total_rm,
            lb.flexo_total_job_qty,
            lb.raw_machine,
            lb.raw_machine_upper,
            lb.raw_process_upper,
            lb.raw_category_upper,
            lb.machine_key,
            lb.normalized_machine,
            lb.standard_make_ready_minutes,
            lb.target_output,
            lb.target_unit,
            lb.target_hourly_capacity,
            lb.base_load_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN (lb.machine_key = ANY (ARRAY['FLEXOPRINT'::text, 'FLEXODIE'::text, 'FLEXOSLIT'::text])) THEN 'meter'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(lb.plan_unit, ''::text)) <> ''::text) THEN lower(lb.plan_unit)
                    ELSE 'qty'::text
                END AS load_qty_unit,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((lb.machine_key = ANY (ARRAY['FLEXOPRINT'::text, 'FLEXODIE'::text, 'FLEXOSLIT'::text])) AND (COALESCE(lb.flexo_total_rm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(lb.flexo_total_job_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND ((upper(COALESCE(lb.plan_unit, ''::text)) ~~ '%PCS%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(lb.plan_unit, ''::text)) ~~ '%UNIT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(lb.plan_unit, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHEET%'::text) OR (COALESCE(lb.base_load_qty, (0)::numeric) > COALESCE(lb.flexo_total_rm, (0)::numeric)) OR (lb.machine_key = 'FLEXODIE'::text))) THEN round(((COALESCE(lb.base_load_qty, (0)::numeric) * lb.flexo_total_rm) / NULLIF(lb.flexo_total_job_qty, (0)::numeric)), 2)
                    ELSE COALESCE(lb.base_load_qty, (0)::numeric)
                END AS load_qty
           FROM load_base lb
        ), load_calc AS (
         SELECT luc.routing_id,
            luc.wo_id,
            luc.wo_number,
            luc.wo_date,
            luc.so_numbers,
            luc.line_nos,
            luc.artwork_nos,
            luc.client_name,
            luc.product_names,
            luc.department_category,
            luc.process_name,
            luc.department,
            luc.planned_machine,
            luc.sequence_no,
            luc.expected_delivery,
            luc.job_priority,
            luc.planned_qty,
            luc.produced_qty,
            luc.balance_qty,
            luc.status,
            luc.plan_unit,
            luc.flexo_total_rm,
            luc.flexo_total_job_qty,
            luc.raw_machine,
            luc.raw_machine_upper,
            luc.raw_process_upper,
            luc.raw_category_upper,
            luc.machine_key,
            luc.normalized_machine,
            luc.standard_make_ready_minutes,
            luc.target_output,
            luc.target_unit,
            luc.target_hourly_capacity,
            luc.base_load_qty,
            luc.load_qty_unit,
            luc.load_qty,
            round((COALESCE(luc.standard_make_ready_minutes, (0)::numeric) / 60.0), 2) AS make_ready_hours,
            round((COALESCE(luc.load_qty, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF(luc.target_hourly_capacity, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS running_load_hours
           FROM load_unit_calc luc
        )
 SELECT routing_id,
    wo_id,
    wo_number,
    wo_date,
    so_numbers,
    line_nos,
    artwork_nos,
    client_name,
    product_names,
    department_category,
    process_name,
    department,
    planned_machine,
    machine_key,
    normalized_machine AS machine,
    expected_delivery,
    planned_qty,
    produced_qty,
    balance_qty,
    plan_unit,
    base_load_qty,
    load_qty,
    load_qty_unit,
    flexo_total_rm,
    flexo_total_job_qty,
    status,
    standard_make_ready_minutes,
    target_output,
    target_unit,
    round(target_hourly_capacity, 2) AS target_hourly_capacity,
    make_ready_hours,
    COALESCE(running_load_hours, (0)::numeric) AS running_load_hours,
    round((COALESCE(running_load_hours, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(make_ready_hours, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS total_load_hours,
    round(((COALESCE(running_load_hours, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(make_ready_hours, (0)::numeric)) / 8.0), 2) AS load_days,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(target_hourly_capacity, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'NO_TARGET'::text
            ELSE 'OPEN_LOAD'::text
        END AS load_status
   FROM load_calc;

-- TOC entry 480 (class 1259 OID 121654)
-- Name: v_report_machine_load_missing_targets; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_machine_load_missing_targets AS
 SELECT routing_id,
    wo_id,
    wo_number,
    wo_date,
    so_numbers,
    line_nos,
    artwork_nos,
    client_name,
    product_names,
    department_category,
    department,
    process_name,
    planned_machine AS current_planned_machine,
    machine_key AS normalized_machine_key,
    machine AS report_machine_label,
    planned_qty,
    produced_qty,
    balance_qty,
    load_qty,
    status,
    load_status,
    expected_delivery,
        CASE
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(planned_machine, process_name, department, ''::text)) ~~ '%PRINT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(department, process_name, planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%PRINT%'::text)) THEN 'Heidelberg SM74 | CD102 | RS4 Printing | Canon Digital Printing | Markany Flexo E5'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(planned_machine, process_name, department, ''::text)) ~~ '%LAMINATION%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(department, process_name, planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%LAMINATION%'::text)) THEN 'Lamination Roll-1 | Lamination 02 | Lamination 03'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(planned_machine, process_name, department, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(department, process_name, planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIE%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(planned_machine, process_name, department, ''::text)) ~~ '%AUTOMATIC%'::text)) THEN 'Die Cutting 01 | Die Cutting 02 | Die Cutting 03 | Automatic Die Cutting | Manual Die Cutting 04 | Manual Die Cutting 05'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(planned_machine, process_name, department, ''::text)) ~~ '%PAST%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(department, process_name, planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%PAST%'::text)) THEN 'Manual Sheet Pasting | Manual Pasting | Flute Laminator | Folder Gluer'::text
            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(planned_machine, process_name, department, ''::text)) ~~ '%STITCH%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(department, process_name, planned_machine, ''::text)) ~~ '%STITCH%'::text)) THEN 'Stitching Manual 01 | Stitching Manual 02 | Auto Stitching'::text
            ELSE 'Review routing department/process and assign a machine that has a Machine Load target'::text
        END AS suggested_target_machines,
    'work_order_routing'::text AS update_table,
    'planned_machine'::text AS update_column,
    'Update work_order_routing.planned_machine where id = routing_id'::text AS update_instruction
   FROM public.v_report_machine_load_lines
  WHERE (load_status = 'NO_TARGET'::text);

            WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(v_report_machine_load_lines.planned_machine, v_report_machine_load_lines.process_name, v_report_machine_load_lines.department, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['PRINTING'::text, 'OFFSET PRINTING'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(v_report_machine_load_lines.department_category, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORRUGATION%'::text)) THEN 'CD102'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(v_report_machine_load_lines.planned_machine, v_report_machine_load_lines.process_name, v_report_machine_load_lines.department, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['PRINTING'::text, 'OFFSET PRINTING'::text])) THEN 'Heidelberg SM74'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(v_report_machine_load_lines.planned_machine, v_report_machine_load_lines.process_name, v_report_machine_load_lines.department, ''::text)) ~~ '%ROTARY%'::text) THEN 'Rotary Cutting'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(v_report_machine_load_lines.planned_machine, v_report_machine_load_lines.process_name, v_report_machine_load_lines.department, ''::text)) = 'LAMINATION'::text) THEN 'Review: report bucket is Lamination; keep/select actual lamination machine if scheduling requires it'::text
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(v_report_machine_load_lines.planned_machine, v_report_machine_load_lines.process_name, v_report_machine_load_lines.department, ''::text)) = 'DIE CUTTING'::text) THEN 'Review: report separates Die Cutting by article department; keep generic only if this is intentional'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS suggested_planned_machine_update,
    'work_order_routing'::text AS update_table,
    'planned_machine'::text AS update_column,
    'Update work_order_routing.planned_machine where id = routing_id after review'::text AS update_instruction
   FROM public.v_report_machine_load_lines
  WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(v_report_machine_load_lines.planned_machine, v_report_machine_load_lines.process_name, v_report_machine_load_lines.department, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['AUTOMATIC'::text, 'AUTO'::text, 'PASTING'::text, 'SIDE PASTING'::text, 'PRINTING'::text, 'OFFSET PRINTING'::text, 'LAMINATION'::text, 'DIE CUTTING'::text])) OR (upper(COALESCE(v_report_machine_load_lines.planned_machine, v_report_machine_load_lines.process_name, v_report_machine_load_lines.department, ''::text)) ~~ '%ROTARY%'::text));


--
-- TOC entry 439 (class 1259 OID 83795)
-- Name: v_report_order_line_traceability; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_order_line_traceability AS
 WITH artwork_base AS (
         SELECT a.so_id,
            a.line_no,
            max(a.artwork_no) AS artwork_no,
            max(a.status) AS artwork_status,
            max(a.plate_status) AS plate_status,
            max(a.die_status) AS die_status
           FROM public.artworks a
          GROUP BY a.so_id, a.line_no
        ), wo_base AS (
         SELECT woj.so_number,
            woj.line_no,
            count(DISTINCT woj.wo_id) AS wo_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT wo.wo_number, ', '::text ORDER BY wo.wo_number) AS wo_numbers
           FROM (public.work_order_jobs woj
             JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
          GROUP BY woj.so_number, woj.line_no
        ), pack_base AS (
         SELECT pr.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(pr.packed_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS packed_qty
           FROM public.packing_records pr
          GROUP BY pr.so_line_id
        ), dispatch_base AS (
         SELECT dr.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS dispatched_qty,
            max(dr.dispatch_date) AS last_dispatch_date
           FROM public.dispatch_records dr
          GROUP BY dr.so_line_id
        ), invoice_base AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS billed_qty
           FROM public.invoice_lines il
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        )
 SELECT so.id AS so_id,
    so.so_number,
    so.so_date,
    so.client_code,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code) AS client_name,
    so.sales_rep,
    so.status AS so_status,
    sol.id AS so_line_id,
    sol.line_no,
    sol.product_code,
    sol.product_name,
    COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
    sol.expected_delivery,
    sol.final_delivery,
    sol.accounts_status,
    sol.business_status,
    ab.artwork_no,
    ab.artwork_status,
    ab.plate_status,
    ab.die_status,
    COALESCE(wb.wo_count, (0)::bigint) AS wo_count,
    COALESCE(wb.wo_numbers, ''::text) AS wo_numbers,
    COALESCE(pb.packed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS packed_qty,
    COALESCE(db.dispatched_qty, (0)::numeric) AS dispatched_qty,
    db.last_dispatch_date,
    COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty
   FROM (((((((public.sales_orders so
     JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN artwork_base ab ON (((ab.so_id = so.id) AND (ab.line_no = sol.line_no))))
     LEFT JOIN wo_base wb ON (((wb.so_number = so.so_number) AND (wb.line_no = sol.line_no))))
     LEFT JOIN pack_base pb ON ((pb.so_line_id = sol.id)))
     LEFT JOIN dispatch_base db ON ((db.so_line_id = sol.id)))
     LEFT JOIN invoice_base ib ON ((ib.so_line_id = sol.id)))
  WHERE (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text);


--
-- TOC entry 594 (class 1259 OID 185345)
-- Name: v_report_otif_job_detail; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_otif_job_detail WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH clock AS (
         SELECT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))::date AS today_date
        ), artwork_ranked AS (
         SELECT a.so_id,
            a.line_no,
            NULLIF(a.artwork_no, ''::text) AS artwork_no,
            NULLIF(a.product_type, ''::text) AS product_type,
            COALESCE(a.status, 'NO_ART'::text) AS artwork_status,
            a.artwork_at,
            a.approved_at AS artwork_approved_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.so_id, a.line_no ORDER BY a.approved_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.artwork_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.id DESC) AS rn
           FROM public.artworks a
        ), artwork_base AS (
         SELECT artwork_ranked.so_id,
            artwork_ranked.line_no,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_no,
            artwork_ranked.product_type,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_status,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_at,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_approved_at,
            artwork_ranked.rn
           FROM artwork_ranked
          WHERE (artwork_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), line_base AS (
         SELECT so.id AS so_id,
            sol.id AS so_line_id,
            so.so_number,
            COALESCE(so.so_date, (so.created_at)::date) AS so_date,
            COALESCE(so.created_at, (so.so_date)::timestamp without time zone) AS so_created_at,
            so.client_code,
            COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            so.sales_rep,
            sol.line_no,
            sol.product_code,
            sol.product_name,
            sol.category,
            sol.division,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.division, ab.product_type, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'Corrugation'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.division, ab.product_type, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEX%'::text) THEN 'Flexo'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.division, ab.product_type, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGI%'::text) THEN 'Digital'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.division, ab.product_type, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(sol.division, ab.product_type, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLAT%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(sol.division, ab.product_type, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%COMMERCIAL%'::text)) THEN 'Offset'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.division, ''::text), NULLIF(ab.product_type, ''::text), NULLIF(sol.category, ''::text), 'Unassigned'::text)
                END AS department,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            COALESCE(sol.unit, ''::text) AS unit,
            COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.net_amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(sol.amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(sol.total_amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(sol.line_total, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS order_value,
            COALESCE(sol.job_type, ''::text) AS job_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.job_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%REPEAT%'::text) THEN 'REPEAT'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.job_type, ''::text)) ~~ '%NEW%'::text) THEN 'NEW'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(sol.job_type), ''::text), 'NEW'::text)
                END AS job_type_bucket,
            COALESCE(sol.job_reference, ''::text) AS sales_job_reference,
            COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_line_status,
            COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS accounts_status,
            sol.accounts_at,
            COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS business_status,
            sol.business_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN 'APPROVED'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, ''::text)) = 'HOLD'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, ''::text)) = 'HOLD'::text)) THEN 'HOLD'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, ''::text)) = 'REJECTED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, ''::text)) = 'REJECTED'::text)) THEN 'REJECTED'::text
                    ELSE 'PENDING'::text
                END AS sales_approval_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(sol.accounts_at, sol.business_at), COALESCE(sol.business_at, sol.accounts_at))
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END AS sales_approval_at,
            ab.artwork_no,
            ab.product_type,
            COALESCE(ab.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text) AS artwork_status,
            ab.artwork_at,
            ab.artwork_approved_at
           FROM (((public.sales_orders so
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN artwork_base ab ON (((ab.so_id = so.id) AND (ab.line_no = sol.line_no))))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.remarks, ''::text)) !~~ '%SYSTEM GENERATED FOR MANUAL BILLING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        ), wo_base AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            count(DISTINCT woj.wo_id) AS wo_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo.wo_number, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo.wo_number, ''::text)) AS wo_numbers,
            min(wo.wo_date) AS first_wo_date,
            max(wo.wo_date) AS latest_wo_date,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(woj.job_reference, ''::text)) AS job_references,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(woj.artwork_no, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(woj.artwork_no, ''::text)) AS wo_artwork_nos
           FROM ((line_base lb
             JOIN public.work_order_jobs woj ON (((woj.so_number = lb.so_number) AND (woj.line_no = lb.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id
        ), routing_base AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(r.status, 'PENDING'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text]))) AS required_stage_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text), ' | '::text ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text)) FILTER (WHERE (upper(COALESCE(r.status, 'PENDING'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text]))) AS required_stages
           FROM ((line_base lb
             JOIN public.work_order_jobs woj ON (((woj.so_number = lb.so_number) AND (woj.line_no = lb.line_no))))
             JOIN public.work_order_routing r ON ((r.wo_id = woj.wo_id)))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id
        ), production_stage_base AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            pe.routing_id,
            max(COALESCE(pe.entry_datetime, pe.created_at)) AS last_stage_entry_at,
            sum(COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))) AS ok_qty
           FROM (public.production_entries pe
             JOIN line_base lb ON (((lb.so_number = pe.so_number) AND ((lb.line_no)::text = btrim(pe.line_no)))))
          WHERE ((COALESCE(pe.so_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (COALESCE(pe.line_no, ''::text) <> ''::text) AND (pe.routing_id IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(pe.ok_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(pe.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pe.rejected_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) > (0)::numeric))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id, pe.routing_id
        ), production_base AS (
         SELECT psb.so_line_id,
            count(DISTINCT psb.routing_id) AS completed_stage_count,
            max(psb.last_stage_entry_at) AS production_completed_at,
            sum(psb.ok_qty) AS production_ok_qty
           FROM production_stage_base psb
          GROUP BY psb.so_line_id
        ), billing_base AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            (count(DISTINCT il.invoice_id))::integer AS invoice_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(inv.invoice_no, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(inv.invoice_no, ''::text)) AS invoice_nos,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS billed_qty,
            min(inv.invoice_date) AS first_invoice_date,
            max(inv.invoice_date) AS last_invoice_date
           FROM (public.invoice_lines il
             JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
          WHERE ((il.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) <> 'CHALLAN'::text) AND (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) !~~ 'DC-H/%'::text))
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT lb.so_id,
            lb.so_line_id,
            lb.so_number,
            lb.so_date,
            lb.so_created_at,
            lb.client_code,
            lb.client_name,
            lb.sales_rep,
            lb.line_no,
            lb.product_code,
            lb.product_name,
            lb.category,
            lb.division,
            lb.department,
            lb.order_qty,
            lb.unit,
            lb.rate,
            lb.order_value,
            lb.job_type,
            lb.job_type_bucket,
            lb.sales_job_reference,
            lb.so_line_status,
            lb.accounts_status,
            lb.accounts_at,
            lb.business_status,
            lb.business_at,
            lb.sales_approval_status,
            lb.sales_approval_at,
            lb.artwork_no,
            lb.product_type,
            lb.artwork_status,
            lb.artwork_at,
            lb.artwork_approved_at,
            COALESCE(wb.wo_count, (0)::bigint) AS wo_count,
            COALESCE(wb.wo_numbers, ''::text) AS wo_numbers,
            wb.first_wo_date,
            wb.latest_wo_date,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wb.job_references, ''::text), NULLIF(lb.sales_job_reference, ''::text), ''::text) AS job_reference,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(lb.artwork_no, ''::text), NULLIF(wb.wo_artwork_nos, ''::text), ''::text) AS effective_artwork_no,
            COALESCE(rb.required_stage_count, (0)::bigint) AS required_stage_count,
            COALESCE(rb.required_stages, ''::text) AS required_stages,
            COALESCE(pb.completed_stage_count, (0)::bigint) AS completed_stage_count,
            pb.production_completed_at,
            COALESCE(pb.production_ok_qty, (0)::numeric) AS production_ok_qty,
            COALESCE(bb.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count,
            COALESCE(bb.invoice_nos, ''::text) AS invoice_nos,
            COALESCE(bb.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
            bb.first_invoice_date,
            bb.last_invoice_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(bb.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) >= COALESCE(lb.order_qty, (0)::numeric)) AND (COALESCE(lb.order_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN bb.last_invoice_date
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS final_billing_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((lb.department = 'Corrugation'::text) AND (lb.job_type_bucket = 'REPEAT'::text)) THEN 6
                    WHEN (lb.department = 'Corrugation'::text) THEN 11
                    ELSE 4
                END AS production_tat_days,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((lb.department = 'Corrugation'::text) AND (lb.job_type_bucket = 'REPEAT'::text)) THEN 7
                    WHEN (lb.department = 'Corrugation'::text) THEN 12
                    ELSE 5
                END AS final_tat_days
           FROM ((((line_base lb
             LEFT JOIN wo_base wb ON ((wb.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN routing_base rb ON ((rb.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN production_base pb ON ((pb.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN billing_base bb ON ((bb.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
        ), targets AS (
         SELECT c.so_id,
            c.so_line_id,
            c.so_number,
            c.so_date,
            c.so_created_at,
            c.client_code,
            c.client_name,
            c.sales_rep,
            c.line_no,
            c.product_code,
            c.product_name,
            c.category,
            c.division,
            c.department,
            c.order_qty,
            c.unit,
            c.rate,
            c.order_value,
            c.job_type,
            c.job_type_bucket,
            c.sales_job_reference,
            c.so_line_status,
            c.accounts_status,
            c.accounts_at,
            c.business_status,
            c.business_at,
            c.sales_approval_status,
            c.sales_approval_at,
            c.artwork_no,
            c.product_type,
            c.artwork_status,
            c.artwork_at,
            c.artwork_approved_at,
            c.wo_count,
            c.wo_numbers,
            c.first_wo_date,
            c.latest_wo_date,
            c.job_reference,
            c.effective_artwork_no,
            c.required_stage_count,
            c.required_stages,
            c.completed_stage_count,
            c.production_completed_at,
            c.production_ok_qty,
            c.invoice_count,
            c.invoice_nos,
            c.billed_qty,
            c.first_invoice_date,
            c.last_invoice_date,
            c.final_billing_date,
            c.production_tat_days,
            c.final_tat_days,
            c.so_date AS so_approval_target_date,
            ((c.so_date + '1 day'::interval))::date AS artwork_approval_target_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN (c.artwork_approved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN (((c.artwork_approved_at)::date + ((c.production_tat_days || ' days'::text))::interval))::date
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS production_target_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((c.required_stage_count > 0) AND (c.completed_stage_count >= c.required_stage_count) AND (c.production_completed_at IS NOT NULL)) THEN (c.production_completed_at)::date
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS production_completed_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((c.required_stage_count > 0) AND (c.completed_stage_count >= c.required_stage_count) AND (c.production_completed_at IS NOT NULL)) THEN (c.production_completed_at)::date
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS dispatch_billing_target_date,
            ((c.so_date + ((c.final_tat_days || ' days'::text))::interval))::date AS final_otif_target_date
           FROM calc c
        ), status_calc AS (
         SELECT t.so_id,
            t.so_line_id,
            t.so_number,
            t.so_date,
            t.so_created_at,
            t.client_code,
            t.client_name,
            t.sales_rep,
            t.line_no,
            t.product_code,
            t.product_name,
            t.category,
            t.division,
            t.department,
            t.order_qty,
            t.unit,
            t.rate,
            t.order_value,
            t.job_type,
            t.job_type_bucket,
            t.sales_job_reference,
            t.so_line_status,
            t.accounts_status,
            t.accounts_at,
            t.business_status,
            t.business_at,
            t.sales_approval_status,
            t.sales_approval_at,
            t.artwork_no,
            t.product_type,
            t.artwork_status,
            t.artwork_at,
            t.artwork_approved_at,
            t.wo_count,
            t.wo_numbers,
            t.first_wo_date,
            t.latest_wo_date,
            t.job_reference,
            t.effective_artwork_no,
            t.required_stage_count,
            t.required_stages,
            t.completed_stage_count,
            t.production_completed_at,
            t.production_ok_qty,
            t.invoice_count,
            t.invoice_nos,
            t.billed_qty,
            t.first_invoice_date,
            t.last_invoice_date,
            t.final_billing_date,
            t.production_tat_days,
            t.final_tat_days,
            t.so_approval_target_date,
            t.artwork_approval_target_date,
            t.production_target_date,
            t.production_completed_date,
            t.dispatch_billing_target_date,
            t.final_otif_target_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN (t.so_date IS NULL) THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text
                    WHEN ((t.sales_approval_at IS NULL) AND (cl.today_date <= t.so_approval_target_date)) THEN 'PENDING_IN_TAT'::text
                    WHEN (t.sales_approval_at IS NULL) THEN 'PENDING_DELAYED'::text
                    WHEN ((t.sales_approval_at)::date <= t.so_approval_target_date) THEN 'ON_TIME'::text
                    ELSE 'DELAYED'::text
                END AS so_approval_otif_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (t.so_date IS NULL) THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text
                    WHEN ((t.artwork_approved_at IS NULL) AND (cl.today_date <= t.artwork_approval_target_date)) THEN 'PENDING_IN_TAT'::text
                    WHEN (t.artwork_approved_at IS NULL) THEN 'PENDING_DELAYED'::text
                    WHEN ((t.artwork_approved_at)::date <= t.artwork_approval_target_date) THEN 'ON_TIME'::text
                    ELSE 'DELAYED'::text
                END AS artwork_approval_otif_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (t.artwork_approved_at IS NULL) THEN 'WAITING_PREVIOUS_STAGE'::text
                    WHEN (t.required_stage_count <= 0) THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text
                    WHEN ((t.production_completed_date IS NULL) AND (cl.today_date <= t.production_target_date)) THEN 'PENDING_IN_TAT'::text
                    WHEN (t.production_completed_date IS NULL) THEN 'PENDING_DELAYED'::text
                    WHEN (t.production_completed_date <= t.production_target_date) THEN 'ON_TIME'::text
                    ELSE 'DELAYED'::text
                END AS production_otif_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (t.production_completed_date IS NULL) THEN 'WAITING_PREVIOUS_STAGE'::text
                    WHEN ((t.first_invoice_date IS NULL) AND (cl.today_date <= t.dispatch_billing_target_date)) THEN 'PENDING_IN_TAT'::text
                    WHEN (t.first_invoice_date IS NULL) THEN 'PENDING_DELAYED'::text
                    WHEN (t.first_invoice_date <= t.dispatch_billing_target_date) THEN 'ON_TIME'::text
                    ELSE 'DELAYED'::text
                END AS dispatch_billing_otif_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (t.so_date IS NULL) THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text
                    WHEN ((t.final_billing_date IS NULL) AND (cl.today_date <= t.final_otif_target_date)) THEN 'PENDING_IN_TAT'::text
                    WHEN (t.final_billing_date IS NULL) THEN 'PENDING_DELAYED'::text
                    WHEN (t.final_billing_date <= t.final_otif_target_date) THEN 'ON_TIME'::text
                    ELSE 'DELAYED'::text
                END AS final_otif_status
           FROM (targets t
             CROSS JOIN clock cl)
        )
 SELECT so_id,
    so_line_id,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    so_created_at,
    client_code,
    client_name,
    sales_rep,
    line_no,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    category,
    division,
    department,
    order_qty,
    unit,
    rate,
    round(order_value, 2) AS order_value,
    job_type,
    job_type_bucket,
    so_line_status,
    accounts_status,
    accounts_at,
    business_status,
    business_at,
    sales_approval_status,
    sales_approval_at,
    effective_artwork_no AS artwork_no,
    product_type,
    artwork_status,
    artwork_at,
    artwork_approved_at,
    wo_count,
    wo_numbers,
    first_wo_date,
    latest_wo_date,
    job_reference,
    required_stage_count,
    completed_stage_count,
    required_stages,
    production_ok_qty,
    production_completed_at,
    production_completed_date,
    invoice_count,
    invoice_nos,
    round(billed_qty, 3) AS billed_qty,
    first_invoice_date,
    last_invoice_date,
    final_billing_date,
    production_tat_days,
    final_tat_days,
    so_approval_target_date,
    (sales_approval_at)::date AS so_approval_actual_date,
    so_approval_otif_status,
    artwork_approval_target_date,
    (artwork_approved_at)::date AS artwork_approval_actual_date,
    artwork_approval_otif_status,
    production_target_date,
    production_otif_status,
    dispatch_billing_target_date,
    first_invoice_date AS dispatch_billing_actual_date,
    dispatch_billing_otif_status,
    final_otif_target_date,
    final_billing_date AS final_otif_actual_date,
    final_otif_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (final_otif_status = 'ON_TIME'::text) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_final_otif_on_time,
    ( SELECT min(v.d) AS min
           FROM ( VALUES (sc.so_approval_target_date), (sc.artwork_approval_target_date), (sc.production_target_date), (sc.dispatch_billing_target_date), (sc.final_otif_target_date)) v(d)
          WHERE (v.d IS NOT NULL)) AS otif_first_target_date,
    ( SELECT max(v.d) AS max
           FROM ( VALUES (sc.so_approval_target_date), (sc.artwork_approval_target_date), (sc.production_target_date), (sc.dispatch_billing_target_date), (sc.final_otif_target_date)) v(d)
          WHERE (v.d IS NOT NULL)) AS otif_last_target_date,
    ( SELECT min(v.d) AS min
           FROM ( VALUES ((sc.sales_approval_at)::date), ((sc.artwork_approved_at)::date), (sc.production_completed_date), (sc.first_invoice_date), (sc.final_billing_date)) v(d)
          WHERE (v.d IS NOT NULL)) AS otif_first_actual_date,
    ( SELECT max(v.d) AS max
           FROM ( VALUES ((sc.sales_approval_at)::date), ((sc.artwork_approved_at)::date), (sc.production_completed_date), (sc.first_invoice_date), (sc.final_billing_date)) v(d)
          WHERE (v.d IS NOT NULL)) AS otif_last_actual_date
   FROM status_calc sc;

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_planning_lifecycle_fast WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH posted_invoice_base AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS posted_billed_qty,
            (count(DISTINCT il.invoice_id))::integer AS posted_invoice_count,
            min(inv.invoice_date) AS posted_first_invoice_date,
            max(inv.invoice_date) AS posted_last_invoice_date,
            max(inv.created_at) AS posted_last_billed_at,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(inv.invoice_no, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(inv.invoice_no, ''::text)) AS posted_invoice_nos,
            string_agg(DISTINCT to_char((inv.invoice_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text), ', '::text ORDER BY (to_char((inv.invoice_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text))) FILTER (WHERE (inv.invoice_date IS NOT NULL)) AS posted_invoice_dates
           FROM (public.invoice_lines il
             JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
          WHERE ((il.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) <> 'CHALLAN'::text) AND (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) !~~ 'DC-H/%'::text))
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        ), artwork_ranked AS (
         SELECT a.so_id,
            a.line_no,
            a.artwork_no,
            a.product_type,
            a.plate_status,
            a.die_status,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(a.status, ''::text),
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text) <> ''::text) THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text
                    ELSE 'NO_ART'::text
                END) AS artwork_status,
            a.artwork_at,
            a.approved_at AS artwork_approved_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.so_id, a.line_no ORDER BY a.approved_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.artwork_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.id DESC) AS rn
           FROM public.artworks a
        ), artwork_base AS (
         SELECT artwork_ranked.so_id,
            artwork_ranked.line_no,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_no,
            artwork_ranked.product_type,
            artwork_ranked.plate_status,
            artwork_ranked.die_status,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_status,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_at,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_approved_at,
            artwork_ranked.rn
           FROM artwork_ranked
          WHERE (artwork_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), wo_base AS (
         SELECT woj.so_number,
            woj.line_no,
            count(DISTINCT woj.wo_id) AS wo_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo.wo_number, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo.wo_number, ''::text)) AS wo_numbers,
            min(wo.wo_date) AS first_wo_at,
            max(wo.wo_date) AS last_wo_at
           FROM (public.work_order_jobs woj
             JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
          GROUP BY woj.so_number, woj.line_no
        ), routing_step_rows AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT woj.so_number,
            woj.line_no,
            COALESCE(r.sequence_no, 0) AS sequence_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(r.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text) AS step_name,
            upper(COALESCE(r.status, 'PENDING'::text)) AS step_status,
            COALESCE(r.created_at, (wo.created_at)::timestamp with time zone, ((wo.wo_date)::timestamp without time zone)::timestamp with time zone) AS marked_at
           FROM ((public.work_order_jobs woj
             JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
             JOIN public.work_order_routing r ON ((r.wo_id = woj.wo_id)))
        ), routing_base AS (
         SELECT routing_step_rows.so_number,
            routing_step_rows.line_no,
            count(*) AS routing_count,
            min(routing_step_rows.marked_at) AS routing_marked_at,
            string_agg(routing_step_rows.step_name, ' | '::text ORDER BY routing_step_rows.sequence_no, routing_step_rows.step_name) AS routing_steps,
            string_agg((((routing_step_rows.step_name || ' ['::text) || routing_step_rows.step_status) || ']'::text), ' | '::text ORDER BY routing_step_rows.sequence_no, routing_step_rows.step_name) AS stage_summary,
            max(routing_step_rows.marked_at) AS stage_last_updated_at
           FROM routing_step_rows
          GROUP BY routing_step_rows.so_number, routing_step_rows.line_no
        ), current_stage AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (routing_step_rows.so_number, routing_step_rows.line_no) routing_step_rows.so_number,
            routing_step_rows.line_no,
            routing_step_rows.step_name AS current_stage,
            routing_step_rows.step_status AS current_stage_status
           FROM routing_step_rows
          WHERE (routing_step_rows.step_status <> 'COMPLETED'::text)
          ORDER BY routing_step_rows.so_number, routing_step_rows.line_no,
                CASE
                    WHEN (routing_step_rows.step_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'::text) THEN 0
                    WHEN (routing_step_rows.step_status = 'PENDING'::text) THEN 1
                    WHEN (routing_step_rows.step_status = 'HOLD'::text) THEN 2
                    WHEN (routing_step_rows.step_status = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) THEN 3
                    ELSE 4
                END, routing_step_rows.sequence_no, routing_step_rows.step_name
        ), base AS (

            so.so_number,
            so.so_date,

            sol.accounts_at,
            COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS business_status,
            sol.business_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN 'APPROVED'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, ''::text)) = 'HOLD'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, ''::text)) = 'HOLD'::text)) THEN 'HOLD'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, ''::text)) = 'REJECTED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, ''::text)) = 'REJECTED'::text)) THEN 'REJECTED'::text
                    ELSE 'PENDING'::text
                END AS sales_approval_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(sol.accounts_at, sol.business_at), COALESCE(sol.business_at, sol.accounts_at))

            pib.posted_first_invoice_date,
            pib.posted_last_invoice_date,

            COALESCE(pib.posted_invoice_nos, ''::text) AS posted_invoice_nos,
            COALESCE(pib.posted_invoice_dates, ''::text) AS posted_invoice_dates
           FROM (((((((public.sales_orders so
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c_1 ON ((c_1.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN artwork_base ab ON (((ab.so_id = so.id) AND (ab.line_no = sol.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN wo_base wb ON (((wb.so_number = so.so_number) AND (wb.line_no = sol.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN routing_base rb ON (((rb.so_number = so.so_number) AND (rb.line_no = sol.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN current_stage cs ON (((cs.so_number = so.so_number) AND (cs.line_no = sol.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN posted_invoice_base pib ON ((pib.so_line_id = sol.id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT b.so_id,

                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(b.so_line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(b.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHORT%CLOSE%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(b.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHORT_CLOSE%'::text)) THEN 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(b.so_line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'PARTIAL_DISPATCHED'::text) THEN 'PARTIAL_DISPATCHED'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(b.so_line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CLOSED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(b.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%MANUAL CLOSE%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(b.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%MANUAL BILLING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(b.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%LEGACY%'::text)) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
                    ELSE 'OPEN'::text

 SELECT so_id,

    posted_last_invoice_date,
    posted_last_billed_at,
    posted_invoice_nos,
    posted_invoice_dates,
    closure_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (closure_status = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(closed_by, ''::text), 'Manual short close'::text)
            WHEN (closure_status = 'PARTIAL_DISPATCHED'::text) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(closed_by, ''::text), 'Marked for partial dispatch'::text)
            WHEN ((closure_status = 'CLOSED'::text) AND (COALESCE(posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric) >= COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric))) THEN 'Fully billed'::text
            WHEN (closure_status = 'CLOSED'::text) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(closed_by, ''::text), 'Closed'::text)
            WHEN (closure_status = 'CANCELLED'::text) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(closed_by, ''::text), 'Cancelled'::text)
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS closure_reason,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(routing_count, (0)::bigint) > 0) THEN 'MARKED'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING'::text
        END AS routing_status,
    GREATEST((COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS billing_gap_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (closure_status = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) THEN GREATEST((COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS short_closed_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (closure_status = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text])) THEN (0)::numeric
            ELSE GREATEST((COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)
        END AS operational_billing_pending_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN (closure_status = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text, 'PARTIAL_DISPATCHED'::text])) THEN closure_status
            WHEN (GREATEST((COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PENDING'::text
            ELSE 'CLOSED'::text
        END AS planning_billing_status,
    ((COALESCE(posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric) < COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric))) AS partially_billed_flag,
    lower(concat_ws(' '::text, so_number, (line_no)::text, po_number, so_line_status, closed_by, client_name, client_code, division, product_code, product_name, category, sales_rep, artwork_no, wo_numbers, routing_steps, stage_summary, posted_invoice_nos)) AS match_text,
    lower(concat_ws(' '::text, accounts_status, business_status, sales_approval_status, so_line_status, artwork_status, plate_status, die_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(routing_count, (0)::bigint) > 0) THEN 'MARKED'::text
            ELSE 'PENDING'::text
        END, current_stage_status, closure_status)) AS status_text
   FROM classified c;
