CREATE VIEW public.v_report_repeat_job_plate_die_procurement AS
 WITH tooling_po_lines AS (
         SELECT pol.id AS po_line_id,
            pol.po_id,
            pol.po_no,
            pol.line_no AS po_line_no,
            po.order_date AS po_date,
            COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS po_status,
            COALESCE(po.vendor_name, ''::text) AS vendor_name,
            COALESCE(po.created_by, ''::text) AS buyer_name,
            upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) AS source_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text])) THEN 'PLATE'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) THEN 'DIE'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END AS procurement_type,
            COALESCE(pol.source_ref, ''::text) AS source_ref,
            regexp_replace(upper(btrim(COALESCE(pol.source_ref, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) AS source_ref_key,
            COALESCE(pol.job_ref, ''::text) AS job_ref,
            COALESCE(pol.item_code, ''::text) AS item_code,
            COALESCE(pol.item_name, ''::text) AS item_name,
            COALESCE(pol.department, ''::text) AS po_department,
            COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS ordered_qty,
            COALESCE(pol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS po_rate,
            COALESCE(pol.tax_pct, (0)::numeric) AS tax_pct,
            abs(COALESCE(NULLIF(pol.amount, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(pol.rate, (0)::numeric)))) AS ordered_basic_value,
            abs(COALESCE(pol.tax_amount, (0)::numeric)) AS ordered_tax_value,
            abs(COALESCE(NULLIF(pol.total_amount, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(NULLIF(pol.amount, (0)::numeric), (COALESCE(pol.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(pol.rate, (0)::numeric))) + COALESCE(pol.tax_amount, (0)::numeric)))) AS ordered_total_value,
            COALESCE(pol.remarks, ''::text) AS po_line_remarks,
            pol.created_at AS po_line_created_at
           FROM (public.purchase_order_lines pol
             JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON ((po.id = pol.po_id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(pol.source_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['ARTWORK_PLATE'::text, 'ARTWORK_DIE'::text, 'DIRECT_PLATE'::text, 'DIRECT_DIE'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(po.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        ), active_receipts AS (
         SELECT r.po_line_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS receipt_count,
            sum(COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS received_qty,
            sum((COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(NULLIF(r.rate, (0)::numeric), tpl.po_rate, (0)::numeric))) AS received_basic_value,
            min(r.receipt_date) AS first_receipt_date,
            max(r.receipt_date) AS last_receipt_date,
            string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(r.grn_no), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(r.challan_no), ''::text), (r.id)::text), ', '::text ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(r.grn_no), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(r.challan_no), ''::text), (r.id)::text)) AS receipt_refs
           FROM (public.purchase_po_receipts r
             JOIN tooling_po_lines tpl ON ((tpl.po_line_id = r.po_line_id)))
          WHERE ((COALESCE(r.qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (r.reversed_at IS NULL) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.inv_ledger rev
                  WHERE ((r.ledger_id IS NOT NULL) AND (rev.ref_no = (r.ledger_id)::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(rev.ref_type, ''::text)) ~~ 'REV-%'::text))))))
          GROUP BY r.po_line_id
        ), po_line_quantities AS (
         SELECT tpl.po_line_id,
            tpl.po_id,
            tpl.po_no,
            tpl.po_line_no,
            tpl.po_date,
            tpl.po_status,
            tpl.vendor_name,
            tpl.buyer_name,
            tpl.source_type,
            tpl.procurement_type,
            tpl.source_ref,
            tpl.source_ref_key,
            tpl.job_ref,
            tpl.item_code,
            tpl.item_name,
            tpl.po_department,
            tpl.ordered_qty,
            tpl.po_rate,
            tpl.tax_pct,
            tpl.ordered_basic_value,
            tpl.ordered_tax_value,
            tpl.ordered_total_value,
            tpl.po_line_remarks,
            tpl.po_line_created_at,
            COALESCE(ar.receipt_count, 0) AS receipt_count,
            COALESCE(ar.received_qty, (0)::numeric) AS received_qty,
            COALESCE(ar.received_basic_value, (0)::numeric) AS received_basic_value,
            ar.first_receipt_date,
            ar.last_receipt_date,
            COALESCE(ar.receipt_refs, ''::text) AS receipt_refs,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(tpl.po_line_remarks, ''::text) ~* '\[PO_SHORT_CLOSE'::text) THEN LEAST(GREATEST((tpl.ordered_qty - COALESCE(ar.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), COALESCE((NULLIF("substring"(COALESCE(tpl.po_line_remarks, ''::text), '\[PO_SHORT_CLOSE[^\]]*qty=([0-9.]+)'::text), ''::text))::numeric, GREATEST((tpl.ordered_qty - COALESCE(ar.received_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)))
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS short_closed_qty
           FROM (tooling_po_lines tpl
             LEFT JOIN active_receipts ar ON ((ar.po_line_id = tpl.po_line_id)))
        ), artwork_jobs AS (
         SELECT a.id AS artwork_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text), (((a.id)::text || '||'::text) || (a.line_no)::text)) AS artwork_key,
            COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text) AS artwork_no,
            so.so_number,
            so.so_date,
            sol.line_no,
            COALESCE(sol.job_type, ''::text) AS job_type,
            COALESCE(sol.division, ''::text) AS division,
            COALESCE(sol.product_code, ''::text) AS product_code,
            COALESCE(sol.product_name, ''::text) AS product_name,
            COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            COALESCE(so.sales_rep, ''::text) AS sales_rep,
            COALESCE(a.product_type, ''::text) AS artwork_product_type,
            COALESCE(a.plate_status, ''::text) AS plate_status,
            COALESCE(a.die_status, ''::text) AS die_status,
            COALESCE(a.plate_size, ''::text) AS plate_size,
            (COALESCE(a.plate_count, 0))::numeric AS plate_count,
            COALESCE(a.hybrid_plate_size, ''::text) AS hybrid_plate_size,
            (COALESCE(a.hybrid_plate_count, 0))::numeric AS hybrid_plate_count,
            (COALESCE(a.die_count, 0))::numeric AS die_count
           FROM (((public.artworks a
             JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = a.so_id)))
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = a.so_id) AND (sol.line_no = a.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(btrim(COALESCE(sol.job_type, ''::text))) ~~ '%REPEAT%'::text))
        ), artwork_job_ref_keys AS (
         SELECT aj.artwork_id,
            aj.artwork_key,
            aj.artwork_no,
            aj.so_number,
            aj.so_date,
            aj.line_no,
            aj.job_type,
            aj.division,
            aj.product_code,
            aj.product_name,
            aj.client_name,
            aj.sales_rep,
            aj.artwork_product_type,
            aj.plate_status,
            aj.die_status,
            aj.plate_size,
            aj.plate_count,
            aj.hybrid_plate_size,
            aj.hybrid_plate_count,
            aj.die_count,
            regexp_replace(upper(((aj.so_number || '/'::text) || (aj.line_no)::text)), '\s+'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) AS job_ref_key
           FROM artwork_jobs aj
        UNION ALL
         SELECT aj.artwork_id,
            aj.artwork_key,
            aj.artwork_no,
            aj.so_number,
            aj.so_date,
            aj.line_no,
            aj.job_type,
            aj.division,
            aj.product_code,
            aj.product_name,
            aj.client_name,
            aj.sales_rep,
            aj.artwork_product_type,
            aj.plate_status,
            aj.die_status,
            aj.plate_size,
            aj.plate_count,
            aj.hybrid_plate_size,
            aj.hybrid_plate_count,
            aj.die_count,
            regexp_replace(upper(((aj.so_number || '||'::text) || (aj.line_no)::text)), '\s+'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) AS job_ref_key
           FROM artwork_jobs aj
        ), artwork_source_ref_keys AS (
         SELECT aj.artwork_id,
            regexp_replace(upper(btrim(aj.artwork_key)), '\s+'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) AS source_ref_key
           FROM artwork_jobs aj
          WHERE (btrim(aj.artwork_key) <> ''::text)
        UNION
         SELECT aj.artwork_id,
            regexp_replace(upper(btrim(aj.artwork_no)), '\s+'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) AS source_ref_key
           FROM artwork_jobs aj
          WHERE (btrim(aj.artwork_no) <> ''::text)
        ), job_ref_tokens AS (
         SELECT plq.po_line_id,
            regexp_replace(upper(btrim(ref_token.value)), '\s+'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) AS job_ref_token
           FROM (po_line_quantities plq
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(plq.job_ref, ''::text), '\s*[,;\n\r]+\s*'::text) ref_token(value))
          WHERE (btrim(ref_token.value) <> ''::text)
        ), token_matches_raw AS (
         SELECT jrt.po_line_id,
            ajrk.artwork_id,
            ajrk.artwork_key,
            ajrk.artwork_no,
            ajrk.so_number,
            ajrk.so_date,
            ajrk.line_no,
            ajrk.job_type,
            ajrk.division,
            ajrk.product_code,
            ajrk.product_name,
            ajrk.client_name,
            ajrk.sales_rep,
            ajrk.artwork_product_type,
            ajrk.plate_status,
            ajrk.die_status,
            ajrk.plate_size,

            ajrk.hybrid_plate_size,
            ajrk.hybrid_plate_count,
            ajrk.die_count,
            'JOB_REF'::text AS linkage_method
           FROM (job_ref_tokens jrt
             JOIN artwork_job_ref_keys ajrk ON ((ajrk.job_ref_key = jrt.job_ref_token)))
        ), token_matches AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (tmr.po_line_id, tmr.so_number, tmr.line_no) tmr.po_line_id,
            tmr.artwork_id,
            tmr.artwork_key,
            tmr.artwork_no,
            tmr.so_number,
            tmr.so_date,
            tmr.line_no,
            tmr.job_type,
            tmr.division,
            tmr.product_code,
            tmr.product_name,
            tmr.client_name,
            tmr.sales_rep,
            tmr.artwork_product_type,
            tmr.plate_status,
            tmr.die_status,
            tmr.plate_size,
            tmr.plate_count,
            tmr.hybrid_plate_size,
            tmr.hybrid_plate_count,
            tmr.die_count,
            tmr.linkage_method
           FROM token_matches_raw tmr
          ORDER BY tmr.po_line_id, tmr.so_number, tmr.line_no, tmr.so_date DESC NULLS LAST, tmr.artwork_id DESC
        ), source_match_ranked AS (
         SELECT plq.po_line_id,
            aj.artwork_id,
            aj.artwork_key,
            aj.artwork_no,
            aj.so_number,
            aj.so_date,
            aj.line_no,
            aj.job_type,
            aj.division,
            aj.product_code,

            aj.client_name,
            aj.sales_rep,
            aj.artwork_product_type,
            aj.plate_status,
            aj.die_status,
            aj.plate_size,
            aj.plate_count,
            aj.hybrid_plate_size,
            aj.hybrid_plate_count,
            aj.die_count,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY plq.po_line_id ORDER BY aj.so_date DESC NULLS LAST, aj.so_number DESC, aj.line_no DESC, aj.artwork_id DESC) AS source_rank
           FROM ((po_line_quantities plq
             JOIN artwork_source_ref_keys asrk ON ((asrk.source_ref_key = plq.source_ref_key)))
             JOIN artwork_jobs aj ON (((aj.artwork_id = asrk.artwork_id) AND ((plq.po_date IS NULL) OR (aj.so_date IS NULL) OR (aj.so_date <= plq.po_date)))))
          WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM token_matches tm
                  WHERE (tm.po_line_id = plq.po_line_id))))
        ), chosen_job_matches AS (
         SELECT tm.po_line_id,
            tm.artwork_id,
            tm.artwork_key,
            tm.artwork_no,
            tm.so_number,
            tm.so_date,
            tm.line_no,
            tm.job_type,
            tm.division,
            tm.product_code,
            tm.product_name,
            tm.client_name,
            tm.sales_rep,
            tm.artwork_product_type,
            tm.plate_status,
            tm.die_status,
            tm.plate_size,
            tm.plate_count,
            tm.hybrid_plate_size,
            tm.hybrid_plate_count,
            tm.die_count,
            tm.linkage_method
           FROM token_matches tm
        UNION ALL
         SELECT smr.po_line_id,
            smr.artwork_id,
            smr.artwork_key,
            smr.artwork_no,
            smr.so_number,
            smr.so_date,
            smr.line_no,
            smr.job_type,
            smr.division,
            smr.product_code,
            smr.product_name,
            smr.client_name,
            smr.sales_rep,
            smr.artwork_product_type,
            smr.plate_status,
            smr.die_status,
            smr.plate_size,
            smr.plate_count,
            smr.hybrid_plate_size,
            smr.hybrid_plate_count,
            smr.die_count,
            'ARTWORK_FALLBACK'::text AS linkage_method
           FROM source_match_ranked smr
          WHERE (smr.source_rank = 1)
        ), job_context AS (
         SELECT cjm.po_line_id,
            (count(*))::integer AS matched_job_count,
            (count(*))::integer AS repeat_job_count,
                CASE
                    WHEN (count(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(cjm.division), ''::text)) <= 1) THEN COALESCE(max(NULLIF(btrim(cjm.division), ''::text)), 'Unassigned'::text)
                    ELSE 'Mixed'::text
                END AS division,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(cjm.division), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(btrim(cjm.division), ''::text)), ''::text) AS division_list,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(cjm.client_name), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(btrim(cjm.client_name), ''::text)), ''::text) AS client_names,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(cjm.product_name), ''::text), ' / '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(btrim(cjm.product_name), ''::text)), ''::text) AS product_names,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(cjm.sales_rep), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(btrim(cjm.sales_rep), ''::text)), ''::text) AS sales_reps,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(cjm.job_type), ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(btrim(cjm.job_type), ''::text)), ''::text) AS job_types,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT ((cjm.so_number || '/'::text) || (cjm.line_no)::text), ', '::text ORDER BY ((cjm.so_number || '/'::text) || (cjm.line_no)::text)), ''::text) AS matched_so_refs,
            COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT ((cjm.so_number || '/'::text) || (cjm.line_no)::text), ', '::text ORDER BY ((cjm.so_number || '/'::text) || (cjm.line_no)::text)), ''::text) AS repeat_so_refs,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(cjm.artwork_no), ''::text)) AS artwork_no,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(cjm.artwork_product_type), ''::text)) AS artwork_product_type,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(cjm.plate_status), ''::text)) AS plate_status,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(cjm.die_status), ''::text)) AS die_status,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(cjm.plate_size), ''::text)) AS plate_size,
            max(COALESCE(cjm.plate_count, (0)::numeric)) AS plate_count,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(cjm.hybrid_plate_size), ''::text)) AS hybrid_plate_size,
            max(COALESCE(cjm.hybrid_plate_count, (0)::numeric)) AS hybrid_plate_count,
            max(COALESCE(cjm.die_count, (0)::numeric)) AS die_count,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or((cjm.linkage_method = 'JOB_REF'::text)) THEN 'JOB_REF'::text
                    ELSE 'ARTWORK_FALLBACK'::text
                END AS linkage_method
           FROM chosen_job_matches cjm
          GROUP BY cjm.po_line_id
        ), report_base AS (
         SELECT plq.po_line_id,
            plq.po_id,
            plq.po_no,
            plq.po_line_no,
            plq.po_date,
            plq.po_status,
            plq.vendor_name,
            plq.buyer_name,
            plq.source_type,
            plq.procurement_type,
            plq.source_ref,
            plq.source_ref_key,
            plq.job_ref,
            plq.item_code,
            plq.item_name,
            plq.po_department,
            plq.ordered_qty,
            plq.po_rate,
            plq.tax_pct,
            plq.ordered_basic_value,
            plq.ordered_tax_value,
            plq.ordered_total_value,
            plq.po_line_remarks,
            plq.po_line_created_at,
            plq.receipt_count,
            plq.received_qty,
            plq.received_basic_value,
            plq.first_receipt_date,
            plq.last_receipt_date,
            plq.receipt_refs,
            plq.short_closed_qty,
            jc.matched_job_count,
            jc.repeat_job_count,
            'REPEAT'::text AS job_type_scope,
            jc.division,
            jc.division_list,
            jc.client_names,
            jc.product_names,
            jc.sales_reps,
            jc.job_types,
            jc.matched_so_refs,
            jc.repeat_so_refs,
            COALESCE(jc.artwork_no, NULLIF(plq.source_ref, ''::text), ''::text) AS artwork_no,
            COALESCE(jc.artwork_product_type, ''::text) AS artwork_product_type,
            COALESCE(jc.plate_status, ''::text) AS plate_status,
            COALESCE(jc.die_status, ''::text) AS die_status,
            COALESCE(jc.plate_size, ''::text) AS plate_size,
            COALESCE(jc.plate_count, (0)::numeric) AS plate_count,
            COALESCE(jc.hybrid_plate_size, ''::text) AS hybrid_plate_size,
            COALESCE(jc.hybrid_plate_count, (0)::numeric) AS hybrid_plate_count,
            COALESCE(jc.die_count, (0)::numeric) AS die_count,
            jc.linkage_method,
            GREATEST(((plq.ordered_qty - plq.received_qty) - plq.short_closed_qty), (0)::numeric) AS pending_qty
           FROM (po_line_quantities plq
             JOIN job_context jc ON ((jc.po_line_id = plq.po_line_id)))
          WHERE (jc.repeat_job_count > 0)
        )
 SELECT ('PO:'::text || (po_line_id)::text) AS record_id,
    (po_line_id)::text AS po_line_id,
    po_no,
    po_date,
    po_status,
    po_line_no,
    vendor_name,
    buyer_name,
    procurement_type,
    source_type,
        CASE
            WHEN (source_type ~~ 'DIRECT_%'::text) THEN 'DIRECT'::text
            ELSE 'ARTWORK_LINKED'::text
        END AS procurement_source,
    linkage_method,
    job_type_scope,
    repeat_job_count,
    matched_job_count,
    repeat_so_refs,
    matched_so_refs,
    artwork_no,
    artwork_product_type,
    division,
    division_list,
    client_names,
    product_names,
    sales_reps,
    job_types,
    plate_status,
    die_status,
    plate_size,
    (plate_count)::numeric(14,4) AS plate_count,
    hybrid_plate_size,
    (hybrid_plate_count)::numeric(14,4) AS hybrid_plate_count,
    (die_count)::numeric(14,4) AS die_count,
        CASE
            WHEN (procurement_type = 'PLATE'::text) THEN ((plate_count + hybrid_plate_count))::numeric(14,4)
            WHEN (procurement_type = 'DIE'::text) THEN (die_count)::numeric(14,4)
            ELSE (0)::numeric(14,4)
        END AS artwork_required_qty,
    item_code,
    item_name,
    po_department,
    source_ref,
    job_ref,
    (ordered_qty)::numeric(14,4) AS ordered_qty,
    (received_qty)::numeric(14,4) AS received_qty,
    (short_closed_qty)::numeric(14,4) AS short_closed_qty,
    (pending_qty)::numeric(14,4) AS pending_qty,
    (po_rate)::numeric(18,4) AS po_rate,
    (tax_pct)::numeric(8,2) AS tax_pct,
    (ordered_basic_value)::numeric(18,2) AS ordered_basic_value,
    (ordered_tax_value)::numeric(18,2) AS ordered_tax_value,
    (ordered_total_value)::numeric(18,2) AS ordered_total_value,
    (received_basic_value)::numeric(18,2) AS received_basic_value,
    round(((received_basic_value * tax_pct) / 100.0), 2) AS received_tax_value,
    round((received_basic_value * ((1)::numeric + (tax_pct / 100.0))), 2) AS received_total_value,
    round((pending_qty * po_rate), 2) AS pending_basic_value,
    round((((pending_qty * po_rate) * tax_pct) / 100.0), 2) AS pending_tax_value,
    round(((pending_qty * po_rate) * ((1)::numeric + (tax_pct / 100.0))), 2) AS pending_total_value,
        CASE
            WHEN ((short_closed_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (pending_qty <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text
            WHEN ((pending_qty <= (0)::numeric) AND (received_qty > (0)::numeric)) THEN 'RECEIVED'::text
            WHEN (received_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PARTIAL'::text
            ELSE 'ORDERED'::text
        END AS procurement_status,
    receipt_count,
    first_receipt_date,
    last_receipt_date,
    receipt_refs,
    po_line_remarks,
    po_line_created_at
   FROM report_base rb;

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_sales_order_lines_fast WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH posted_invoice_base AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS billed_qty,
            (count(DISTINCT il.invoice_id))::integer AS invoice_count,
            min(inv.invoice_date) AS first_invoice_date,
            max(inv.invoice_date) AS last_invoice_date,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(inv.invoice_no, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(inv.invoice_no, ''::text)) AS invoice_nos,
            string_agg(DISTINCT to_char((inv.invoice_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text), ', '::text ORDER BY (to_char((inv.invoice_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text))) FILTER (WHERE (inv.invoice_date IS NOT NULL)) AS invoice_dates
           FROM (public.invoice_lines il
             JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
          WHERE ((il.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) <> 'CHALLAN'::text) AND (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) !~~ 'DC-H/%'::text))
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        ), base AS (
         SELECT so.id AS so_id,
            sol.id AS so_line_id,
            so.so_number,
            so.so_date,
            so.po_number,
            so.po_date,
            COALESCE(so.created_at, (so.so_date)::timestamp without time zone) AS so_datetime,
            so.created_at AS so_created_at,
            to_char(COALESCE(so.created_at, (so.so_date)::timestamp without time zone), 'HH24:MI'::text) AS so_time,
            so.client_code,
            COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            so.sales_rep,
            sol.line_no,
            COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_line_status,
            sol.product_code,
            sol.product_name,
            sol.category,
            sol.division,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            sol.unit,
            COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
            round((COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS line_amount,
            sol.expected_delivery,
            sol.final_delivery,
            COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS accounts_status,
            sol.accounts_at,
            COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS business_status,
            sol.business_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN 'APPROVED'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, ''::text)) = 'HOLD'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, ''::text)) = 'HOLD'::text)) THEN 'HOLD'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, ''::text)) = 'REJECTED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(sol.business_status, ''::text)) = 'REJECTED'::text)) THEN 'REJECTED'::text
                    ELSE 'PENDING'::text
                END AS sales_approval_status,
            COALESCE(pib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
            GREATEST((COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS billing_pending_qty,
            COALESCE(pib.invoice_count, 0) AS invoice_count,
            COALESCE(pib.invoice_nos, ''::text) AS invoice_nos,
            COALESCE(pib.invoice_dates, ''::text) AS invoice_dates,
            pib.first_invoice_date,
            pib.last_invoice_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text])) THEN upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text))
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(pib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) >= COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric))) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
                    ELSE 'PENDING'::text
                END AS billing_status
           FROM (((public.sales_orders so
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN posted_invoice_base pib ON ((pib.so_line_id = sol.id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
        )
 SELECT so_id,
    so_line_id,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    po_number,
    po_date,
    so_datetime,
    so_created_at,
    so_time,
    client_code,
    client_name,
    sales_rep,
    line_no,
    so_line_status,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    category,
    division,
    order_qty,
    unit,
    rate,
    line_amount,
    expected_delivery,
    final_delivery,
    accounts_status,
    accounts_at,
    business_status,
    business_at,
    sales_approval_status,
    billed_qty,
    billing_pending_qty,
    invoice_count,
    invoice_nos,
    invoice_dates,
    first_invoice_date,
    last_invoice_date,
    billing_status,
    lower(concat_ws(' '::text, so_number, (line_no)::text, po_number, sales_rep, client_name, client_code, division, product_code, product_name, category, invoice_nos)) AS match_text,
    lower(concat_ws(' '::text, so_line_status, accounts_status, business_status, sales_approval_status, billing_status, division, category)) AS status_text
   FROM base b;

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_sheet_utilization_lines WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH base AS (
         SELECT a.id AS artwork_id,
            NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM a.artwork_no), ''::text) AS artwork_no,
            a.so_id,
            a.line_no,
            so.so_number,
            so.so_date,
            so.po_number,
            so.po_date,
            so.sales_rep,
            COALESCE(c_1.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            sol.id AS so_line_id,
            sol.product_code,
            sol.product_name,
            sol.category,
            sol.division,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            sol.unit,
            sol.status AS so_line_status,
            a.product_type,
            a.status AS artwork_status,
            a.artwork_at,
            a.approved_at,
            a.sheet_length,
            a.sheet_width,
            a.across_width,
            a.teeth,
            a.sheet_ups,
            a.across_ups,
            a.along_ups,
            a.total_ups,
            i.length_mm AS item_length_mm,
            i.width_mm AS item_width_mm
           FROM ((((public.artworks a
             JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = a.so_id)))
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = a.so_id) AND (sol.line_no = a.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c_1 ON ((c_1.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN public.items i ON ((upper(i.item_code) = upper(sol.product_code))))
          WHERE ((NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM a.artwork_no), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text))
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT b.artwork_id,
            b.artwork_no,
            b.so_id,
            b.line_no,
            b.so_number,
            b.so_date,
            b.po_number,
            b.po_date,
            b.sales_rep,
            b.client_name,
            b.so_line_id,
            b.product_code,
            b.product_name,
            b.category,
            b.division,
            b.order_qty,
            b.unit,
            b.so_line_status,
            b.product_type,
            b.artwork_status,
            b.artwork_at,
            b.approved_at,
            b.sheet_length,
            b.sheet_width,
            b.across_width,
            b.teeth,
            b.sheet_ups,
            b.across_ups,
            b.along_ups,
            b.total_ups,
            b.item_length_mm,
            b.item_width_mm,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(b.product_type, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.across_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(b.teeth, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN b.across_width
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(b.sheet_length, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(b.sheet_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN b.sheet_length
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS sheet_basis_length_mm,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(b.product_type, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.across_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(b.teeth, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN (b.teeth * 3.175)
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(b.sheet_length, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(b.sheet_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN b.sheet_width
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS sheet_basis_width_mm,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(b.product_type, ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.across_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(b.teeth, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN ((b.across_width * (b.teeth * 3.175)) / 645.16)
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(b.sheet_length, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(b.sheet_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (GREATEST(b.sheet_length, b.sheet_width) <= (120)::numeric)) THEN (b.sheet_length * b.sheet_width)
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(b.sheet_length, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(b.sheet_width, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN ((b.sheet_length * b.sheet_width) / 645.16)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS sheet_area_sq_in,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b.sheet_ups, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN b.sheet_ups
                    WHEN (COALESCE(b.total_ups, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN b.total_ups
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS layout_ups,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(b.item_length_mm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(b.item_width_mm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric)) THEN (b.item_length_mm * b.item_width_mm)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS item_area_mm2
           FROM base b
        )
 SELECT artwork_id,
    artwork_no,
    so_id,
    so_line_id,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    po_number,
    po_date,
    sales_rep,
    line_no,
    client_name,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    category,
    division,
    order_qty,
    unit,
    so_line_status,
    product_type,
    artwork_status,
    artwork_at,
    approved_at,
    sheet_length,
    sheet_width,
    across_width,
    teeth,
    sheet_ups,
    across_ups,
    along_ups,
    total_ups,
    sheet_basis_length_mm,
    sheet_basis_width_mm,
    round(sheet_area_sq_in, 4) AS sheet_area_sq_in,
    item_length_mm,
    item_width_mm,
    round((item_area_mm2 / 645.16), 4) AS item_area_sq_in,
    layout_ups,
    round(((item_area_mm2 * layout_ups) / 645.16), 4) AS job_layout_area_sq_in,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(sheet_basis_length_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(sheet_basis_width_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'MISSING_SHEET_SIZE'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(item_length_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(item_width_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'MISSING_ITEM_DIMENSION'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(layout_ups, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'MISSING_UPS'::text
            ELSE 'OK'::text
        END AS line_calc_status
   FROM calc c;

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_sheet_utilization WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH grouped AS (
         SELECT l.artwork_no,
            min(l.so_date) AS first_so_date,
            max(l.so_date) AS last_so_date,
            min(l.artwork_at) AS artwork_created_at,
            max(l.approved_at) AS artwork_approved_at,
            max(NULLIF(l.product_type, ''::text)) AS product_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and((upper(COALESCE(l.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN 'APPROVED'::text
                    WHEN bool_or((upper(COALESCE(l.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text)) = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text)) THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text
                    WHEN bool_or((upper(COALESCE(l.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::text
                    ELSE 'NO_ART'::text
                END AS artwork_status,
            max(l.sheet_basis_length_mm) AS sheet_basis_length_mm,
            max(l.sheet_basis_width_mm) AS sheet_basis_width_mm,
            max(l.sheet_area_sq_in) AS sheet_area_sq_in,
            max(l.sheet_length) AS sheet_length,
            max(l.sheet_width) AS sheet_width,
            max(l.across_width) AS across_width,
            max(l.teeth) AS teeth,
            max(l.across_ups) AS across_ups,
            max(l.along_ups) AS along_ups,
            max(l.total_ups) AS total_ups,
            (count(*))::integer AS job_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((COALESCE(l.item_length_mm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(l.item_width_mm, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric))))::integer AS jobs_with_dimension,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((COALESCE(l.item_length_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(l.item_width_mm, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric))))::integer AS missing_dimension_jobs,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(l.layout_ups, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)))::integer AS missing_ups_jobs,
            sum(COALESCE(l.layout_ups, (0)::numeric)) AS total_layout_ups,
            sum(COALESCE(l.order_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS total_order_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(l.job_layout_area_sq_in, (0)::numeric)) AS jobs_area_sq_in,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(l.so_number, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(l.so_number, ''::text)) AS so_numbers,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(l.client_name, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(l.client_name, ''::text)) AS client_names,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(l.division, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(l.division, ''::text)) AS divisions,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(l.sales_rep, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(l.sales_rep, ''::text)) AS sales_reps,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(l.category, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(l.category, ''::text)) AS categories,
            string_agg(DISTINCT (l.line_no)::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (l.line_no)::text) AS line_nos,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(l.product_name, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(l.product_name, ''::text)) AS product_names,
            string_agg(concat_ws(' | '::text, NULLIF(l.so_number, ''::text), ('Ln '::text || COALESCE((l.line_no)::text, ''::text)), NULLIF(l.product_name, ''::text), ('UPS '::text || COALESCE(NULLIF((l.layout_ups)::text, '0'::text), 'NA'::text)), ('Area '::text || COALESCE((round(COALESCE(l.job_layout_area_sq_in, (0)::numeric), 2))::text, '0'::text))), '
'::text ORDER BY l.so_number, l.line_no) AS job_area_detail
           FROM public.v_report_sheet_utilization_lines l
          GROUP BY l.artwork_no
        ), calc AS (
         SELECT g.artwork_no,
            g.first_so_date,
            g.last_so_date,
            g.artwork_created_at,
            g.artwork_approved_at,
            g.product_type,
            g.artwork_status,
            g.sheet_basis_length_mm,
            g.sheet_basis_width_mm,
            g.sheet_area_sq_in,
            g.sheet_length,
            g.sheet_width,
            g.across_width,
            g.teeth,
            g.across_ups,
            g.along_ups,
            g.total_ups,
            g.job_count,
            g.jobs_with_dimension,
            g.missing_dimension_jobs,
            g.missing_ups_jobs,
            g.total_layout_ups,
            g.total_order_qty,
            g.jobs_area_sq_in,
            g.so_numbers,
            g.client_names,
            g.divisions,
            g.sales_reps,
            g.categories,
            g.line_nos,
            g.product_names,
            g.job_area_detail
           FROM grouped g
        )
 SELECT artwork_no,
    first_so_date,
    last_so_date,
    artwork_created_at,
    artwork_approved_at,
    product_type,
    artwork_status,
    so_numbers,
    line_nos,
    client_names,
    divisions,
    sales_reps,
    categories,
    product_names,
    sheet_length,
    sheet_width,
    across_width,
    teeth,
    sheet_basis_length_mm,
    sheet_basis_width_mm,
    sheet_area_sq_in,
    across_ups,
    along_ups,
    total_ups,
    job_count,
    jobs_with_dimension,
    missing_dimension_jobs,
    missing_ups_jobs,
    total_layout_ups,
    total_order_qty,
    round(jobs_area_sq_in, 4) AS jobs_area_sq_in,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(sheet_area_sq_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round(LEAST((100)::numeric, ((jobs_area_sq_in / sheet_area_sq_in) * (100)::numeric)), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS utilization_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(sheet_area_sq_in, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round(GREATEST((0)::numeric, ((100)::numeric - ((jobs_area_sq_in / sheet_area_sq_in) * (100)::numeric))), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS wastage_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(sheet_area_sq_in, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'MISSING_SHEET_SIZE'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(missing_dimension_jobs, 0) > 0) THEN 'MISSING_ITEM_DIMENSION'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(missing_ups_jobs, 0) > 0) THEN 'MISSING_UPS'::text
            WHEN (((jobs_area_sq_in / NULLIF(sheet_area_sq_in, (0)::numeric)) * (100)::numeric) > (100)::numeric) THEN 'OVER_UTILIZED'::text
            WHEN (((jobs_area_sq_in / NULLIF(sheet_area_sq_in, (0)::numeric)) * (100)::numeric) < (70)::numeric) THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION'::text
            ELSE 'GOOD'::text
        END AS utilization_status,
    job_area_detail
   FROM calc c;

-- TOC entry 578 (class 1259 OID 176567)
-- Name: v_report_short_excess_dispatch_invoice_lines; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_short_excess_dispatch_invoice_lines WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT il.id AS invoice_line_id,
    il.invoice_id,
    inv.invoice_no,
    inv.invoice_date,
    inv.posted_at,
    inv.created_at AS invoice_created_at,
    upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) AS invoice_status,
    upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) AS document_type,
    il.so_id,
    il.so_line_id,
    so.so_number,
    so.so_date,
    so.po_number,
    so.po_date,
    so.sales_rep,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, inv.client_name, inv.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
    COALESCE(so.client_code, inv.client_code, ''::text) AS client_code,
    sol.line_no,
    COALESCE(sol.product_code, il.product_code, ''::text) AS product_code,
    COALESCE(sol.product_name, il.product_name, ''::text) AS product_name,
    COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text) AS category,
    COALESCE(sol.division, il.division, ''::text) AS division,
    COALESCE(sol.unit, il.unit, 'Pcs'::text) AS unit,
    COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
    COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
    COALESCE(il.rate, sol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
    COALESCE(il.taxable_amount, il.line_amount, il.line_total, (COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(il.rate, sol.rate, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS billed_value,
    COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_line_status,
    COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_status,
    lower(concat_ws(' '::text, COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text), COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text), COALESCE((sol.line_no)::text, ''::text), COALESCE(so.po_number, ''::text), COALESCE(so.sales_rep, ''::text), COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, inv.client_name, inv.client_code, ''::text), COALESCE(sol.division, il.division, ''::text), COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text), COALESCE(sol.product_code, il.product_code, ''::text), COALESCE(sol.product_name, il.product_name, ''::text))) AS match_text
   FROM ((((public.invoice_lines il
     JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
     JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.id = il.so_line_id)))
     JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = sol.so_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
  WHERE ((il.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) <> 'CHALLAN'::text) AND (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) !~~ 'DC-H/%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.remarks, ''::text)) !~~ '%SYSTEM GENERATED FOR MANUAL BILLING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text));


--
-- TOC entry 440 (class 1259 OID 83800)
-- Name: v_report_unbilled_dispatch; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_unbilled_dispatch AS
 WITH dispatch_base AS (
         SELECT dr.so_line_id,
            max(dr.so_number) AS so_number,
            max(dr.line_no) AS line_no,
            max(dr.product_name) AS product_name,
            max(dr.dispatch_date) AS dispatch_date,
            sum(COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS dispatched_qty
           FROM public.dispatch_records dr
          GROUP BY dr.so_line_id
        ), invoice_base AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS billed_qty
           FROM public.invoice_lines il
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        )
 SELECT db.so_line_id,
    db.so_number,
    db.line_no,
    db.product_name,
    db.dispatch_date,
    db.dispatched_qty,
    COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
    GREATEST((db.dispatched_qty - COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS unbilled_qty
   FROM (dispatch_base db
     LEFT JOIN invoice_base ib ON ((ib.so_line_id = db.so_line_id)))
  WHERE (GREATEST((db.dispatched_qty - COALESCE(ib.billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric);

--
-- TOC entry 513 (class 1259 OID 129729)
-- Name: v_report_wip_stage_lines; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_wip_stage_lines AS
 WITH line_base AS (
         SELECT p.so_id,
            p.so_line_id,
            p.so_number,
            p.so_date,
            p.client_code,
            p.client_name,
            p.sales_rep,
            p.line_no,
            sol.division,
            p.product_code,
            p.product_name,
            p.category,
            COALESCE(p.order_qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            COALESCE(p.unit, ''::text) AS unit,
            COALESCE(p.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
            COALESCE(sol.net_amount, sol.amount, (COALESCE(p.order_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(p.rate, (0)::numeric)), sol.total_amount, sol.line_total, (0)::numeric) AS order_value,
            COALESCE(p.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS accounts_status,
            COALESCE(p.business_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS business_status,
            COALESCE(sol.status, p.so_line_status, 'OPEN'::text) AS so_line_status,
            COALESCE(sol.closed_by, ''::text) AS closed_by,
            p.artwork_no,
            COALESCE(p.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text) AS artwork_status,
            p.artwork_at,
            p.artwork_approved_at,
            COALESCE(p.wo_count, (0)::bigint) AS wo_count,
            COALESCE(p.wo_numbers, ''::text) AS wo_numbers,
            p.routing_count,
            p.routing_status,
            p.billing_status
           FROM ((public.v_report_planning_lines p
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.id = p.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = p.so_id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, p.so_line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.remarks, ''::text)) !~~ '%SYSTEM GENERATED FOR MANUAL BILLING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.closed_by, ''::text)) !~~ '%SHORT%CLOSE%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.closed_by, ''::text)) !~~ '%SHORT_CLOSE%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.closed_by, ''::text)) !~~ '%MANUAL CLOSE%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.closed_by, ''::text)) !~~ '%MANUAL BILLING%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.closed_by, ''::text)) !~~ '%LEGACY%'::text))
        ), wo_line_base AS (
         SELECT lb.so_line_id,
            woj.wo_id,
            sum(GREATEST(COALESCE(woj.qty, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric)) AS job_qty
           FROM (line_base lb
             JOIN public.work_order_jobs woj ON (((woj.so_number = lb.so_number) AND (woj.line_no = lb.line_no))))
          GROUP BY lb.so_line_id, woj.wo_id
        ), wo_line_share AS (
         SELECT wlb.so_line_id,
            wlb.wo_id,
            wlb.job_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN (sum(wlb.job_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wlb.wo_id) > (0)::numeric) THEN (wlb.job_qty / NULLIF(sum(wlb.job_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wlb.wo_id), (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE ((1)::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY wlb.wo_id), 0))::numeric)
                END AS wo_share
           FROM wo_line_base wlb
        ), wo_base AS (
         SELECT wls.so_line_id,
            count(DISTINCT wls.wo_id) AS wo_count,
            string_agg(DISTINCT wo.wo_number, ', '::text ORDER BY wo.wo_number) FILTER (WHERE (COALESCE(wo.wo_number, ''::text) <> ''::text)) AS wo_numbers,
            min(wo.wo_date) AS first_wo_date,
            max(wo.wo_date) AS latest_wo_date
           FROM (wo_line_share wls
             LEFT JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = wls.wo_id)))
          GROUP BY wls.so_line_id
        ), packing_base AS (
         SELECT pr.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(pr.packed_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS packed_qty,
            max(COALESCE(pr.produced_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS packing_produced_qty,
            max(pr.packed_at) AS last_packed_at
           FROM public.packing_records pr
          WHERE (pr.so_line_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY pr.so_line_id
        ), dispatch_base AS (
         SELECT dr.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS dispatched_qty,
            max(dr.dispatch_date) AS last_dispatch_date
           FROM public.dispatch_records dr
          WHERE ((dr.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(dr.status, 'DISPATCHED'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text))
          GROUP BY dr.so_line_id
        ), billing_base AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS billed_qty,
            max(inv.invoice_date) AS last_invoice_date
           FROM (public.invoice_lines il
             JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
          WHERE ((il.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) <> 'CHALLAN'::text) AND (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) !~~ 'DC-H/%'::text))
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        ), stage_raw AS (
         SELECT wls.so_line_id,
            q.routing_id,
            q.wo_id,
            q.wo_number,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(q.process_name, ''::text), NULLIF(q.department, ''::text), 'PROCESS'::text) AS process_name,
            q.department,
            q.planned_machine,
            COALESCE(q.sequence_no, 0) AS sequence_no,
            q.department_category,
            COALESCE(q.status, 'PENDING'::text) AS stage_status,
            round((COALESCE(q.planned_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(wls.wo_share, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS process_planned_qty,
            round((COALESCE(q.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(wls.wo_share, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS process_produced_qty,
            round((COALESCE(q.balance_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(wls.wo_share, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS process_balance_qty
           FROM (public.v_production_stage_queue_fast q
             JOIN wo_line_share wls ON ((wls.wo_id = q.wo_id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(q.status, 'PENDING'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text])) AND (COALESCE(q.balance_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric))
        ), stage_balances AS (
         SELECT sr.so_line_id,
            sr.routing_id,
            min(sr.wo_number) AS wo_number,
            sr.process_name,
            max(sr.department) AS department,
            max(sr.planned_machine) AS planned_machine,
            min(sr.sequence_no) AS sequence_no,
            max(sr.department_category) AS department_category,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or((upper(COALESCE(sr.stage_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'IN_PROGRESS'::text)) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'::text
                    WHEN bool_or((upper(COALESCE(sr.stage_status, 'PENDING'::text)) = 'HOLD'::text)) THEN 'HOLD'::text
                    ELSE 'PENDING'::text
                END AS stage_status,
            sum(sr.process_planned_qty) AS process_planned_qty,
            sum(sr.process_produced_qty) AS process_produced_qty,
            sum(sr.process_balance_qty) AS process_balance_qty
           FROM stage_raw sr
          GROUP BY sr.so_line_id, sr.routing_id, sr.process_name
        ), stage_totals AS (
         SELECT stage_balances.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(stage_balances.process_balance_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS total_process_balance_qty,
            count(*) AS open_stage_count
           FROM stage_balances
          GROUP BY stage_balances.so_line_id
        ), last_stage_ranked AS (
         SELECT q.wo_id,
            COALESCE(q.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) AS produced_qty,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY q.wo_id ORDER BY COALESCE(q.sequence_no, 0) DESC, q.routing_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM public.v_production_stage_queue_fast q
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(q.status, 'PENDING'::text)) <> 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text)
        ), last_stage_produced AS (
         SELECT wls.so_line_id,
            sum((COALESCE(lsr.produced_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(wls.wo_share, (0)::numeric))) AS final_stage_produced_qty
           FROM (wo_line_share wls
             JOIN last_stage_ranked lsr ON (((lsr.wo_id = wls.wo_id) AND (lsr.rn = 1))))
          GROUP BY wls.so_line_id
        ), line_qty_base AS (
         SELECT lb.so_id,
            lb.so_line_id,
            lb.so_number,
            lb.so_date,
            lb.client_code,
            lb.client_name,
            lb.sales_rep,
            lb.line_no,
            lb.division,
            lb.product_code,
            lb.product_name,
            lb.category,
            lb.order_qty,
            lb.unit,
            lb.rate,
            lb.order_value,
            lb.accounts_status,
            lb.business_status,
            lb.so_line_status,
            lb.closed_by,
            lb.artwork_no,
            lb.artwork_status,
            lb.artwork_at,
            lb.artwork_approved_at,
            lb.wo_count,
            lb.wo_numbers,
            lb.routing_count,
            lb.routing_status,
            lb.billing_status,
            COALESCE(wb.wo_count, (0)::bigint) AS live_wo_count,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(wb.wo_numbers, ''::text), lb.wo_numbers, ''::text) AS live_wo_numbers,
            wb.first_wo_date,
            wb.latest_wo_date,
            COALESCE(pb.packed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS packed_qty,
            GREATEST(COALESCE(pb.packing_produced_qty, (0)::numeric), COALESCE(lsp.final_stage_produced_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS production_completed_qty,
            pb.last_packed_at,
            COALESCE(db.dispatched_qty, (0)::numeric) AS dispatched_qty,
            db.last_dispatch_date,
            COALESCE(bb.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
            bb.last_invoice_date,
            COALESCE(st.total_process_balance_qty, (0)::numeric) AS total_process_balance_qty,
            COALESCE(st.open_stage_count, (0)::bigint) AS open_stage_count
           FROM ((((((line_base lb
             LEFT JOIN wo_base wb ON ((wb.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN packing_base pb ON ((pb.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN dispatch_base db ON ((db.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN billing_base bb ON ((bb.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN last_stage_produced lsp ON ((lsp.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN stage_totals st ON ((st.so_line_id = lb.so_line_id)))
        ), line_open AS (
         SELECT lqb.so_id,
            lqb.so_line_id,
            lqb.so_number,
            lqb.so_date,
            lqb.client_code,
            lqb.client_name,
            lqb.sales_rep,
            lqb.line_no,
            lqb.division,
            lqb.product_code,
            lqb.product_name,
            lqb.category,
            lqb.order_qty,
            lqb.unit,
            lqb.rate,
            lqb.order_value,
            lqb.accounts_status,
            lqb.business_status,
            lqb.so_line_status,
            lqb.closed_by,
            lqb.artwork_no,
            lqb.artwork_status,
            lqb.artwork_at,
            lqb.artwork_approved_at,
            lqb.wo_count,
            lqb.wo_numbers,
            lqb.routing_count,
            lqb.routing_status,
            lqb.billing_status,
            lqb.live_wo_count,
            lqb.live_wo_numbers,
            lqb.first_wo_date,
            lqb.latest_wo_date,
            lqb.packed_qty,
            lqb.production_completed_qty,
            lqb.last_packed_at,
            lqb.dispatched_qty,
            lqb.last_dispatch_date,
            lqb.billed_qty,
            lqb.last_invoice_date,
            lqb.total_process_balance_qty,
            lqb.open_stage_count,
            GREATEST((COALESCE(lqb.order_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(lqb.billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS open_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(lqb.order_qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (COALESCE(lqb.order_value, (0)::numeric) / NULLIF(lqb.order_qty, (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE COALESCE(lqb.rate, (0)::numeric)
                END AS unit_value
           FROM line_qty_base lqb
        ), line_dispatch_alloc AS (
         SELECT lo.so_id,
            lo.so_line_id,
            lo.so_number,
            lo.so_date,
            lo.client_code,
            lo.client_name,
            lo.sales_rep,
            lo.line_no,
            lo.division,
            lo.product_code,
            lo.product_name,
            lo.category,
            lo.order_qty,
            lo.unit,
            lo.rate,
            lo.order_value,
            lo.accounts_status,
            lo.business_status,
            lo.so_line_status,
            lo.closed_by,
            lo.artwork_no,
            lo.artwork_status,
            lo.artwork_at,
            lo.artwork_approved_at,
            lo.wo_count,
            lo.wo_numbers,
            lo.routing_count,
            lo.routing_status,
            lo.billing_status,
            lo.live_wo_count,
            lo.live_wo_numbers,
            lo.first_wo_date,
            lo.latest_wo_date,
            lo.packed_qty,
            lo.production_completed_qty,
            lo.last_packed_at,
            lo.dispatched_qty,
            lo.last_dispatch_date,
            lo.billed_qty,
            lo.last_invoice_date,
            lo.total_process_balance_qty,
            lo.open_stage_count,
            lo.open_qty,
            lo.unit_value,
            LEAST(lo.open_qty, GREATEST((COALESCE(lo.dispatched_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(lo.billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) AS dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty
           FROM line_open lo
          WHERE (lo.open_qty > (0)::numeric)
        ), line_packed_alloc AS (
         SELECT lda.so_id,
            lda.so_line_id,
            lda.so_number,
            lda.so_date,
            lda.client_code,
            lda.client_name,
            lda.sales_rep,
            lda.line_no,
            lda.division,
            lda.product_code,
            lda.product_name,
            lda.category,
            lda.order_qty,
            lda.unit,
            lda.rate,
            lda.order_value,
            lda.accounts_status,
            lda.business_status,
            lda.so_line_status,
            lda.closed_by,
            lda.artwork_no,
            lda.artwork_status,
            lda.artwork_at,
            lda.artwork_approved_at,
            lda.wo_count,
            lda.wo_numbers,
            lda.routing_count,
            lda.routing_status,
            lda.billing_status,
            lda.live_wo_count,
            lda.live_wo_numbers,
            lda.first_wo_date,
            lda.latest_wo_date,
            lda.packed_qty,
            lda.production_completed_qty,
            lda.last_packed_at,
            lda.dispatched_qty,
            lda.last_dispatch_date,
            lda.billed_qty,
            lda.last_invoice_date,
            lda.total_process_balance_qty,
            lda.open_stage_count,
            lda.open_qty,
            lda.unit_value,
            lda.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty,
            LEAST(GREATEST((lda.open_qty - lda.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty), (0)::numeric), GREATEST((COALESCE(lda.packed_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(lda.dispatched_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) AS packed_ready_wip_qty
           FROM line_dispatch_alloc lda
        ), line_packing_alloc AS (
         SELECT lpa.so_id,
            lpa.so_line_id,
            lpa.so_number,
            lpa.so_date,
            lpa.client_code,
            lpa.client_name,
            lpa.sales_rep,
            lpa.line_no,
            lpa.division,
            lpa.product_code,
            lpa.product_name,
            lpa.category,
            lpa.order_qty,
            lpa.unit,
            lpa.rate,
            lpa.order_value,
            lpa.accounts_status,
            lpa.business_status,
            lpa.so_line_status,
            lpa.closed_by,
            lpa.artwork_no,
            lpa.artwork_status,
            lpa.artwork_at,
            lpa.artwork_approved_at,
            lpa.wo_count,
            lpa.wo_numbers,
            lpa.routing_count,
            lpa.routing_status,
            lpa.billing_status,
            lpa.live_wo_count,
            lpa.live_wo_numbers,
            lpa.first_wo_date,
            lpa.latest_wo_date,
            lpa.packed_qty,
            lpa.production_completed_qty,
            lpa.last_packed_at,
            lpa.dispatched_qty,
            lpa.last_dispatch_date,
            lpa.billed_qty,
            lpa.last_invoice_date,
            lpa.total_process_balance_qty,
            lpa.open_stage_count,
            lpa.open_qty,
            lpa.unit_value,
            lpa.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty,
            lpa.packed_ready_wip_qty,
            LEAST(GREATEST(((lpa.open_qty - lpa.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty) - lpa.packed_ready_wip_qty), (0)::numeric), GREATEST((COALESCE(lpa.production_completed_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(lpa.packed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) AS packing_pending_wip_qty
           FROM line_packed_alloc lpa
        ), line_alloc AS (
         SELECT lpa.so_id,
            lpa.so_line_id,
            lpa.so_number,
            lpa.so_date,
            lpa.client_code,
            lpa.client_name,
            lpa.sales_rep,
            lpa.line_no,
            lpa.division,
            lpa.product_code,
            lpa.product_name,
            lpa.category,
            lpa.order_qty,
            lpa.unit,
            lpa.rate,
            lpa.order_value,
            lpa.accounts_status,
            lpa.business_status,
            lpa.so_line_status,
            lpa.closed_by,
            lpa.artwork_no,
            lpa.artwork_status,
            lpa.artwork_at,
            lpa.artwork_approved_at,
            lpa.wo_count,
            lpa.wo_numbers,
            lpa.routing_count,
            lpa.routing_status,
            lpa.billing_status,
            lpa.live_wo_count,
            lpa.live_wo_numbers,
            lpa.first_wo_date,
            lpa.latest_wo_date,
            lpa.packed_qty,
            lpa.production_completed_qty,
            lpa.last_packed_at,
            lpa.dispatched_qty,
            lpa.last_dispatch_date,
            lpa.billed_qty,
            lpa.last_invoice_date,
            lpa.total_process_balance_qty,
            lpa.open_stage_count,
            lpa.open_qty,
            lpa.unit_value,
            lpa.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty,
            lpa.packed_ready_wip_qty,
            lpa.packing_pending_wip_qty,
            GREATEST((((lpa.open_qty - lpa.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty) - lpa.packed_ready_wip_qty) - lpa.packing_pending_wip_qty), (0)::numeric) AS production_or_early_wip_qty
           FROM line_packing_alloc lpa
        ), base_output AS (
         SELECT la.so_id,
            la.so_line_id,
            la.so_number,
            la.so_date,
            la.client_code,
            la.client_name,
            la.sales_rep,
            la.line_no,
            la.division,
            la.product_code,
            la.product_name,
            la.category,
            la.order_qty,
            la.unit,
            la.rate,
            la.order_value,
            la.accounts_status,
            la.business_status,
            la.so_line_status,
            la.closed_by,
            la.artwork_no,
            la.artwork_status,
            la.artwork_at,
            la.artwork_approved_at,
            la.wo_count,
            la.wo_numbers,
            la.routing_count,
            la.routing_status,
            la.billing_status,
            la.live_wo_count,
            la.live_wo_numbers,
            la.first_wo_date,
            la.latest_wo_date,
            la.packed_qty,
            la.production_completed_qty,
            la.last_packed_at,
            la.dispatched_qty,
            la.last_dispatch_date,
            la.billed_qty,
            la.last_invoice_date,
            la.total_process_balance_qty,
            la.open_stage_count,
            la.open_qty,
            la.unit_value,
            la.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty,
            la.packed_ready_wip_qty,
            la.packing_pending_wip_qty,
            la.production_or_early_wip_qty,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(la.artwork_no, ''::text) = ''::text) AND (COALESCE(la.live_wo_count, (0)::bigint) = 0)) THEN 'ORDER'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(la.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text)) <> 'APPROVED'::text) THEN 'ARTWORK'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(la.live_wo_count, (0)::bigint) = 0) THEN 'WORK_ORDER'::text
                    ELSE 'WORK_ORDER'::text
                END AS early_stage_group,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(la.artwork_no, ''::text) = ''::text) AND (COALESCE(la.live_wo_count, (0)::bigint) = 0)) THEN 'Order Stage'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(la.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text)) <> 'APPROVED'::text) THEN 'Artwork Pending'::text
                    WHEN (COALESCE(la.live_wo_count, (0)::bigint) = 0) THEN 'Work Order Pending'::text
                    ELSE 'Routing / Production Pending'::text
                END AS early_stage_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(la.artwork_no, ''::text) = ''::text) AND (COALESCE(la.live_wo_count, (0)::bigint) = 0)) THEN 10
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(la.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text)) <> 'APPROVED'::text) THEN 20
                    WHEN (COALESCE(la.live_wo_count, (0)::bigint) = 0) THEN 30
                    ELSE 40
                END AS early_stage_sort
           FROM line_alloc la
        )
 SELECT bo.so_id,

UNION ALL
 SELECT bo.so_id,

    bo.packed_qty,
    bo.production_completed_qty,
    bo.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty,
    bo.packed_ready_wip_qty,
    bo.packing_pending_wip_qty,
    bo.production_or_early_wip_qty,
    bo.last_packed_at,
    bo.last_dispatch_date,
    bo.last_invoice_date
   FROM base_output bo
  WHERE (bo.packed_ready_wip_qty > (0)::numeric)
UNION ALL
 SELECT bo.so_id,
    bo.so_line_id,
    bo.so_number,
    bo.so_date,
    bo.client_code,
    bo.client_name,
    bo.sales_rep,

    bo.product_code,
    bo.product_name,
    bo.category,
    bo.order_qty,
    bo.unit,
    bo.rate,
    round(COALESCE(bo.order_value, (0)::numeric), 2) AS order_value,
    bo.accounts_status,
    bo.business_status,
    bo.so_line_status,
    bo.artwork_no,
    bo.artwork_status,
    bo.artwork_at,
    bo.artwork_approved_at,
    bo.live_wo_count AS wo_count,
    bo.live_wo_numbers AS wo_numbers,
    bo.first_wo_date,

    NULL::uuid AS routing_id,

    'Dispatch Done / Billing Pending'::text AS wip_stage_name,
    920 AS wip_stage_sort,
    round(bo.dispatch_unbilled_wip_qty, 3) AS wip_qty,

--
-- TOC entry 515 (class 1259 OID 130316)
-- Name: v_report_wip_stage_reconciliation; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_wip_stage_reconciliation AS
 SELECT so_line_id,
    so_number,
    line_no,
    max(client_name) AS client_name,
    max(division) AS division,
    max(product_code) AS product_code,
    max(product_name) AS product_name,
    max(order_qty) AS order_qty,
    max(order_value) AS order_value,
    max(billed_qty) AS billed_qty,
    max(open_qty) AS expected_open_qty,
    round(sum(COALESCE(wip_qty, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS allocated_wip_qty,
    round((max(open_qty) - sum(COALESCE(wip_qty, (0)::numeric))), 3) AS gap_qty,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN (max(order_qty) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((max(open_qty) * max(order_value)) / NULLIF(max(order_qty), (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2) AS expected_open_value,
    round(sum(COALESCE(wip_value, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS allocated_wip_value,
    round((
        CASE
            WHEN (max(order_qty) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((max(open_qty) * max(order_value)) / NULLIF(max(order_qty), (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END - sum(COALESCE(wip_value, (0)::numeric))), 2) AS gap_value,
    string_agg(DISTINCT wip_stage_name, ' | '::text ORDER BY wip_stage_name) AS allocated_stages
   FROM public.v_report_wip_stage_lines
  GROUP BY so_line_id, so_number, line_no;

-- TOC entry 514 (class 1259 OID 129734)
-- Name: v_report_wip_stage_summary; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_report_wip_stage_summary AS
 SELECT wip_stage_sort,
    wip_stage_group,
    wip_stage_name,
    count(DISTINCT so_line_id) AS so_line_count,
    count(DISTINCT so_number) AS so_count,
    round(sum(COALESCE(wip_qty, (0)::numeric)), 3) AS wip_qty,
    round(sum(COALESCE(wip_value, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS wip_value,
    min(so_date) AS oldest_so_date,
    max(so_date) AS latest_so_date
   FROM public.v_report_wip_stage_lines
  GROUP BY wip_stage_sort, wip_stage_group, wip_stage_name;

-- TOC entry 596 (class 1259 OID 191318)
-- Name: v_sales_dashboard_billing_lines; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_dashboard_billing_lines WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT il.id AS invoice_line_id,
    inv.id AS invoice_id,
    inv.invoice_no,
    inv.invoice_date,
    inv.created_at,
    inv.posted_at,
    upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) AS invoice_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['INVOICE'::text, 'CHALLAN'::text])) THEN upper(inv.document_type)
            WHEN (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) ~~ 'DC-H/%'::text) THEN 'CHALLAN'::text
            ELSE 'INVOICE'::text
        END AS document_type,
    COALESCE(inv.billing_mode, ''::text) AS billing_mode,
    COALESCE(il.source_mode, ''::text) AS source_mode,
    COALESCE(inv.client_code, so.client_code, 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS client_code,
    COALESCE(inv.client_name, c.client_name, inv.client_code, so.client_code, 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS client_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(so.sales_rep), ''::text), 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS sales_rep,
    COALESCE(il.so_id, sol.so_id) AS so_id,
    il.so_line_id,
    COALESCE(il.so_number, so.so_number, ''::text) AS so_number,
    COALESCE(il.line_no, sol.line_no) AS line_no,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(il.division), ''::text), NULLIF(btrim(sol.division), ''::text), 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS division,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(il.line_total, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((((COALESCE(il.taxable_amount, il.line_amount, (il.qty * il.rate), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(il.cgst_amt, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(il.sgst_amt, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(il.igst_amt, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS billed_value,
    COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty
   FROM ((((public.invoice_lines il
     JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.id = il.so_line_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = COALESCE(il.so_id, sol.so_id))))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = COALESCE(inv.client_code, so.client_code))))
  WHERE (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text);

-- TOC entry 600 (class 1259 OID 191338)
-- Name: v_sales_dashboard_activity_feed; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_dashboard_activity_feed WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH order_values AS (
         SELECT sales_order_lines.so_id,
            sum(COALESCE(NULLIF(sales_order_lines.line_total, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(sales_order_lines.total_amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((((COALESCE(NULLIF(sales_order_lines.net_amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((sales_order_lines.amount - COALESCE(sales_order_lines.disc_amount, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (sales_order_lines.qty * sales_order_lines.rate), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(sales_order_lines.cgst, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sales_order_lines.sgst, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sales_order_lines.igst, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), NULLIF((COALESCE(NULLIF(sales_order_lines.net_amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((sales_order_lines.amount - COALESCE(sales_order_lines.disc_amount, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (sales_order_lines.qty * sales_order_lines.rate), (0)::numeric) * ((1)::numeric + (COALESCE(sales_order_lines.gst_pct, (0)::numeric) / 100.0))), (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric)) AS order_value
           FROM public.sales_order_lines
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(sales_order_lines.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)
          GROUP BY sales_order_lines.so_id
        ), order_events AS (
         SELECT ('ORDER:'::text || (so.id)::text) AS event_id,
            (so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text) AS event_at,
            'ORDER'::text AS event_type,
            so.so_number AS reference_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(so.sales_rep), ''::text), 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS sales_rep,
            so.client_code,
            COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS client_name,
            COALESCE(ov.order_value, NULLIF(so.subtotal, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(so.grand_total, (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS event_value,
            'New order booked'::text AS headline
           FROM ((public.sales_orders so
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN order_values ov ON ((ov.so_id = so.id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text))
        ), dispatch_events AS (
         SELECT ('DISPATCH:'::text || (dr.id)::text) AS event_id,
            (dr.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text) AS event_at,
            'DISPATCH'::text AS event_type,
            COALESCE(dr.dispatch_no, dr.so_number) AS reference_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(so.sales_rep), ''::text), 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS sales_rep,
            so.client_code,
            COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS client_name,
            (COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric)) AS event_value,
            'Goods dispatched'::text AS headline
           FROM (((public.dispatch_records dr
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.id = dr.so_line_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = COALESCE(dr.so_id, sol.so_id))))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(dr.status, 'DISPATCHED'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text))
        ), invoice_events AS (
         SELECT ((('BILL:'::text || (bl.invoice_id)::text) || ':'::text) || bl.sales_rep) AS event_id,
            max(COALESCE(bl.posted_at, (bl.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))) AS event_at,
            'INVOICE'::text AS event_type,
            bl.invoice_no AS reference_no,
            bl.sales_rep,
            bl.client_code,
            bl.client_name,
            sum(bl.billed_value) AS event_value,
                CASE
                    WHEN (bl.document_type = 'CHALLAN'::text) THEN 'Challan posted'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(bl.billing_mode, ''::text)) = 'MANUAL'::text) THEN 'Manual bill posted'::text
                    ELSE 'Bill posted'::text
                END AS headline
           FROM public.v_sales_dashboard_billing_lines bl
          GROUP BY bl.invoice_id, bl.invoice_no, bl.document_type, bl.billing_mode, bl.sales_rep, bl.client_code, bl.client_name
        )
 SELECT order_events.event_id,
    order_events.event_at,
    order_events.event_type,
    order_events.reference_no,
    order_events.sales_rep,
    order_events.client_code,
    order_events.client_name,
    order_events.event_value,
    order_events.headline
   FROM order_events
UNION ALL
 SELECT dispatch_events.event_id,
    dispatch_events.event_at,
    dispatch_events.event_type,
    dispatch_events.reference_no,
    dispatch_events.sales_rep,
    dispatch_events.client_code,
    dispatch_events.client_name,
    dispatch_events.event_value,
    dispatch_events.headline
   FROM dispatch_events
UNION ALL
 SELECT invoice_events.event_id,
    invoice_events.event_at,
    invoice_events.event_type,
    invoice_events.reference_no,
    invoice_events.sales_rep,
    invoice_events.client_code,
    invoice_events.client_name,
    invoice_events.event_value,
    invoice_events.headline
   FROM invoice_events;

    so.status AS order_status,
    sol.status AS line_status,
    GREATEST((so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text), COALESCE(sol.status_updated_at, (so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))) AS last_activity_at
   FROM ((public.sales_orders so
