     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
  WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text));


--
-- TOC entry 595 (class 1259 OID 191313)
-- Name: v_sales_live_line_snapshot; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_live_line_snapshot WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH dispatch_agg AS (
         SELECT dr.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(dr.dispatch_qty, (0)::numeric)) AS dispatched_qty,
            max(dr.dispatch_date) AS last_dispatch_date,
            max(dr.created_at) AS last_dispatch_at
           FROM public.dispatch_records dr
          WHERE (upper(COALESCE(dr.status, 'DISPATCHED'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)
          GROUP BY dr.so_line_id
        ), billing_agg AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS billed_qty,
            sum(COALESCE(NULLIF(il.line_total, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((((COALESCE(il.taxable_amount, il.line_amount, (il.qty * il.rate), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(il.cgst_amt, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(il.sgst_amt, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(il.igst_amt, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric)) AS billed_value,
            max(inv.invoice_date) AS last_invoice_date,
            max(COALESCE(inv.posted_at, (inv.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))) AS last_billed_at
           FROM (public.invoice_lines il
             JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) <> 'CHALLAN'::text) AND (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) !~~ 'DC-H/%'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.billing_mode, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(il.source_mode, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL'::text))
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        ), line_base AS (
         SELECT so.id AS so_id,
            sol.id AS so_line_id,
            so.so_number,
            so.so_date,
            (so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text) AS order_created_at,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(so.sales_rep), ''::text), 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS sales_rep,
            so.client_code,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(c_1.client_name), ''::text), so.client_code, 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS client_name,
            sol.line_no,
            sol.product_code,
            sol.product_name,
            COALESCE(sol.division, ''::text) AS division,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.line_total, (0)::numeric), NULLIF(sol.total_amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((((COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.net_amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((sol.amount - COALESCE(sol.disc_amount, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (sol.qty * sol.rate), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(sol.cgst, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sol.sgst, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sol.igst, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), NULLIF((COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.net_amount, (0)::numeric), NULLIF((sol.amount - COALESCE(sol.disc_amount, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric), (sol.qty * sol.rate), (0)::numeric) * ((1)::numeric + (COALESCE(sol.gst_pct, (0)::numeric) / 100.0))), (0)::numeric), (0)::numeric) AS order_value,
            COALESCE(da.dispatched_qty, (0)::numeric) AS dispatched_qty,
            COALESCE(ba.billed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS billed_qty,
            COALESCE(ba.billed_value, (0)::numeric) AS billed_value,
            COALESCE(sol.final_delivery, sol.expected_delivery) AS due_date,
            so.status AS order_status,
            sol.status AS line_status,
            COALESCE(sol.closed_by, ''::text) AS closed_by,
            sol.closed_at,
            da.last_dispatch_date,
            ba.last_invoice_date,
            GREATEST((so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text), sol.status_updated_at, (da.last_dispatch_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text), ba.last_billed_at) AS last_activity_at
           FROM ((((public.sales_orders so
             JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON ((sol.so_id = so.id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c_1 ON ((c_1.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN dispatch_agg da ON ((da.so_line_id = sol.id)))
             LEFT JOIN billing_agg ba ON ((ba.so_line_id = sol.id)))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text))
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT lb.so_id,
            lb.so_line_id,
            lb.so_number,
            lb.so_date,
            lb.order_created_at,
            lb.sales_rep,
            lb.client_code,
            lb.client_name,
            lb.line_no,
            lb.product_code,
            lb.product_name,
            lb.division,
            lb.order_qty,
            lb.rate,
            lb.order_value,
            lb.dispatched_qty,
            lb.billed_qty,
            lb.billed_value,
            lb.due_date,
            lb.order_status,
            lb.line_status,
            lb.closed_by,
            lb.closed_at,
            lb.last_dispatch_date,
            lb.last_invoice_date,
            lb.last_activity_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(lb.order_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(lb.line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CANCELLED'::text)) THEN 'CANCELLED'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(lb.order_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CLOSED'::text) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
                    WHEN ((lb.order_qty > (0)::numeric) AND (lb.billed_qty >= lb.order_qty)) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(lb.line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(lb.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHORT%CLOSE%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(lb.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%SHORT_CLOSE%'::text)) THEN 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text
                    WHEN ((upper(COALESCE(lb.line_status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'CLOSED'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(lb.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%MANUAL CLOSE%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(lb.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%MANUAL BILLING%'::text) OR (upper(COALESCE(lb.closed_by, ''::text)) ~~ '%LEGACY%'::text)) THEN 'CLOSED'::text
                    ELSE 'OPEN'::text
                END AS closure_status
           FROM line_base lb
        )
 SELECT so_id,
    so_line_id,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    order_created_at,
    sales_rep,
    client_code,
    client_name,
    line_no,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    division,
    order_qty,
    rate,
    order_value,
    dispatched_qty,
    billed_qty,
    billed_value,
    due_date,
    order_status,
    line_status,
    closed_by,
    closed_at,
    last_dispatch_date,
    last_invoice_date,
    last_activity_at,
    closure_status,
    GREATEST((order_qty - dispatched_qty), (0)::numeric) AS dispatch_gap_qty,
    GREATEST((order_qty - billed_qty), (0)::numeric) AS billing_gap_qty,
    GREATEST((order_value - billed_value), (0)::numeric) AS billing_gap_value,
        CASE
            WHEN (closure_status = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text])) THEN (0)::numeric
            WHEN (order_qty > (0)::numeric) THEN (GREATEST((order_qty - billed_qty), (0)::numeric) * (order_value / order_qty))
            ELSE GREATEST((order_value - billed_value), (0)::numeric)
        END AS open_order_value,
        CASE
            WHEN (closure_status = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'SHORT_CLOSED'::text])) THEN (0)::numeric
            ELSE GREATEST((order_qty - billed_qty), (0)::numeric)
        END AS operational_open_qty,
        CASE
            WHEN ((due_date < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))::date) AND (closure_status = 'OPEN'::text)) THEN (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))::date - due_date)
            ELSE 0
        END AS overdue_days,
        CASE
            WHEN ((due_date < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))::date) AND (closure_status = 'OPEN'::text)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_overdue
   FROM classified c;

-- TOC entry 599 (class 1259 OID 191333)
-- Name: v_sales_dashboard_client_summary; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_dashboard_client_summary WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT d.today,
            (date_trunc('week'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone))::date AS week_start,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone))::date AS month_start,
            ((date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone) - '1 mon'::interval))::date AS prior_start,
            ((date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon'::interval))::date AS next_start,
            EXTRACT(day FROM d.today) AS month_day_no,
            EXTRACT(day FROM ((date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval))::date) AS month_days
           FROM ( SELECT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))::date AS today) d
        ), orders AS (
         SELECT s.client_code,
            s.client_name,
            string_agg(DISTINCT s.sales_rep, ', '::text ORDER BY s.sales_rep) AS sales_reps,
            sum(s.order_value) FILTER (WHERE (s.so_date = b_1.today)) AS order_value_today,
            sum(s.order_value) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.week_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS order_value_wtd,
            sum(s.order_value) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.month_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS order_value_mtd,
            sum(s.order_value) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.prior_start) AND (s.so_date < b_1.month_start))) AS order_value_prior_month,
            count(DISTINCT s.so_id) FILTER (WHERE (s.so_date = b_1.today)) AS orders_today,
            count(DISTINCT s.so_id) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.week_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS orders_wtd,
            count(DISTINCT s.so_id) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.month_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS orders_mtd,
            max(s.last_activity_at) AS last_activity_at
           FROM (public.v_sales_dashboard_order_lines s
             CROSS JOIN bounds b_1)
          GROUP BY s.client_code, s.client_name
        ), backlog AS (
         SELECT s.client_code,
            sum(s.open_order_value) FILTER (WHERE (s.operational_open_qty > (0)::numeric)) AS backlog_value,
            sum(s.open_order_value) FILTER (WHERE s.is_overdue) AS overdue_value,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.is_overdue) AS overdue_lines
           FROM public.v_sales_live_line_snapshot s
          GROUP BY s.client_code
        ), billing AS (
         SELECT bl_1.client_code,
            max(bl_1.client_name) AS client_name,
            string_agg(DISTINCT bl_1.sales_rep, ', '::text ORDER BY bl_1.sales_rep) AS sales_reps,
            sum(bl_1.billed_value) FILTER (WHERE (bl_1.invoice_date = b_1.today)) AS billing_value_today,
            sum(bl_1.billed_value) FILTER (WHERE ((bl_1.invoice_date >= b_1.week_start) AND (bl_1.invoice_date <= b_1.today))) AS billing_value_wtd,
            sum(bl_1.billed_value) FILTER (WHERE ((bl_1.invoice_date >= b_1.month_start) AND (bl_1.invoice_date <= b_1.today))) AS billing_value_mtd
           FROM (public.v_sales_dashboard_billing_lines bl_1
             CROSS JOIN bounds b_1)
          GROUP BY bl_1.client_code
        ), client_keys AS (
         SELECT orders.client_code
           FROM orders
        UNION
         SELECT backlog.client_code
           FROM backlog
        UNION
         SELECT billing.client_code
           FROM billing
        UNION
         SELECT sales_client_benchmarks.client_code
           FROM public.sales_client_benchmarks
          WHERE sales_client_benchmarks.active
        )
 SELECT ck.client_code,
    COALESCE(o.client_name, bl.client_name, cb.client_name, ck.client_code, 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS client_name,
    COALESCE(o.sales_reps, bl.sales_reps, ''::text) AS sales_reps,
    COALESCE(o.order_value_today, (0)::numeric) AS order_value_today,
    COALESCE(o.order_value_wtd, (0)::numeric) AS order_value_wtd,
    COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) AS order_value_mtd,
    COALESCE(o.order_value_prior_month, (0)::numeric) AS order_value_prior_month,
    COALESCE(bl.billing_value_today, (0)::numeric) AS billing_value_today,
    COALESCE(bl.billing_value_wtd, (0)::numeric) AS billing_value_wtd,
    COALESCE(bl.billing_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) AS billing_value_mtd,
    COALESCE(o.orders_today, (0)::bigint) AS orders_today,
    COALESCE(o.orders_wtd, (0)::bigint) AS orders_wtd,
    COALESCE(o.orders_mtd, (0)::bigint) AS orders_mtd,
    COALESCE(bg.backlog_value, (0)::numeric) AS backlog_value,
    COALESCE(bg.overdue_value, (0)::numeric) AS overdue_value,
    COALESCE(bg.overdue_lines, (0)::bigint) AS overdue_lines,
    COALESCE(cb.historical_max_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) AS historical_max_monthly_value,
    COALESCE(cb.historical_avg_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) AS historical_avg_monthly_value,
    cb.historical_top_rank,
    COALESCE(cb.baseline_period_label, ''::text) AS baseline_period_label,
    COALESCE(cb.decline_alert_pct, (25)::numeric) AS decline_alert_pct,
    COALESCE(cb.active, false) AS benchmark_active,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(cb.historical_avg_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric)) THEN round(((cb.historical_avg_monthly_value * b.month_day_no) / b.month_days), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS expected_mtd_value,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(cb.historical_avg_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric)) THEN GREATEST((round(((cb.historical_avg_monthly_value * b.month_day_no) / b.month_days), 2) - COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS expected_mtd_gap_value,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(cb.historical_avg_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_day_no > (0)::numeric)) THEN round(((COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) / b.month_day_no) * b.month_days), 2)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS projected_month_end_value,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(cb.historical_avg_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric) AND (((cb.historical_avg_monthly_value * b.month_day_no) / b.month_days) > (0)::numeric)) THEN round((((100)::numeric * COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric)) / ((cb.historical_avg_monthly_value * b.month_day_no) / b.month_days)), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS expected_mtd_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(cb.historical_avg_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_day_no > (0)::numeric)) THEN round((((100)::numeric * (((COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) / b.month_day_no) * b.month_days) - cb.historical_avg_monthly_value)) / cb.historical_avg_monthly_value), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS projected_vs_average_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(cb.historical_max_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_day_no > (0)::numeric)) THEN round((((100)::numeric * (((COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) / b.month_day_no) * b.month_days) - cb.historical_max_monthly_value)) / cb.historical_max_monthly_value), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS projected_vs_max_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(cb.historical_max_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) > cb.historical_max_monthly_value)) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS new_benchmark_flag,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(cb.historical_avg_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) < (((cb.historical_avg_monthly_value * b.month_day_no) / b.month_days) * ((1)::numeric - (COALESCE(cb.decline_alert_pct, (25)::numeric) / 100.0))))) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS running_average_decline_flag,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(cb.historical_avg_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((((100)::numeric * (COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) - cb.historical_avg_monthly_value)) / cb.historical_avg_monthly_value), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS vs_average_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(cb.historical_max_monthly_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN GREATEST((cb.historical_max_monthly_value - COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS benchmark_gap_value,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(o.order_value_prior_month, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((((100)::numeric * (COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) - o.order_value_prior_month)) / o.order_value_prior_month), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS order_growth_pct,
    o.last_activity_at
   FROM (((((client_keys ck
     LEFT JOIN orders o ON ((o.client_code = ck.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN backlog bg ON ((bg.client_code = ck.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN billing bl ON ((bl.client_code = ck.client_code)))
     CROSS JOIN bounds b)
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_client_benchmarks cb ON (((cb.client_code = ck.client_code) AND cb.active)));

-- TOC entry 598 (class 1259 OID 191328)
-- Name: v_sales_dashboard_rep_summary; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_dashboard_rep_summary WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT d.today,
            (date_trunc('week'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone))::date AS week_start,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone))::date AS month_start,
            ((date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone) - '1 mon'::interval))::date AS prior_start,
            ((date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon'::interval))::date AS next_start,
            EXTRACT(day FROM d.today) AS month_day_no,
            EXTRACT(day FROM ((date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval))::date) AS month_days,
            (((d.today - GREATEST((date_trunc('week'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone))::date, (date_trunc('month'::text, (d.today)::timestamp with time zone))::date)) + 1))::numeric AS week_elapsed_days
           FROM ( SELECT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text))::date AS today) d
        ), orders AS (
         SELECT s.sales_rep,
            sum(s.order_value) FILTER (WHERE (s.so_date = b_1.today)) AS order_value_today,
            sum(s.order_value) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.week_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS order_value_wtd,
            sum(s.order_value) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.month_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS order_value_mtd,
            sum(s.order_value) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.prior_start) AND (s.so_date < b_1.month_start))) AS order_value_prior_month,
            count(DISTINCT s.so_id) FILTER (WHERE (s.so_date = b_1.today)) AS orders_today,
            count(DISTINCT s.so_id) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.week_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS orders_wtd,
            count(DISTINCT s.so_id) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.month_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS orders_mtd,
            count(DISTINCT s.client_code) FILTER (WHERE (s.so_date = b_1.today)) AS active_clients_today,
            count(DISTINCT s.client_code) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.week_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS active_clients_wtd,
            count(DISTINCT s.client_code) FILTER (WHERE ((s.so_date >= b_1.month_start) AND (s.so_date <= b_1.today))) AS active_clients_mtd,
            max(s.last_activity_at) AS last_activity_at
           FROM (public.v_sales_dashboard_order_lines s
             CROSS JOIN bounds b_1)
          GROUP BY s.sales_rep
        ), backlog AS (
         SELECT s.sales_rep,
            sum(s.open_order_value) FILTER (WHERE (s.operational_open_qty > (0)::numeric)) AS backlog_value,
            sum(s.open_order_value) FILTER (WHERE s.is_overdue) AS overdue_value,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.is_overdue) AS overdue_lines
           FROM public.v_sales_live_line_snapshot s
          GROUP BY s.sales_rep
        ), billing AS (
         SELECT bl_1.sales_rep,
            sum(bl_1.billed_value) FILTER (WHERE (bl_1.invoice_date = b_1.today)) AS billing_value_today,
            sum(bl_1.billed_value) FILTER (WHERE ((bl_1.invoice_date >= b_1.week_start) AND (bl_1.invoice_date <= b_1.today))) AS billing_value_wtd,
            sum(bl_1.billed_value) FILTER (WHERE ((bl_1.invoice_date >= b_1.month_start) AND (bl_1.invoice_date <= b_1.today))) AS billing_value_mtd,
            sum(bl_1.billed_value) FILTER (WHERE ((bl_1.invoice_date >= b_1.prior_start) AND (bl_1.invoice_date < b_1.month_start))) AS billing_value_prior_month
           FROM (public.v_sales_dashboard_billing_lines bl_1
             CROSS JOIN bounds b_1)
          GROUP BY bl_1.sales_rep
        ), rep_keys AS (
         SELECT orders.sales_rep
           FROM orders
        UNION
         SELECT backlog.sales_rep
           FROM backlog
        UNION
         SELECT billing.sales_rep
           FROM billing
        UNION
         SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(t_1.sales_rep), ''::text), 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS "coalesce"
           FROM (public.sales_monthly_targets t_1
             CROSS JOIN bounds b_1)
          WHERE ((t_1.period_month = b_1.month_start) AND t_1.active)
        )
 SELECT rk.sales_rep,
    COALESCE(o.order_value_today, (0)::numeric) AS order_value_today,
    COALESCE(o.order_value_wtd, (0)::numeric) AS order_value_wtd,
    COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) AS order_value_mtd,
    COALESCE(o.order_value_prior_month, (0)::numeric) AS order_value_prior_month,
    COALESCE(bl.billing_value_today, (0)::numeric) AS billing_value_today,
    COALESCE(bl.billing_value_wtd, (0)::numeric) AS billing_value_wtd,
    COALESCE(bl.billing_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) AS billing_value_mtd,
    COALESCE(bl.billing_value_prior_month, (0)::numeric) AS billing_value_prior_month,
    COALESCE(o.orders_today, (0)::bigint) AS orders_today,
    COALESCE(o.orders_wtd, (0)::bigint) AS orders_wtd,
    COALESCE(o.orders_mtd, (0)::bigint) AS orders_mtd,
    COALESCE(o.active_clients_today, (0)::bigint) AS active_clients_today,
    COALESCE(o.active_clients_wtd, (0)::bigint) AS active_clients_wtd,
    COALESCE(o.active_clients_mtd, (0)::bigint) AS active_clients_mtd,
    COALESCE(bg.backlog_value, (0)::numeric) AS backlog_value,
    COALESCE(bg.overdue_value, (0)::numeric) AS overdue_value,
    COALESCE(bg.overdue_lines, (0)::bigint) AS overdue_lines,
    COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) AS order_target_value,
    COALESCE(t.billing_target_value, (0)::numeric) AS billing_target_value,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric)) THEN round((t.order_target_value / b.month_days), 2)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS daily_order_target_value,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric)) THEN round(((t.order_target_value / b.month_days) * b.week_elapsed_days), 2)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS wtd_order_target_value,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric)) THEN round(((t.order_target_value / b.month_days) * b.month_day_no), 2)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS mtd_run_rate_target_value,
    GREATEST((COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS order_target_deficit,
    GREATEST((COALESCE(t.billing_target_value, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(bl.billing_value_mtd, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS billing_target_deficit,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((((100)::numeric * COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric)) / t.order_target_value), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS order_target_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric)) THEN (COALESCE(o.order_value_today, (0)::numeric) >= (t.order_target_value / b.month_days))
            ELSE false
        END AS daily_order_target_hit,
        CASE
            WHEN ((COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (b.month_days > (0)::numeric)) THEN (COALESCE(o.order_value_wtd, (0)::numeric) >= ((t.order_target_value / b.month_days) * b.week_elapsed_days))
            ELSE false
        END AS wtd_order_target_hit,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(t.order_target_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN (COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) >= t.order_target_value)
            ELSE false
        END AS monthly_order_target_hit,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(t.billing_target_value, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((((100)::numeric * COALESCE(bl.billing_value_mtd, (0)::numeric)) / t.billing_target_value), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS billing_target_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(o.order_value_prior_month, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN round((((100)::numeric * (COALESCE(o.order_value_mtd, (0)::numeric) - o.order_value_prior_month)) / o.order_value_prior_month), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS order_growth_pct,
    o.last_activity_at
   FROM (((((rep_keys rk
     LEFT JOIN orders o ON ((o.sales_rep = rk.sales_rep)))
     LEFT JOIN backlog bg ON ((bg.sales_rep = rk.sales_rep)))
     LEFT JOIN billing bl ON ((bl.sales_rep = rk.sales_rep)))
     CROSS JOIN bounds b)
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_monthly_targets t ON (((t.period_month = b.month_start) AND (lower(btrim(t.sales_rep)) = lower(btrim(rk.sales_rep))) AND t.active)));


--
-- TOC entry 512 (class 1259 OID 129578)
-- Name: v_sales_order_advance_payment_clearance; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_order_advance_payment_clearance WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT so.id AS so_id,
    so.so_number,
    so.so_date,
    so.created_at AS so_created_at,
    so.client_code,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
    COALESCE(so.sales_rep, ''::text) AS sales_rep,
    (count(l.id))::integer AS line_count,
    (COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(l.qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,3) AS total_qty,
    string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(l.product_name, ''::text), NULLIF(l.product_code, ''::text), 'Item'::text), ' | '::text ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(l.product_name, ''::text), NULLIF(l.product_code, ''::text), 'Item'::text)) AS product_summary,
    string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(l.category, ''::text), 'Uncategorised'::text), ' | '::text ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(l.category, ''::text), 'Uncategorised'::text)) AS category_summary,
    string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(l.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text), ' | '::text ORDER BY COALESCE(l.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text)) AS accounts_status_summary,
    string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(l.business_status, 'PENDING'::text), ' | '::text ORDER BY COALESCE(l.business_status, 'PENDING'::text)) AS business_status_summary,
    COALESCE(so.advance_payment_required, false) AS advance_payment_required,
    COALESCE(so.advance_payment_received, false) AS advance_payment_received,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(so.advance_payment_required, false) AND COALESCE(so.advance_payment_received, false)) THEN 'PAYMENT_RECEIVED'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(so.advance_payment_required, false) THEN 'PAYMENT_PENDING'::text
            ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED'::text
        END AS advance_payment_status,
    lower(concat_ws(' '::text, COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text), COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text), COALESCE(so.sales_rep, ''::text), string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(l.product_name, ''::text), ' '::text), string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(l.product_code, ''::text), ' '::text), string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(l.category, ''::text), ' '::text),
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(so.advance_payment_received, false) THEN 'payment received'::text
            ELSE 'payment pending'::text
        END)) AS match_text
   FROM ((public.sales_orders so
     JOIN public.sales_order_lines l ON ((l.so_id = so.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
  WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(l.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (COALESCE(so.advance_payment_required, false) = true))
  GROUP BY so.id, so.so_number, so.so_date, so.created_at, so.client_code, c.client_name, so.sales_rep, so.advance_payment_required, so.advance_payment_received;


--
-- TOC entry 567 (class 1259 OID 173692)
-- Name: v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH posted_billing AS (
         SELECT il.so_line_id,
            (sum(COALESCE(il.qty, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(18,3) AS posted_billed_qty
           FROM (public.invoice_lines il
             JOIN public.invoices inv ON ((inv.id = il.invoice_id)))
          WHERE ((il.so_line_id IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.status, 'POSTED'::text)) = 'POSTED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(inv.document_type, 'INVOICE'::text)) <> 'CHALLAN'::text) AND (COALESCE(inv.invoice_no, ''::text) !~~ 'DC-H/%'::text))
          GROUP BY il.so_line_id
        )
 SELECT so.id AS so_id,
    l.id AS so_line_id,
    so.so_number,
    so.so_date,
    upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(so.client_code, ''::text))) AS client_code,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
    l.line_no,
    upper(COALESCE(l.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text)) AS accounts_status,
    upper(COALESCE(l.business_status, 'PENDING'::text)) AS business_status,
    (COALESCE(l.qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,3) AS order_qty,
    (COALESCE(pb.posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,3) AS posted_billed_qty,
    (GREATEST((COALESCE(l.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pb.posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,3) AS open_qty,
    (COALESCE(l.line_total, l.total_amount, l.net_amount, l.amount, (COALESCE(l.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS ordered_line_value,
    (round(
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(l.qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) THEN ((GREATEST((COALESCE(l.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(pb.posted_billed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l.line_total, l.total_amount, l.net_amount, l.amount, (COALESCE(l.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(l.rate, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)) / NULLIF(l.qty, (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END, 2))::numeric(18,2) AS open_line_value
   FROM (((public.sales_order_lines l
     JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = l.so_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN posted_billing pb ON ((pb.so_line_id = l.id)))
  WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(l.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (COALESCE(so.so_number, ''::text) !~* '^MB[/-]'::text));


--
-- TOC entry 568 (class 1259 OID 173697)
-- Name: v_sales_order_client_credit_exposure; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_order_client_credit_exposure WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 WITH pipeline AS (
         SELECT v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure.client_code,
            (round(sum(v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure.open_line_value), 2))::numeric(18,2) AS approved_pipeline_value
           FROM public.v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure
          WHERE ((v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure.accounts_status = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure.open_qty > (0)::numeric))
          GROUP BY v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure.client_code
        )
 SELECT upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM c.client_code)) AS client_code,
    c.client_name,
    s.credit_limit,
    s.current_balance,
    (COALESCE(p.approved_pipeline_value, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS approved_pipeline_value,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.current_balance IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (round((s.current_balance + COALESCE(p.approved_pipeline_value, (0)::numeric)), 2))::numeric(18,2)
        END AS total_exposure,
        CASE
            WHEN ((s.credit_limit IS NULL) OR (s.current_balance IS NULL)) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (round((s.credit_limit - (s.current_balance + COALESCE(p.approved_pipeline_value, (0)::numeric))), 2))::numeric(18,2)
        END AS available_credit,
    (s.client_code IS NOT NULL) AS has_credit_snapshot,
    s.synced_at AS credit_synced_at,
    s.synced_by AS credit_synced_by
   FROM ((public.clients c
     LEFT JOIN public.client_credit_snapshot s ON ((s.client_code = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM c.client_code)))))
     LEFT JOIN pipeline p ON ((p.client_code = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM c.client_code)))));

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_order_lines_for_approval WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT so.so_number,
    so.so_date,
    so.created_at AS so_created_at,
    so.client_code,
    c.client_name,
    so.sales_rep,
    l.line_no,
    l.product_name,
    l.category,
    l.qty,
    l.rate,
    l.accounts_status,
    l.accounts_at,
    l.business_status,
    l.business_at,
    so.sales_type,
    so.order_prefix,
    upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) AS header_status,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'OPEN'::text) AS line_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) THEN false
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(l.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) THEN false
            ELSE true
        END AS is_line_active,
    COALESCE(so.advance_payment_required, false) AS advance_payment_required,
    COALESCE(so.advance_payment_received, false) AS advance_payment_received,
    COALESCE(l.division, ''::text) AS division
   FROM ((public.sales_order_lines l
     JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = l.so_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
  WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(l.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (so.so_number !~* '^MB[/-]'::text));

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_order_approval_enriched WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT base.so_number,
    base.so_date,
    base.so_created_at,
    exposure.so_id,
    exposure.so_line_id,
    base.line_no,
    base.sales_rep,
    base.client_code,
    base.client_name,
    base.division,
    base.product_name,
    base.category,
    base.qty,
    base.rate,
    base.accounts_status,
    base.accounts_at,
    base.business_status,
    base.business_at,
    base.sales_type,
    base.order_prefix,
    base.header_status,
    base.line_status,
    base.is_line_active,
    base.advance_payment_required,
    base.advance_payment_received,
    (COALESCE(exposure.open_line_value, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS open_line_value,
    credit.credit_limit,
    credit.current_balance,
    (COALESCE(credit.approved_pipeline_value, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS approved_pipeline_value,
    credit.total_exposure,
    credit.available_credit,
    COALESCE(credit.has_credit_snapshot, false) AS has_credit_snapshot,
    credit.credit_synced_at,
    credit.credit_synced_by,
    COALESCE(approved_artwork.has_approved_artwork, false) AS has_approved_artwork,
    COALESCE(approved_artwork.approved_artwork_no, ''::text) AS approved_artwork_no
   FROM (((public.v_sales_order_lines_for_approval base
     LEFT JOIN public.v_sales_order_credit_line_exposure exposure ON (((exposure.so_number = base.so_number) AND (exposure.line_no = base.line_no))))
     LEFT JOIN public.v_sales_order_client_credit_exposure credit ON ((credit.client_code = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(base.client_code, ''::text))))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT true AS has_approved_artwork,
            NULLIF(btrim(a.artwork_no), ''::text) AS approved_artwork_no
           FROM public.artworks a
          WHERE ((a.so_id = exposure.so_id) AND (a.line_no = base.line_no) AND (upper(COALESCE(a.status, ''::text)) = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim(a.artwork_no), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))
          ORDER BY a.approved_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) approved_artwork ON (true));

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_order_line_details WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT sol.id,
    sol.so_id,
    so.so_number,
    so.so_date,
    sol.line_no,
    sol.product_code,
    sol.product_name,
    sol.category,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.hsn_group, ''::text), i.hsn_group, ''::text) AS hsn_group,
    COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) AS qty,
    COALESCE(sol.unit, ''::text) AS unit,
    COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric) AS rate,
    COALESCE(sol.gst_pct, (0)::numeric) AS gst_pct,
    COALESCE(sol.disc_pct, (0)::numeric) AS disc_pct,
    COALESCE(sol.amount, (COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric))) AS amount,
    COALESCE(sol.disc_amount, (0)::numeric) AS disc_amount,
    COALESCE(sol.cgst, (0)::numeric) AS cgst,
    COALESCE(sol.sgst, (0)::numeric) AS sgst,
    COALESCE(sol.igst, (0)::numeric) AS igst,
    COALESCE(sol.line_total, ((((COALESCE(sol.amount, (COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) * COALESCE(sol.rate, (0)::numeric))) - COALESCE(sol.disc_amount, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sol.cgst, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sol.sgst, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sol.igst, (0)::numeric))) AS line_total,
    COALESCE(sol.job_type, ''::text) AS job_type,
    COALESCE(sol.job_reference, ''::text) AS job_reference,
    COALESCE(sol.job_priority, ''::text) AS job_priority,
    COALESCE(sol.division, ''::text) AS division,
    COALESCE(sol.quote_no, ''::text) AS quote_no,
    COALESCE(sol.pm_code, ''::text) AS pm_code,
    sol.expected_delivery,
    sol.final_delivery,
    COALESCE(sol.prepress_remarks, ''::text) AS prepress_remarks,
    COALESCE(sol.product_remarks, ''::text) AS product_remarks,
    COALESCE(sol.accounts_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS accounts_status,
    COALESCE(sol.business_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS business_status,
    COALESCE(src.wo_status, 'PENDING'::text) AS wo_status,
    COALESCE(sol.final_delivery, sol.expected_delivery) AS delivery_display,
    concat_ws(' | '::text, NULLIF(sol.product_remarks, ''::text), NULLIF(sol.prepress_remarks, ''::text)) AS remarks_display,
    so.order_prefix,
    so.client_code,
    c.id AS client_id,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, ''::text) AS client_name,
    COALESCE(c.state, ''::text) AS client_state,
    COALESCE(c.gstin, ''::text) AS client_gstin,
    COALESCE(c.bill_to_address, ''::text) AS client_bill_to_address,
    COALESCE(c.bill_to_city, ''::text) AS client_bill_to_city,
    COALESCE(c.bill_to_state, ''::text) AS client_bill_to_state,
    COALESCE(c.bill_to_pincode, ''::text) AS client_bill_to_pincode,
    COALESCE(c.ship_to_address, ''::text) AS client_ship_to_address,
    COALESCE(c.ship_to_city, ''::text) AS client_ship_to_city,
    COALESCE(c.ship_to_state, ''::text) AS client_ship_to_state,
    COALESCE(c.ship_to_pincode, ''::text) AS client_ship_to_pincode,
    upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) AS status,
    COALESCE(src.line_count, 0) AS line_count,
    COALESCE(src.total_qty, (0)::numeric) AS total_qty,
    src.latest_delivery,
    COALESCE(src.is_approval_hold, false) AS is_approval_hold,
    COALESCE(src.can_edit, (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)) AS can_edit,
    COALESCE(src.can_hold, (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)) AS can_hold,
    COALESCE(src.can_cancel, (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)) AS can_cancel,
    COALESCE(src.hold_target,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'HOLD'::text) THEN 'OPEN'::text
            ELSE 'HOLD'::text
        END) AS hold_target,
    COALESCE(src.hold_label,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'HOLD'::text) THEN 'Reopen'::text
            ELSE 'Hold'::text
        END) AS hold_label
   FROM ((((public.sales_order_lines sol
     JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = sol.so_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN public.items i ON ((i.item_code = sol.product_code)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_rollup_cache src ON ((src.so_id = (so.id)::text)));

CREATE VIEW public.v_sales_orders_list_fast WITH (security_invoker='on') AS
 SELECT so.id,
    so.so_number,

    so.order_prefix,
    so.client_code,
    COALESCE(c.client_name, ''::text) AS client_name,
    btrim(concat_ws(' '::text, COALESCE(so.client_code, ''::text), COALESCE(c.client_name, ''::text))) AS client_search_text,
    so.sales_rep,
    so.po_number,
    so.sales_type,
    so.currency,
    so.subtotal,
    so.discount_total,
    so.cgst_total,
    so.sgst_total,
    so.igst_total,
    so.grand_total,
    so.remarks,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(so.mode_of_transport, ''::text), ''::text) AS mode_of_transport,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(so.transport_preference, ''::text), ''::text) AS transport_preference,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(so.transport_payment, ''::text), ''::text) AS transport_payment,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(so.billing_remarks, ''::text), ''::text) AS billing_remarks,
    COALESCE(src.accounts_status, NULLIF(upper(COALESCE(so.accounts_approved, ''::text)), ''::text), 'PENDING'::text) AS accounts_status,
    COALESCE(src.business_status, NULLIF(upper(COALESCE(so.business_approved, ''::text)), ''::text), 'PENDING'::text) AS business_status,
    upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) AS status,
    COALESCE(src.wo_status, NULLIF(upper(COALESCE(so.wo_status, ''::text)), ''::text), 'PENDING'::text) AS wo_status,
    COALESCE(src.line_count, 0) AS line_count,
    COALESCE(src.total_qty, (0)::numeric) AS total_qty,
    src.latest_delivery,
    COALESCE(src.is_approval_hold, false) AS is_approval_hold,
    COALESCE(src.can_edit, (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)) AS can_edit,
    COALESCE(src.can_hold, (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)) AS can_hold,
    COALESCE(src.can_cancel, (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text)) AS can_cancel,
    COALESCE(src.hold_target,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'HOLD'::text) THEN 'OPEN'::text
            ELSE 'HOLD'::text
        END) AS hold_target,
    COALESCE(src.hold_label,
        CASE
            WHEN (upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) = 'HOLD'::text) THEN 'Reopen'::text
            ELSE 'Hold'::text
        END) AS hold_label
   FROM ((public.sales_orders so
     LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
     LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_rollup_cache src ON ((src.so_id = (so.id)::text)));

-- TOC entry 546 (class 1259 OID 160154)
-- Name: v_standard_processed_work_orders; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -

CREATE VIEW public.v_standard_processed_work_orders AS
 WITH latest_artwork AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.so_id, (a.line_no)::text) a.so_id,
            (a.line_no)::text AS line_no_key,
            a.artwork_no,
            a.product_type,
            a.sheet_length,
            a.sheet_width,
            a.sheet_ups,
            a.printing_colors,
            a.across_ups,
            a.along_ups,
            a.total_ups,
            a.across_width,
            a.teeth,
            a.across_gap_mm,
            a.along_gap_mm,
            COALESCE(a.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric) AS stock_qty_to_bill,
            upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(a.status, ''::text), 'PENDING'::text)) AS artwork_status,
            a.approved_at
           FROM public.artworks a
          ORDER BY a.so_id, (a.line_no)::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(a.artwork_no, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END, a.approved_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.artwork_at DESC NULLS LAST, a.id DESC
        ), standard_wo_jobs AS (
         SELECT wo.id AS wo_id,
            wo.wo_number,
            wo.wo_date,
            woj.so_number,
            (woj.line_no)::text AS line_no_key,
            woj.product_name AS woj_product_name,
            COALESCE(woj.qty, (0)::numeric) AS job_qty,
            woj.unit,
            woj.category AS woj_category,
            woj.sales_rep AS woj_sales_rep,
            woj.so_date AS woj_so_date,
            woj.artwork_no AS woj_artwork_no,
            woj.client_name AS woj_client_name,
            woj.expected_delivery AS woj_expected_delivery,
            woj.po_number AS woj_po_number,
            woj.job_priority AS woj_job_priority,
            woj.product_remarks AS woj_product_remarks,
            woj.so_remarks AS woj_so_remarks,
            woj.job_reference AS woj_job_reference,
            woj.prepress_remark AS woj_prepress_remark
           FROM (public.work_order_jobs woj
             JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
          WHERE ((COALESCE(woj.qty, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (NOT ((upper(COALESCE((wo.snapshot_json #>> '{jobDetails,type}'::text[]), ''::text)) = 'FLEXO'::text) OR (COALESCE(wo.snapshot_json, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'flexoDetails'::text))))
        ), line_processed_totals AS (
         SELECT swj.so_number,
            swj.line_no_key,
            sum(swj.job_qty) AS processed_total_qty,
            string_agg(DISTINCT swj.wo_number, ', '::text ORDER BY swj.wo_number) AS wo_list
           FROM standard_wo_jobs swj
          GROUP BY swj.so_number, swj.line_no_key
        ), base AS (
         SELECT swj.wo_id,
            swj.wo_number,
            swj.wo_number AS wo_no,
            swj.wo_date,
            ''::text AS wo_time,
            COALESCE(to_char((swj.wo_date)::timestamp without time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text), ''::text) AS wo_date_time,
            swj.so_number,
            COALESCE(so.so_date, swj.woj_so_date) AS so_date,
            COALESCE(to_char((so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text), 'HH24:MI'::text), ''::text) AS so_time,
            btrim(concat_ws(' '::text, COALESCE((COALESCE(so.so_date, swj.woj_so_date))::text, ''::text), COALESCE(to_char((so.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'::text), 'HH24:MI'::text), ''::text))) AS so_date_time,
            COALESCE(swj.woj_sales_rep, so.sales_rep, ''::text) AS sales_rep,
            COALESCE(so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_code,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_client_name, ''::text), c.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            swj.line_no_key AS line_no,
            COALESCE(sol.product_code, ''::text) AS product_code,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_product_name, ''::text), sol.product_name, ''::text) AS product_name,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_category, ''::text), sol.category, ''::text) AS category,
            COALESCE(sol.qty, swj.job_qty, (0)::numeric) AS order_qty,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.unit, ''::text), sol.unit, ''::text) AS unit,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_po_number, ''::text), so.po_number, ''::text) AS po_number,
            COALESCE(swj.woj_expected_delivery, sol.expected_delivery) AS expected_delivery,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_job_priority, ''::text), sol.job_priority, ''::text) AS job_priority,
            COALESCE(sol.job_type, ''::text) AS job_type,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_so_remarks, ''::text), so.remarks, ''::text) AS so_remarks,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_product_remarks, ''::text), sol.product_remarks, ''::text) AS product_remarks,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_prepress_remark, ''::text), sol.prepress_remarks, ''::text) AS prepress_remark,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_job_reference, ''::text), sol.job_reference, ''::text) AS job_reference,
            upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.accounts_status, ''::text), 'PENDING'::text)) AS accounts_status,
            upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.business_status, ''::text), 'PENDING'::text)) AS business_status,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_artwork_no, ''::text), la.artwork_no, ''::text) AS artwork_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(la.product_type, ''::text),
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(swj.woj_category, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'Corrugated'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(swj.woj_category, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'Digital'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(swj.woj_category, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(swj.woj_category, ''::text), sol.category, ''::text)
                END) AS product_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(la.product_type, ''::text), swj.woj_category, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(la.product_type, ''::text), swj.woj_category, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(la.product_type, ''::text), swj.woj_category, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(la.product_type, ''::text), swj.woj_category, sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(swj.woj_category, sol.category, ''::text))
                END AS department_category,
            la.sheet_length,
            la.sheet_width,
            la.sheet_ups,
            la.printing_colors,
            la.across_ups,
            la.along_ups,
            la.total_ups,
            la.across_width,
            la.teeth,
            la.across_gap_mm,
            la.along_gap_mm,
            COALESCE(la.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric) AS stock_qty_to_bill,
            COALESCE(la.artwork_status, 'NO_ART'::text) AS artwork_status,
            la.approved_at AS artwork_approved_at,
            swj.job_qty AS processed_qty,
            COALESCE(lpt.processed_total_qty, swj.job_qty) AS processed_total_qty,
            COALESCE(lpt.wo_list, swj.wo_number) AS all_wo_list
           FROM (((((standard_wo_jobs swj
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.so_number = swj.so_number)))
             LEFT JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = so.id) AND ((sol.line_no)::text = swj.line_no_key))))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN latest_artwork la ON (((la.so_id = so.id) AND (la.line_no_key = swj.line_no_key))))
             LEFT JOIN line_processed_totals lpt ON (((lpt.so_number = swj.so_number) AND (lpt.line_no_key = swj.line_no_key))))
        )
 SELECT wo_id,
    wo_number,
    wo_no,
    wo_date,
    wo_time,
    wo_date_time,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    so_time,
    so_date_time,
    sales_rep,
    client_code,
    client_name,
    line_no,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    category,
    department_category,
    product_type,
    processed_qty AS qty,
    order_qty,
    stock_qty_to_bill,
    GREATEST((GREATEST((COALESCE(order_qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(processed_total_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS remaining_qty,
    processed_qty,
    unit,
    po_number,
    expected_delivery,
    job_priority,
    job_type,
    so_remarks,
    product_remarks,
    prepress_remark,
    job_reference,
    accounts_status,
    business_status,
    artwork_no,
    sheet_length,
    sheet_width,
    sheet_ups,
    printing_colors,
    across_ups,
    along_ups,
    total_ups,
    across_width,
    teeth,
    across_gap_mm,
    along_gap_mm,
    artwork_status,
    artwork_approved_at,
        CASE
            WHEN ((accounts_status = 'REJECTED'::text) OR (business_status = 'REJECTED'::text) OR (artwork_status = 'REJECTED'::text)) THEN 'Rejected'::text
            WHEN ((accounts_status <> 'APPROVED'::text) OR (business_status <> 'APPROVED'::text) OR (artwork_status <> 'APPROVED'::text)) THEN 'Pending'::text
            ELSE 'Approved'::text
        END AS approval_stage
   FROM base
  WHERE (department_category !~~ '%FLEXO%'::text);

--
-- TOC entry 454 (class 1259 OID 97394)
-- Name: v_workorder_candidates; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_workorder_candidates AS
 WITH service_only_items AS (
         SELECT v.item_code,
            v.item_name,
            v.category
           FROM ( VALUES ('SLC001'::text,'FLEXO PRINTING PLATE'::text,'FLEXO PRINTING PLATE'::text), ('SLC002'::text,'OFFSET PRINTING PLATE'::text,'OFFSET PRINTING PLATE'::text), ('SLC003'::text,'DIE'::text,'DIE'::text)) v(item_code, item_name, category)
        ), artwork_ranked AS (
         SELECT a.so_id,
            a.line_no,
            a.artwork_no,
            a.product_type,
            a.sheet_length,
            a.sheet_width,
            a.sheet_ups,
            a.printing_colors,
            a.across_ups,
            a.along_ups,
            a.total_ups,
            a.across_width,
            a.teeth,
            a.across_gap_mm,
            a.along_gap_mm,
            COALESCE(a.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric) AS stock_qty_to_bill,
            a.status,
            a.approved_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.so_id, a.line_no ORDER BY COALESCE(a.approved_at, a.artwork_at) DESC NULLS LAST, a.id DESC) AS rn
           FROM public.artworks a
        ), artwork_pick AS (
         SELECT artwork_ranked.so_id,
            artwork_ranked.line_no,
            artwork_ranked.artwork_no,
            artwork_ranked.product_type,
            artwork_ranked.sheet_length,
            artwork_ranked.sheet_width,
            artwork_ranked.sheet_ups,
            artwork_ranked.printing_colors,
            artwork_ranked.across_ups,
            artwork_ranked.along_ups,
            artwork_ranked.total_ups,
            artwork_ranked.across_width,
            artwork_ranked.teeth,
            artwork_ranked.across_gap_mm,
            artwork_ranked.along_gap_mm,
            artwork_ranked.stock_qty_to_bill,
            artwork_ranked.status,
            artwork_ranked.approved_at,
            artwork_ranked.rn
           FROM artwork_ranked
          WHERE (artwork_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), wo_totals AS (
         SELECT woj.so_number,
            woj.line_no,
            sum(COALESCE(woj.qty, (0)::numeric)) AS processed_qty,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(wo.wo_number, ''::text), ', '::text ORDER BY NULLIF(wo.wo_number, ''::text)) AS wo_list
           FROM (public.work_order_jobs woj
             LEFT JOIN public.work_orders wo ON ((wo.id = woj.wo_id)))
          GROUP BY woj.so_number, woj.line_no
        ), base AS (
         SELECT so.id AS so_id,
            sol.id AS so_line_id,
            so.so_number,
            so.so_date,
            so.created_at AS so_created_at,
            to_char(COALESCE(so.created_at, (so.so_date)::timestamp without time zone), 'HH24:MI'::text) AS so_time,
            so.sales_rep,
            so.client_code,
            COALESCE(c.client_name, so.client_code, ''::text) AS client_name,
            sol.line_no,
            sol.product_code,
            sol.product_name,
            sol.category,
            sol.qty,
            sol.unit,
            so.po_number,
            sol.expected_delivery,
            sol.job_priority,
            sol.job_type,
            so.remarks AS so_remarks,
            sol.product_remarks,
            sol.prepress_remarks AS prepress_remark,
            sol.job_reference,
            upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.accounts_status, ''::text), 'PENDING'::text)) AS accounts_status,
            upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(sol.business_status, ''::text), 'PENDING'::text)) AS business_status,
            ap.artwork_no,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.product_type, ''::text),
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'Flexo'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'Corrugated'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'Digital'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'Offset'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END) AS product_type,
            ap.sheet_length,
            ap.sheet_width,
            ap.sheet_ups,
            ap.printing_colors,
                CASE
                    WHEN (ap.so_id IS NULL) THEN 'NO_ART'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.status, ''::text), 'PENDING'::text))
                END AS artwork_status,
            ap.approved_at AS artwork_approved_at,
            COALESCE(wt.processed_qty, (0)::numeric) AS processed_qty,
            GREATEST((GREATEST((COALESCE(sol.qty, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(ap.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(wt.processed_qty, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric) AS remaining_qty,
            COALESCE(wt.wo_list, ''::text) AS wo_list,
                CASE
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.product_type, ''::text), sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%FLEXO%'::text) THEN 'FLEXO'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.product_type, ''::text), sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%CORR%'::text) THEN 'CORRUGATION'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.product_type, ''::text), sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%DIGITAL%'::text) THEN 'DIGITAL'::text
                    WHEN (upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.product_type, ''::text), sol.category, ''::text)) ~~ '%OFFSET%'::text) THEN 'OFFSET'::text
                    ELSE upper(COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text))
                END AS department_category,
            COALESCE(ap.stock_qty_to_bill, (0)::numeric) AS stock_qty_to_bill,
            ap.across_ups,
            ap.along_ups,
            ap.total_ups,
            ap.across_width,
            ap.teeth,
            ap.across_gap_mm,
            ap.along_gap_mm,
            COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text) AS sales_type,
            COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text) AS order_prefix
           FROM ((((public.sales_order_lines sol
             JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.id = sol.so_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.clients c ON ((c.client_code = so.client_code)))
             LEFT JOIN artwork_pick ap ON (((ap.so_id = sol.so_id) AND (ap.line_no = sol.line_no))))
             LEFT JOIN wo_totals wt ON (((wt.so_number = so.so_number) AND (wt.line_no = sol.line_no))))
          WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CANCELLED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.sales_type, ''::text)) <> 'MANUAL_BILLING'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(so.order_prefix, ''::text)) <> 'MB'::text) AND (so.so_number !~* '^MB[/-]'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM service_only_items s
                  WHERE ((s.item_code = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(sol.product_code, ''::text)))) OR (s.item_name = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(sol.product_name, ''::text)))) OR (s.category = upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(sol.category, ''::text)))))))))
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT b.so_id,
            b.so_line_id,
            b.so_number,
            b.so_date,
            b.so_created_at,
            b.so_time,
            b.sales_rep,
            b.client_code,
            b.client_name,
            b.line_no,
            b.product_code,
            b.product_name,
            b.category,
            b.qty,
            b.unit,
            b.po_number,
            b.expected_delivery,
            b.job_priority,
            b.job_type,
            b.so_remarks,
            b.product_remarks,
            b.prepress_remark,
            b.job_reference,
            b.accounts_status,
            b.business_status,
            b.artwork_no,
            b.product_type,
            b.sheet_length,
            b.sheet_width,
            b.sheet_ups,
            b.printing_colors,
            b.artwork_status,
            b.artwork_approved_at,
            b.processed_qty,
            b.remaining_qty,
            b.wo_list,
            b.department_category,
            b.stock_qty_to_bill,
            b.across_ups,
            b.along_ups,
            b.total_ups,
            b.across_width,
            b.teeth,
            b.across_gap_mm,
            b.along_gap_mm,
            b.sales_type,
            b.order_prefix,
            concat_ws(' / '::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.accounts_status = 'REJECTED'::text) THEN 'Accounts'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.business_status = 'REJECTED'::text) THEN 'Business'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.artwork_status = 'REJECTED'::text) THEN 'Artwork'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS rejected_stage_list,
            concat_ws(' / '::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.accounts_status <> 'APPROVED'::text) THEN 'Accounts'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.business_status <> 'APPROVED'::text) THEN 'Business'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.artwork_status <> 'APPROVED'::text) THEN 'Artwork'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS pending_stage_list
           FROM base b
          WHERE (b.department_category !~~ '%FLEXO%'::text)
        )
 SELECT so_id,
    so_line_id,
    so_number,
    so_date,
    so_created_at,
    so_time,
    sales_rep,
    client_code,
    client_name,
    line_no,
    product_code,
    product_name,
    category,
    department_category,
    qty,
    unit,
    po_number,
    expected_delivery,
    job_priority,
    job_type,
    so_remarks,
    product_remarks,
    prepress_remark,
    job_reference,
    accounts_status,
    business_status,
    artwork_no,
    product_type,
    sheet_length,
    sheet_width,
    sheet_ups,
    printing_colors,
    artwork_status,
    artwork_approved_at,
    processed_qty,
    remaining_qty,
    wo_list,
        CASE
            WHEN (rejected_stage_list <> ''::text) THEN ('Rejected at '::text || rejected_stage_list)
            WHEN (pending_stage_list <> ''::text) THEN ('Pending at '::text || pending_stage_list)
            ELSE 'Approved'::text
        END AS approval_stage,
    ((rejected_stage_list = ''::text) AND (pending_stage_list = ''::text)) AS can_create_wo,
    stock_qty_to_bill,
    across_ups,
    along_ups,
    total_ups,
    across_width,
    teeth,
    across_gap_mm,
    along_gap_mm,
    sales_type,
    order_prefix
   FROM scored;


--
-- TOC entry 464 (class 1259 OID 107548)
-- Name: v_workorder_candidates_active; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: -
--

CREATE VIEW public.v_workorder_candidates_active AS
 SELECT wc.so_id,
    wc.so_line_id,
    wc.so_number,
    wc.so_date,
    wc.so_created_at,
    wc.so_time,
    wc.sales_rep,
    wc.client_code,
    wc.client_name,
    wc.line_no,
    wc.product_code,
    wc.product_name,
    wc.category,
    wc.department_category,
    wc.qty,
    wc.unit,
    wc.po_number,
    wc.expected_delivery,
    wc.job_priority,
    wc.job_type,
    wc.so_remarks,
    wc.product_remarks,
    wc.prepress_remark,
    wc.job_reference,
    wc.accounts_status,
    wc.business_status,
    wc.artwork_no,
    wc.product_type,
    wc.sheet_length,
    wc.sheet_width,
    wc.sheet_ups,
    wc.printing_colors,
    wc.artwork_status,
    wc.artwork_approved_at,
    wc.processed_qty,
    wc.remaining_qty,
    wc.wo_list,
    wc.approval_stage,
    wc.can_create_wo,
    wc.stock_qty_to_bill,
    wc.across_ups,
    wc.along_ups,
    wc.total_ups,
    wc.across_width,
    wc.teeth,
    wc.across_gap_mm,
    wc.along_gap_mm,
    wc.sales_type,
    wc.order_prefix
   FROM ((public.v_workorder_candidates wc
     JOIN public.sales_orders so ON ((so.so_number = wc.so_number)))
     JOIN public.sales_order_lines sol ON (((sol.so_id = so.id) AND ((sol.line_no)::text = (wc.line_no)::text))))
  WHERE ((upper(COALESCE(so.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (upper(COALESCE(sol.status, 'OPEN'::text)) <> ALL (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text])));
